Storm of Grinding Iron.name: Storm of Grinding Iron
Storm of Grinding Iron.components: V, S, M (handful of metal shards)
Storm of Grinding Iron.description:
Class(es):sorcerer,warlock,wizard

You create a storm that occupies a sphere centered on a point you choose upon casting, where it remains for the duration. You must choose to make the sphere’s radius 5, 10, 15, 20, or 25 feet when you cast the spell.

The area within the sphere isdifficult terrainand lightly obscured, and creatures aredeafenedwhile within the area. When a creature enters the area for the first time ona turn or starts its turn there, it must make aConstitutionsaving throw. On a failure, it suffers an amount of necrotic damage and slashing damage, or half as much damage ona success. The amount of necrotic and slashing damage is determined by the storm’s radius.

At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the necrotic and slashing damage increase by 1d4 each for each spell slot level above 4th.

This is not the complete license attribution -see the full license for this page

Hedgehog Dozen.name: Hedgehog Dozen
Hedgehog Dozen.description:
Eleven illusory duplicates of the touched creature appear in its space. A creature affected by hedgehog dozen seems to have a dozen arms, shields, and weapons-a swarm of partially overlapping, identical creatures.

Until the spell ends, these duplicates move with the target and mimic its actions, shifting position so it’s impossible to track which image is real. You can use your action to dismiss the illusory duplicates.

While surrounded by duplicates, a creature gains advantage against any opponent because of the bewildering number of weapons and movements.

Each time a creature targets you with an attack during the spell’s duration, roll a d8 to determine whether theattackinstead targets one of your duplicates. On a roll of 1, it strikes you. On any other roll it removes one of your duplicates; when you have only five duplicates remaining, the spell ends.

A creature is unaffected by this spell if it can’t see, if it relies on senses other than sight, such as blindsight, or if it can perceive illusions as false as with truesight.

Warlock Grimoire 2. Authors: Wolfgang Baur, Celeste Conowitch, David “Zeb” Cook, Dan Dillon, Robert Fairbanks, Scott Gable, Richard Green, Victoria Jaczko, TK Johnson, Christopher Lockey, Sarah Madsen, Greg Marks, Ben McFarland, Kelly Pawlik, Lysa Penrose, Richard Pett, Marc Radle, Hannah Rose, Jon Sawatsky, Robert Schwalb, Brian Suskind, Ashley Warren, Mike Welham. © 2020 Open Design LLC.

Devouring Worms.name: Devouring Worms
Devouring Worms.description:
You target a creature you can see within range. A dozen tiny gray worms appear on the target and attempt to devour it. The target must succeed on aConstitutionsaving throw or take 1 necrotic damage as the worms feed on its flesh. When the worms feed, they quickly reproduce, doubling the number of worms consuming the target each round. At the start of the caster’s next turn, the target must make anotherConstitutionsaving throw or take 2 points of necrotic damage. At the start of the caster’s third turn, the damage doubles to 4. On the caster’s fourth turn, the damage increases to 8, on the fifth turn to 16, and on the sixth turn to 32. The target makes aConstitutionsaving throw each round, avoiding additional damage and ending the spell on a success. If the target takes fire damage, it has advantage on its nextConstitutionsaving throw.

Tome of Spell Mastery, © 2024, Necromancer Games; Author: Frog God Games.

Repulsing Wall.name: Repulsing Wall
Repulsing Wall.description:
You create a shimmering wall of light on a solid surface within range. You can make the wall up to 60 feet long, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick, or a ringed wall up to 20 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 1 foot thick. The wall is translucent, and creatures have disadvantage onWisdom(Perception) checks to look through the wall.

One side of the wall, selected by you when you cast this spell, deals 5d8 radiant damage when a creature enters the wall for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there. A creature attempting to pass through the wall must make aStrengthsaving throw. On a failed save, a creature is pushed 10 feet away from the wall and fallsprone. A creature that is undead, a fiend, or vulnerable to radiant damage has disadvantage on this saving throw. The other side of the wall deals no damage and doesn’t restrict movement through it.

At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 4th.

Tome of Heroes ©2022 Open Design LLC; Authors: Celeste Conowitch, Jeff Lee, Sarah Madsen, Ben McFarland, Kelly Pawlik, Brian Suskind

Symbol.name: Symbol
Symbol.components: V, S, M(mercury, phosphorus, and powdered diamond and opal with a total value of at least 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes)
Symbol.description:
When you cast this spell, you inscribe a harmful glyph either on a surface (such as a section of floor, a wall, or a table) or within an object that can be closed to conceal the glyph (such as a book, a scroll, or a treasure chest). If you choose a surface, the glyph can cover an area of the surface no larger than 10 feet in diameter. If you choose an object, that object must remain in its place; if the object is moved more than 10 feet from where you cast this spell, the glyph is broken, and the spell ends without being triggered.

The glyph is nearly invisible, requiring anIntelligence(Investigation) check against your spell save DC to find it.

You decide what triggers the glyph when you cast the spell. For glyphs inscribed on a surface, the most typical triggers include touching or stepping on the glyph, removing another object covering it, approaching within a certain distance of it, or manipulating the object that holds it. For glyphs inscribed within an object, the most common triggers are opening the object, approaching within a certain distance of it, or seeing or reading the glyph.

You can further refine the trigger so the spell is activated only under certain circumstances or according to a creature’s physical characteristics (such as height or weight), or physical kind (for example, the ward could be set to affect hags or shapechangers). You can also specify creatures that don’t trigger the glyph, such as those who say a certain password.

When you inscribe the glyph, choose one of the options below for its effect. Once triggered, the glyph glows, filling a 60-foot-radius sphere with dim light for 10 minutes, after which time the spell ends. Each creature in the sphere when the glyph activates is targeted by its effect, as is a creature that enters the sphere for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there.

Death: Each target must make aConstitutionsaving throw, taking 10d10 necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful save.

Discord: Each target must make aConstitutionsaving throw. On a failed save, a target bickers and argues with other creatures for 1 minute. During this time, it is incapable of meaningful communication and has disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

Fear: Each target must make aWisdomsaving throw and becomesfrightenedfor 1 minute on a failed save. Whilefrightened, the target drops whatever it is holding and must move at least 30 feet away from the glyph on each of its turns, if able.

Hopelessness: Each target must make aCharismasaving throw. On a failed save, the target is overwhelmed with despair for 1 minute. During this time, it can’t attack or target any creature with harmful abilities, spells, or other magical effects.

Insanity: Each target must make anIntelligencesaving throw. On a failed save, the target is driven insane for 1 minute. An insane creature can’t take actions, can’t understand what other creatures say, can’t read, and speaks only in gibberish. The GM controls its movement, which is erratic.

Pain: Each target must make aConstitutionsaving throw and becomes incapacitated with excruciating pain for 1 minute on a failed save.

Sleep: Each target must make aWisdomsaving throw and falls unconscious for 10 minutes on a failed save. A creature awakens if it takes damage or if someone uses an action to shake or slap it awake.

Stunning: Each target must make aWisdomsaving throw and becomesstunnedfor 1 minute on a failed save.
Symbol.material_component: mercury, phosphorus, and powdered diamond and opal with a total value of at least 1,000 gp, which the spell consumes

Arcane Veins.name: Arcane Veins
Arcane Veins.description:
Veins of arcane power course throughout the touched structure, adding magical strength and stability to it. The structure becomes sturdier and less susceptible to damage, increasing its AC by 2, itshit pointsby 10%, and its damage threshold increased by 10%.

This spell has no effect on magical structures or creatures (including constructs). If cast on a structure, the spell initially affects an area 20 feet by 20 feet insize. This area grows over the course of time, however, at a rate of an additional 20-foot-by-20-foot area per year in the direction as designated at the time of the casting and continues for a total of five years. The effects of the spell can spread beyond the structure it was initially cast upon to adjacent structures if they are physically connected (such as by a wall or bridge).

Additional castings of the spell on the same object or structure have no additional effect, though if cast on a structure larger than the spells area of effect, they can be combined for better coverage of that area.

At Higher Levels. When the spell is cast using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the structure’shit pointsand damage threshold increase by 10% for each slot level above 3rd.

Tome of Spell Mastery, © 2024, Necromancer Games; Author: Frog God Games.

Burst Stone.name: Burst Stone
Burst Stone.description:
You cause the ground at a point you can see within range to explode. The ground must be sand, earth, or unworked rock. Each creature within 10 feet of that point must make aDexteritysaving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 4d8 bludgeoning damage and is forcedprone. On a successful save, the creature takes half as much damage and isn’t forcedprone. The area then becomesdifficult terrainwith a 5-foot-deep pit centered on the point you chose.

At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 3rd.

Tome of Heroes ©2022 Open Design LLC; Authors: Celeste Conowitch, Jeff Lee, Sarah Madsen, Ben McFarland, Kelly Pawlik, Brian Suskind

Limbus Lightning.name: Limbus Lightning
Limbus Lightning.duration: Instantaneous Classes: Druid, Ranger, Sorcerer, Wizard
Limbus Lightning.description:
Classes: Druid, Ranger, Sorcerer, Wizard

You hurl an undulating bolt of lightning at one creature in range. Make a ranged spellattackagainst the target. On a hit, the target takes 2d8 + 1d6 lightning damage. Choose one of the d8s. If you roll the same number on both d8s, the Limbus bolt leaps from the target to a different creature of your choice within 30 feet of it. Make a newattackroll against the new target, and make a new damage roll, which could cause the lightning to leap again. A creature can be targeted only once by each casting of this spell.

At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, each target takes 1d6 extra damage of the type rolled for each slot level above 1st.

Angel Feathers.description:
You point at an area and angelic feathers erupt from your hands, piercing through everything. Each creature in a 60- foot cone in the direction in which you pointed must make aDexteritysaving throw, taking 6d8 radiant damage on a failed

Emotional Gamut.name: Emotional Gamut
Emotional Gamut.description:
You force a creature you can see within range to experience a rush of emotions and powerful memories from its life. The target must succeed on aWisdomsaving throw or become overwhelmed with emotions as it recalls emotionally charged events from its life for the duration.

While overwhelmed with emotions, the target’s speed is reduced by 10 feet, and it has disadvantage on the firstattackroll it makes on its turn. A target automatically succeeds on this saving throw if it can’t becharmed.

At the end of each of its turns, the target can make anotherWisdomsaving throw. On a failure, the target takes 1d4 psychic damage. On a success, the spell ends.

Essence Shield.name: Essence Shield
Essence Shield.description:
You imbue vitality into your Summon, which gains a number oftemporary hit pointsequal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier for the duration.

Thetemporary hit pointsgranted by this spell increase by 1d4 when you reach 5th level (2d4), 11th level (3d4), and 17th level (4d4).

This is not the complete license attribution -see the full license for this page

Magma Flow.name: Magma Flow
Magma Flow.components: V, S, M (piece of dried lava)
Magma Flow.description:
Class(es): Druid, Sorcerer, Synthetist

You transform a 60-foot-long, 20-foot-wide strip of land into a flowing stream of molten lava starting from a point you choose within range. The area becomesdifficult terrainand is filled with intense heat. Any creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must make aDexteritysaving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 10d6 fire damage and is engulfed in flames, suffering an additional 1d6 fire damage at the start of each of its turns until it takes an action to douse the flames or the spell ends. On a successful save, a creature takes half as much damage and doesn’t suffer ongoing fire damage.

You create a comforting phantasm, which leeches onto the psyche of a nearby target. The creature can attempt aWisdomsaving throw to prevent the phantasm from entering its psyche; on a failed saving throw it takes up permanent residence in the target’s mind. The phantasm fills its target’s dreams with happy visions, comforting manifestations of loved ones, and incredible vistas, feeding the target a perfect fantasy life it never wishes to leave. After the target’s next night’s sleep, the target must succeed at aWisdomsaving throw to wake up; otherwise, it remains asleep for the rest of the day and following night. Each night it must succeed at a new saving throw or remain asleep for days or weeks on end as it slowly starves to death (presuming it normally needs to eat to survive). Loud noises, jostling, and even pain won’t rouse the slumbering target. Dealing damage awakens the target, but the target awakens with a level ofexhaustionand has disadvantage on all saving throws against spells and effects that may put it back to sleep until the phantasm has been banished.

As a bonus action, the caster may send any or all of the moons to any points within range, causing their light to emanate from that point with a radius of 30 feet. You create a ball of arcing lightning in an unoccupied space you can see within range.

The ball sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. The ball buzzes and crackles with electricity and occupies a 5-foot space.

When a creature gets within 5 feet of the ball for the first time on its turn or starts its turn there, it is targeted by arcs of electricity, and it must succeed on aConstitutionsaving throw or take 8d4 lightning damage.

On each of your turns after you cast this spell, you can use an action to move the ball up to 60 feet in any direction.

Illusory pit.name: Illusory pit
Illusory pit.description:
DurationConcentration, up to 1 minute

You create an illusory pit within the area. Any creature entering the area or beginning their turn within must make aWisdomsaving throw or believe they are falling into a bottomless pit. While the spell is active all creatures can ‘see’ the pit in the area. If a creature fails their saving throw, they fallproneand are unable to take anyactionsor move.

They can only flail around as they believe they are falling.

Each round at the end of their turn, a creature may attempt aDexteritysaving throw to try to stop their ‘fall’, on a success, they may then reattempt aWisdomsaving throw to disbelieve the illusion, otherwise they cling to the ground as if they have barely saved themselves. Each round thereafter they may make anAthleticscheck to climb against the spell save DC to ‘climb out’, failing by 5 or more means they think they are falling again. If they succeed or fail by less than 5, they may attempt theWisdomsave to disbelieve the spell.

Flying creatures are not affected by this spell. If a non-flying creature succeeds on theWisdomsave for this spell or the spell’s duration ends, they are freed from the it’s effects and are no longer affected by it but they arestunneduntil the beginning of their next turn.

Weak and Wounds.name: Weak and Wounds
Weak and Wounds.description:
You blast the mind of a humanoid that you can see within range, forcibly inserting violent urges into its psyche. The target takes 4d6 psychic damage and must make anIntelligencesaving throw. On a failed save, the impulse slowly takes root and reinforces itself in thecharmedtarget’s mind over a period of 1d4 days. Thecharmedtarget’s conscious mind remains completely unaware of the homicidal urge secretly swelling within. When the urge has grown to an overpowering psychosis, the target goes berserk. For 10 minutes, thecharmedtarget gains 50temporary hit points, has advantage onattackrolls with simple and martial weapons, has proficiency inStrengthandConstitutionsaving throws, and canattacktwice, instead of once, when it takes theAttackaction on its turn (it ignores this benefit if it already has a feature that grants extra attacks). Each time the target takes damage while it is berserk, it can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. It regards all creatures it can see as enemies until the spell ends. Whenever the affected creature chooses another creature as a target, it must choose the target at random from among the creatures it can see within range of theattack, spell, or other ability it’s using. If an enemy provokes an opportunityattackfrom the affected creature, the creature must make thatattackif it is able to. The spell can also be ended bygreater restoration,heal, orwish.

You become a Medium chromatic or metallic dragon. This effect is similar topolymorph, but you retain your ownhit points, ability scores, and saving throws, with a temporary +2 bonus to yourStrengthandConstitutionas long as you remain in dragon form. You sprout wings that allow you to fly 40 feet and you gaindarkvision60 feet. While in dragon form, you gain Armor Class 17 (natural armor) and the followingattackactions. You are proficient with your bite and claw attacks.

Chaotic Flowerfall.description:
A shower of flowers falls across the ground at ten different points you can see within range. The flowers fall in 10-foot cubes centered on each point, and each cube must be contiguous with at least one other cube. Each friendly creature in a cube chooses one of the following when the flowers appear—it regains 10d6hit pointsor it is cured of all diseases and all the following conditions:blinded,charmed,deafened,paralyzed,petrified, andpoisoned.

Each hostile creature in a cube must make aDexteritysaving throw, taking 10d10 necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature in the area of more than one cube of falling flowers is affected only once.

For the duration, you and up to five other creatures of your choice within the radius at the time of casting gain the ability to perform an additional bonus action on each of your turns. This extra bonus action can be used to make one weaponattack, cast a cantrip, or take theDash,Disengage,Hide, orUse an Objectaction.

Create Living Construct.name: Create Living Construct
Create Living Construct.description:
This spell creates a biomantic servant known as a living construct. Choose up to three animals within range, as per the below list. Your spell imbues the target with life, transforming it into a more extreme version of a humour you choose, depending on its base stock:

As a bonus action on each of your turns, you can mentallycommandany creature you created with this spell if the creature is within 120 feet of you (if you control multiple creatures, you can command any or all of them at the same time, issuing the samecommandto each one). You decide what action the creature will take and where it will move during its next turn, or you can issue a generalcommand, such as to guard a particular chamber or corridor. If you issue no commands, the creature only defends itself against hostile creatures. Once given an order, the creature continues to follow it until its task is complete. The creature is under your control for 24 hours, after which it stops obeying anycommandyou have given it. To maintain control of the creature for another 24 hours, you must cast this spell on the creature before the current 24-hour period ends. This use of the spell reasserts your control over up to three creatures you have created with this spell, rather than creating new ones.

At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a 7th-level spell slot, you can animate or reassert control over four living constructs. When you cast this spell using an 8th-level spell slot, you can animate or reassert control over five living constructs. When you cast this spell using a 9th-level spell slot, you can animate or reassert control over six living constructs.

Guiding Bolt.description:
A flash of light streaks toward a creature of your choice within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 4d6 radiant damage, and the next attack roll made against this target before the end of your next turn has advantage, thanks to the mystical dim light glittering on the target until then.

At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1st.

Chain Dispel.name: Chain Dispel
Chain Dispel.description:
You unleash antimagic that strikes a creature within range, ending any spell of 4th level or lower on that target. For each spell of 5th level or higher on the target, make an ability check using your spellcasting ability score with a DC of 10 + the spell’s level, with a successful check ending the spell.

After the bolt strikes the initial target, the spell arcs to three other targets, each of which must be within 30 feet of your original target. The chaindispelaffects these targets in the same way.

Alternatively, you can have the chain dispel affect all creatures you choose within 30 feet of the original target.

In this case, you automatically end any spells of 2nd level or lower on all creatures targeted by the chain dispel and make a check as described above to end spells of 3rd level or higher. However, spells of 6th level or above are unaffected by this version of chain dispel.

At Higher Levels. When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, you increase the level of spells that you automaticallydispeland that you can affect with the “all creatures” version of chaindispelby one for each additional slot level.

Your blood becomes as hard as iron on contact with air. If you take at least 5 piercing or slashing, your blood infuses your clothing or armor and strengthens it, granting you a +1 bonus to Armor Class on your next turn. If you take at least 5 piercing or slashing weapon on two or more consecutive rounds, this bonus increases to +2.

If a creature has an ability to drain blood, you gain an additional +1 bonus to Armor Class and have advantage on any saving throws against that ability, as well asresistanceto damage caused by such blood drain.

Illusory Double.name: Illusory Double
Illusory Double.description:
You becomeinvisibleat the same time that an illusory double of you appears where you are standing. The double does not move, smell, or make any noise.

The illusion andinvisibilityend at the beginning of your next turn.

Physical interaction with the double reveals it to be an illusion, because things can pass through it. A creature that uses its action to examine the image can determine that it is an illusion with a successfulIntelligence(Investigation) check against your spell save DC. Creatures have advantage on this saving throw due to the static nature of the illusion. If a creature discerns the illusion for what it is, the creature can see through the image.

You whisper a holy prayer to your deity and summon amagic weaponin the shape of your deity’s favored weapon, ornamented with inscriptions of prayer. The weapon appears in your hand and emanates a good aura in a 30-foot radius, turning the ground within the aura to consecrated ground.

For the duration of the spell, you can use your action to make a melee spellattackthat deals 10d10 radiant damage on a hit.

If you let go of the weapon, it disappears.

If an evil creature is killed with this weapon, it turns to ash along with the items it is carrying, wearing, and wielding.

Control Water.name: Control Water
Control Water.components: V, S, M(a drop of water and a pinch of dust)
Control Water.description:
Until the spell ends, you control any freestanding water inside an area you choose that is a cube up to 100 feet on a side. You can choose from any of the following effects when you cast this spell. As an action on your turn, you can repeat the same effect or choose a different one.

Flood: You cause the water level of all standing water in the area to rise by as much as 20 feet. If the area includes a shore, the flooding water spills over onto dry land. If you choose an area in a large body of water, you instead create a 20-foot tall wave that travels from one side of the area to the other and then crashes down. Any Huge or smaller vehicles in the wave’s path are carried with it to the other side. Any Huge or smaller vehicles struck by the wave have a 25 percent chance of capsizing. The water level remains elevated until the spell ends or you choose a different effect. If this effect produced a wave, the wave repeats on the start of your next turn while the flood effect lasts.

Part Water: You cause water in the area to move apart and create a trench. The trench extends across the spell’s area, and the separated water forms a wall to either side. The trench remains until the spell ends or you choose a different effect. The water then slowly fills in the trench over the course of the next round until the normal water level is restored.

Redirect Flow: You cause flowing water in the area to move in a direction you choose, even if the water has to flow over obstacles, up walls, or in other unlikely directions. The water in the area moves as you direct it, but once it moves beyond the spell’s area, it resumes its flow based on the terrain conditions. The water continues to move in the direction you chose until the spell ends or you choose a different effect.

Whirlpool: This effect requires a body of water at least 50 feet square and 25 feet deep. You cause a whirlpool to form in the center of the area. The whirlpool forms a vortex that is 5 feet wide at the base, up to 50 feet wide at the top, and 25 feet tall. Any creature or object in the water and within 25 feet of the vortex is pulled 10 feet toward it. A creature can swim away from the vortex by making aStrength(Athletics) check against your spell save DC. When a creature enters the vortex for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make aStrengthsaving throw. On a failed save, the creature takes 2d8 bludgeoning damage and is caught in the vortex until the spell ends. On a successful save, the creature takes half damage, and isn’t caught in the vortex. A creature caught in the vortex can use its action to try to swim away from the vortex as described above, but has disadvantage on theStrength(Athletics) check to do so.

The first time each turn that an object enters the vortex, the object takes 2d8 bludgeoning damage; this damage occurs each round it remains in the vortex.

Blood to Sap.name: Blood to Sap
Blood to Sap.description:
This spell causes one target creature’s blood to thicken and slow in its veins. An affected creature suffers excruciating pain and must make aConstitutionsaving throw. On a failure, the target takes 28 (8d6) poison damage, ispoisonedfor the spell’s duration. On a success, the target takes half as much damage and is notpoisoned.

Creaturespoisonedby this spell have their speed halved, are treated as having an AC of at least 18, and are immune to critical hits as though they were wearingadamantine armor.

Blood to sap can target only living creatures with a discernible anatomy and a bloodstream.

Towers of Gore.name: Towers of Gore
Towers of Gore.description:
Hemorrhage TraitA spell with the hemorrhage trait have an effect below the expectations of the spell’s level, but this effect increases if the caster is bleeding when the spell is cast. You are bleeding if you aren’t at a fullhit pointsand you’ve taken piercing or slashing damage in the past hour. The spell description designates these effects with “If you are bleeding…” before presenting the additional effects. To gain greater control of their bleeding, casters who dabble in blood magic often learn the bit of blood cantrip and use it to ensure the steady stream of blood necessary to empower their spells. That such spellcasters would so carelessly spill their own blood for more powerful magic makes them seem reckless in many people’s eyes.

Towers of semi-congealed blood erupt from surfaces in the area, strong enough to lift creatures into the air and splashing the area with viscous blood. The DM might determine additional effects from this sudden profusion of blood, such as drawing the attention of sahuagins,vampires, or other creatures attracted to blood. The entire area becomesdifficult terrainuntil the blood naturally dries, usually over the course of several days. You can choose for up to four towers of blood to rise from 10-foot squares in the area. These blood towers ascend up to 60 feet in height, stopping if they hit a structure or ceiling. Each creature on a tower when it stops rising must succeed at aDexteritysaving throw or fall off the nearest edge, taking falling damage as appropriate. Creatures atop a tower that hits a structure or ceiling automatically fall off. The towers then quickly descend, depositing any creatures that didn’t fall off of them back onto the ground in the same space they were when lifted.

If you are bleeding, you can choose to have any or all of the towers collapse with supernatural force. Each creature on or adjacent to a collapsing tower of blood must make aDexteritysaving throw. A creature takes 30d6 bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature on or adjacent to multiple towers takes this damage only once.

Bloodmagic, 5e © 2020, Owen K.C. Stephens; Author: Ron Lundeen. Project manager and

You touch a creature, and that creature must succeed on aWisdomsaving throw or become cursed for the duration of the spell. When you cast this spell, choose the nature of the curse from the following options:

Aremove cursespell ends this effect. At the GM’s option, you may choose an alternative curse effect, but it should be no more powerful than those described above. The GM has final say on such a curse’s effect.

At Higher Levels: If you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the duration is concentration, up to 10 minutes. If you use a spell slot of 5th level or higher, the duration is 8 hours. If you use a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the duration is 24 hours. If you use a 9th level spell slot, the spell lasts until it is dispelled. Using a spell slot of 5th level or higher grants a duration that doesn’t require concentration.

Aegis of Honor.description:
You reach out toward the friendly target, placing a brief barrier between the target and the target’s attacker.

The damage the target takes is reduced by 1d6 + your spellcasting ability modifier. If this effect reduces the damage to 0, you can turn the damage back on the attacker. Make a ranged spellattackagainst the attacker.

On a hit, the attacker takes force damage equal to the amount of damage you reduced.

Scavenger’s Eye.description:
Benefit(s): Increase yourIntelligenceorWisdomscore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gain advantage onInvestigationandPerceptionchecks when searching for resources or hidden items in ruins or wastelands. Additionally, you have advantage onDexteritysaving throws made to avoid traps and hazards.

Playful Creature.name: Playful Creature
Playful Creature.description:
This feat is intended for creatures whose race is animalistic in some way, with fur or feathers or similar bestial traits, such as gnolls and catfolk.

You’re charming enough that others assume any faux pas is just a delightful quirk. If you fail aDeceptioncheck to deceive, an Intimidate check to gain a target’s cooperation, or aSleight of Handcheck to steal from another creature, you can immediately attempt a Diplomacy check against the same DC as a bonus action. If you succeed, your target assumes youractionswere in jest or just some awkward misunderstanding between your bestial inclinations and the social norms of others. The creature’s attitude toward you does not change based on your failed action (though lateractionscan still shift its attitude towards you). You can use this feat only once per day per target.

Glyph Adept.name: Glyph Adept
Glyph Adept.description:
Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You add glyph of warding toyour spells known or prepared. It is a class spell for you and doesn’t count against the number of spells you know or can have prepared.
When you cast glyph of warding, its casting time is reduced to 10 minutes.
When you cast glyph of warding to produce explosive runes, you can have the runes deal acid, cold, fire, force, lightning, necrotic, poison, psychic, radiant, or thunder damage.
If another creature attempts to counter or dispel a glyph of warding you cast, your glyph is treated as being 1 level higher than the level at which you actually cast it.
Once you are able to cast 7th-level spells (or if you are already able to), you add symbol to your spells known or prepared. It is a class spell for you and doesn’t count against the number of spells you know or can have prepared.

Magic Marksman.name: Magic Marksman
Magic Marksman.description:
As an action, you can store the potential of a spell with a range of touch and a casting time of one action into an arrow or other ammunition. To cast the stored spell, choose a creature or point within the weapon’s range and loose the missile from a weapon that uses that ammunition. While casting the spell this way, the weapon counts as a spell focus and the act of firing counts as the somatic component if the spell requires them. If the chosen spell requires a spellattackroll to hit its target, make a ranged weapon attack roll using the weapon instead. Otherwise, the spell comes into effect as though you had touched the targeted point or creature.

If the stored spell is not used before the end of your next turn, it dissipates.

Galder’s Gazetteer Author(s) Matt Click, Gabe Hicks, Jess Ross

Furious Chaos.name: Furious Chaos
Furious Chaos.description:
Benefit(s): When an enemy creature makes a melee weapon attack against you, as a reaction, you can force them to reroll the attack or direct the attack at another enemy creature adjacent to your space. If the original attack roll intended for you is high enough to hit the other creature, the new target suffers the damage instead of you.

If an enemy creature takes the Disengage action to escape from you, you can still use your reaction to make an opportunity attack against them.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Epic Warrior.name: Epic Warrior
Epic Warrior.description: Legendary Adventures © 2020 Mike Myler, published under license by Legendary Games.

Expert Trapsmith.name: Expert Trapsmith
Expert Trapsmith.description:
Effect: When you make either aDexterityorIntelligencecheck or saving throw using tools to craft or disarm a trap, you can add both yourDexterityandIntelligencemodifiers to the roll.

Warlock Grimoire 4. ©2023 Open Design LLC. Authors: Lou Anders, Wolfgang Baur, HH Carlan, Robert Fairbanks, Basheer Ghouse, Richard Green, Tim Hitchcock, Jeremy Hochhalter, Victoria Jaczko, Rajan Khanna, Sarah Madsen, Ben McFarland, Jonathan Miley, Kelly Pawlik, Sebastian Rombach, Adam W. Roy, Paul Scofield, Amber Stewart, Brian Suskind, Mike Welham.

Moving Target.name: Moving Target
Moving Target.description:
When you move at least 40 feet in a round, you gain a +1 bonus to your AC and advantage onDexterity-based saving throws until the beginning of your next turn.

Breath of Life - The Scout (5e)© 2024, Orphaned Bookworm Productions; Authors: Norman Mitchell Jr. and Connor Bates

Hero’s Display.name: Hero’s Display
Hero’s Display.description:
With a dramatic flourish you display your weapons to the crowd. Onlookers are elated, and your enemies are demoralized.

Battlemasters & Berserkers © 2021, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

Iron Maiden’s Embrace.name: Iron Maiden’s Embrace
Iron Maiden’s Embrace.description:
Your Strength score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
While you are wearing heavy armor, you can use your bonus action to damage a creature within 5 feet of you that is grappled by you. The damage is equal to 1d4 plus your Strength modifier, and you can choose to deal bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage.

Clustered Shots.name: Clustered Shots
Clustered Shots.description:
You take a moment to carefully aim your shots, causing them all to strike nearly the same spot.

Battlemasters & Berserkers © 2021, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

Submarine Skirmish.name: Submarine Skirmish
Submarine Skirmish.description: Pirate Campaign Compendium© 2018, Legendary Games; Lead Designer Jason Nelson. Authors: Alex Augunas, Jeff Gomez, Matt Goodall, Jim Groves, Tim Hitchcock, Victoria Jaczko, Jonathan H. Keith, Lyz Liddell, Thomas J. Phillips, Alistair J. Rigg, Alex Riggs, Loren Sieg, Neil Spicer, Todd Stewart, Rachel Ventura, Michael D. Welham, Linda Zayas-Palmer.

Beast Trainer.name: Beast Trainer
Beast Trainer.description:
You can acquire a companion of up to CR 1. Starting at 6th level, you can acquire a companion with a challenge rating as high as your character level divided by 3, rounded down.
Your companion is proficient with your saving throws.
Your companion’s hit point maximum equals its normal maximum or five times your character level, whichever is higher.

Herbalist.name: Herbalist
Herbalist.description:
You gain proficiency with the herbalism kit.
When you craft items with the herbalism kit, you can choose to reduce either the time required or the cost of materials by half.
Creatures that regain hit points by using an item you craft regain additional hit points equal to your level.

Beast Slayer.name: Beast Slayer
Beast Slayer.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Carpenter Surgeon.name: Carpenter Surgeon
Carpenter Surgeon.description:
Increase your Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
If you are proficient with carpenter’s tools, you can use them to stabilize a creature that has 0 hit points, without needing to make a Wisdom (Medicine) check.
You have advantage on Wisdom (Medicine) skill checks made to treat or identify wounds.

Concussive Spell.name: Concussive Spell
Concussive Spell.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Fundamental Attitude.name: Fundamental Attitude
Fundamental Attitude.description:
Benefit(s): You gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class, attacks and damage when fighting unarmed.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Gladiator.name: Gladiator
Gladiator.description:
You have fought for years and endured your fair share of punishment, making you tough as nails.

You can take this feat several times, with a different type of damage every time.

Insulating Insanity.name: Insulating Insanity
Insulating Insanity.description:
As long as you have this insanity, you have advantage on Constitution saving throws to concentrate on spells and on all Wisdom saving throws. If your insanity is cured, you may either gain a different insanity or choose a new feat in place of this one.

Sandy Petersen’s Cthulhu Mythos, © 2018, Petersen Games; Authors: Sandy Petersen, David N. Ross, James Jacobs, Arthur Petersen, Ian Starcher.

Soul Bond.name: Soul Bond
Soul Bond.description:
of any special senses it has. While perceiving through your companion’s senses, you are deaf and blind with regard to your own senses.
During a short rest, your companion regains all lost hit points. As a light activity during a short rest, you may spend 10 gp worth of rare herbs to call your companion’s spirit, restoring your companion to life with all its hit points at your location at the end of the rest.

Wise.name: Wise
Wise.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Bare-knuckled Brawler.name: Bare-knuckled Brawler
Bare-knuckled Brawler.description: You are well practiced in tavern brawls, boxing, or some other form of unarmed combat. You gain +1Strength, to a maximum of 20. Additionally, your unarmed strike deals bludgeoning damage equal to 1d6 + yourStrengthmodifier.

Elemental Terror.name: Elemental Terror
Elemental Terror.description:
Deadly elementals of withstand mighty attacks, but not from you.

Power Damage. When you make anAttackroll orcast a spellthat inflicts damage on anElemental, you deal additional Force damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Searing Barrage. When youcast a spellusing a spell slot that deals Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage, you can change half that damage into Radiant damage instead. You may do this a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus; a Long Rest restores your uses.

The Dragon’s Hoard #60 © 2025, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Darrin Drader, Robert J. Grady, Kate Baker, Joel Flank, Wren Brown, James-Levi Cooke.

Amphibious Adaptation.name: Amphibious Adaptation
Amphibious Adaptation.description:
You can survive out of water far longer than your aquatic kin.

The Dragon’s Hoard #37© 2023, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Matt Kimmel, Michael Mifsud, Scott D. Young, Miguel Colon.

Ignition Resistance.name: Ignition Resistance
Ignition Resistance.description:
Through sheer will, you can briefly force your natural resistances to strengthen magically, shielding you entirely from that which you could previously only partially withstand.

YourConstitutionscore increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Whenever you take damage of any type you haveresistanceto, you can use yourreactionto gain immunity to that type of damage until the start of your next turn.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining spent uses when you complete a short or long rest.

Unrelenting Caster.name: Unrelenting Caster
Unrelenting Caster.description: does not apply if a target makes a successful saving throw but still takes damage, a condition, or any other negative effect from your spell.

Pirate’s Charisma.name: Pirate’s Charisma
Pirate’s Charisma.description:
Increase yourCharismascore by 1, to a maximum of 20. Additionally, you gain proficiency in theIntimidationandPersuasionskills. If you are already proficient in any of these skills, you gain expertise instead.

Pirates and Plunder A Compendium For 5e © 2024 Published by Mythos Chronicles; Author Filippo Bardoscia

Infernal Experiment.name: Infernal Experiment
Infernal Experiment.description:
Diabolical rituals performed while you grew in the womb (or those enacted on one of your family line in ages past) run strong in your blood, making your body perfectly suited to adopt limbs and organs parts ripped from the blasphemous entities of Hell: devils.

You may spend yourreactionto gain advantage on a saving throw. You may use this feature a number of times equal to half your proficiency bonus before requiring a long rest to recharge it. You may also recharge this feature by taking a short rest after committing a duplicitous or evil act.

Book of Exalted Darkness. © 2018 Mike Myler, published under license by Legendary Games.

Spirit -Touched.name: Spirit -Touched
Spirit -Touched.description:
Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You can see visions of the life of a spirit that you can either name or describe. When you use this ability as an action, you become incapacitated for 1 minute. During that minute, you have visions that provide a brief summary of the significant lore about the spirit. This lore includes important moments in their life as well as specifics about their death.
You are immune to being possessed by ghosts.

Divine Darkness.name: Divine Darkness
Divine Darkness.description:
You gain 1 additional use of Channel Divinity per rest.

When you Channel Divinity, as a bonus action you can cause writhing shadows emanate from your unholy symbol shrouding a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on you in darkness until the start of your next turn. Nonmagical light cannot illuminate this darkness. Creatures withoutdarkvisiontreat the area as heavily obscured and even creatures withdarkvisiontreat it as lightly obscured.

You must finish a short rest before you may use this ability again. After using it a second time in one day, you must finish a long rest before you may use it again.

The Dragon’s Hoard #45© 2024, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Darren Drader, Robert J. Grady, Nicholas Hite, Matt Kimmel

Arachnid Athletics.name: Arachnid Athletics
Arachnid Athletics.description:
You have learned to emulate the skittering movement of the arachnids so precious to your kin.

Underworld Races and Classes © 2017 AAW Games LLC; Designers: Thilo Graf and Mike Myler

Arcane Resurgence.name: Arcane Resurgence
Arcane Resurgence.description:
Benefit(s): Increase yourCharisma,IntelligenceorWisdomscore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Once per turn when youcast a spellof 1st level or higher that inflicts damage of a type to which you haveresistanceor immunity, you may reroll a number of damage dice up to your modifier for the chosen ability (minimum of one reroll). You must use the new rolls.

Rockwalker.name: Rockwalker
Rockwalker.description:
Your connection with the earth allows you to navigate through stone seamlessly. As an action duringyour turn, you can move through solid rock and earth without disturbing the material or leaving a tunnel.

This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.

Soldier’s Endurance.name: Soldier’s Endurance
Soldier’s Endurance.description:
You received military training and are able to push yourself to the limits and beyond, and you have learned to survive on foods that most people could not stomach. You gain the following abilities:

Stone Mother’s Assault - © 2020, Adrian Arduini; Author: Adrian Arduini

Power Attack.name: Power Attack
Power Attack.description:
You can make exceptionally deadlymelee attacksby sacrificing accuracy for strength.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Two Weapon Master.name: Two Weapon Master
Two Weapon Master.description:
If you are wielding a one-handed or versatile weapon in each hand and canattackwith both, you gain the following benefits.

Stone Mother’s Assault - © 2020, Adrian Arduini; Author: Adrian Arduini

Shield of Swings.name: Shield of Swings
Shield of Swings.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Tree Stalker.name: Tree Stalker
Tree Stalker.description:
You can merge into a large or bigger tree by spending 5 feet of movement to step into its space. If the tree is destroyed or reduced to a size smaller than large, you are shunted to a space within 5 feet of the tree that you choose.
While occupying a tree, you can spend 5 feet of movement to magically move to another living tree, which must be within a certain distance from the tree you’re in. The distance in feet equals 20 x your proficiency bonus.
While occupying a tree, you can sense the location and condition of all plant life within the same range you would be able to move to another tree in.

Summoner Bond.name: Summoner Bond
Summoner Bond.description:
You and your summon are two halves of a whole. You exude confidence while interacting with your summon:

Creed's Codex: Arcane Secrets of the Summoners © 2022 Brendan Jonesrebandt Consulting LLC DBA Knight Vision Creative, Author Brendan Jonesrebandt

Precious Elements.name: Precious Elements
Precious Elements.description: Choose one Charisma-based skill. If you do not have proficiency in it, you gain proficiency with that skill. If you had proficiency with it already, you can add your proficiency bonus to it a second time (unless a feature like expertise was already allowing you to do so). When you make a Charisma-based ability check or saving throw, you may roll 1d4 and add it to the result. You may do this a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining spent uses when you complete a long rest.

Flesh Eater.name: Flesh Eater
Flesh Eater.description:
Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain a bite attack that acts as a finesse weapon with which you have proficiency. This attack deals 1d4 piercing damage. If you already have a bite attack, its damage increases by one die size (i.e., d4 increases to d6, or d3 to d4, etc.).
When you reduce a creature to 0 hit points with a melee attack on your turn, you can use a bonus action to move up to half your speed and make a bite attack.
At the end of a short or long rest during which you consume at least half a pound of flesh, you gain temporary hit points equal to 1/2 the Intelligence score of the creature whose flesh you have eaten (minimum 1 hit point).

Legendary Fortitude.name: Legendary Fortitude
Legendary Fortitude.description: Legendary Adventures © 2020 Mike Myler, published under license by Legendary Games.

Haunting Voice.name: Haunting Voice
Haunting Voice.description:
Choose a 1st-level spell that requires a vocal component from any spell list. You can cast that spell once, using Charisma as your spellcasting ability. Once you do so, you can’t do so again until you finish a long rest.
You learn the message cantrip, which you can cast without somatic or material components, using Charisma as your spellcasting ability. When you cast it using this feat, the communication only works one way, so the target can’t reply to you through the spell.
When you make a Charisma (Performance) check to sing, recite, or perform oratory, you do so with advantage.

Steeled Mind.name: Steeled Mind
Steeled Mind.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Combat Expertise.name: Combat Expertise
Combat Expertise.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Keen Intellect.name: Keen Intellect
Keen Intellect.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Hated Enemy.name: Hated Enemy
Hated Enemy.description:
There is a particular type of opponent you hate above all others. You have become especially brutal against a particular type of opponent.

Battlemasters & Berserkers © 2021, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

Deceitful.name: Deceitful
Deceitful.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Titanic Stomp.name: Titanic Stomp
Titanic Stomp.description:
Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
The area of effect for your Mighty Stomp racial feature increases to 30 feet.
You regain one expended use of your Mighty Stomp ability each time you finish a short rest.

Ghost Speaker.name: Ghost Speaker
Ghost Speaker.description:
Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You can comprehend and verbally communicate with the undead, even if they cannot normally speak. Their willingness to communicate with you is limited by their intelligence and their general attitude toward the living, but even if they might attack you shortly afterward, they can usually be persuaded to give you information about nearby locations and monsters, including whatever they can perceive or have perceived within the past day.
When you make an Insight or Persuasion check against a non-hostile undead, your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of those skills.

Herbal Healer.name: Herbal Healer
Herbal Healer.description:
You know which plants and herbs to use to make herbal poultices and unguents.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Giant’s Grasp.name: Giant’s Grasp
Giant’s Grasp.description:
Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain advantage on Strength ability checks and saving throws. You can grapple creatures up to two sizes larger than you, instead of one.

Find Weakness.name: Find Weakness
Find Weakness.description:
You know the weakness of your hated enemy type and can inflict grievous wounds on them.

Battlemasters & Berserkers © 2021, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

Extra Fighting Style.name: Extra Fighting Style
Extra Fighting Style.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Infernal Pact.name: Infernal Pact
Infernal Pact.description: You have sworn your impiety to an infernal duke. When selecting the feat, you must determine which Circle you swear fealty to. This Circle determines infernal feats you can choose from.

Polyform.name: Polyform
Polyform.description:
Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
When you use your action to use shapechanger, you can transform your appearance into that of any human, not just your specific human form. You can assume the form of a Small human (such as a human child) if you wish.
You can use your action to transform into a fox or back into your human form or your true form, as if using the change appearance option of the alter self spell, except this ability doesn’t require concentration and ignoring the restriction against assuming the form of a creature with a different size and shape. This fox form is a Tiny beast and is of comparable age, build, and gender to your true form, has the same fur color and eye color, and has an identical fur pattern to yours. Your statistics are the same in this form, except your Strength score is reduced to 3 (-4) and your Dexterity score becomes 15 (+2) if it’s normally lower than this. Your gear melds into your new form. You are limited in the actions you can perform by the nature of your new form, and you can’t speak, cast spells, or take any other action that requires hands or speech. You can’t activate, wield, or otherwise benefit from any of your equipment.

Ogre Grip.name: Ogre Grip
Ogre Grip.description:
You have advantage on Strength checks to grapple or shove a creature (see Grappling and Shoving a Creature).
Any weapon that does not have the heavy property has the light property when you wield it.
You can wield a weapon with the two-handed property in one hand, in which case you must apply a -1 penalty to the damage of this weapon.
Whenever you wield a weapon with the two-handed or versatile property in two hands, you add a bonus equal to half your Strength modifier (rounded down) to the damage of this weapon.

Potent Summoning.name: Potent Summoning
Potent Summoning.description: Your mastery over summoning rituals ensures your conjured creatures are more resilient. When you summon a creature using a spell, it gains a number oftemporary hit pointsequal to your proficiency bonus + your spellcasting ability modifier. Additionally, when a summoned creature you control makes a saving throw, it can add your spellcasting ability modifier to the result.

Unsettling Presence.name: Unsettling Presence
Unsettling Presence.description:
You have advantage to Charisma (Intimidation) checks against creatures within 10 feet of you. Constructs and undead are immune to this effect.
Creatures within 10 feet of you have disadvantage on saving throws against being frightened. Constructs and undead are immune to this effect, and you can choose any number of creatures to be immune to this effect.
When a creature starts its turn within 10 feet of you, it must make a Wisdom saving throw against a DC equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Charisma modifier.

Corpulescent.name: Corpulescent
Corpulescent.description:
Exercise and starvation utterly failed to affect your weight gain, the very evil of your soul accruing more and more flesh around your body—much of it is dead and rotting but you’ve lost all feeling in those nerves.

At the end of a long rest after journeying, if you traveled at a pace faster thanSlowfor more than 2 hours make a DC 15Constitutionsaving throw. If you traveled at aFastpace, you make this saving throw with disadvantage. On a failure, you gain 1 level ofexhaustion.

Book of Exalted Darkness. © 2018 Mike Myler, published under license by Legendary Games.

Arctic Sculptor (Cold).name: Arctic Sculptor (Cold)
Arctic Sculptor (Cold).description:
Choose one energy type other than cold. You are able to change spells with that descriptor to spells with a cold descriptor.
You may take this feat more than once, with each instance being a different descriptor.
You gain resistance to cold-based damage and you have advantage on all saving throws made against cold-based spells or effects.

Cure Self.name: Cure Self
Cure Self.description:
NoteInfernal feats are first gained by taking the Infernal Pact feat. This feat ties a character to a Circle’s particular lord. If the character is not from that Circle, the Circle is considered his “home” Circle from that point on. The feats available to a character are determined by his home Circle—a character cannot take infernal feats that are not listed as tied to a Circle.

The spells’ spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

Duelist.name: Duelist
Duelist.description:
You gain a +5 bonus to initiative if you are not surprised.
If you are tied with another creature for initiative, you go first.
After the GM has determined the position of all characters in a combat, if you are not surprised, you may move 5 feet as a reaction. This movement does not trigger attacks of opportunity.

Underfoot.name: Underfoot
Underfoot.description:
Benefit(s): You gain a +1 bonus to AC against attacks from opponents larger than you.

Then making anyStrength(Athletics) check to avoid an opponent or resist a combat maneuver, you may instead useDexterity.

You gain a +1 bonus toDexterity. This cannot improve your ability score to greater than 20.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Extra Rage.name: Extra Rage
Extra Rage.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Font of The Furnace.name: Font of The Furnace
Font of The Furnace.description:
Benefit(s): Spells you cast of the fire type ignore fireresistance. Sorcerers with this feat may expend 5 sorcery points to cause a successfully cast spell of the fire type to ignore fire immunity for 1 round. In addition, when you roll damage for a spell you cast that deals fire damage of that type, you can treat any 1 on a damage die as a 2.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Body Shield.name: Body Shield
Body Shield.description:
With a sly maneuver, you force agrappledopponent into the path of an incoming attack.

Battlemasters & Berserkers © 2021, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

Beast Companion.name: Beast Companion
Beast Companion.description:
With this feat you attract a creature of the beast type to be your companion. Choose a beast with a challenge rating of ¼ or lower, such as a mastiff, panther, hawk, riding horse, vulture, or wolf. The beast companion serves you to the best of its ability. It takes its turn on yourinitiativeand obeys your directions in combat. It can be instructed to take theAttack,Dash,Disengage, orHelpactions. You must use an action to issue these commands. If you have more than oneattackper turn, you can use one of your attacks to issue commands to the beast companion. Lacking anycommand, the beast’s default action is tododge.

Your proficiency bonus is added to the beast’sattackanddamage rolls, saving throws, AC, and skill checks that it is proficient with. Its maximumhit pointsare equal to 4 times your character level. The companion will use itsreactionsand bonusactionswithout being instructed. If you areunconsciousor otherwise unable to issue commands to the beast, it will act on its own and attempt to protect you and itself. If a beast companion dies, you can spend 8 hours recruiting a new one. You can also dismiss your current companion and recruit a new one.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Improved Channel Divinity.name: Improved Channel Divinity
Improved Channel Divinity.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Fast as Lightning.name: Fast as Lightning
Fast as Lightning.description:
You can use two reactions between the start of your turn and the start of your next turn. However, these two reactions cannot be used to activate the same effect twice. For example, you cannot make two opportunity attacks within the same round, and a rogue with Uncanny Dodge cannot use it more than once within the same round.
Whenever you fail a Dexterity saving throw, you can immediately use a reaction to reroll this saving throw. The result of the second roll replaces the first.

Tactician.name: Tactician
Tactician.description:
You learn two commands of your choice from among those available to the College of Adjuration bardic college. If a command you use requires a target to make a saving throw to resist the command’s effects, the saving throw DC equals 8 + your proficiency modifier + your Charisma modifier.
If you already have Bardic Inspiration dice, you gain one more; otherwise you have a single Bardic Inspiration die, which is a d6. This die is used to issue your commands. A Bardic Inspiration die is expended when you use it. You regain your expended Bardic Inspiration dice when you finish a short or long rest.

Net Fighter.name: Net Fighter
Net Fighter.description:
You are proficient with nets.
While you are wielding a net, you gain a +2 bonus to your Armor Class, as if you were using a shield. You are proficient in using a net this way, even if you are not proficient with using a shield.
When a creature attacks you with a melee weapon attack, you can use your reaction to attempt to disarm the creature if you are holding a net. Make an attack roll contested by the target’s Strength (Athletics) check or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check. If you win the contest, the attacking creature’s weapon comes away in your net. You have disadvantage on your attack roll if the attacking creature is holding the item with two or more hands, or if the creature is larger than you. You have advantage on the attack roll if the creature is smaller than you.

Great Strength.name: Great Strength
Great Strength.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Buccaneer’s Aim.name: Buccaneer’s Aim
Buccaneer’s Aim.description:
Your practice with firearms allows you to hit your target with unerring precision. Increase yourDexterityscore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Additionally, you can use a bonus action to aim carefully with a firearm, granting you advantage on the nextattackroll made with it during the current turn.

Pirates and Plunder A Compendium For 5e © 2024 Published by Mythos Chronicles; Author Filippo Bardoscia

Fearsome Reputation.name: Fearsome Reputation
Fearsome Reputation.description:
Additionally, you can use your bonus action to attempt to frighten a creature within 30 feet of you that can see and hear you. The target must make aWisdomsaving throw (with a DC equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus + yourCharismamodifier) or befrightenedfor 1 minute. A creature has advantage on the saving throw if it has never heard of you before. Afrightenedtarget can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining the ability to do so when you finish a short or long rest.

Pirates and Plunder A Compendium For 5e © 2024 Published by Mythos Chronicles; Author Filippo Bardoscia

Predictive Defense.name: Predictive Defense
Predictive Defense.description: A small shuffle of a foot, a twitch in the claw of a monster, or the unskilled tactics of a group of bandits. You have learned to combine your instincts and intellect into perfect harmony. Onyour turn, you can use yourreactionto assume an anticipating stance. You can use yourreactionto add your intelligence modifier to your AC (minimum of one) until the start of your next turn.

Backstreet Brawler.name: Backstreet Brawler
Backstreet Brawler.description:
You deal 1d6 damage with improvised weapons, instead of 1d4 damage.
You are proficient with all improvised weapons, even ones that do not resemble weapons you are proficient with.
Your unarmed strikes deal 1d4 bludgeoning damage instead of 1.
When you are wielding an improvised weapon or are unarmed, you add your proficiency bonus to Dexterity checks for determining initiative order.

Superior Critical.name: Superior Critical
Superior Critical.description: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 18-20.

Arcanist.name: Arcanist
Arcanist.description:
Your mastery of the arcane arts allows you to conjure familiars of raw arcane power. You can expend a spell slot of 2nd level or higher in order to summon a number of arcane familiars equal to the level of the spell slot expended. All arcane familiars summoned this way must be of the same form, chosen from the following list: arcane motes, arcane wisps, arcane servitors, arcane darts, arcane wards, arcane eyes.

You can’t have more than one type of arcane familiar at a time. If you summon arcane familiars while you already have arcane familiars, their number changes to match that of the new spell slot used and you may cause them to adopt a new form.

Parting Shot.name: Parting Shot
Parting Shot.description:
You are an expert skirmisher, able to rain missiles upon your enemies as you retreat.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Frost Giant’s Fury.name: Frost Giant’s Fury
Frost Giant’s Fury.description:
As a bonus action during your turn, you can touch a simple or martial weapon and infuse it with the power of cold. For the next minute, the weapon deals an extra 1d6 cold damage when it hits. After you use this bonus action, you can’t do so again until you finish a short or a long rest.
When you take cold damage, you can use your reaction to grant yourself immunity to that instance of damage. You can use this reaction once, and you regain the ability to do so after you finish a long rest.

Spirited Charge.name: Spirited Charge
Spirited Charge.description:
Your mounted charge attacks are capable of dealing a tremendous amount of damage.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Siege Engineer.name: Siege Engineer
Siege Engineer.description:
Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
When you fire a siege weapon, it does not suffer a mishap on a roll of 1.
When you aim a siege weapon, you gain advantage on any intelligence checks to aim.

Darkvision.name: Darkvision
Darkvision.description: NoteInfernal feats are first gained by taking the Infernal Pact feat. This feat ties a character to a Circle’s particular lord. If the character is not from that Circle, the Circle is considered his “home” Circle from that point on. The feats available to a character are determined by his home Circle—a character cannot take infernal feats that are not listed as tied to a Circle.

Drag Down.name: Drag Down
Drag Down.description:
When you are knockedprone, you are skilled at bringing your opponent down with you.

Battlemasters & Berserkers © 2021, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

Uncanny Dodge.name: Uncanny Dodge
Uncanny Dodge.description:
You can use yourreactionto gainresistanceagainst oneattackfrom a creature that you can see.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Poison Mastery.name: Poison Mastery
Poison Mastery.description:
You add double your proficiency bonus on any checks relating to a poisoner’s kit or using a poison.
When you make a weapon attack with a piercing or slashing weapon, you can apply an injury poison (such as a basic poison), without using an action. The poison must be reasonably accessible (in hand, in a belt pouch, in a vial kept around your neck, using a customized weapon with a poison channel, et cetera).
If you score a critical hit with a poisoned weapon, a creature that fails its saving throw takes double damage from the poison.

Sleeper in Dust.name: Sleeper in Dust
Sleeper in Dust.description:
Sand Sense. You gain Tremorsense with a range of 5 feet, or 10 feet if you areProne. If you are Hidden by Dust, the range increases to 10 feet and 20 feet, respectively.

Ancient Tombs (5E) © 2025, Legendary Games; Authors Alex Riggs, Anthony Adam, Jason Nelson, Loren Sieg, and Robert J. Grady

Draw Forth The Life.name: Draw Forth The Life
Draw Forth The Life.description:
Benefit(s): Increase yourStrengthorConstitutionby 1, to a maximum of 20. If your biteattackdrops an opponent to0 hit points, you gaintemporary hit pointsequal to the amount of damage you inflicted.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Charming Smile.name: Charming Smile
Charming Smile.description: Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Accomplished Dredger.name: Accomplished Dredger
Accomplished Dredger.description:
Benefit(s): Increase yourIntelligenceby 1 to a maximum of 20. You learn an additional language. If you can castconjure elementalthen you may cast it with a 5th-level spell slot instead of a 6th with no changes to the spell, and you may cast it as anActionas long as you are conjuring an Earthelemental.

Guilds of Sundara © 2022, eGDC Ltd; Author: Neal Litherland

Tactical Commander.name: Tactical Commander
Tactical Commander.description:
You can direct your allies toattackat opportune moments. Onyour turn, you can use yourattackto shout instructions to one ally that can see and hear you. That ally can immediately use theirreactionto make a weaponattack, adding yourIntelligencemodifier to theattackroll.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Deep One Toughness.name: Deep One Toughness
Deep One Toughness.description:
Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain bulging eyes that grant you darkvision 60 ft. If you already had darkvision, its range increases by 30 feet.
Your skin is thick and scaled, so that your AC without armor is equal to 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

True Disguise.name: True Disguise
True Disguise.description:
Benefit(s): Your Disguise racial ability lets you castalter selfat will instead ofdisguise self. You may still castdisguise selfon yourself if you so choose. You do not need to keep concentration on the spell if you only use the Change Appearance portion ofalter self. YourCharismascore increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Distant Spell (Meta Magic).name: Distant Spell (Meta Magic)
Distant Spell (Meta Magic).description:
Druids of the Arcane Circle have exclusive access to metamagic feats. Rather than taking the Ability Score Improvement feature at 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th and 19th level, they can choose this feat.

When youcast a spellthat has a range of 5 feet or greater, you can spend 1 sorcery point to double the range of the spell.

When youcast a spellthat has a range of touch, you can spend 1 sorcery point to make the range of the spell 30 feet.

Deep Elven Adept.name: Deep Elven Adept
Deep Elven Adept.description:
You learned to use your magic to prowl caves undetected. You can cast thesilent imagespell at will, without needing a material component. You useCharismaas the spellcasting ability for this spell. You can also cast theinvisibilityspell once. You regain the ability to cast this spell when you finish a short orlong rest.

If you belong to a spellcasting class, you addinvisibilityandsilent imageto your spells known or prepared. They are class spells for you and don’t count against the number of spells you know or can have prepared.

Scarred Lands Player’s Guide © 2016 Onyx Path Publishing Authors: Bill Ashbless, Jason Bolte, Chris Cowger, Adam Eichelberger, Alain Giorla, Nathan Knaack, Chris Sims, Eddy Webb

Arcane Siphon.name: Arcane Siphon
Arcane Siphon.description: You learn to siphon vitality from the magic you wield. Whenever youcast a spellof 1st level or higher, you gaintemporary hit pointsequal to the spell’s level, lasting for 1 minute.

Thrown Weapons Master.name: Thrown Weapons Master
Thrown Weapons Master.description:
Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Simple and martial melee weapons without the thrown property can be treated as if they have the thrown property. One-handed weapons have a range of 20/60, while two-handed weapons have a range of 15/30.
Weapons that naturally have the thrown property increase their range by +20/+40.

Water Maker.name: Water Maker
Water Maker.description:
You’ve studied with the divine casters who keep desert cities supplied with water, and you’ve learned to copy their tricks. You gain the following benefits.

Water Source. You always haveCreate or Destroy Waterprepared and can cast it using any spell slots you have. You may castCreate or Destroy Waterwithout using a spell slot a number of times per day equal to your Proficiency Bonus. ChooseCharisma,Wisdom, orIntelligenceas your spellcasting ability for this feat. A Long Rest restores all uses. Water Miracle. By expending two uses of Water Source, you can castControl Waterinstead.

The Dragon’s Hoard #60 © 2025, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Darrin Drader, Robert J. Grady, Kate Baker, Joel Flank, Wren Brown, James-Levi Cooke.

Friend of the Forest.name: Friend of the Forest
Friend of the Forest.description: Tome of Heroes ©2022 Open Design LLC; Authors: Celeste Conowitch, Jeff Lee, Sarah Madsen, Ben McFarland, Kelly Pawlik, Brian Suskind

Opportunist.name: Opportunist
Opportunist.description: You are constantly aware of the battlefield around you, honing this awareness into lethal prowess. When a creature within 5 feet of you takes damage from anattack, you may use yourreactionto make amelee attackagainst the damaged creature.

Elemental Aegis.name: Elemental Aegis
Elemental Aegis.description:
Increase yourConstitutionby 1, to a maximum of 20.

As areactionwhen you take acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage, you can grant yourself a ward that reduces the damage by an amount equal to half your level (rounded down, minimum one) + yourConstitutionmodifier.

Pervasive Necrosis.name: Pervasive Necrosis
Pervasive Necrosis.description: Rot festers deep within your soul. Damage you deal with an attack, spell, or other feature ignoresresistanceto necrotic damage. Additionally, when you roll for necrotic damage, you can reroll one of the dice and choose either result.

Perilous Casting.name: Perilous Casting
Perilous Casting.description:
You have learned a controversial technique for over-channeling your life force into the spells you cast.

5E: Age of Antiquity Adventure and Intrigue in the Ancient World © 2019 Aruzian Publishing, Stephen Delucchi, Marcus Lundin

Fortuitous.name: Fortuitous
Fortuitous.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Steadfast Companion.name: Steadfast Companion
Steadfast Companion.description: If an ally within 10 feet of you suffers damage from anattackwhile you are subject to movement restrictions caused by physical means, such as binding with chain or thegrappledcondition, you instead may use areactionto immediately roll the appropriate check to see if you remove the restriction. If you succeed on your check, you may choose to move as per Steadfast Companion on your next turn.

Intuitive Combatant.name: Intuitive Combatant
Intuitive Combatant.description:
You gain one bonus combat talent.
Whenever you finish a long rest, you may replace one combat talent you know with a different combat talent.

Point-Blank Shot.name: Point-Blank Shot
Point-Blank Shot.description:
You are especially accurate when makingranged attacksagainst close targets.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Rampage.name: Rampage
Rampage.description: When you reduce a creature to0 hit pointswith a weaponmelee attack, you gain one extraattackuntil the end ofyour turn. You cannot gain a number of extra attacks from this feat higher than your proficiency bonus on the same turn.

Alter Self.name: Alter Self
Alter Self.description: NoteInfernal feats are first gained by taking the Infernal Pact feat. This feat ties a character to a Circle’s particular lord. If the character is not from that Circle, the Circle is considered his “home” Circle from that point on. The feats available to a character are determined by his home Circle—a character cannot take infernal feats that are not listed as tied to a Circle.

Taunt.name: Taunt
Taunt.description:
Your vicious words infuriate others.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Combat Dabbler.name: Combat Dabbler
Combat Dabbler.description:
Increase one ability score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain a bonus martial talent.

Hulking.name: Hulking
Hulking.description: Even among your people, you are massive. Your incrediblesizemeans you wear bigger armor, carry bigger weapons, and eat bigger meals. In order to remain balanced, this feat relies on the GM enforcing food and water requirements, as well as reasonable size restrictions on stealth and movement in tight spaces.

Breaker.name: Breaker
Breaker.description:
You gain a +5 bonus on attack rolls against objects and Strength checks made to break objects.
When you attack a creature, you can take a -5 penalty to the attack roll and aim for its extremities. If you hit, the creature suffers one level of exhaustion unless it is immune to that condition. A creature can’t die from exhaustion in this way.

Reserved and Insular.name: Reserved and Insular
Reserved and Insular.description:
Benefit(s): As a bonus action, the lava gnome can spend two Hit Dice to use their Pyromancer ability twice when targeting the same opponent with a double fire bolt blast.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Theologist.name: Theologist
