Theologist.description:
Increase yourIntelligence,WisdomorCharismascore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gain proficiency in theReligionskill. If you are already proficient in the skill, you add double your proficiency bonus to checks you make with it.

You learn a cantrip from theclericspell list, and thedetect evil and goodspell. You can castdetect evil and goodonce without expending a spell slot, and you regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest.

Barfly.name: Barfly
Barfly.description:
When you are poisoned, you do not have disadvantage on attack rolls, and you have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.
You have advantage on ability checks associated with gambling games.
Mist and fog, magical or not, hamper your vision less than normal. You suffer no negative effects from a lightly obscured area, and a heavily obscured area only gives you disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.
You are a veritable night owl, with the vision to match.
You gain darkvision out to a range of 30 feet. If you already have darkvision, its range increases by 30 feet.
You have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks contested by a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) or Dexterity (Stealth) check.

Battleborn Swiftness.name: Battleborn Swiftness
Battleborn Swiftness.description:
Benefit(s): As a bonus action, you may expend a hit die and take theDashaction. As areaction, you may expend a hit die and gain a +1 bonus to your AC.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Mountain’s Endurance.name: Mountain’s Endurance
Mountain’s Endurance.description:
Your Constitution score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You have resistance to poison damage, and advantage on saving throws against being poisoned. Each time you finish a short rest, you can remove one level of exhaustion affecting you (if any).

Giant-foe.name: Giant-foe
Giant-foe.description:
Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You do not have disadvantage on attack rolls using weapons with the heavy tag.
When a giant scores a critical hit against you, it deals no additional damage.

Crystalline Resolve.name: Crystalline Resolve
Crystalline Resolve.description:
Increase yourConstitutionorWisdomscore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gainresistanceto psychic damage. Additionally, as areactionwhen you take damage, you can crystallize your skin, granting youresistanceto that instance of damage. Once you use this ability, you can’t use it again until you complete a short or long rest.

Sea Dog.name: Sea Dog
Sea Dog.description:
Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency with any one of the following weapons: club, dagger, handaxe, light crossbow, net, shortbow, shortsword, spear, or whip.
You gain proficiency in the Nature skill, and your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make with that skill regarding coastlines, islands, or weather.
You gain proficiency with any two of the following tools: carpenter’s tools, cook’s utensils, navigator’s tools, vehicles (water), or any one type of musical instrument.
You have advantage on Acrobatics checks made to keep your balance and on Athletics checks made to climb.

Elemental Inurement.name: Elemental Inurement
Elemental Inurement.description:
For a long time, you have been exposed to a hostile element, for example by living in a polar region. After years of enduring this element, you have become exceptionally-and perhaps supernaturally-resistant to it.

You can take this feat several times, with a different type of damage every time.

Divine Stench.name: Divine Stench
Divine Stench.description:
You gain 1 additional use of Channel Divinity per rest.

When you Channel Divinity, as a bonus action you can cause an infernal reek to belch forth from your unholy symbol. Living creatures other than fiends adjacent to you have must succeed aConstitutionsave against your spell save DC or bepoisonedfor 1 round.

You must finish a short rest before you may use this ability again. After using it a second time in one day, you must finish a long rest before you may use it again.

The Dragon’s Hoard #45© 2024, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Darren Drader, Robert J. Grady, Nicholas Hite, Matt Kimmel

Grappler.name: Grappler
Grappler.description:
You have advantage on attack rolls against a creature you are grappling.
You can use your action to try to pin a creature grappled by you. To do so, make another grapple check. If you succeed, you and the creature are both restrained until the grapple ends.

Disengaging Flourish.name: Disengaging Flourish
Disengaging Flourish.description:
Distracting your opponents gives you the opportunity to make a swift retreat.

Battlemasters & Berserkers © 2021, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

Burning Thunder of Omnikinesis.name: Burning Thunder of Omnikinesis
Burning Thunder of Omnikinesis.description:
From within the blazing heart of the storm, you can fold lightning into a torrent of caustic, deep-stone chemicals; you may twist glittering ice into raging steam and terrible flame; you may bend the fundamental forces of the universe into alien shapes as you desire and back again, as you see fit.

You may choose, as areaction, to change damage that deals acid, cold, electricity, or fire damage, to one of the other three energy types. Any non-damaging effects remain unchanged unless the new energy type invalidates them; such effects are subject to GM discretion.

You can use this ability a number of times per day equal to 3 + yourConstitutionmodifier.

The Dragon’s Hoard #25 © 2022, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Robert J. Grady, Darrin Drader, James-Levi Cooke.

Triumph of the Will.name: Triumph of the Will
Triumph of the Will.description:
You can proficiency in the Intimidation skill, or double proficiency if already proficient.
When you make a Charisma (Intimidation) check to try forcing a creature to act friendly toward your or comply with your requests, the effect lasts for 1d6 hours, plus one hour for every point by which your check exceeds the DC.
Alternatively, you can attempt to force a number of creatures equal to your Charisma modifier to act friendly toward you for 1d6 minutes. Have the target creature with the highest Wisdom saving throw bonus (or Charisma (Intimidation) modifier, if proficient in it) roll d20 and add that modifier, plus 1 for every 2 creatures you try to affect, rounding down. Using that as the DC, make a Charisma (Intimidation) check, and if you succeed increase the duration by one minute for every point by which your check exceeds the DC. All creatures to be affected must be within 30 feet.

Medium Armor Expertise.name: Medium Armor Expertise
Medium Armor Expertise.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Alchemist.name: Alchemist
Alchemist.description:
You learn the forbidden art of creating life through alchemy. Using 10 gp of alchemical reagents and an alchemist’s kit, you can grow 1d4 + 1 creatures in jars as a light activity during a long rest, chosen from the following list: containedfetal horror jar, green ooze, pickled watcher, preserved flayer mind, sanguine lamprey vial, suspended metamorphic nymph, twisted abomination bottle.

You may only have 5 such alchemical jars prepared at a time. Any jars created in excess of 5 are inert and have no effect.

Wondrous item, uncommon

As an action, you can throw this jar up to 20 feet to an unoccupied square, shattering it on impact. A fetal horror emerges from the shattered jar. Rollinitiativefor the creature, which has its own turns. It obeys any verbal commands that you issue to it (no action required by you). At the end of each of the creature’s turns, it makes aCharismasaving throw. On a failed save, the creature continues to obey you. On a successful save, your control of the creature ends and the creature mayattackor flee.

From the eyestalk of a watcher, a pygmy is grown in a sealed jar of swirling blue alchemical fluid. The dead eyes and slack-jawed mouth, filled with needlelike teeth, bob in the murky arcane liquid. These jars are often ornate, fastened with double lids: one for consuming the fluid, and a second for removing the shriveled, bloated watcher within.

If the fluid around the watcher is consumed, the imbiber is granted true sight, the ability to see the nature of things and pierce all illusions. However, the mortal eye was not meant to bear the intensity of this gaze for long. Consuming the liquid makes the imbiber sensitive to the sun and other bright lights. As the effects of the elixir fade, vision may fade with it, leaving the imbiber blind. Normal sight eventually returns for most, though some have gone truly blind from consuming too much of the pickled watcher’s elixir.

When you drink this potion you gain truesight and sunlight sensitivity for 10 minutes. After 10 minutes you must succeed on a DC 13Constitutionsaving throw or beblindedfor 1 hour.

Proper potions of healing, sanctioned by the alchemists guild, cost an enormous sum for the common man. Fifty gold pieces, though affordable for an adventurer flush with treasure from plundered hoards, is far beyond the reach of most ordinary folk. Many turn to back-alley alchemists or blackmarket dealers for sanguine elixirs. These cheap replacements are consumed by sick commoners, wounded soldiers, and injured mercenaries. They are often made poorly, and the odds of sickness from the worms is exacerbated by the unskilled hands of the alchemist who created them.

Blackmarket Potions. Though alchemists failed at creating true fae, the result was not without some aspects of faerie power. The dust that glitters in the rosy waters of the elixir is fairy dust, a powerful intoxicant and aphrodisiac. Those who drink such a potion are swept up in the wild magic of the fey, charmed by all creatures they encounter. It heightens natural attraction, and often leads to the imbiber thinking they have fallen in love. Beyond simply being a love potion for the imbiber, it also suffuses them with an aura of powerful pheromones, causing the creatures around them to be similarly enthralled by the potion’s effects. These potions are often sold as blackmarket love potions, with this particular side-effect omitted during the bartering.

When you drink this potion you gain advantage to allIntelligenceandWisdomskill checks for 1 hour. After 1 hour you must succeed on a DC 13Wisdomsaving throw or suffer 1d4 psychic damage and the effects of a short-term madness.

Toughness.name: Toughness
Toughness.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Robust Genealogy.name: Robust Genealogy
Robust Genealogy.description:
Your body is harder and stronger than the average tiefling, having a rockier or more gemlike texture.

YourStrengthorConstitutionscore increases by 1, to a maximum of 20. When you are unarmored and would take piercing, slashing, or bludgeoning damage, the damage of these types you take is reduced by an amount equal to your proficiency bonus.

Observant Heart.name: Observant Heart
Observant Heart.description:
Increase Charisma or Wisdom by 1 point to a maximum of 20.
No matter which ability score increased, you may claim advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) and Wisdom (Insight) checks.

Fox Form.name: Fox Form
Fox Form.description:
Benefit(s): As an action, you are able to transform into a fox. You keep your ability scores andhit points, but turn Tiny sized and lose the ability to speak any language(s) while in this form. In fox form, you are able to communicate with animals as if under a constantspeak with animalsspell. This does not improve their disposition towards you. YourWisdomscore increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Spirit Medium.name: Spirit Medium
Spirit Medium.description:
Your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
While you are touching an object or within 10 feet of a location you can see, you can use an action to learn how many creatures have died while touching the object or while within 10 feet of the location. You also gain a general sense of how each creature died, its identity, and how long ago it died.
You can cast speak with dead, but only as a ritual. When you cast it in this way, you can only ask the corpse 3 questions. Once you do so, you can’t do so again until you finish a long rest.

Glacier of Hate.name: Glacier of Hate
Glacier of Hate.description:
You burn with slow, chill wrath; you strike with the power of a screaming ice-storm. You breathe with the strength of cold murder in the night; your voice is frozen agony in pitiless winter. Your blood flows with that shattered numbness known only to the doomed and dying as their extremities crackle and fall off—one by one—blackened & shriveled.

When dealing cold damage, your Divine Smite does not deal additional damage to undead or fiends, instead, the damage increases by 1d8 if the target is a beast or plant, to a maximum of 6d8.

Legendary Classes: Templars & Tyrants© 2023, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Darrin Drader, Miguel Colon, Clinton J. Boomer, Amber Scott

Forbidden Techniques.name: Forbidden Techniques
Forbidden Techniques.description:
You learn one cantrip from the Wizard or Warlock spell list. Your spellcasting ability for this cantrip is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (your choice).
When you take the Attack action, you can forgo one of your attacks to cast a cantrip with a casting time of 1 action.

Twisted Flesh.name: Twisted Flesh
Twisted Flesh.description:
You were once afflicted by a tainted plague, but rather than bringing death, you recovered with a strange alteration to your physical form.

You gain a +1 natural armor bonus to AC and also gaindamage resistanceto cold, fire, or lightning. The hideous appearance of your corrupted and scarred flesh also grants you advantage onCharisma(Intimidation) checks. However, you have disadvantage on all otherCharismabased skill checks andCharisma-based skill checks, and disadvantage onConstitutionsaves. You have natural immunity to any tainted plague from your native wounded land.

You must select this feat as a 1st-level character.

The Dragon’s Hoard #26© 2022, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Robert J. Grady, Darrin Drader, James-Levi Cooke.

Ship Sage.name: Ship Sage
Ship Sage.description: ends if you spend more than one month away from your ship or if you familiarize yourself with another ship.

Tundra Walker.name: Tundra Walker
Tundra Walker.description:
Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You are adapted to cold environments, allowing you to automatically succeed on Constitution saving throws to avoid exhaustion while traveling through regions where the temperature is at or below 0 degrees Fahrenheit.
If the frostbite and hypothermia conditions are used, you automatically succeed on saving throws against nonmagical sources of them.
You can move on slippery ice as though it were normal terrain.
You do not contribute to the total weight when calculating the weight tolerance of thin ice you are moving across.

Metamagic Activator.name: Metamagic Activator
Metamagic Activator.description:
You can apply any metamagic ability you possess to items that allow you to cast spells. Activating the metamagic still requires sorcery points.

Breath of Life: The Beguiler (5e), © 2024, Orphaned Bookworm Productions, LLC, Authors: Connor Bates and Norman Mitchell Jr.

Deathbound.name: Deathbound
Deathbound.description:
Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
When you make a death saving throw, you can roll with advantage.
When you reduce a creature to 0 hit points, you can choose to regain a number of hit points equal to your Constitution modifier. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining any expended uses when you finish a long rest.

Invisibility.name: Invisibility
Invisibility.description: NoteInfernal feats are first gained by taking the Infernal Pact feat. This feat ties a character to a Circle’s particular lord. If the character is not from that Circle, the Circle is considered his “home” Circle from that point on. The feats available to a character are determined by his home Circle—a character cannot take infernal feats that are not listed as tied to a Circle.

Sea Legs.name: Sea Legs
Sea Legs.description: Battlemasters & Berserkers © 2021, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

Gunner’s Precision.name: Gunner’s Precision
Gunner’s Precision.description:
Your experience with firearms grants you exceptional precision. Attacking at long range doesn’t impose disadvantage on yourattackrolls with firearms. Additionally, your attacks made with firearms score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

Pirates and Plunder A Compendium For 5e © 2024 Published by Mythos Chronicles; Author Filippo Bardoscia

Heavenly Scribe.name: Heavenly Scribe
Heavenly Scribe.description:
You learn the Celestial language if you don’t already know it.
You learn one angelic seal of your choice from among those available to the Angelic Scribe arcane tradition. If it requires a saving throw, your DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Intelligence modifier.

Wayfaring Soul.name: Wayfaring Soul
Wayfaring Soul.description:
Your Wisdom score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You have advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to navigate any terrain.
You always know how much time has passed and what direction you are facing.
You can spend 1 minute consulting the spirits, learning both the safest and the most direct route to a location within 10 miles of you. Alternatively, you can learn the location of the nearest portal to another plane within 1 mile of you.

Gunnery.name: Gunnery
Gunnery.description: You gain proficiency with carpenter’s tools or smith’s tools, and you may use an action to perform field repairs with the appropriate tools, which repair 1d6hit pointsof damage sustained by siege equipment. You can use this ability again after a short orlong rest.

Blaggard.name: Blaggard
Blaggard.description:
You gain proficiency with the Charisma (Intimidation) skill.
When you make a Charisma (Intimidation) skill check against a good aligned character, you add double your proficiency bonus to the check.
You can, in a city or town, maintain a comfortable lifestyle by extorting the local populace. This counts as practicing a profession as a downtime activity.

Giant’s Wrath.name: Giant’s Wrath
Giant’s Wrath.description:
Your strength rivals that of the ancient giants.

Increase yourStrengthorConstitutionscore by 1, to a maximum of 20. Additionally, when you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can add yourStrengthorConstitutionmodifier (the one increased by this feat) to the damage roll. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain any expended uses when you finish a short or a long rest.

Unlocked Limbic System.name: Unlocked Limbic System
Unlocked Limbic System.description:
Incredibly small evil creatures from another dimension have crawled inside your skull, attaching all over your limbic system to enhance its neural activity.

Book of Exalted Darkness. © 2018 Mike Myler, published under license by Legendary Games.

Bonded Monster.name: Bonded Monster
Bonded Monster.description:
Though their adult counterparts are often evil or destructive, these young creatures can learn and grow alongside their new family, becoming something more. Many of these creatures are orphaned, lost, or abandoned. It falls to you to become their guardian, their companion. They can be trained to use their unique abilities to aid and protect you in battle, and even grow alongside you as you progress together through your adventures.

You call forth a magical creature from the wilderness to serve as your faithful companion. This companion is loyal to you, follows your verbal commands, and takes its turn immediately after yours. It understands the languages you understand but can’t speak. The creature can only take theDash,Disengage,Dodge,Hide, orHelpactionsunless you use your action onyour turnto command it to take a specific action, such as theAttackaction. It may move and take bonusactionsandreactionsas normal. If your companion is slain, the magical bond you share allows you to return it to life. As a light activity during a long rest, you may spend 10 gp worth of rare herbs to call your companion’s spirit, which restores your companion to life with all itshit pointsat your location at the end of the rest. You can return your companion to life in this way using the magic of your bond even if its body is lost or destroyed.

When you take this feat, choose one of the following creatures to be your companion: basilisk whelp, blink dog pup, displacer cub, dragon hatchling, ember runt, flailing snailing, phoenix fledgling, or pygmy watcher.

Flames of the Heart.name: Flames of the Heart
Flames of the Heart.description: Flames of the Heart lasts for a minimum of 1 round, plus as many additional rounds as yourWisdommodifier.

Ruin Survivor.name: Ruin Survivor
Ruin Survivor.description:
Benefit(s): Increase yourConstitutionorWisdomscore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gain proficiency in theSurvivalskill. If you are already proficient in this skill, you gain expertise in it, meaning you can add double your proficiency bonus to checks made with this skill. Additionally, once per long rest, you can intensely focus to gain a +5 bonus on a singleSurvivalcheck.

Blind Fight.name: Blind Fight
Blind Fight.description: As long as at least one of your other senses can be used to perceive the environment, you gain blindsight up to a range of 10 feet. In addition, you do not suffer disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures as a result of them being hidden from you.

Blood Frenzy.name: Blood Frenzy
Blood Frenzy.description: end, including the temporary hit points. You must complete a short rest before you can enter a frenzy again.

Nimble Fingers.name: Nimble Fingers
Nimble Fingers.description:
Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain a +2 bonus to Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks, as well as to checks to pick locks, craft, arm, or disarm a trap, tie up a creature or object, and any other non-combat action that calls upon your fine motor skills (at the GM’s discretion).

Defensive Combat Training.name: Defensive Combat Training
Defensive Combat Training.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Brawling.name: Brawling
Brawling.description:
You are skilled at fighting while unarmed.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Powder Monkey.name: Powder Monkey
Powder Monkey.description:
You’ve spent countless hours handling gunpowder and firearms. You gain proficiency with pistols or muskets (your choice). Additionally, when you use your action to reload a firearm, you can make one weaponattackwith that firearm as a bonus action.

Pirates and Plunder A Compendium For 5e © 2024 Published by Mythos Chronicles; Author Filippo Bardoscia

Deceptive Exchange.name: Deceptive Exchange
Deceptive Exchange.description:
You trick an adversary into grabbing an object you hand them, even in the midst of combat.

Battlemasters & Berserkers © 2021, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

Magical Reminiscence.name: Magical Reminiscence
Magical Reminiscence.description:
Increase the score of your spellcasting ability by 1, to a maximum of 20.
At any time, you can add a spell to your list of prepared spells (no action required). This spell must be among the spells you know (spellbook for wizards, class list for other classes). You can then cast the added spell normally, by spending the necessary casting time, components, and spell slot. This benefit lasts until you finish a long rest. Every time you use this benefit, you take a level of exhaustion.

Strike Back.name: Strike Back
Strike Back.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Soul of Battle.name: Soul of Battle
Soul of Battle.description:
for a number of rounds equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum of 1):
You do an additional 2 damage on melee weapon attacks.
You gain a bonus to your AC equal to your proficiency bonus.
You cannot be paralyzed or stunned.
You must finish a long rest before you can use this feature again.

Mage Killer.name: Mage Killer
Mage Killer.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Lycanthrope Slayer.name: Lycanthrope Slayer
Lycanthrope Slayer.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Close Quarters Combat.name: Close Quarters Combat
Close Quarters Combat.description: Benefit(s): When you either successfully grapple a creature or break free of a grapple, you may make a melee weaponattackagainst the creature as abonus action. Additionally, if a creature attempts to grapple you and fails, you may use yourreactionto make amelee attackagainst it and move 5 feet away without provoking opportunity attacks.

Bladed Deflection.name: Bladed Deflection
Bladed Deflection.description: When attacked with a ranged weapon, you can use yourreactionto attempt to deflect the damage. Roll a d20. If the roll is less than the total of theattackroll of theranged attack, you fail. If it is higher than the total of theranged attackroll, you take half damage from theattack. If the roll is equal to the total of theranged attackroll, you split the projectile in half and take no damage. This can only be used on non-magical attacks and weaponry.

Unlucky.name: Unlucky
Unlucky.description: You have 5 unlucky points. Whenever a creature within 30 feet of you makes anattackroll, ability check, or saving throw, you can spend an unlucky point to roll an additional d20. You can do this after the creature rolls the die, but before the outcome is known. You choose which d20 rolls to use for the action. A creature can combat your unlucky dice with their own lucky rolls, or vice versa, cancelling each other out. When you use this feat against a creature, you bestow your bad luck onto them for 1 minute and alleviate it from yourself. You no longer have critical failures on a 1 or 2 but the target does. You regain a single unlucky point when you roll a critical failure and regain all expended unlucky points when you finish a long rest.

Psionic Tracker.name: Psionic Tracker
Psionic Tracker.description:
Benefit(s): As part of an action, you may expend a Hit Die and gain advantage on allWisdom(Survival) skill checks to track creatures with a living mind. This sense is not blocked by water, wood, or soil, but the bonus is negated if the target is shielded in solid stone or thick metal.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

March of Will.name: March of Will
March of Will.description:
You may increase your Constitution score by 1 to a maximum of 20.
Once per short rest, if you would otherwise gain a level of exhaustion due to environmental effect or spell, you may ignore it.

Necroharmonic.name: Necroharmonic
Necroharmonic.description:
By channeling the power of the negative energy plane, you can briefly cause a creature you hit with an unarmed strike to be overwhelmed by necrotic energy, suffering from the damaging effects of theinflict woundsspell. This does not count as a magical effect or spell.

You can invoke this effect a number of times per day equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining spent uses when you complete a long rest. When you use this feature, you may expend one or more additional use of this feature to increase the damage by 1d10 each.

Herculean Sharpshooter.name: Herculean Sharpshooter
Herculean Sharpshooter.description:
Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
When you make an attack with a ranged weapon, you can choose to use your Strength modifier instead of Dexterity for the attack and damage roll.
Attacking at long range doesn’t impose disadvantage on your ranged weapon attack rolls.
Your ranged weapon attacks ignore half and threequarters cover.

Tiger’s Intuition.name: Tiger’s Intuition
Tiger’s Intuition.description:
Benefit(s): Gain proficiency inSleight of Hand,PerceptionandInsight. If you are already trained in any of those skills, you gain a +2 bonus on checks for them. Raise your passivePerceptionby +5. You cannot besurprisedas long as you are conscious.

Guilds of Sundara © 2022, eGDC Ltd; Author: Neal Litherland

Hemomancy Adept.name: Hemomancy Adept
Hemomancy Adept.description: Your study or innate connection to the life essence of blood allows you to channel additional power in your blood magic. Spells you cast ignoreresistanceto necrotic damage, and treat immunity to necrotic damage asresistance.

Giant Slayer.name: Giant Slayer
Giant Slayer.description: When you hit a Large or bigger creature with a melee weapon attack, you can deal an extra 1d4 damage of the type associated with your weapon (e.g., slashing, piercing, or bludgeoning).

Bless Feast.name: Bless Feast
Bless Feast.description: from a special blessing which lasts for 24 hours. While under the effect of this blessing, a character has advantage on death saving throws and saving throws against fear, provided they are within at least 60 feet of someone else with whom they shared the meal.

Winged Flight.name: Winged Flight
Winged Flight.description:
Benefit(s): You no longer fall at the end ofyour turnif you are flying due to your Flight racial ability. YourDexterityscore increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Bloodbound Adept.name: Bloodbound Adept
Bloodbound Adept.description:
You learn the blood bolt cantrip. Your spellcasting ability for this cantrip is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (your choice).
When you are below half your hit point maximum, the damage of your necrotic spells increases by an amount equal to your proficiency bonus. This effect can occur only once per spell cast.

Silver Resistance.name: Silver Resistance
Silver Resistance.description: Through exposure and conditioning, you have developed a tolerance to silver. Increase yourConstitutionscore by 1, to a maximum of 20. In addition, you have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing and slashing damage from attacks made with silvered weapons.

Fangs.name: Fangs
Fangs.description: NoteInfernal feats are first gained by taking the Infernal Pact feat. This feat ties a character to a Circle’s particular lord. If the character is not from that Circle, the Circle is considered his “home” Circle from that point on. The feats available to a character are determined by his home Circle—a character cannot take infernal feats that are not listed as tied to a Circle.

Imp’s Eye.name: Imp’s Eye
Imp’s Eye.description:
You gain darkvision 60 feet. If you already have darkvision it increases by 60 feet.
Magical darkness does not impede your vision.
You are at disadvantage when making non-Intimidation Charisma ability checks against creatures that are not evil and able to see you.

Flameheart Courage.name: Flameheart Courage
Flameheart Courage.description:
Increase yourCharismaorConstitutionscore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You have advantage on saving throws against beingfrightened. In addition, as a bonus action, you can invoke the power of your inner flame to shed bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. This light lasts for 1 minute or until you dismiss it as a bonus action. Creatures in the bright light have a +2 to saving throw against spells or effects that would frighten them.

Hunter of the Damned.name: Hunter of the Damned
Hunter of the Damned.description:
Increase your Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain access to the Turn Undead cleric feature. Your saving throw DC for this feature equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Wisdom modifier. Once used, you must finish a short or long rest to use it again.
You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened by undead.

Broken Wing Gambit.name: Broken Wing Gambit
Broken Wing Gambit.description:
You feign weakness, making yourself a tempting and distracting target.

Battlemasters & Berserkers © 2021, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

Elemental Focus.name: Elemental Focus
Elemental Focus.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Improved Flight (General).name: Improved Flight (General)
Improved Flight (General).description:
NoteInfernal feats are first gained by taking the Infernal Pact feat. This feat ties a character to a Circle’s particular lord. If the character is not from that Circle, the Circle is considered his “home” Circle from that point on. The feats available to a character are determined by his home Circle—a character cannot take infernal feats that are not listed as tied to a Circle.

You sprout bat-like wings. With your wings, you have a flying speed of 20 feet if you aren’t wearing heavy armor and aren’t exceeding your carrying capacity.

Assassin’s Grace.name: Assassin’s Grace
Assassin’s Grace.description: Breath of Life - The Scout (5e)© 2024, Orphaned Bookworm Productions; Authors: Norman Mitchell Jr. and Connor Bates

Minor Magic.name: Minor Magic
Minor Magic.description: Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Deva Wings.name: Deva Wings
Deva Wings.description:
Large, magnificent wings made from feathers of gold sprout out of your shoulder blades, allowing you to both soar through the skies and call on celestial energies to smite your foes.

Book of Exalted Darkness. © 2018 Mike Myler, published under license by Legendary Games.

Mental Haze.name: Mental Haze
Mental Haze.description:
As an action, you can cause up to 3 creatures within 30 feet of you to feel sharp mental pain that pulls their attention from their surroundings. Those creatures must attempt aWisdomsaving throw. On a failure, they have disadvantage on the nextattackroll, ability check, or saving throw they make within 1 minute.

The DC for thisWisdomsave is equal to 8 + yourCharismamodifier + your proficiency bonus.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining spent uses when you complete a long rest.

Composite Bow Master.name: Composite Bow Master
Composite Bow Master.description:
Increase your Strength or Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You have proficiency with the longbow and the great bow.
When you wield a longbow or a great bow, that weaponâs normal damage becomes 1d10 piercing and you can add your Strength modifier to the damage instead of Dexterity.
 
Copyright Notice
See the full license for this page

Conjunctive Attunement.name: Conjunctive Attunement
Conjunctive Attunement.description: As a result of this technique, you can be attuned to a maximum of four magical items, rather than the normal limit of three. Other attunement limitations still apply.

Forgiving Cheekbones.name: Forgiving Cheekbones
Forgiving Cheekbones.description:
You have advantage on skill checks made to convince others that you are in fact a living halfling, child or gnome.
You gain tool proficiency with disguise kits. If you already have tool proficiency with disguise kits, you instead add twice your proficiency bonus to ability checks made to create disguises.

Wyrmblooded Paragon.name: Wyrmblooded Paragon
Wyrmblooded Paragon.description:
Choose one subtype of draaki to which you currently do not belong from the Draaki Heritage table. You gain the Breath Weapon or Other Abilities of the draaki subtype as well as their Draaki Resistance. You are treated as belonging to both subtypes of draaki.
You may use each of your breath weapons, if you have one breath weapon or more, one additional time before requiring a short or long rest to recharge.
You may take this feat multiple times. Each time you take it, you choose another draaki subtype, gaining the benefits associated. The effects stack.

Doomsday Prepper.name: Doomsday Prepper
Doomsday Prepper.description:
Benefit(s): Increase yourIntelligenceorWisdomscore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You have advantage on saving throws and ability checks to avoid or resist traps, hazards, and environmental effects related to the apocalypse. Additionally, you have advantage on ability checks made to find food or water.

Worldly.name: Worldly
Worldly.description:
You’ve seen some things, and it has kept you alive!

Art of Might: Artful Dodgers© 2022, d20fsrd.com Publishing; Author: Ed Kabar

Audire Shepherd.name: Audire Shepherd
Audire Shepherd.description:
You can assume the form of a Medium living tree or fungus with a small number of limbs. The exact nature of the tree or fungus and its appearance is completely under your control. Even the closest inspection cannot reveal that the tree in question is actually a magically concealed creature. To all normal tests you are, in fact, a tree or fungus, although detect magic detects a faint aura of transmutation. While in this form, you can observe all that transpires around you as if you were in your normal form and your abilities are unaffected. You gain a damage threshold of 5, but have a Dexterity score of 1 and a speed of 0 feet. You are immune to critical hits while in tree form and you cannot cast spells with somatic components while in this form. You can revert to your normal form as a bonus action on your turn.
You may, as an action, extend root-like rhizomes to burrow ten feet down into the earth. To do so, you must be on dirt, sand or any other easily dug soil (gravel, sheet rock, slate and similar harder substances thwart this use of the feat). You can move part of your bulk down alongside your rhizomes, potentially up to halving your height. You can only burrow down and you can burrow no further in any direction, save back up. You are proficient in the Stealth skill and receive advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while using this ability and also become immune to the prone condition. If you manage to surprise a creature and hit it in the first round of combat with a melee attack after using this ability, the target must succeed a Dexterity saving throw against DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution or Wisdom modifier (your choice) or become prone, as you resume your normal form.

Feint Expertise.name: Feint Expertise
Feint Expertise.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Mobility.name: Mobility
Mobility.description:
You can easily move through a dangerous melee.

This ability can be applied to a number of enemy creatures each round equal to yourDexteritymodifier.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Long Jumper.name: Long Jumper
Long Jumper.description:
Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
When you are wearing light armor, your jump distance is tripled. While wearing medium armor, your jump distance is doubled.
You can exceed your maximum movement speed to complete a jump. This does not permit you to jump after you have expended all your movement.
You take half falling damage.

Aqua Adept.name: Aqua Adept
Aqua Adept.description:
Increase yourIntelligenceorWisdomscore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You know and can cast the steam veil cantrip. Once per long rest, you can castcreate or destroy wateras a 3rd-level spell without expending a spell slot, and you can choose to deal 3d8 bludgeoning damage to any creature within 5 feet of the water you create with this spell.

Improved Critical.name: Improved Critical
Improved Critical.description: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

Grave Knowledge.name: Grave Knowledge
Grave Knowledge.description:
Increase your Intelligence by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You can make an Intelligence check and add your proficiency bonus even if you would not otherwise do so. You can use this ability once, and can do so again after finishing a long rest.
You learn the unseen servant as a ritual. The unseen servant summoned in this way is in fact a wayward spirit that develops a kinship with you. At your GM’s discretion, the summoned servant can eventually develop a personality and speak to you as a contact with knowledge of the spirit world. If it becomes prominent enough, it may even decide to manifest without being summoned.

Scrying Adept.name: Scrying Adept
Scrying Adept.description:
You are particularly skilled at using thescryingspell. You gain the following advantages.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Breaching Leap.name: Breaching Leap
Breaching Leap.description:
You can take theDashaction orDisengageaction as a bonus action onyour turnif you are swimming.

If you fall into water, the maximum falling damage you may suffer is 3d6 no matter what height you fall from.

You gain advantage onDexterity(Acrobatics) checks made to jump when you are swimming. If you are swimming and you jump at least 5 feet immediately before attacking, you gain a +1 bonus ondamage rollsfor every 5 feet you jump.

Pirate Campaign Compendium© 2018, Legendary Games; Lead Designer Jason Nelson. Authors: Alex Augunas, Jeff Gomez, Matt Goodall, Jim Groves, Tim Hitchcock, Victoria Jaczko, Jonathan H. Keith, Lyz Liddell, Thomas J. Phillips, Alistair J. Rigg, Alex Riggs, Loren Sieg, Neil Spicer, Todd Stewart, Rachel Ventura, Michael D. Welham, Linda Zayas-Palmer.

Divine Pestilence.name: Divine Pestilence
Divine Pestilence.description:
You gain 1 additional use of Channel Divinity per rest.

When you Channel Divinity, as a bonus action you can cause a choking miasma seeps forth from your unholy symbol. Living creatures other than fiends adjacent to you have must succeed aConstitutionsaving throw against your spell save DC or gain one level ofexhaustionfor 1 minute.

You must finish a short rest before you may use this ability again. After using it a second time in one day, you must finish a long rest before you may use it again.

The Dragon’s Hoard #45© 2024, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Darren Drader, Robert J. Grady, Nicholas Hite, Matt Kimmel

Daunting Interface.name: Daunting Interface
Daunting Interface.description: The Dragon’s Hoard #13 © 2021, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Miguel Colon, Robert J. Grady, Michael “solomani” Mifsud, Dan Dillon, Matt Kimmel, Scott D. Young, and JamesLevi Cooke

Shield Expertise.name: Shield Expertise
Shield Expertise.description:
Your skill with shields grants you improved protection against area effects.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Symbiotic Host.name: Symbiotic Host
Symbiotic Host.description:
You form a symbiotic bond with an aberrant creature. While the creature is bonded to you it is considered a part of you and cannot move, take anyactions, or losehit points. If the creature is destroyed it regrows attached to you over the course of a long rest.

When you choose this feat, select one of the following creatures to bond with: spine worm, silent lurker, gibbering arm, widow’s blades, or siren’s tail.

You may take this feat multiple times, selecting a different option each time.

Jack-in-the-Limb.name: Jack-in-the-Limb
Jack-in-the-Limb.description:
You can duplicate any tool worth 30 gp or less by breaking off crystalline sections of your body. Breaking off a tool from your body is an action. You can’t break off specific items (like a key to a certain lock), but could break off a substitute for a lockpick, for example. You are always considered proficient in these makeshift tools, but due to their improvised nature, checks made using them are made at disadvantage. You may duplicate up to 20 gp worth of tools per day without repercussions. Any more than that and you increase your exhaustion level by +1. If your size is Small, you instead only can generate 10 gp worth of tools before risking exhaustion and the maximum value you can duplicate is only 15 gp. Tools created from your body quickly decay after 1 day per Hit Die you have and thus cannot be sold unless you succeed a Charisma (Deception) check against an unwitting target.
You may also break off a more significant section of your body to duplicate a simple or martial melee weapon of your choice. Breaking off a single weapon from your body is an action. You are always proficient with a weapon taken from your own body, but you may not duplicate weapons that have a lot of moving parts like a flail. Weapons made from a colliatur’s body emit light like a sputtering torch and, if the wielder is a colliatur, he may will them to deal radiant damage instead of their usual damage type. You may create two simple weapons with the light or finesse property or one regular simple weapon sans repercussions. Creating a martial weapon takes a heavier toll and increases your exhaustion level by 1. If you create a martial weapon with the heavy or two-handed property from your body, you instead increase your exhaustion level by 2. Small colliatur have crystalline structures that are too dense to break off martial weapons. Large colliatur seem to be able to create more devastating weaponry: Large colliatur can create up to 4 simple weapons with the light or finesse properties

Aquatic Adaptation.name: Aquatic Adaptation
Aquatic Adaptation.description: Benefit(s)You gain a swim speed equal to your walking speed, and you can breathe water or air interchangeably. Additionally, one ability score of your choice increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Draaki Savage.name: Draaki Savage
Draaki Savage.description:
Casting Time: 1 action

Components: V, S, M (draaki tooth)

Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute

Your teeth and jaw reform, granting you a savage bite to use in conjunction with your other attacks. For the duration of this spell, you gain the following ability:

Underworld Races and Classes © 2017 AAW Games LLC; Designers: Thilo Graf and Mike Myler

Devil’s Pact.name: Devil’s Pact
Devil’s Pact.description:
You learn the thaumaturgy cantrip.
You learn the Infernal language.
Based on the type of devil lord you made a pact with, choose one of the following devils to serve you: thieving devil, feasting devil, flayer devil, alluring devil, massacre devil, abhorrent devil, searing devil.
The devil acts independently of you, but it always obeys your commands and takes its turn immediately after yours. The devil can’t attack, but it can take other actions as normal.
As an action, you can summon your devil into an unoccupied space within 5 feet of you, as long as you are on the same plane of existence as your devil.
When your devil reaches 0 hit points, it disappears, leaving behind no physical form. It reappears within 5 feet of you after you complete a short or long rest.

Face of True Fear.name: Face of True Fear
Face of True Fear.description:
Your countenance has been warped and scarred beyond recognition, and the windows of your rotten soul stare from a wrack of self-inflicted ruin most foul; as you desire, you can place true terror into an assailant’s heart simply by meeting their gaze at the moment of theirattack.

Legendary Classes: Templars & Tyrants© 2023, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Darrin Drader, Miguel Colon, Clinton J. Boomer, Amber Scott

Trip Expertise.name: Trip Expertise
Trip Expertise.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Quickdraw.name: Quickdraw
Quickdraw.description:
You can draw and fire your firearm with lightning speed. You can draw or stow a pistol as a free action, and you can reload a pistol part of theattack. Additionally, when you roll forinitiativeand aren’t surprised, you can use yourreactionto make anattackwith a pistol your are holding.

Pirates and Plunder A Compendium For 5e © 2024 Published by Mythos Chronicles; Author Filippo Bardoscia

Crossbow Expertise.name: Crossbow Expertise
Crossbow Expertise.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Oracular Whispers.name: Oracular Whispers
Oracular Whispers.description:
Benefit(s): After ten minutes of meditation, as an action, the Eostrix is granted advantage on any skill check or ability roll. This advantage does not apply toattackor combat rolls. This can be used once per short rest. The cost for this advantage check is 2HD.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Mutant’s Resistance.name: Mutant’s Resistance
Mutant’s Resistance.description: Choose one type of environmental hazard (e.g., extreme heat, radiation). You gain immunity to that hazard. Additionally, once per long rest, when you are about to take damage, you can use yourreactionto gainresistanceto all damage until the start of your next turn.

Human Form.name: Human Form
Human Form.description:
You gain an alternate humanoid form of roughly the same size as your natural form. This is a specific individual form and cannot be changed once chosen. This works like the Change Appearance option of Alter Self, but it is always the same form.

Special: You can gain this feat multiple times. Each time you take this feat, you are granted another specific humanoid form. Silver dragon descendants who have this ability are also able to take the feat, granting another specific humanoid form.

Efficient Artisan.name: Efficient Artisan
Efficient Artisan.description:
Your efficient hands have completed so many works that you could almost perform your craft in your sleep. When you spend a day of downtime to craft an item related to your specialty, you can craft one or more items with a total market value of 10 gp or less; you must still expend raw materials worth half the total market value. If something you want to craft has a market value greater than 10 gp, you make progress every day in 10-gp increments until you reach the market value of the item.

Alternately, given just a couple of hours, which can be part of along rest, you can craft crude but functional versions of simple items related to your specialty, as shown on the table below. Items crafted this way are fragile and have only half their normalhit points. You must have the appropriate artisan’s tools and enough raw materials.

Other items might be possible using these or other tool proficiencies. In general, only simple items normally costing 1 gp or less should be permitted, and only if it seems reasonable that a crude version could be crafted by a highly skilled artisan in a couple of hours.

Scarred Lands Player’s Guide © 2016 Onyx Path Publishing Authors: Bill Ashbless, Jason Bolte, Chris Cowger, Adam Eichelberger, Alain Giorla, Nathan Knaack, Chris Sims, Eddy Webb

Stealthy Caster.name: Stealthy Caster
Stealthy Caster.description:
You have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide.
You can cast one spell you know without somatic or verbal components; you must finish a short or long rest before you can cast a spell this way again.

Refocusing Defense.name: Refocusing Defense
Refocusing Defense.description:
When you use theDodgeaction in a round, you can shift yourinitiativeto be 20 + yourinitiativebonus for the rest of combat.

Breath of Life - The Scout (5e)© 2024, Orphaned Bookworm Productions; Authors: Norman Mitchell Jr. and Connor Bates

Ash Walker.name: Ash Walker
Ash Walker.description:
Benefit(s): Increase yourDexterityorConstitutionscore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gain immunity to the detrimental effects of ash, smoke, and thin air, such as those found in a volcanic wasteland. Additionally, you have advantage on saving throws against effects that would blind or suffocate you.

Diehard.name: Diehard
Diehard.description:
Increase your Constitution score by 1, up to a maximum of 20.
You have advantage on saving throws against effects that cause you to suffer a level of exhaustion.
You have advantage on death saving throws.

Fantasfunglet Liana.name: Fantasfunglet Liana
Fantasfunglet Liana.description:
You gain the ability to use the plentiful liana extending from your body to perform fine manipulations. You may use your liana to manipulate objects 10 feet beyond your reach, including using skills. Since your liana have significant tactile finesse, you may even manipulate objects you cannot see. You gain blindsight 10 feet and extend liana to manipulate objects in tight holes, around corners, etc.
So long as you have at least two surfaces no farther than your reach + your liana’s 10 feet apart to bounce against, you can ricochet your body from one to the next. Once on a new wall, you can fall slowly for 20 feet and before bounding across again, allowing you to fall any distance indefinitely.

Ritualist.name: Ritualist
Ritualist.description: would typically allow you to choose whether a spell can be cast as a normal spell or a ritual spell.

Swashbuckler’s Agility.name: Swashbuckler’s Agility
Swashbuckler’s Agility.description:
Increase yourDexterityscore by 1, to a maximum of 20. Additionally, when you take theDashaction,difficult terraindoesn’t cost you extra movement, and you gain a +2 bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.

Pirates and Plunder A Compendium For 5e © 2024 Published by Mythos Chronicles; Author Filippo Bardoscia

Vindictive Hatred.name: Vindictive Hatred
Vindictive Hatred.description: Underworld Races and Classes © 2017 AAW Games LLC; Designers: Thilo Graf and Mike Myler

Energy Resistance.name: Energy Resistance
Energy Resistance.description: NoteInfernal feats are first gained by taking the Infernal Pact feat. This feat ties a character to a Circle’s particular lord. If the character is not from that Circle, the Circle is considered his “home” Circle from that point on. The feats available to a character are determined by his home Circle—a character cannot take infernal feats that are not listed as tied to a Circle.

Rapid Shot.name: Rapid Shot
Rapid Shot.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Artech Savant.name: Artech Savant
Artech Savant.description:
Benefit(s): Increase yourIntelligencescore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You have advantage onIntelligence(Arcana) checks when making magical items, scrolls, and potions.

You gain proficiency in one set of artisan’s tools.

You know the recipe of one uncommon magical item. Pick one from the following list of items: alchemy jug,bag of holding,cloak of the manta ray, driftglobe,goggles of night, potion of greaterhealing,potion of resistance,ring of jumping,ring of warmth, staff of the adder.

Extra Secondary Archetype.name: Extra Secondary Archetype
Extra Secondary Archetype.description: Legendary Adventures © 2020 Mike Myler, published under license by Legendary Games.

Lock and Key.name: Lock and Key
Lock and Key.description:
Benefit(s): Gain proficiency inSleight of Hand, or a +2 bonus onSleight of Handchecks if you are already proficient in it. Gain proficiency in thieves’ tools, or a +2 bonus on checks when you use them if you are already proficient with them. Increase yourDexterityby 1 to a maximum of 20. Whenever a trap goes off, and you can reach that trap with a single move, you may approach it and try to cease it from triggering by making an appropriate check to disable the trap at a -2 penalty. If you succeed you have not disabled the trap, but you have stopped it from triggering. You may do this a number of times per day equal to yourDexteritymodifier.

Guilds of Sundara © 2022, eGDC Ltd; Author: Neal Litherland

Breath of the Draaki.name: Breath of the Draaki
Breath of the Draaki.description:
You increase the damage dice of one of your breath weapon by +1d6. If you have more than one draaki breath weapon, you may reassign to which this bonus applies after a short rest.
You may breathe all your breath weapons in either a 15 ft. cone or a 5 ft. by 30 ft. line.
You may use your breath weapon up to your Constitution modifier additional times before requiring a short or long rest to recharge. If you also have the Wyrmblooded Paragon feat, you may freely distribute these additional uses among your breath weapons.

Grave Sight.name: Grave Sight
Grave Sight.description:
Increase your Wisdom by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to perceive undead creatures.
You can use a simple ritual to drive out hidden spirits. With one minute of concentration, and blessed salt, you can create a small 10 ft area on the ground that reveals undead for 1 minute. Any incorporeal or buried undead in or below this area are forced to manifest or are brought to the surface. The creature cannot burrow, become invisible, or possess a creature or object for the remainder of that minute. The undead becomes hostile to you.
At 5th level, you gain the knowledge of the protection from evil and good spell. You can cast this spell once, and can do so again after finishing a short rest.

Virtuoso.name: Virtuoso
Virtuoso.description:
Whenever you have advantage on an ability check using the chosen skill, you can reroll one of the dice once, replacing that result.
You cannot have disadvantage on any ability check using the chosen skill.

Piercing Corruption.name: Piercing Corruption
Piercing Corruption.description:
You know how to truly reach out and touch someone. Whether they want to be touched or not, of course, matters little.

Legendary Classes: Templars & Tyrants© 2023, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Darrin Drader, Miguel Colon, Clinton J. Boomer, Amber Scott

Final Blow.name: Final Blow
Final Blow.description:
Why make this longer than it needs to be.

After you dealsneak attackdamage, if the creature has less than a 10th of its totalhit pointsremaining, it must succeed on aConstitutionsave or you instantly kill orknockthe foeunconscious, your choice.

Art of Might: Artful Dodgers© 2022, d20fsrd.com Publishing; Author: Ed Kabar

Grappling Expertise.name: Grappling Expertise
Grappling Expertise.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Steadfast.name: Steadfast
Steadfast.description: You have advantage on saving throws against attempts to charm or frighten you, and against effects that might result in madness or corruption.

Hammer the Gap.name: Hammer the Gap
Hammer the Gap.description:
You repeatedly strike the same location, causing increasing amounts of damage.

Battlemasters & Berserkers © 2021, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

War Reaper.name: War Reaper
War Reaper.description:
When you wield a sickle you use 1d6 for the damage die.
The first time on your turn when you reduce a creature to 0 hit points with an attack using a sickle or scythe, you may immediately make another melee attack against an enemy within reach using the same weapon as part of the same attack.

Shield of the Fallen.name: Shield of the Fallen
Shield of the Fallen.description:
Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You are able to carry an unconscious, dead, or helpless creature up to one size larger than yours without the creature’s weight counting against your carrying capacity. Carrying them does not burden you or prevent you from attacking with a weapon or benefiting from a shield.
When you stand adjacent to a prone ally, any attacks against them do not gain advantage.
While wearing a shield and standing adjacent to a prone creature, as a reaction you can grant that creature your shield bonus to AC. You still retain the shield bonus as well.

Ironsinger.name: Ironsinger
Ironsinger.description:
You have learned lethal harmonics that can tear foes apart, called Ironsinging for the smell of iron that accompanies the blood spilled.

Underworld Races and Classes © 2017 AAW Games LLC; Designers: Thilo Graf and Mike Myler

Moonlight Stalker Master.name: Moonlight Stalker Master
Moonlight Stalker Master.description:
You leave your opponents swinging at shadows while you slide elusively through thedarkness.

Fighters Unlimited 5E© 2019, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

Drunken Brute.name: Drunken Brute
Drunken Brute.description:
Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
While raging, if you consume at least one flask or tankard of alcohol, you can treat it as a potion of healing. Once you do, you can’t do so again until you enter a new rage. Rare and expensive alcohols may count as rarer, more expensive potions of healing, as determined by the GM. If you have the barbarian’s Persistent Rage feature, you can use this feature twice during each rage.
While raging, you can use an action to consume at least one flask or tankard of alcohol to maintain your rage during a round in which it would otherwise end prematurely.

Sea Singer.name: Sea Singer
Sea Singer.description:
Benefit(s): You can use potent subsonic humming to create bardic performances with auditory components underwater and castbardspells with verbal components while underwater, even while holding your breath. These spells and effects have the normal range and effect, save that languagedependent effects do not function in conjunction with this feat (such as thecommandspell). You cannot use this feat to cast spells from other classes.

If you are at least level 10, you can cast spells if you magically assume the form of a creature with a swim speed.

Pirate Campaign Compendium© 2018, Legendary Games; Lead Designer Jason Nelson. Authors: Alex Augunas, Jeff Gomez, Matt Goodall, Jim Groves, Tim Hitchcock, Victoria Jaczko, Jonathan H. Keith, Lyz Liddell, Thomas J. Phillips, Alistair J. Rigg, Alex Riggs, Loren Sieg, Neil Spicer, Todd Stewart, Rachel Ventura, Michael D. Welham, Linda Zayas-Palmer.

Stealthy.name: Stealthy
Stealthy.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Survivor.name: Survivor
Survivor.description:
Increase your Constitution or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You require only half of the food and water normally required for a creature of your size.
You can withstand extreme temperatures indefinitely, and you automatically pass saving throws made against extreme heat and cold for a number of days equal to your Constitution or Wisdom modifier, whichever is lower. After this time, you must make saving throws as normal until you spend 24 hours in a comfortable temperature.

Cautious.name: Cautious
Cautious.description: You are extremely careful when dealing with delicate or dangerous devices. You have advantage on all checks that use your proficiency with thieves’ tools.

Blood Mage.name: Blood Mage
Blood Mage.description: When youcast a spellthat requires you to roll one or more damage dies, you can expend a number of hit dices equal to the spell’s level to reroll all the damage dice. You can choose which set of results to use.

True Love’s Kiss.name: True Love’s Kiss
True Love’s Kiss.description:
Increase your Wisdom or Charisma by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Choose any one character – PC or NPC, – subject to GM approval – as your true love; alternatively, the GM might select a specific character, without your knowledge, as your true love. The selected character does not necessarily have to choose you as his or her true love in the event he or she also selects this feat: a mother might have true love for her young son, but the son might gain the benefits of this feat for another at a later time. As an action, you can kiss your true love, removing all curses and ending any one spell affecting them. Additionally, as long as you live, your true love automatically stabilizes from dying.

Street Smarts.name: Street Smarts
Street Smarts.description:
Increase your Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency in the Wisdom (Insight) skill. If you are already proficient in the skill, you add double your proficiency bonus to checks you make with it.

Gambler’s Arsenal.name: Gambler’s Arsenal
Gambler’s Arsenal.description:
You may use gambit die and abilities or feats typically limited to only combat cards with any thrown weapon with which you are proficient and with melee quarterstaff attacks.

Polymorph: The Dealer (5E), © 2024, Orphaned Bookworm Productions, LLC, Author: Connor Bates.

Hellwalker.name: Hellwalker
Hellwalker.description:
Your exposure to the magical hazards of a blasted, hellfire-wreathed landscape has forced you to develop supernatural resilience simply to survive. The ways of shadow and flame grant you the following benefits.

Sandy Petersen’s Planet Apocalypse, © 2021, Petersen Games.

Master Herbalist.name: Master Herbalist
Master Herbalist.description:
You have advantage on either (choose one) Intelligence (Nature) or Wisdom (Medicine) checks made to prepare an herbal concoction.
You gain resistance to poison damage.
When in an outdoor environment, your ability to use your natural surroundings is such that you are always considered to be carrying a healer’s kit (but not an herbalism kit).

Fallout’s Fury.name: Fallout’s Fury
Fallout’s Fury.description:
Benefit(s): Increase yourStrengthorConstitutionscore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Once per short rest, as a bonus action, you can enter a state of fury for 1 minute. During this time, you gain advantage onStrengthandConstitutionchecks and saving throws, and your weapon and spell attacks deal an additional 1d4 damage of the weapon or spell type.

Perfect Timing.name: Perfect Timing
Perfect Timing.description:
You always know the correct time of day and can accurately measure the passage of time without a timekeeping device.
You have advantage on initiative rolls.
When a creature you can see makes an attack against you while your speed isn’t 0, you can use your reaction to move 5 feet. When you do so, you can force the attacker to roll the attack with disadvantage.
When you use your reaction to make an attack, such as with an opportunity attack or a readied action, you have advantage on the attack roll.

Stone’s Endurance.name: Stone’s Endurance
Stone’s Endurance.description: Increase yourConstitutionscore by 1, to a maximum of 20. Additionally, you can use yourreactionwhen you take damage to roll a d12. Add yourConstitutionmodifier to the roll and reduce the damage by that total. You can use this feature a number of times equal to youConstitutionmodifier (minimum of 1), and you regain any expended uses of this feature when you finish a long rest.

Beacon of the End.name: Beacon of the End
Beacon of the End.description:
Benefit(s): Increase yourCharismascore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

As an action, you can bolster the resolve of your allies.

Each ally within 30 feet of you gains advantage on their next saving throw until the end of your next turn. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest. Additionally you can use this feature as a bonus action an extra time per long rest.

Branded.name: Branded
Branded.description: Branded With An Unholy Sign, 5e© 2020, Owen K.C. Stephens; Author: Dustin Knight. Publisher: Owen K.C. Stephens. Project manager and Planning: Lj Stephens. Bon Vivant: Stan!

Eagle-Eyed Awareness.name: Eagle-Eyed Awareness
Eagle-Eyed Awareness.description:
Your vision andreactiontime is comparable to the most prolific of avian predators. You may double your proficiency bonus toPerceptionandWisdommodifier toinitiativeinstead of yourDexteritymodifier.

Breath of Life - The Scout (5e)© 2024, Orphaned Bookworm Productions; Authors: Norman Mitchell Jr. and Connor Bates

Dodging Expertise.name: Dodging Expertise
Dodging Expertise.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Shield Ally.name: Shield Ally
Shield Ally.description: Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Takedown Specialist.name: Takedown Specialist
Takedown Specialist.description: 5E: Age of Antiquity Adventure and Intrigue in the Ancient World © 2019 Aruzian Publishing, Stephen Delucchi, Marcus Lundin

Riotous Combatant.name: Riotous Combatant
Riotous Combatant.description: Benefit(s)When you take theDashorDisengageaction, you can use your bonus action to make one weaponattackbefore the end ofyour turn. Additionally, when you take theDashaction, you can ignoredifficult terrainuntil the start of your next turn.

Cursed Might.name: Cursed Might
Cursed Might.description: The lycanthropic curse flowing through your veins enhances your physical prowess. Increase yourStrengthscore by 1, to a maximum of 20. Additionally, when you are in yourwolfor hybrid form, your bite deals an additional 1d6 piercing damage.

Arcane Impetus.name: Arcane Impetus
Arcane Impetus.description: When youcast a spellof 1st level or higher duringyour turn, you can choose to grant yourself or one target of the spell a burst of speed. The chosen target’s movement speed is increased by 10 feet until the end of their turn, and they can take theDash,Disengage, orHideaction as a bonus action on their turn. This feature can be used a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, with all expended uses being restored after a long rest.

Alluring Magic.name: Alluring Magic
Alluring Magic.description: A whisper of the Scintillating Fey Courts’ influence accompanies your magic, seducing your targets with its intoxicating allure. When youcast a spellthat requires a non-hostile creature (excluding fey) to make a saving throw to resist beingcharmedby you, the creature must roll 1d4 and subtract the number rolled from the saving throw’s result. Additionally, when a creature (excluding fey) makes a saving throw to resist beingcharmedby one of your spells and fails by 5 or more, it has disadvantage on ability checks until the end of its next turn.

Discordant Thoughts.name: Discordant Thoughts
Discordant Thoughts.description: Benefit(s)When a creature uses magic to read your thoughts, access or modify your memories, or determine if you’re telling the truth, the attempt automatically fails. Additionally, when you are targeted by a spell while the caster can’t see you, the caster must roll 1d4. On a roll of 1, the spell doesn’t affect you, as though the spell couldn’t target you.

Liminal Slip.name: Liminal Slip
Liminal Slip.description:
You possess an incorporeal aspect that allows you to move through other creatures. Moving through a friendly creature’s space doesn’t count asdifficult terrainfor you. Additionally, you can move through a hostile creature’s space, but the creature’s space counts asdifficult terrainfor you.

You can’t takeactionsorreactionswhile within another creature’s space, and if you are in another creature’s space at the end of a turn, you are shunted into the nearest unoccupied space. You take 1d10 force damage for every 5 feet you are shunted.

Once you move through a creature’s space, that creature has disadvantage on opportunity attacks made against you until the start of your next turn.

Pious.name: Pious
Pious.description:
You gain proficiency with your deity’s favored weapon.
You can use your god’s favored weapon or a divine token (see the table below) as a spellcasting focus to cast divine spells. Divine tokens are mundane items related to your deity that can easily be found or crafted and don’t require special preparation.
You gain the Channel Divinity feature (see below).
Channel Divinity
You gain the ability to channel divine energy directly from your deity, using that energy to fuel magical effects. You gain two Channel Divinity effects: Call of the Faithful and Shield the Pious. When you use your Channel Divinity, you choose which effect to create. You must then finish a short or long rest to use your Channel Divinity again.
If you already have Channel Divinity from another source, you gain one extra use of Channel Divinity.
Call of the Faithful. When you make an ability check related to your god’s sphere of influence (as shown on the table below), you can use your Channel Divinity to gain advantage on that check. The spheres of influence are broad so that they might apply to many situations or ability checks. Your GM can let you know if using Channel Divinity in this way will provide a benefit.
Shield the Pious. When you are the target of an attack that you can see, you can use your Channel Divinity to impose disadvantage on the attack roll.

Fiendfoe.name: Fiendfoe
Fiendfoe.description:
You are a practiced hunter of demons, devils, and all their unholy ilk. You gain advantage onIntelligence(Arcana),Intelligence(Investigation), andIntelligence(Religion) checks made to identify fiends and their abilities, and on checks to identify spells they cast (and at the GM’s discretion, magic items or other permanent magical effects they have created). You gain a +1 bonus on weapondamage rollsagainst fiends, and this bonus is increased to +1d4 if the fiend hasresistanceagainst the type of damage your weapon deals.

The Dragon’s Hoard #26© 2022, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Robert J. Grady, Darrin Drader, James-Levi Cooke.

Wasteland Navigator.name: Wasteland Navigator
Wasteland Navigator.description:
Benefit(s): Increase yourWisdomscore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You can use the bonus action granted by your Cunning Action to make aWisdom(Survival) check.

Augmented Conjuring.name: Augmented Conjuring
Augmented Conjuring.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Ring-Bound.name: Ring-Bound
Ring-Bound.description:
from the ring:
You have advantage on saving throws against transmutation spells.
You can physically bind your ring to a weapon with 1 hour of work that can be completed during a short rest. While the ring is attached to the weapon, you can use a bonus action to make the weapon magical until the start of your next turn. After activating this ability twice, you must finish a short or long rest before using it again.
Ring wardens and others who respect the traditions of ring magic are favorably disposed toward you. Their starting attitude toward you automatically improves by one step, and you have advantage on Charisma checks related to social interaction with such individuals.

Expert Navigator.name: Expert Navigator
Expert Navigator.description:
Additionally, you gain proficiency in water vehicles and navigator’s tools, and advantage in anyWisdom(Survival) checks you make at sea.

Pirates and Plunder A Compendium For 5e © 2024 Published by Mythos Chronicles; Author Filippo Bardoscia

Antique Appraiser.name: Antique Appraiser
Antique Appraiser.description: (chosen at the time you take this feat):

Mantle of Doubt.name: Mantle of Doubt
Mantle of Doubt.description:
Casting Time: 1 action

DurationConcentration, up to 1 minute

You wrap your mind in phantasms of crippling doubt that assail any who dare harm you. When a creature within 30 feet attacks you or attempts to affect you with a harmful effect, it must make aWisdomsaving throw as these specters of uncertainty force themselves into its mind. Ongoing effects trigger the mantle only if the creature consciously directs them against you. A given creature need only roll a saving throw against your mantle of doubt at most once per round. If the creature’sattackor effect against you causes psychic damage or thecharmedorfrightenedcondition, that creature’s saving throw is made with disadvantage. A creature that fails its saving throw against your mantle of doubt isfrightenedfor 1 minute and takes 2d10 psychic damage. A creature that isfrightenedmay make a new saving throw at the end of each of its turns; on a success, that condition ends for that creature.

Forest Kingdom Campaign Compendium 5e© 2017, Legendary Games; Lead Designer Jason Nelson. Authors: Clinton J. Boomer, Benjamin Bruck, Matt Goodall, Tim Hitchcock, N. Jolly, Julian Neale, Jason Nelson, Thomas J. Phillips, Alistair J. Rigg, David N. Ross, Neil Spicer, Todd Stewart, Russ Taylor, Michael D. Welham, Linda Zayas-Palmer.

Slow Fall.name: Slow Fall
Slow Fall.description:
While you are conscious, you take no damage from falling damage. If you fall unconscious while flying, you only take half the falling damage that you normally would.
Your Dexterity score increases by +1, to a maximum of 20.

Mark of The Blood.name: Mark of The Blood
Mark of The Blood.description:
Benefit(s): Gain Advantage onConstitutionchecks made to concentrate on a spell. Increase your total pool of sorcery points by 1. 1/day when you finish a short rest you may regain half your sorcery points, rounded down.

Guilds of Sundara © 2022, eGDC Ltd; Author: Neal Litherland

Spell Endurance.name: Spell Endurance
Spell Endurance.description:
You are especially resistant to magic.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Diplomatic.name: Diplomatic
Diplomatic.description:
Increase yourCharismascore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gain proficiency in thePersuasionskill. If you are already proficient in this skill, double your proficiency bonus to checks you make with it.

If you spend at least 1 minute talking to someone who can understand what you say, you can make aCharisma(Persuasion) check contested by the creature’sWisdom(Insight) check. The creature gains advantage if it is hostile to you or any of your companions. If you succeed, the target considers you a friendly acquaintance, from then on, when you make aCharisma(Persuasion) orCharisma(Deception) check, you can treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as a 10. The effect ends if you or your companions do anything harmful to it.

Spell Focus.name: Spell Focus
Spell Focus.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Supernatural Feline.name: Supernatural Feline
Supernatural Feline.description:
Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain a magical symbol or holy symbol as a pattern in your fur. This pattern or symbol can be used as a spellcasting focus for any class you belong to, even if the class can’t normally use a spellcasting focus. The focus cannot be disarmed or stolen from you, but can be (temporarily) rendered unusable if the surrounding fur is shaved, burned away, etc.
You can use material components or a spellcasting focus within 30 feet for your spells without touching them.
You can use a bonus action to remove the requirement for verbal components for the next spell you cast this turn.

Pincer Attack.name: Pincer Attack
Pincer Attack.description: Onyour turn, whenever you make amelee attackagainst a creature and a non-incapacitated ally of yours is within 5 feet of your target, you can use a bonus action to gain advantage on theattackroll. If thisattackis successful, add your proficiency bonus to the damage.

Floral Resistance.name: Floral Resistance
Floral Resistance.description:
You no longer have the Weakness to Fire racial ability.
Your Constitution score increases by +1, to a maximum of 20.

Medium Armor Proficiency.name: Medium Armor Proficiency
Medium Armor Proficiency.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Boarding Specialist.name: Boarding Specialist
Boarding Specialist.description: Pirates and Plunder A Compendium For 5e © 2024 Published by Mythos Chronicles; Author Filippo Bardoscia

Felling Escape.name: Felling Escape
Felling Escape.description:
Through the use of fluid contortions and manipulations of leverage, you can throw your opponent to the ground after escaping a grapple.

Fighters Unlimited 5E© 2019, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

Master Craftsman.name: Master Craftsman
Master Craftsman.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Forbidden Scholar.name: Forbidden Scholar
Forbidden Scholar.description:
Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
