You gain proficiency in the Arcana skill. When you make Intelligence (Arcana) checks related to forbidden magic or lore, you can add double your proficiency bonus instead of your normal proficiency bonus.
You learn one exotic language of your choice.

Master Craftswoman.name: Master Craftswoman
Master Craftswoman.description:
You are a master artisan, capable of crafting great works of stunning beauty and effectiveness.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Quicken Spell.name: Quicken Spell
Quicken Spell.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Unbreakable Bond.name: Unbreakable Bond
Unbreakable Bond.description:
Your connection to your Summon is nearly unshakable, making it harder to sever. After reaching0 hit points, your Summon remains active for 1 minute or until it takes a total of damage exceeding four times your Summoner level instead of disappearing immediately. During this time, your Summon cannot regainhit points.

You have achieved true mastery over the art of summoning, pushing your magic beyond mortal limits. As an action, you can channel your inner power, reinforcing the bond between you and your Summon. Your Summon immediately regains all itshit pointsand is cured of any conditions affecting it. Once you use this ability, you must finish a long rest before you can use it again.

Stygian Sorcery.name: Stygian Sorcery
Stygian Sorcery.description: You find a twisted comfort when suffering the familiar torments of the Iron Hells.

Persuasive.name: Persuasive
Persuasive.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Expert.name: Expert
Expert.description:
Focused, constant practice breeds results. Gain one additional skill for your expertise class feature.

Art of Might: Artful Dodgers© 2022, d20fsrd.com Publishing; Author: Ed Kabar

Potent Cantrip.name: Potent Cantrip
Potent Cantrip.description: When a creature succeeds on a saving throw against your cantrip, the creature takes half the cantrip’s damage (if any) but suffers no additional effect from the cantrip.

Psychic Inhibitor.name: Psychic Inhibitor
Psychic Inhibitor.description:
Benefit(s)Your mind roils with chaotic energy that destabilizes nearby thoughts and inhibits psychic phenomena.

Creatures within 10 feet of you experience the following effects:

You can choose any number of creatures to ignore all of this feat’s effects.

Hearty Constitution.name: Hearty Constitution
Hearty Constitution.description:
Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Whenever you regain hit points as a result of a spell, potion, class feature, or other means, you regain additional hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.
When a creature uses a spell, Wisdom (Medicine) check, healer’s kit, or other means to stabilize you when you are dying, you also regain hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.

Tool’s Folly.name: Tool’s Folly
Tool’s Folly.description: last until the end of your next turn or until you use this ability on a different target. If your check fails, you cannot deceive the target in this way for three rounds.

Favored of the Gods.name: Favored of the Gods
Favored of the Gods.description:
You can’t use this feat again until you finish a long rest.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Improved Cleaving Finish.name: Improved Cleaving Finish
Improved Cleaving Finish.description:
You can cut down many opponents in a single strike.

Fighters Unlimited 5E© 2019, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

Blowback.name: Blowback
Blowback.description:
You have advantage on attack rolls against any creature that has taken its turn before you in combat.
When you roll a 1 on a damage die on an attack where you have advantage you may reroll that die. You must take the new roll.

Poison Blood.name: Poison Blood
Poison Blood.description: NoteInfernal feats are first gained by taking the Infernal Pact feat. This feat ties a character to a Circle’s particular lord. If the character is not from that Circle, the Circle is considered his “home” Circle from that point on. The feats available to a character are determined by his home Circle—a character cannot take infernal feats that are not listed as tied to a Circle.

Arctic Survivor.name: Arctic Survivor
Arctic Survivor.description:
You have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) and Intelligence (Investigation) checks made to detect pits, traps, and snares, or other cold based environmental dangers (avalanches)
You have advantage on saves to avoid or resist pits, traps, snares, or other cold based environmental dangers as determined by the GM.
You have resistance to cold damage

Monster Conjurer.name: Monster Conjurer
Monster Conjurer.description:
You can use an action to manifest a ball of magic in your hand and throw it up to 20 feet. When the ball lands, it transforms into a creature you determine by rolling a d8 (1—ankylosaurus, 2—basilisk, 3—giant scorpion, 4—hell hound, 5—manticore, 6—nightmare, 7—owlbear, 8—yeti). The creature vanishes after 24 hours or when it is reduced to0 hit points. The creature is friendly to you and your companions, and it acts onyour turn.

At the start of each of your turns you can command (no action required) how the creature moves and what action it takes, or to give it general orders, such as toattackyour enemies. In the absence of such orders, the creature acts in a fashion appropriate to its nature. Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

Legendary Adventures © 2020 Mike Myler, published under license by Legendary Games.

Whirlwind Strike.name: Whirlwind Strike
Whirlwind Strike.description: As an action duringyour turn, you can make a melee weapon attack against all creatures within 5 feet of you. Make a separate roll for each creature in range, with a -5 penalty to the attack roll. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and you regain any expended uses when you finish a long rest.

Favored Defense.name: Favored Defense
Favored Defense.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Deep Intuition.name: Deep Intuition
Deep Intuition.description:
You have a greater understanding of yourself, others, and the world around you. You gain advantage onWisdomsaving throws.

Additionally, if you are surprised at the beginning of combat and aren’tincapacitatedyou can roll aWisdom(Insight) check with a DC equal to the enemies’ highestinitiativescore. On a success, you can act normally onyour turn.

Combat Medic.name: Combat Medic
Combat Medic.description:
You have learned that placing the safety of your companions above your own is of vital importance. When you take a short rest, if you choose not to spend any hit dice yourself, you may instead attempt tohelpa companion tend their wounds. When a single companion rolls hit dice to regain health during a short rest, make aMedicineskill check with a DC equal to 10 + the number of hit dice your companion rolls. If you succeed, all of your companion’s hit dice automatically roll the highest number.

5E: Age of Antiquity Adventure and Intrigue in the Ancient World © 2019 Aruzian Publishing, Stephen Delucchi, Marcus Lundin

Empowered Spell (Meta Magic).name: Empowered Spell (Meta Magic)
Empowered Spell (Meta Magic).description:
Druids of the Arcane Circle have exclusive access to metamagic feats. Rather than taking the Ability Score Improvement feature at 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th and 19th level, they can choose this feat.

When you roll damage for a spell, you can spend 1 sorcery point to reroll a number of the damage dice up to yourIntelligencemodifier (minimum of one). You must use the new rolls.

You can use Empowered Spell even if you have already used a different Metamagic option during the casting of the spell.

Locus of Control.name: Locus of Control
Locus of Control.description:
Your Wisdom or Charisma score increases by 1, to a minimum of 20.
When a creature teleports or is summoned, it can’t appear within 10 feet of you unless you allow it.
You have advantage on opportunity attacks.

Evasion.name: Evasion
Evasion.description:
You can nimblydodgeout of the way of certain area effects, such as a red dragon’s fiery breath or afireballspell. When you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make aDexteritysaving throw to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on the saving throw, and only half damage if you fail.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Xenophilia.name: Xenophilia
Xenophilia.description: The Dragon’s Hoard #40 © 2023, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Matt Kimmel, Darrin Drader, Mike Myler

Observant.name: Observant
Observant.description: Art of Might: Artful Dodgers© 2022, d20fsrd.com Publishing; Author: Ed Kabar

Fey Soul: Satyr.name: Fey Soul: Satyr
Fey Soul: Satyr.description:
Summary: You have given into your fey soul fully allowing you to manifest a greater portion of its power.

Ram’s Legs: if you didn’t have them already, your legs become like those of a ram complete with hooves. They grant you the following abilities:

Life of the Party: When you join a festivity or put on a performance, you have the power to become the center of everyone’s attention. This a magical charm effect and creatures that can’t becharmedare not affected. When you perform for 1 minute, you can attempt to entice a number of humanoids equal to your proficiency modifier that have witnessed your full performance to join in your revelry.

Each humanoid must make aCharismasaving throw (DC = 8 + your Satyr Magic ability modifier + your proficiency bonus) or becharmedby you. Whilecharmedin this way, the humanoid will follow you around partaking in any dance and song you initiate; consequently, the creature has disadvantage on all concentration and perception checks whilecharmed. Thecharmedcondition ends for the creature after 1 hour, if it takes any damage, if youattackthe target, or if the target witnesses you or your allies attacking or damaging any of the target’s allies.

Once used, you regain the use of this ability after completing a long rest.

Stone Mother’s Assault - © 2020, Adrian Arduini; Author: Adrian Arduini

Avid Gamer.name: Avid Gamer
Avid Gamer.description:
Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency with a gaming set of your choice.
When playing in board, card, and other games of chance and skill, you may add double your proficiency bonus to any gaming set with which you are already proficient. You may add your proficiency bonus to ability checks when playing all other games.
You also have advantage on any Wisdom (Insight) checks to tell when a gaming opponent is bluffing, and any Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) or Charisma (Deception) checks made against you in the context of the game are made with disadvantage.

Iron Will.name: Iron Will
Iron Will.description:
You are more resistant to mental effects.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Rimecaster.name: Rimecaster
Rimecaster.description:
When you cast a spell that deals damage, you can use a reaction to change the type of damage the spell deals to cold damage.
When you cast a spell that deals cold damage, you gain resistance to cold damage until the start of your next turn. If you already have resistance to cold damage, you are immune to cold damage until the start of your next turn instead.

Entropic Strike.name: Entropic Strike
Entropic Strike.description:
Benefit(s): Increase yourStrengthorDexterityscore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a weaponattack, you can deal an additional 1d6 necrotic damage to that target.

One Step Ahead.name: One Step Ahead
One Step Ahead.description:
Benefit(s): When you rollinitiative, you can choose to either add or subtract 5 to the roll. This must be done before anyactionsin combat are taken.

You may choose to shift yourinitiativeto go either before the creature that acts before you, or after the creature that acts after you, assuming that the creature is willing to do so. This decision must be made before anyactionsin combat are taken. You may use this trait once perlong rest.

Expert Swimmer.name: Expert Swimmer
Expert Swimmer.description: Pirates and Plunder A Compendium For 5e © 2024 Published by Mythos Chronicles; Author Filippo Bardoscia

Master Poisoner.name: Master Poisoner
Master Poisoner.description:
Increase your Dexterity or Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency with the poisoner’s kit. You have advantage on ability checks associated with the poisoner’s kit.
As an action, you can automatically detect the presence of any nonmagical poison within 5 feet of you that you can see or smell.
Enhance Poison: You can dedicate 1 hour to improving an existing poison. This requires you to have a poisoner’s kit and to spend 10% of the poison’s initial value in special ingredients. Improving a poison increases its DC by your proficiency bonus. You can improve the same poison only once. When you fail a saving throw against a poison, you can use your reaction to reroll it. The result of the second roll replaces the first.

Obsessive Drive.name: Obsessive Drive
Obsessive Drive.description:
Steeped in the emotional extremes that permeate the Scintillating Fey Courts, you’ve learned to channel that intensity into an obsessive drive to succeed when others would simply accept failure, though it can crush your morale if you still can’t make things work the way you want. When you would fail an ability check or miss anattackroll onyour turn, you can use yourreactionto reroll the d20, but you must use the new result, even if it’s lower.

If the new result still causes you to fail the ability check or miss the attack, you become crestfallen until the end of your next turn. While crestfallen, your speed is halved and you can’t take reactions.

Rancorous.name: Rancorous
Rancorous.description:
with regard to your hated enemies:
Your attacks against hated enemies score a critical hit on a 19 or 20.
If a hated enemy leaves your reach, it provokes an opportunity attack from you even if it uses the Disengage action or a similar ability.
You have advantage on Intelligence checks to recall information about your hated enemies.
You learn one language of your choice that is spoken by your hated enemies, if they speak one at all.

Bound to Blackest Witchcraft.name: Bound to Blackest Witchcraft
Bound to Blackest Witchcraft.description:
You are sworn to the eternal, devout protection of a witchblooded ward, one for whom you would gladly kill, die, or wordlessly commit the most terrible of atrocities with coldest precision. By your grim hand, resolute heart and ceaseless vigilance, this earthly embodiment of your patron’s otherworldly power shall overcome all those who would foolishly stand in the way of greatness.

Legendary Classes: Templars & Tyrants© 2023, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Darrin Drader, Miguel Colon, Clinton J. Boomer, Amber Scott

Eclectic Training.name: Eclectic Training
Eclectic Training.description:
Gain an additional spell for your Magical Creators racial ability, using a different spell list. You can cast both your original spell, and this one once each before having to take a short rest or long rest to cast it again.
Your Intelligence score increases by +1, to a maximum of 20.

Friend of Death.name: Friend of Death
Friend of Death.description:
Increase your Charisma by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain the ability to communicate with most undead. An undead with an Intelligence score of 4 or higher can communicate, albeit limited by their relative score. An undead with an Intelligence of 3 or lower can understand but not communicate. An undead that is hostile, hungry, or commanded to be aggressive can communicate, but is not likely to be cooperative.
You have advantage on Charisma checks made to influence undead creatures that share a language with you, such as vampires and liches. Though this doesn’t guarantee cooperation, it is likely that they will see in you a kindred spirit, potentially showing mercy or even assistance.
You learn find familiar as a ritual. The familiar summoned is considered undead. It is also immune to poison damage, and immune to the charmed, frightened, exhaustion, and poisoned conditions. The familiar otherwise functions as per the spell.

Titanic Strength.name: Titanic Strength
Titanic Strength.description:
Increase your Strength score by 1, up to a maximum of 22. Additionally, your Strength score maximum increases by 2.
Your reach with melee weapons increases by 5 feet.
Your melee weapon attacks deal double damage to objects and structures.
Designer’s Note
The Titanic Strength feat is specifically designed for very high magic or epic campaigns where characters engage in extraordinary feats and face larger-than-life challenges. For this reason, Game Masters should evaluate its compatibility with the tone and balance of their specific campaign before allowing in their game.

Radiant Supremacy.name: Radiant Supremacy
Radiant Supremacy.description: Radiant power burns brightly within your soul. Damage you deal with an attack, spell, or other feature ignoresresistanceto radiant damage. Additionally, when you roll for radiant damage, you can discard one of the dice after seeing the result, replacing it with a number equal to your proficiency bonus.

Enduring Soul.name: Enduring Soul
Enduring Soul.description:
Benefit(s): Increase yourWisdomscore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You can add yourWisdommodifier on death saving throws. In addition, once per long rest, if you fail a death saving throw, you can reroll it and must use the new roll.

Heavy Armor Mastery.name: Heavy Armor Mastery
Heavy Armor Mastery.description: from a short rest even while wearing your heavy armor.

Shadow Mage.name: Shadow Mage
Shadow Mage.description:
You learn the minor illusion cantrip. Choose Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma as your spellcasting ability for this cantrip.
When you cast an illusion spell while you are in an area of dim light or darkness, any creature interacting with the illusion has disadvantage on its saving throws against the spell and on Intelligence (Investigation) checks made to disbelieve the illusion.
You add silent image to your spells known or prepared. It is a class spell for you and doesn’t count against the number of spells you know or can have prepared.
When you take the Hide action while you are in an area of dim light or darkness, you have advantage on the Dexterity (Stealth) check.

Shrouded Spirit.name: Shrouded Spirit
Shrouded Spirit.description:
Your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
When a creature targets you with a spell while it can’t see you, or when you are chosen as the subject of a locate creature spell, you can make a Charisma (Deception) check against a DC equal to 10 + the spell’s level (a cantrip counts as 0 level). On a success, the spell has no effect on you and can’t be used to locate or observe you.
You have advantage on saving throws against spells or effects that attempt to locate or observe you, such as the scrying spell.
You always know when another creature attempts to use magic to observe or detect you, though you don’t know the observer’s identity, its location, or its means of observation.

Gruesome Grinder.name: Gruesome Grinder
Gruesome Grinder.description:
Benefit(s): Increase yourConstitutionby 1 to a maximum of 20. Gain immunity to thefrightenedcondition. Roll with Advantage on all saving throws against disease and necrotic damage.

Guilds of Sundara © 2022, eGDC Ltd; Author: Neal Litherland

Master Hunter.name: Master Hunter
Master Hunter.description: Choose a quarry: one of monstrosities, aberrations, undead or fiends. You have advantage onSurvivalchecks to track your chosen quarry,Insightchecks against their deception and onHistorychecks to recall information about them. Furthermore, your bonus toattackrolls against your quarry increases by 1 and you have advantage on saving throws against the spells and abilities used by them.

Redeemed Scoundrel.name: Redeemed Scoundrel
Redeemed Scoundrel.description:
Battered and bruised by the worst excesses of your old life, you possess no lack of sympathy for those souls still trapped in a vicious circle of violence, debt, addiction, and rage.

You gain advantage onCharisma(Deception), (Persuasion), (Intimidation), and onWisdom(Insight) checks when dealing creatures with a chaotic or evil alignment.

In a wounded land, everything from the air you breathe to the ground under your feet is infused with primordial chaos, evil, and corruption. The simple act of living in such an environment exposes travelers to a wasting sickness that rots both body and mind with a supernatural disease. A creature whoseConstitutiondamage equals itsConstitutionscore is consumed by rot from the inside out, its body reduced to moldering filth 24 hours later.

TakingWisdomdamage equal to a creature’sWisdomscore causes that creature to become insane (GM’s discretion as to type of insanity) even if theWisdomdamage is later healed.

The save DC to resist a tainted plague varies depending on a creature’s exposure to the wounded land. Creatures exposed by physical contact alone can resist the tainted plague with a successful DC 13Constitutionsave. The DC increases to 15 for those who breathe the air of the wounded land, and to 20 for creatures who eat or drink anything native to the wounded land (unless they usepurify food and drinkor similar magic first). Failing this check results in 1d6Constitutionand 1d6Wisdomdamage daily.

Affected creatures may make a new save once per day. It requires two consecutive successful saves to recover.

The Dragon’s Hoard #26© 2022, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Robert J. Grady, Darrin Drader, James-Levi Cooke.

Green Thumb.name: Green Thumb
Green Thumb.description:
Increase your Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20
If you cast a spell or use an ability that conjures or creates a plant creature, the creature has 50% more hit points, and it gains a +1 bonus to AC
Plants you grow are considered magical for the purposes of effects targeting them
Whenever you make an Intelligence (Nature) check related to the origins of a plant, you are considered proficient in the Nature skill and add double your proficiency bonus to the check, instead of your normal proficiency bonus.

Circle Spellcaster.name: Circle Spellcaster
Circle Spellcaster.description:
Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You can spend 2 hours (which can be during a long rest) creating a mystical bond with another spellcaster.
Both of you must spend this time in meditation, and you must remain within 10 feet of each other. The bond goes into effect when the meditation is over (or when you finish your long rest). Once the bond is formed, the two of you can bolster one another’s magic. When one of you must make a Constitution saving throw to maintain concentration on a spell, the other can use his or her reaction to help maintain the effect. Both of you make the saving throw. If either save is successful, the caster maintains concentration. If both saves are failed, both of you lose concentration on any spells you are maintaining and each of you takes 2d6 psychic damage from the strain. You can maintain this bond with only one spellcaster at a time. If you create a new bond, the previous one breaks. Otherwise, the bond lasts until you finish your next long rest.

Expression Blank.name: Expression Blank
Expression Blank.description:
Increase your Wisdom score by 1 point to a maximum of 20.
Wisdom (Insight) rolls made against you to determine the intent behind your words are at a disadvantage.
If you are within a magical effect that compels truth, such as the zone of truth spell, you are automatically aware of the magical compulsion.

Dark Whisperer.name: Dark Whisperer
Dark Whisperer.description:
You learn the message and thaumaturgy cantrips.
When you cast a spell that would charm or frighten a creature, you can choose one target of the spell to have disadvantage on the saving throw.

Vicious in Victory.name: Vicious in Victory
Vicious in Victory.description: As an action, maghra can tear at the flesh of fallen enemies and devour it to regain hit points equal to one Hit Die. The maghra can gain no more than 1 hit dice worth of benefit per Small or Medium creature. Each size category of a creature beyond Medium increases the Hit Dice benefit by one.

Combination Striker.name: Combination Striker
Combination Striker.description:
Through your martial arts training, you have honed a particular combination of moves that effectively puts your opponents off-guard. You may spend a ki point to empower your unarmed strikes in the following ways. By spending a single ki point, you have access to the entire combo, but must use the following abilities in sequence.

5E: Age of Antiquity Adventure and Intrigue in the Ancient World © 2019 Aruzian Publishing, Stephen Delucchi, Marcus Lundin

Undetectable Lie.name: Undetectable Lie
Undetectable Lie.description: NoteInfernal feats are first gained by taking the Infernal Pact feat. This feat ties a character to a Circle’s particular lord. If the character is not from that Circle, the Circle is considered his “home” Circle from that point on. The feats available to a character are determined by his home Circle—a character cannot take infernal feats that are not listed as tied to a Circle.

Ruined Arcanist.name: Ruined Arcanist
Ruined Arcanist.description:
Benefit(s): Increase yourIntelligenceorCharismascore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You learn two cantrips of your choice from any spell list.

Alertness.name: Alertness
Alertness.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Two-Weapon Fighter.name: Two-Weapon Fighter
Two-Weapon Fighter.description:
You are skilled at fighting with a weapon in each of your hands. You gain the following benefits.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Alchemaestro.name: Alchemaestro
Alchemaestro.description: from a single elixir at a time. If it drinks a second elixir while another elixir is in effect, the first elixir’s effect immediately ends.

Heat-acclimated.name: Heat-acclimated
Heat-acclimated.description:
Ability Score Increase. Increase yourConstitutionscore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Hot Weather Adaptation. You automatically succeed at saving throws against extreme heat.

Path Through Fire. When you’re hit by anattackthat deals Fire damage, the Fire damage is reduced by an amount equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

The Dragon’s Hoard #60 © 2025, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Darrin Drader, Robert J. Grady, Kate Baker, Joel Flank, Wren Brown, James-Levi Cooke.

Part of the Pack.name: Part of the Pack
Part of the Pack.description:
As an action, you can howl to summon a wolf to assist you. The wolf appears in 1d4 rounds and remains within 50 feet of you until 1 hour elapses or until it dies, whichever occurs first. You cannot control the wolf, though it will notattackyou or your companions and willattackany creature you are engaging in melee combat. If you are level 4 or higher when you summon a wolf, there is a 50% chance you will summon a dire wolf instead. At the GM’s discretion, you may not be able to summon a wolf if you are indoors or in a region that wolves are not native to.

Once you have summoned a wolf with this feat, you must finish a long rest before you can summon another wolf.

Warlock Grimoire 2. Authors: Wolfgang Baur, Celeste Conowitch, David “Zeb” Cook, Dan Dillon, Robert Fairbanks, Scott Gable, Richard Green, Victoria Jaczko, TK Johnson, Christopher Lockey, Sarah Madsen, Greg Marks, Ben McFarland, Kelly Pawlik, Lysa Penrose, Richard Pett, Marc Radle, Hannah Rose, Jon Sawatsky, Robert Schwalb, Brian Suskind, Ashley Warren, Mike Welham. © 2020 Open Design LLC.

Cheater of Death.name: Cheater of Death
Cheater of Death.description:
If you are reduced to0 hit points, and you succeed on your first death saving throw, it counts as two successes. If you make a third successful death saving throw, you regain 1 hit point and stand up if you areprone.

Galder’s Gazetteer Author(s) Matt Click, Gabe Hicks, Jess Ross

Yuralith Flight.name: Yuralith Flight
Yuralith Flight.description: You gain flying speed equal to twice your base speed.

Dirty Trickster.name: Dirty Trickster
Dirty Trickster.description:
Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You may choose to use your Dexterity in place of Strength when attempting an unarmed strike.
Your unarmed strike uses a d4 for damage.
When you succeed in making an unarmed strike against a creature, in place of dealing damage you may choose to impose a temporary penalty on your target in the form of a dirty trick. Examples include throwing slime in an opponent’s face to impose the blinded condition on them, tangling their legs in cave spider silk to halve their speed, or striking them in a sensitive area to leave them stunned.

Necromantic Alchemist.name: Necromantic Alchemist
Necromantic Alchemist.description:
Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency with alchemist’s supplies.
You can use your alchemist’s supplies to produce arcane smoke that identifies invisible spirits or other creatures. You can spend one minute using your alchemist’s supplies to create a 20-foot cube of thin gray smoke centered on your tools. Any creatures or objects within the cube cannot benefit from being invisible. Once you use your alchemist’s supplies in this way, you cannot do so again until you have completed a short or long rest.
Using your alchemist’s supplies, you can investigate a non-magical object that was owned or handled by a spirit during their lifetime. You can spend one minute using your alchemist’s supplies to glean useful information from the object. After the minute is complete, you can ask five questions that can be answered with a yes or no. The object will vibrate, glow, spin, or float in a way that makes the answer to the question clear. The object can only answer questions related to the spirit of its former owner. It will not respond to questions that are beyond its knowledge.

Charging Hurler.name: Charging Hurler
Charging Hurler.description: Battlemasters & Berserkers © 2021, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

Share Breath.name: Share Breath
Share Breath.description:
Benefit(s): As an action, you can imbue an ally with the ability to breathe water. Your ally must remain within 10 feet of you. This ability persists until you revoke it as an action or until the creature moves farther from you than the above distance. If the ability ends while that creature is still underwater, it may begin to drown.

Pirate Campaign Compendium© 2018, Legendary Games; Lead Designer Jason Nelson. Authors: Alex Augunas, Jeff Gomez, Matt Goodall, Jim Groves, Tim Hitchcock, Victoria Jaczko, Jonathan H. Keith, Lyz Liddell, Thomas J. Phillips, Alistair J. Rigg, Alex Riggs, Loren Sieg, Neil Spicer, Todd Stewart, Rachel Ventura, Michael D. Welham, Linda Zayas-Palmer.

Hear the Cries.name: Hear the Cries
Hear the Cries.description:
Increase your Wisdom by 1 to a maximum of 20
You may roll a Wisdom (Medicine) check with advantage when attempting to stabilize or heal yourself or an ally.
In addition, if you have racial or class features, or feats, that grant a restoration of hit points to yourself or others, instead of rolling dice to determine the amount restored you may restore the maximum amount of hit points. You may use this ability three times per long rest.

Bulging.name: Bulging
Bulging.description:
Unholy power fills you with great strength but the blasphemous tumors that empower you have contorted your muscles and press upon your skull.

Book of Exalted Darkness. © 2018 Mike Myler, published under license by Legendary Games.

Smithkin Resistance.name: Smithkin Resistance
Smithkin Resistance.description:
Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain resistance to fire.

Practiced Drinker.name: Practiced Drinker
Practiced Drinker.description:
You can drink a potion as a bonus action, instead of as an action.
You have advantage on any saving throws triggered by ingesting an alcoholic beverage or poisonous substance.

Beware The Tail.name: Beware The Tail
Beware The Tail.description:
Benefit(s): YourStrengthscore increases by 1, to a maximum of 20. You are proficient with the use of your tail in combat. As an action, you can use your tail as a weapon. A successfulattackdoes 1d6 plusStrengthin damage.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Backstab.name: Backstab
Backstab.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Deft Hands.name: Deft Hands
Deft Hands.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Bestial Endurance.name: Bestial Endurance
Bestial Endurance.description:
You can store reserves of food and water efficiently, allowing you to go without food and water for long periods.

You can go without food for a number of days equal to 6 + yourConstitutionmodifier. At the end of each day beyond that limit, you automatically suffer one level ofexhaustion.

In addition, you can survive normally on half the normal amount of water without ill effects.

The Dragon’s Hoard #20© 2022, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Miguel Colon, Alex Riggs, Mike Myler, Robert J. Grady, Michael “solomani” Mifsud, Darrin Drader, Matt Kimmel, Scott D. Young.

Natural Spell.name: Natural Spell
Natural Spell.description:
Your magical gifts blend seamlessly with your primal shapeshifting powers.

The Dragon’s Hoard #49© 2024, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Nick Hite, Darrin Drader, Michael Mifsud, Dan Dillon, Matt Kimmel, David N. Ross

Elemental Penetration.name: Elemental Penetration
Elemental Penetration.description:
This feat may be applied to any spell with an energy subtype (fire, cold, sonic, etc.).

The spell ignores a target’s energyresistance. Anelementalpenetration spell uses up a spell slot one level higher than the spell’s actual level.Elementalpenetration spells have no impact on creatures with immunity to an energy type, onlyresistance.

Flight.name: Flight
Flight.description: NoteInfernal feats are first gained by taking the Infernal Pact feat. This feat ties a character to a Circle’s particular lord. If the character is not from that Circle, the Circle is considered his “home” Circle from that point on. The feats available to a character are determined by his home Circle—a character cannot take infernal feats that are not listed as tied to a Circle.

Intuitive Diviner.name: Intuitive Diviner
Intuitive Diviner.description: Your supernal insight originates from the hidden depths of your mind-and reaches into hidden realities.

Toxic Resistance.name: Toxic Resistance
Toxic Resistance.description:
Benefit(s): Increase yourConstitutionscore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gainresistanceto poison damage or immunity to it if you’re already resistant.

You have advantage on saving throws against beingpoisoned.

Master Apothecary.name: Master Apothecary
Master Apothecary.description:
Increase yourWisdomscore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You have advantage onWisdom(Medicine) checks to stabilize a creature. If you expend one use of healer’s kit to stabilize a creature that has0 hit points, the creature regains 1d4hit points.

Contortionist.name: Contortionist
Contortionist.description:
Increase your Dexterity by +1 to a maximum of 20.
You may claim advantage on any checks made to resist becoming grappled.
In addition, once per short rest, you may claim advantage on any single saving throw made to resist becoming restrained either through physical means such as rope, chains, or manacles or via spell effect such as the hold person spell. This effect resets after a short rest.

Dvergr Pick Master.name: Dvergr Pick Master
Dvergr Pick Master.description:
You treat war picks as though they have the thrown (range 20/60) property. If your war pick is an aerodynamic pick (see Dvergr Equipment), you increase their normal and maximum range by +10 ft.
You treat war picks as though they have the versatile (1d10) property.

Trollkin Resilience.name: Trollkin Resilience
Trollkin Resilience.description:
Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
The AC bonus granted by your Natural Toughness racial trait increases by 1.

Spellscholar.name: Spellscholar
Spellscholar.description:
Through intense study of your spellbook or holy texts, you have learned a degree of flexibility in your spell preparation. This allows you, in times of extreme duress, to alter your spell preparation for the day. As an action, you can instantly prepare a spell from your available class spell list (or spellbook, if you prepare spells from one) that you did not have prepared. This spell choice must be of a level for which you have spell slots remaining. You then lose preparation of a different spell of your choice of equal or higher spell level.

If you are multiclassed, you can only use Spellscholar to rapidly prepare and swap spells from a class that prepares spells. Once you use this ability, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again.

Arcane Smite.name: Arcane Smite
Arcane Smite.description:
With this feat, you can expend arcane spell slots to inflict more damage with yourmelee attacks. When you hit a creature with a melee weaponattack, you can expend one arcane spell slot to deal force damage to the target, in addition to the weapon’s damage. The extra damage is 2d8 for a 1st-level spell slot, plus 1d8 for each spell level higher than 1st, to a maximum of 5d8.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Draconic Blessing.name: Draconic Blessing
Draconic Blessing.description:
While you cannot siphon artifacts for sustenance like true dragons, you are able to disrupt the flow of Vaya inside them through a similar way. You can use your action to concentrate and target one magic item you can see within 60 feet of you. Its magical properties are suppressed for 10 minutes, or until you lose your concentration.

You cannot use this ability again until you finish a short or long rest.

Subtle Spell.name: Subtle Spell
Subtle Spell.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Major Magic.name: Major Magic
Major Magic.description:
With this feat you develop your spellcasting abilities to their fullest potential. You learn the spelldetect magicand can cast it at will without expending a spell slot. You also choose one spell from the following list:detect thoughts,invisibility,see invisibility,suggestion,spider climb,levitate,mirror image, orminor illusion.

And also choose one spell from the follow list:clairvoyance,dispel magic,fly,gaseous form,haste,major image,tongues,water breathing, orwater walk.

The spells you chose cannot be changed. You may cast each of them once and regain the ability to do so after completing a long rest. Casting these spells does not use a spell slot.Charismais your spellcasting ability for all of these spells.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Black Powder Alchemist.name: Black Powder Alchemist
Black Powder Alchemist.description:
You have mastered the art of creating and using explosives. Increase yourDexterityorIntelligencescore by 1, to a maximum of 20. Additionally, you can spend 1 hour and 10 gp worth of materials to create a bomb. As an action, you can throw this bomb up to 30 feet. Each creature within 10 feet of where it lands must make a DC 15Dexteritysaving throw, taking 4d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

Pirates and Plunder A Compendium For 5e © 2024 Published by Mythos Chronicles; Author Filippo Bardoscia

Master of Hemomancy.name: Master of Hemomancy
Master of Hemomancy.description:
Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
When you cast a spell that deals necrotic damage, instead of rolling dice to determine the damage dealt, you can instead use the highest number possible for each die. Once you use this ability, you must finish a long rest to use it again.

Legionnaire.name: Legionnaire
Legionnaire.description:
You gain proficiency with medium armor, plus the following benefits, depending on your character’s spire affiliation:

Scarred Lands Player’s Guide © 2016 Onyx Path Publishing Authors: Bill Ashbless, Jason Bolte, Chris Cowger, Adam Eichelberger, Alain Giorla, Nathan Knaack, Chris Sims, Eddy Webb

Melee Wand Wielder.name: Melee Wand Wielder
Melee Wand Wielder.description:
You can use a wand as a light melee weapon that deals 1d4 piercing or bludgeoning damage.

Additionally, you may use a bonus action to activate the wand after amelee attackwith it or, you can use a charge from the wand to increase the wand’s damage to 1d8 for 1 round.

Breath of Life: The Beguiler (5e), © 2024, Orphaned Bookworm Productions, LLC, Authors: Connor Bates and Norman Mitchell Jr.

Guided Hands.name: Guided Hands
Guided Hands.description: Yourhealingis guided by divine providence. When you use a spell or feature to restorehit points, if the result on any die required is lower than yourWisdommodifier, you may use yourWisdommodifier in place of that roll.

Cleave.name: Cleave
Cleave.description:
You can strike two adjacent foes with a single blow.

You make anattackagainst a foe within reach. If you hit, you deal damage normally and can make an additionalattackas a bonus action against a foe that is adjacent to the previous foe and also within your reach. This cleaveattackonly counts as one action (and your bonus action).

When you cleave, your movement is halved for your current turn.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Courage.name: Courage
Courage.description: Sandy Petersen’s Planet Apocalypse, © 2021, Petersen Games.

Root and Branch.name: Root and Branch
Root and Branch.description:
Benefit(s): As an action, you gain the ability to communicate with other briarborn that are in physical contact with the natural world. This ability works at a range of 500 miles anywhere on the Prime Material Plane. It can be used once per short rest and lasts one minute per HD spent. The receiver of the message can respond within limits described.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Barbaric Shout.name: Barbaric Shout
Barbaric Shout.description:
When you take this feat for the first time, you learn two 1st-level battlecry spells, choosing from the list below.

If you choose this feat again, you learn two new spells, choosing from either 1st- or 2nd-level options. You cannot cast your battlecries using spell slots.

Cabalist.name: Cabalist
Cabalist.description:
When wizards first learned to write down magic into symbols and ciphers, some among them also began to harness the power of the holy writings of the gods for themselves. These secrets, collectively known as the cabal, have been transmitted from master to apprentice down through the centuries. You have learned these secrets and how to weave them into your spells.

You can use a holy symbol as an arcane focus to cast your spells. In addition, you gain the Channel Divinity feature:

You gain the ability to channel divine energy directly from your deity, using that energy to fuel magical effects. You start with two Channel Divinity effects: Invocation of Wrath and Litany of Reliance. When you use your Channel Divinity, you choose which effect to create. You must then finish a short orlong restto use your Channel Divinity again.

If you already have Channel Divinity from another source, you gain one extra use of Channel Divinity.

Scarred Lands Player’s Guide © 2016 Onyx Path Publishing Authors: Bill Ashbless, Jason Bolte, Chris Cowger, Adam Eichelberger, Alain Giorla, Nathan Knaack, Chris Sims, Eddy Webb

Heroic.name: Heroic
Heroic.description:
When you make an ability check, saving throw, or attack roll, instead of rolling the d20, spend 1 heroism point to resolve the roll as if you had rolled a 12. Alternately, spend 2 heroism points to resolve the roll as if you had rolled a 15. At an additional cost of 1 heroism point, you can use either of these benefits after you have rolled the d20, thus replacing your initial roll.
Heroism Points Spent
Effect
2
Turn a successful attack roll into a critical hit.
1
Give disadvantage to all attacks against you for 1 round.
1
Make a creature reroll an attack against you, then choose which roll applies.
1
Double your speed for 1 round.
1
Gain proficiency in a skill or tool for 1 round. You can spend 1 additional point to extend that duration to 1 minute.
1
Immediately spend 1 Hit Die and regain hit points in accordance with the short rest rules (see the Adventuring chapter).
2
Remove a level of exhaustion.
You regain your expended heroism points when you finish a long rest.

Evolved Form.name: Evolved Form
Evolved Form.description:
Increase your Summon’s Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution score by 2, up to a maximum of 22.
Increase your Summon’s hit point maximum by an amount equal to your Summoner level.
Your Summon gains resistance to one damage type of your choice.
You can take this feat multiple times, choosing a different benefit each time.

Alignment Channel.name: Alignment Channel
Alignment Channel.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Campaigner.name: Campaigner
Campaigner.description:
Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You have advantage on Constitution saving throws to avoid exhaustion when you travel for more than 8 hours in a day.
You can don or doff a suit of medium or heavy armor in half the time normally required (minimum 1 minute).

Battlefield Grace.name: Battlefield Grace
Battlefield Grace.description:
When an enemy or ally you can see within 60 feet must make a death saving throw, as a reaction you can grant that creature advantage or impose disadvantage on the die roll. You may use this ability once between short rests.
When a friendly creature you can see within 30 feet drops to 0 hit points, as a reaction you can expend one of your hit dice, healing that creature by the amount rolled plus your Charisma bonus (minimum of 1). This ability and your hit die expended recharges following a long rest.
If any of your chosen comrades on the battlefield drops to 0 hit points, you immediately know their general direction and distance, and how close to death they are, including the most serious condition afflicting them. You retain this awareness so long as you are conscious, even if you are blinded or deafened.

Enfilading Fire.name: Enfilading Fire
Enfilading Fire.description: Fighters Unlimited 5E© 2019, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

Exotic Equipment Proficiency.name: Exotic Equipment Proficiency
Exotic Equipment Proficiency.description:
You have trained to master the use of exotic equipment.

Your existing armor and weapon proficiencies now extend to exotic equipment of the same type.

Creed's Codex: Arcane Secrets of the Summoners © 2022 Brendan Jonesrebandt Consulting LLC DBA Knight Vision Creative, Author Brendan Jonesrebandt

Abbsins Pliable Tail.name: Abbsins Pliable Tail
Abbsins Pliable Tail.description: You can attack an additional time with your tail whenever you take the attack action on your turn.

Bear Hug.name: Bear Hug
Bear Hug.description:
Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Natural Grappler. When you hit a target with a Wild Shape form’s attack you can use both the Damage and the Grapple option. You can use this benefit only once per turn.
Attack Advantage. You have advantage on attack rolls against a creature Grappled by you while in Wild Shape.
Bear’s Strength. Your speed is not halved when you move a creature Grappled by you while in Wild Shape if the creature is your size or smaller.

Around the Corner.name: Around the Corner
Around the Corner.description:
When making anattack, you can curve the attack of your combat card to attack creatures around corners so long as you have enough space for the card to maneuver. When creating the trajectory you need to count the squares of unimpeded movement the card would need to make to hit the target.

Using those squares, you apply your range increment penalties if any. Next, you treat the card as a flying ‘creature’ it can turn 45 degrees each square of movement without any difficulty. If you need the card to make a 90 degree turn to hit the target, the attack has disadvantage and 5 extra feet of distance.

Polymorph: The Dealer (5E), © 2024, Orphaned Bookworm Productions, LLC, Author: Connor Bates.

Storm Touched.name: Storm Touched
Storm Touched.description:
Increase your Wisdom, Charisma, Intelligence, or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You learn to command the storm’s power. You can cast the call lightning spell once per day without expending a spell slot. You can also cast this spell using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spell’s spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

Magic Resistance.name: Magic Resistance
Magic Resistance.description:
You gain advantage on allDexterityandWisdomsaving throws against spells and magic.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Olympic Athlete.name: Olympic Athlete
Olympic Athlete.description: also applies to saving throws and ability or skill checks that use your Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution modifier.

Fey Soul: Naiad.name: Fey Soul: Naiad
Fey Soul: Naiad.description:
Summary:Your fey soul is that of a naiad, one of the river nymphs

Stone Mother’s Assault - © 2020, Adrian Arduini; Author: Adrian Arduini

Alchemical Artillerist.name: Alchemical Artillerist
Alchemical Artillerist.description:
Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You may treat thrown alchemical weapons as simple ranged weapons with the finesse and thrown (range 20/60) qualities, instead of as improvised weapons.
Throwing alchemical weapons at long range doesn’t impose disadvantage on your ranged weapon attack rolls.
When attacking with alchemical weapons, you deal 1 additional die of damage.

Rescuer.name: Rescuer
Rescuer.description:
On your turn, whenever you provide medical care to a creature other than yourself, your movement does not provoke opportunity attacks and you gain temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus. This benefit only applies once per turn.
Whenever a friendly creature takes a critical hit or is reduced to 0 hit points, you can use your reaction to move up to your speed toward this creature. This movement does not provoke opportunity attacks.
Whenever you use a healer’s kit or make a Wisdom (Medicine) check to stabilize a creature, you can do so with a bonus action instead of an action.
You have advantage on Wisdom (Medicine) checks to stabilize a creature.

Brilliant Mind.name: Brilliant Mind
Brilliant Mind.description:
Your mind is extraordinarily keen, and your mental defenses are nearly impossible to penetrate.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Sharpshooter’s Eye.name: Sharpshooter’s Eye
Sharpshooter’s Eye.description:
Increase yourDexterityscore by 1, to a maximum of 20. Additionally, attacking at long range doesn’t impose disadvantage on yourranged attackrolls with firearms, and you ignore halfcoverand three-quarterscoverwhen making anattackwith one of these weapons.

Pirates and Plunder A Compendium For 5e © 2024 Published by Mythos Chronicles; Author Filippo Bardoscia

Extended Spell (Meta Magic).name: Extended Spell (Meta Magic)
Extended Spell (Meta Magic).description:
Druids of the Arcane Circle have exclusive access to metamagic feats. Rather than taking the Ability Score Improvement feature at 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th and 19th level, they can choose this feat.

When youcast a spellthat has a duration of 1 minute or longer, you can spend 1 sorcery point to double its duration, to a maximum duration of 24 hours.

Runecarved Horns.name: Runecarved Horns
Runecarved Horns.description:
Benefit(s): You gain proficiency inArcanaorReligion. As areaction(and with the expenditure of a Hit Die), when you are casting a spell, you can add yourWisdomorCharismamodifier to damage. YourCharismaorWisdomscore increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Disease Immunity.name: Disease Immunity
Disease Immunity.description: NoteInfernal feats are first gained by taking the Infernal Pact feat. This feat ties a character to a Circle’s particular lord. If the character is not from that Circle, the Circle is considered his “home” Circle from that point on. The feats available to a character are determined by his home Circle—a character cannot take infernal feats that are not listed as tied to a Circle.

Magical Armaments.name: Magical Armaments
Magical Armaments.description: Legendary Adventures © 2020 Mike Myler, published under license by Legendary Games.

Ambidextrous.name: Ambidextrous
Ambidextrous.description:
Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Extra Strike. When you are wielding a light melee weapon in each hand and take the Attack action, you can use a bonus action to attack twice with your second weapon instead of once (see the Combat chapter: Making an Attack).
Double Strike. When you are wielding a light melee weapon in each hand and have advantage on your attack rolls against a creature, if you make a successful weapon attack against this creature and the lower of the two dice would have been sufficient to hit, you can immediately use your reaction to add the damage of your second weapon to your attack. Your ability modifier does not apply to this additional damage unless you have the Two-Weapon Fighting class feature.
Your character is wielding a scimitar and a shortsword and is making a scimitar attack with advantage. You need to roll 12 or more to hit. You roll 17 and 14, meaning that in addition to your scimitar’s damage, you can use your reaction to deal the damage of your shortsword.

Magical Aptitude.name: Magical Aptitude
Magical Aptitude.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Tenacious Resolve.name: Tenacious Resolve
Tenacious Resolve.description:
Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
When you would make a death saving throw, you can take 1 level of exhaustion instead of rolling and treat the saving throw as though you had rolled a 10 on the d20.
When you finish a short rest, you can spend a Hit Die and roll it. If you don’t roll a 1 on the die, you remove 1 level of exhaustion from yourself. If you roll the highest possible result on the die (i.e. a 10 on a d10), you also gain temporary hit points equal to your level. You can spend more than one Hit Die in this way, rolling one at a time, but you can’t remove more than 1 level of exhaustion during the same short rest. Hit Dice spent in this way don’t restore hit points.

Naval Commander.name: Naval Commander
Naval Commander.description: Pirate Campaign Compendium© 2018, Legendary Games; Lead Designer Jason Nelson. Authors: Alex Augunas, Jeff Gomez, Matt Goodall, Jim Groves, Tim Hitchcock, Victoria Jaczko, Jonathan H. Keith, Lyz Liddell, Thomas J. Phillips, Alistair J. Rigg, Alex Riggs, Loren Sieg, Neil Spicer, Todd Stewart, Rachel Ventura, Michael D. Welham, Linda Zayas-Palmer.

Hardened.name: Hardened
Hardened.description: Benefit(s): Your mind, body, and even your possessions have borne the brunt of everything the world can throw at it, leaving you dulled to disgust and pain.

Silver Tongued.name: Silver Tongued
Silver Tongued.description:
With an intuitive understanding of others and a silver tongue, you have always been able to make others believe what you want.

Increase yourCharismascore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gain advantage onCharisma(Deception) checks when attempting to deceive a creature that is not actively hostile to you.

Siktauryi Specialist.name: Siktauryi Specialist
Siktauryi Specialist.description:
Whenever you feed siktauryi poison, it generates twice the amount of shots, up to its maximum capacity.
Any siktauryi you use doubles its maximum capacity to 24 doses of acid. Excess doses above its normal limit are lost if the siktauryi leaves your possession.
Choose one damage type from the following: Cold, fire, lightning, thunder. You can condition a siktauryi via special pheromones to emit this type of energy instead of the default acid. You can change damage types upon making a short or long rest.

Adventuring Companion.name: Adventuring Companion
Adventuring Companion.description:
In return for their service, you agree to train them and provide for their basic needs (food, shelter, etc.). The companion helps and serves you to the best of their ability. They may perform many menial tasks such as errands, portage, research, or donning armor. They may also help in combat. They take their turns on yourinitiativeand obey your directions in combat. As long as the companion is within 60 feet of you, they use your proficiency bonus for attacks, saving throws, and skills they are proficient in, as they are actively learning from you. However, if you fallunconsciousor move more than 60 feet away, they lose this bonus. The companion will not tolerate abuse and will abandon you or turn on you if they feel mistreated. Companions do not gain experience points or advance in level while they serve you. After studying under you for a time, they eventually move on to pursue career opportunities elsewhere and must be replaced with a new recruit. If a companion dies or leaves, you can spend 8 hours recruiting a new one. You can also dismiss your current companion and recruit a new one.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Empowered Spell.name: Empowered Spell
Empowered Spell.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Crusher.name: Crusher
Crusher.description:
Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Your unarmed strike uses a d4 for damage.
You can use your action to force a creature grappled by you to make a Strength saving throw.
The saving throw DC equals 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Strength modifier. On a failed save, you deal bludgeoning damage to the creature equal to twice the damage dealt by your unarmed strike.

Acrobatic.name: Acrobatic
Acrobatic.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Catastrophe’s Child.name: Catastrophe’s Child
Catastrophe’s Child.description:
Choose one damage type associated with cataclysms (acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder). You gainresistanceto that damage type.

As a bonus action, you can unleash a burst of energy.

Each creature within 10 feet of you must make aDexteritysaving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your highest ability score modifier) or take damage of the chosen type equal to your proficiency bonus.

Epic Defense.name: Epic Defense
Epic Defense.description: Legendary Adventures © 2020 Mike Myler, published under license by Legendary Games.

Cutlass and Pistol.name: Cutlass and Pistol
Cutlass and Pistol.description:
You can engage in two-weapon fighting using light melee weapons and light ranged weapons. When you do, you can add your ability modifier to the damage of the second attack.
Pistols are light weapons for you.
Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn’t impose disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls with light ranged weapons.

Ferocious.name: Ferocious
Ferocious.description: when you are within 5 feet of a hostile creature and no friendly creatures are within 30 feet of you:

Hell Raisin’.name: Hell Raisin’
Hell Raisin’.description:
Benefit(s): As a bonus action, the ruanoch can spend four Hit Dice to make a specialattackversus multiple attackers adjacent to themselves. This ability can be used anytime a new opponent enters combat. When this happens, the Ruanoch can immediately use itsreactionto take an extra attack with advantage. Only this extra attack can be taken with advantage granted by this option. If the Ruanoch has advantage on its normal attacks, they are not affected by this ability.

Anytime a new opponent enters a square adjacent to the ruanoch, as areaction, they may spend two hit dice to make an extra attack against the target.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Corporeal Optimization.name: Corporeal Optimization
Corporeal Optimization.description: Vigorous energies resist invasive substances that would interfere with your body’s normal function. You haveresistanceto poison damage, and you have advantage on saving throws against poison and disease.

Nimble.name: Nimble
Nimble.description:
Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You can use your Dexterity instead of your Strength to determine the distance you can jump.
You have advantage on saving throws against being forced prone, and standing up from prone costs you only 5 feet of movement.
When you fall, you can use your reaction to take half damage from the fall. You are not prone after landing.

Adaptable.name: Adaptable
Adaptable.description:
Increase your Intelligence score by 1 to a maximum of 20.
You may select three from this list and gain proficiency in your selections: Arcana, History, Nature, Religion, any one language spoken in the Realm, your choice of artisan’s tools. You must not already be proficient in these selections. This feat cannot be taken multiple times.

Fecund Avatar.name: Fecund Avatar
Fecund Avatar.description:
You are a living representation of the gods of unholy fecundity. Your monstrous brood will one day cover the world. This grants the following horrific ability.

Each new moon you are blessed by your dark god, becoming visibly pregnant, regardless your gender. On the night of the full moon you give birth to a random living monster that is at least one size category smaller than you, and with a CR of no more than half your level.

The creature is an ally to you and your companions. In combat, the creature shares yourinitiativecount, but it takes its turn immediately after yours. It obeys your verbal commands (no action required by you). If you don’t issue any, it takes theDodgeaction and uses its move to avoid danger.

The creature remains under your control until its next sibling is born, at which point it sets off into the world to sow chaos. If the creature dies while it is under your care your patron deity shows their disapproval by afflicting you with thebanespell for the entirety of each day until it is replaced.

Clerics & Cultists© 2021, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader, Nicholas Hite, Sean K Reynolds, Jason Nelson, Jenny Jarzabski, Miguel Colon, Michael “solomani” Mifsud, Matt Daley, Nathan Reinecke.

Martial Convergence.name: Martial Convergence
Martial Convergence.description:
When you take theattackaction onyour turn, you can choose to tap into the power of convergence for one additional weaponattack. You must then roll on the convergence table to determine your mental accuracy. You regain the use of this ability once you’ve completed a short or long rest.

Creed's Codex: Arcane Secrets of the Summoners © 2022 Brendan Jonesrebandt Consulting LLC DBA Knight Vision Creative, Author Brendan Jonesrebandt

Skilled.name: Skilled
Skilled.description:
Choose any three skills, tools, instruments, or vehicles you are not proficient with. You gain proficiency with the chosen skills, tools, instruments, or vehicles.

You can take this feat multiple times. Each time you select three new skills, tools, instruments, or vehicles.

Agile Climber.name: Agile Climber
Agile Climber.description:
Additionally, you gain a climbing speed equal to your walking speed, and you have advantage onStrength(Athletics) checks made to climb difficult surfaces.

Pirates and Plunder A Compendium For 5e © 2024 Published by Mythos Chronicles; Author Filippo Bardoscia

Ahool Senses.name: Ahool Senses
Ahool Senses.description:
You gain blindsight 60 ft. You cannot use blindsight when deafened. (Note: If you’re using the Vestraadi’s sonar-rules, you may gain access to the sonar, subject to your GM’s approval.)
If you have vampiric bite, you may use it one additional time before requiring a short or long rest to recharge.

Touch of Convergence.name: Touch of Convergence
Touch of Convergence.description:
Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You learn the Monstrous Transformation spell and one Conjuration or Transmutation 1st-level spell of your choice. You can cast each spell gained by this feat once, refreshing upon a long rest. If you have access to spell slots, you can also use slots of the appropriate level to cast these spells. The spellcasting ability for these spells is the ability increased by the feat.
Whenever you cast a conjuration or transmutation spell, you can choose to roll on the convergence table.

Slippery.name: Slippery
Slippery.description:
When you are the target of an opportunity attack, you have resistance against the resulting damage.
You have advantage on rolls to escape being grappled or restrained by a creature. When you use the Dash action, difficult terrain doesn’t cost you extra movement on that turn.
You can squeeze into a smaller space (see the Combat chapter) with no ill effects. Moving through a non-hostile creature’s space costs you no extra movement.
You can attempt to move through the space of a creature whose size should normally prevent you from doing so. Make a contested Dexterity (Acrobatics) check. If you are successful, you can move through the creature’s space (it is still considered difficult terrain) and your movement does not provoke opportunity attacks from that creature until the end of your turn.

Daunting.name: Daunting
Daunting.description:
Your size and feats of strength are quite intimidating. When you make aCharisma(Intimidation) check, you can add yourStrengthbonus as well.

Scarred Races. © 2019, Wanderer’s Haven Publications; Author: Jeremy Hochhalter

Mad Passion.name: Mad Passion
Mad Passion.description:
When you make a Constitution saving throw to concentrate on a spell, treat a d20 roll of 7 or lower as an 8.
Enchantments, dread, insanity, and the incapacitated condition don’t prevent you from doing any of the following: casting spells; using or giving Bardic Inspiration dice; making ability checks using Arcana, History, Nature, Performance, Religion, or Yog-Sothothery; making ability checks with artisan’s tools; or discussing any of the previous. However, you still can’t perform actions you are physically incapable of (such as if you are petrified or unconscious).

Dweorg Weapon Mastery.name: Dweorg Weapon Mastery
Dweorg Weapon Mastery.description:
When you take the Attack action and attack with only a battleaxe or a warhammer, you use the damage value for use with two hands when wielding the weapon in one hand. When wielding the weapon in two hands, the weapon instead has a damage value of 2d6.
When using light hammers or handaxes to make a ranged attack, increase the normal and maximum range by +10 ft.

Dreamer.name: Dreamer
Dreamer.description:
Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency in Charisma saving throws. If you already had that proficiency, instead you gain proficiency in Intelligence saving throws.
You can travel knowingly in your dreams to the shared universe of the Dreamlands (see Chapter 4). Generally, you can only bring miniscule mundane things without value (such as a leaf or rock) between your physical form and the Dreamlands unless they are artifacts or magic items designed to be brought this way. You can wake yourself up from the Dreamlands by succeeding at a DC 15 Charisma check as an action. When you do, your dream-form vanishes until you return to the Dreamlands, and you awaken in your physical body.
If your Charisma check fails, you can’t make another attempt for 10 minutes.
When you gain this feat, you gain full access to all your dream form’s memories alongside your waking form’s memories and your two parallel identities are no longer independent: you are the same person in both worlds.

Brutal Hit.name: Brutal Hit
Brutal Hit.description:
Your Strength OR Dexterity increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
When you land a critical hit you double your ability score modifier for damage, in addition to doubling the damage dice.

Invigorating Warcry.name: Invigorating Warcry
Invigorating Warcry.description: Once per short rest, you may give a fearsome warcry as an action to bolster your allies and demoralize your foes.

One-Eyed Shooter.name: One-Eyed Shooter
One-Eyed Shooter.description:
and penalties:
You suffer a -2 penalty on melee attack rolls.
You have advantage on ranged attack rolls.
Your increased accuracy with ranged weapons makes you more deadly. When you score a critical hit with a ranged weapon, you may add twice your proficiency bonus to the damage dealt.

Gem Fighter.name: Gem Fighter
Gem Fighter.description:
So long as a jewel or gem has a value of 50 gp or more, you can treat it as a dagger. When you roll a natural 1 on a ranged attack roll with a gem or jewel, it is destroyed. You are always considered to be proficient with gems.
If a gem or jewel of 500 gp or more is used by you as a thrown weapon, treat it as a +1 dagger that threatens a critical hit when you roll a 19 and 20.
When you roll a natural 1 on a ranged attack roll with a gem or jewel, it is destroyed.

Vampiric Charge.name: Vampiric Charge
Vampiric Charge.description:
Driven by bloodlust, you can charge into the fray with devastating effect.

Underworld Races and Classes © 2017 AAW Games LLC; Designers: Thilo Graf and Mike Myler

Keen Hunter.name: Keen Hunter
Keen Hunter.description:
As a bonus action, you can make aPerceptioncheck against a target’s AC. If you succeed, you do not provoke attacks of opportunity when moving out of the target’s threatened area and the target does not get advantage on theirattackrolls due to flanking.

Breath of Life - The Scout (5e)© 2024, Orphaned Bookworm Productions; Authors: Norman Mitchell Jr. and Connor Bates

Elemental Channel.name: Elemental Channel
Elemental Channel.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Terrifying Revelation.name: Terrifying Revelation
Terrifying Revelation.description:
You know how to use your reputation to strike terror into the hearts of your foes.

Underworld Races and Classes © 2017 AAW Games LLC; Designers: Thilo Graf and Mike Myler

Overrun Expertise.name: Overrun Expertise
Overrun Expertise.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Timeless Youth.name: Timeless Youth
Timeless Youth.description:
One of your ability scores increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Your natural lifespan triples.
Your body never physically ages beyond adulthood and never suffers from growing old.
You are immune to magic that would cause you to age unnaturally.

Greater Grotesque.name: Greater Grotesque
Greater Grotesque.description:
Benefit(s): Whenever you are in shadow, you gain advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. Whenever you are in complete darkness, you have advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Relic Hunter.name: Relic Hunter
Relic Hunter.description: Creed's Codex: Arcane Secrets of the Summoners © 2022 Brendan Jonesrebandt Consulting LLC DBA Knight Vision Creative, Author Brendan Jonesrebandt

Silent Takedown.name: Silent Takedown
Silent Takedown.description: Breath of Life - The Scout (5e)© 2024, Orphaned Bookworm Productions; Authors: Norman Mitchell Jr. and Connor Bates

Skill Focus.name: Skill Focus
Skill Focus.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Lightning Reflexes.name: Lightning Reflexes
Lightning Reflexes.description:
You have faster reflexes than normal.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Reinforced Bone Structure.name: Reinforced Bone Structure
Reinforced Bone Structure.description: Your skeletal form becomes tougher, bolstered by your connection to necromantic energy. YourConstitutionscore increases by 1, up to a maximum of 20. Additionally, you gainresistanceto bludgeoning damage.

Gory Finish.name: Gory Finish
Gory Finish.description:
By drawing upon wells of savagery, you can slay your foe in creative and horrifyingly gruesome manners, intimidating nearby foes.

Fighters Unlimited 5E© 2019, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

Rousing Performance.name: Rousing Performance
Rousing Performance.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Draconic Rune Casting.name: Draconic Rune Casting
Draconic Rune Casting.description:
You learn two draconic runes of your choice. These runes can’t be master runes.
You learn the master runes up to the highest level of spell you can currently cast. As you grow in power and increase in level, you automatically learn the master runes for each spell level you can cast.
You can inscribe draconic runes you know on objects and empower those runes with your magic when you finish a long rest. You can have a number of empowered runes at one time equal to 1 + your proficiency bonus. You can use empowered runes to replicate spells.
You can magically mark an inscribed rune to use as a spellcasting focus for your spells.

Diehard (General).name: Diehard (General)
Diehard (General).description:
You have advantage on Constitution checks to avoid exhaustion, hold your breath, march for hours without rest, go without sleep, survive without food or water or avoid temporary damage (when applicable).
When you are reduced to zero hit points, you have advantage on Death Saves. In addition, you need only succeed at two Death Saves to stabilize.
When you are reduced to zero hit points, you can choose to remain conscious and continue fighting rather than falling unconscious. However, you are at disadvantage on all attacks, checks and saves while in this state and you must still make Death Saves to stabilize. Your Death Saves are neither advantaged nor disadvantaged, as the two conditions cancel one another out. In addition, if you take damage while in this state, you immediately fall unconscious and are treated as though you had failed two Death Saves just as if you had taken damage while unconscious.

Elven Resolve.name: Elven Resolve
Elven Resolve.description: This feat may be taken up to three times. Each time it applies to a different mental stat.

Natural Armor.name: Natural Armor
Natural Armor.description:
Your flesh and bones are thick and resistant to damage.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Claws.name: Claws
Claws.description: NoteInfernal feats are first gained by taking the Infernal Pact feat. This feat ties a character to a Circle’s particular lord. If the character is not from that Circle, the Circle is considered his “home” Circle from that point on. The feats available to a character are determined by his home Circle—a character cannot take infernal feats that are not listed as tied to a Circle.

Zephyr’s Step.name: Zephyr’s Step
Zephyr’s Step.description:
Increase yourDexterityscore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Your movement speed increases by 10 feet. Additionally, when you take theDashaction duringyour turn, you can make one weaponattackas part of it.

Aberrant Foe.name: Aberrant Foe
Aberrant Foe.description:
Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20
Whenever you make an Intelligence (Arcana) check related to the origins of an aberration, you are considered proficient in the Arcana skill and add double your proficiency bonus to the check, instead of your normal proficiency bonus
You have advantage on attempts to escape grapples from a creature grappling you with a tentacle or similar appendage
You have advantage on saving throws against effects from an aberration that inflicts a condition on you. This does not apply to the aberration’s spellcasting.

Magical Crafter.name: Magical Crafter
Magical Crafter.description:
Constructs have disadvantage on their saving throws against your spells.
When you cast a spell that enhances a weapon, such as branding smite or magic weapon, that spell’s duration is doubled.
When you cast a spell of 1st level or higher that targets an object or a construct, you can grant the target a number of temporary hit points equal to 1d6 per spell level.

Marathon Runner.name: Marathon Runner
Marathon Runner.description:
Benefit(s): YourConstitutionscore increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Your movement speed increases by 5 feet.

You have advantage onConstitutionsaving throws against becoming exhausted.

Brutal Strikes.name: Brutal Strikes
Brutal Strikes.description: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon, you can choose to reroll any of the weapon’s damage dice once. You must use the new roll.

Mixed Success.name: Mixed Success
Mixed Success.description: Whenever you make anattackwith disadvantage and miss, but the result of the higher die would have been sufficient to hit your target, you can turn this failedattackinto a successful one. However, you suffer a consequence. Resolve the successfulattacknormally, then roll on the following table. If, for any reason, the consequence cannot apply, nothing happens:

Harpooner.name: Harpooner
Harpooner.description:
When you make aranged attackusing a weapon with the thrown property and without the finesse property, you can add yourDexteritymodifier to the damage roll in addition to yourStrengthmodifier. Moreover, as a bonus action, you can bring the weapon back to your hand.

Alternatively, if your thrown weapon deals piercing damage, you can use your bonus action to harpoon your target instead of recovering your weapon. The target of your harpooning must be no more than onesizelarger than you.

Make aStrengthcheck contested by the target’sStrengthorDexterity(target’s choice). If you succeed, the target isgrappled(see the Conditions chapter). The target can escape the grapple as normal (see the Grappling section of the Combat chapter: Making anAttack). The rope can also be attacked (AC 12;hp5; immunity to bludgeoning, poison, and psychic damage) to end the grapple. As long as a creature is harpooned and you hold the strap tied to the weapon’s rope, you can automatically make a successful harpoonattackas an action. Finally, instead of using the normal rules for moving agrappledcreature, you can forsake your movement to draw a harpooned creature toward you up to half your speed.

Fiendish Tongue.name: Fiendish Tongue
Fiendish Tongue.description:
You have spent time studying fiends and their cruel hierarchy. You know their words and their names and gain the following benefits.

Sandy Petersen’s Planet Apocalypse, © 2021, Petersen Games.

Taste of Death.name: Taste of Death
Taste of Death.description:
