Benefit(s): Increase yourStrengthorConstitutionby 1, to a maximum of 20. When you hit an undead creature with a melee weaponattack, you do an additional 1d4 weapon damage.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Helfire Master.name: Helfire Master
Helfire Master.description:
You have mastered the eldritch practices and infernal powers of the gitwerc. You gain the following benefits.

Underworld Races and Classes © 2017 AAW Games LLC; Designers: Thilo Graf and Mike Myler

Rainbow Aura.name: Rainbow Aura
Rainbow Aura.description:
You increase yourConstitutionability score by 1 up to a maximum of 20. In addition, up to three times per long rest, when you successfully hit on anattack, you may roll an additional 1d6. The result on the die determines the additional damage of theattackas follows:

If the original roll to hit was a critical success, double the amount of additional damage dealt via this feat as well.

Fey Soul: Dryad.name: Fey Soul: Dryad
Fey Soul: Dryad.description:
Summary:Your fey soul is that of adryad, one of the beautiful wood nymphs.

Stone Mother’s Assault - © 2020, Adrian Arduini; Author: Adrian Arduini

On Pain of Death.name: On Pain of Death
On Pain of Death.description:
Benefit(s): As an action, the mortiss can spend three Hit Dice and temporarily raise theirConstitutionscore by 2, gaining an additional temporary hit point per level. This effect lasts for ten minutes, after which theConstitutionmodifier is removed, and any unusedtemporary hit pointsare lost.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Draaki Breath.name: Draaki Breath
Draaki Breath.description:
Casting Time: 1 action or 1reaction, which you take in response to an ally within 30 feet casting Breath Weapon Crossfire

Components: S, M (talon from an Underworld creature)

If you touch a creature that is not a draaki, they receive one use of a draaki breath weapon as though they were a draaki with hit dice equal to their own hit dice.

If you touch a draaki, they receive another, temporary use of their breath weapon. You may target yourself.

If the additional use is not used within one round of casting the spell, it is lost.

Underworld Races and Classes © 2017 AAW Games LLC; Designers: Thilo Graf and Mike Myler

Mixologist.name: Mixologist
Mixologist.description: 5E: Age of Antiquity Adventure and Intrigue in the Ancient World © 2019 Aruzian Publishing, Stephen Delucchi, Marcus Lundin

Exotic Weapon Master.name: Exotic Weapon Master
Exotic Weapon Master.description:
Increase your Strength score or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
When you obtain a melee weapon with which you are proficient that does not have the heavy property, you can declare it an exotic weapon.
When you declare a weapon exotic, you can change the weapon’s damage type to bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing and add one of the following properties to the weapon if it does not already possess it: finesse, reach, thrown (20/60), or versatile (increase the weapon’s damage die by 1 size when you wield it in two hands).

Severed Strike.name: Severed Strike
Severed Strike.description:
Benefit(s): Once per round, when you deal damage with your biteattack, you deliver an additional 1d4 necrotic damage to the target.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Liquid Tolerance.name: Liquid Tolerance
Liquid Tolerance.description:
Benefit(s): When consuming alcohol, you can either suffer the full effect or adjust the level of the drink up to three steps weaker, allowing you to take more drinks before reaching your intoxication threshold. You also gain Dwarven Resilience and advantage on saving throws against beingpoisoned.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Seafarer.name: Seafarer
Seafarer.description:
Increase yourConstitutionscore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gain proficiency with Vehicles (Water). If you already have proficiency, you add double your proficiency bonus to checks you make with it.

You double yourConstitutionmodifier when determining how long you can hold your breath and the number of rounds you an survive when you run out of breath. You also gain a Swimming speed equal to your walking speed. Furthermore, weapon attacks you make against submerged creatures without swimming speed have advantage.

Amplified Risk.name: Amplified Risk
Amplified Risk.description: Creed's Codex: Arcane Secrets of the Summoners © 2022 Brendan Jonesrebandt Consulting LLC DBA Knight Vision Creative, Author Brendan Jonesrebandt

Three-Armed Fighting.name: Three-Armed Fighting
Three-Armed Fighting.description:
You can draw or stow up to one one-handed weapon per arm you have or one two-handed weapon per two arms you have (in any combination) when you would otherwise be able to draw or stow a single weapon.
You can use two-weapon fighting to attack with a light weapon after using the Attack action to attack with any weapon you wield in one or two hands.
When you use two-weapon fighting with light melee weapons, you can make a third attack with a third light melee weapon you wield in a third hand. You don’t add your ability modifier to the damage with the third attack (even if you have the Two-Weapon Fighting option for your Fighting Style feature).

Careful Spell (Meta Magic).name: Careful Spell (Meta Magic)
Careful Spell (Meta Magic).description:
Druids of the Arcane Circle have exclusive access to metamagic feats. Rather than taking the Ability Score Improvement feature at 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th and 19th level, they can choose this feat.

When youcast a spellthat forces other creatures to make a saving throw, you can protect some of those creatures from the spell’s full force. To do so, you spend 1 sorcery point and choose a number of those creatures up to yourIntelligencemodifier (minimum of one creature). A chosen creature automatically succeeds on its saving throw against the spell.

Foil Scrutiny.name: Foil Scrutiny
Foil Scrutiny.description:
You are skilled at concealing your thoughts and intentions. You gain the following benefits.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Marksman.name: Marksman
Marksman.description:
Focus: You cannot have disadvantage to your attack, unless you have disadvantage from multiple sources at the same time. Additionally, your attack ignores half cover and three-quarters cover.
Take Aim: If your attack is successful, add a +2 bonus to the damage. In addition, your attack scores a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

Cannoneer.name: Cannoneer
Cannoneer.description:
Increase yourDexterityorIntelligencescore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Additionally, you gain proficiency in cannons and swivel guns, and when you fire with one of these weapons, you have advantage on theattackroll.

Pirates and Plunder A Compendium For 5e © 2024 Published by Mythos Chronicles; Author Filippo Bardoscia

Disengaging Shot.name: Disengaging Shot
Disengaging Shot.description:
You make one lastattackbefore beating a hasty retreat.

Fighters Unlimited 5E© 2019, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

Winged Guardian.name: Winged Guardian
Winged Guardian.description:
Blessed by a deity or powerful extraplanar creature, you can use an action to magically sprout wings for 1 minute. If you are good or neutral, these wings appear feathered; if you are evil, they appear bat-like. The wings grant you a flying speed of 50 feet, though you cannot fly if you are exceeding your carrying capacity. You can’t use this feat again until you finish a long rest.

Sandy Petersen’s Planet Apocalypse, © 2021, Petersen Games.

Quickened Spell (Meta Magic).name: Quickened Spell (Meta Magic)
Quickened Spell (Meta Magic).description:
Druids of the Arcane Circle have exclusive access to metamagic feats. Rather than taking the Ability Score Improvement feature at 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th and 19th level, they can choose this feat.

When youcast a spellthat has a casting time of 1 action, you can spend 2 sorcery points to change the casting time to 1 bonus action for this casting.

Strong Personality.name: Strong Personality
Strong Personality.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Diabolical Avatar.name: Diabolical Avatar
Diabolical Avatar.description:
You are an incarnate contract with a god of infernal bargains, granting the following abilities:

You must finish a short rest before you may use this ability again. After using it a second time in one day, you must finish a long rest before you may use it again.

Clerics & Cultists© 2021, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader, Nicholas Hite, Sean K Reynolds, Jason Nelson, Jenny Jarzabski, Miguel Colon, Michael “solomani” Mifsud, Matt Daley, Nathan Reinecke.

Markings of the Order.name: Markings of the Order
Markings of the Order.description:
You gainresistanceto necrotic and poison damage.

Sandy Petersen’s Planet Apocalypse, © 2021, Petersen Games.

Pious Fervor.name: Pious Fervor
Pious Fervor.description: When you channel divine power from the Bright Wylds, you are inspired to move with unparalleled zeal. When youcast a spellof 1st level or higher, you can use yourreactionto move up to 5 feet for each level of the spell you cast. This movement doesn’t provoke opportunity attacks.

Silence Foe.name: Silence Foe
Silence Foe.description: Breath of Life - The Scout (5e)© 2024, Orphaned Bookworm Productions; Authors: Norman Mitchell Jr. and Connor Bates

Quick Tail.name: Quick Tail
Quick Tail.description:
Your base speed increases by 5 feet.
You can use a portion of your tail to make an unusually effective unarmed strike. Your unarmed strike with your tail deals 1d6 bludgeoning damage and has the finesse and light properties.
When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike using your tail, you can use a bonus action to attempt to shove the target.

Lunging Attack.name: Lunging Attack
Lunging Attack.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Flesh of Many Skins.name: Flesh of Many Skins
Flesh of Many Skins.description: of a swarm made up of Tiny creatures, and you have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, slashing damage, and are immune to the charmed, frightened, grappled, paralyzed, petrified, prone, restrained, and stunned conditions. You are also immune to any spell or effect that targets a specific number of creatures – including single target spells such as disintegrate. You can still be grappled, and you may still enter a grapple or perform grapple actions. In addition, you do not deal swarm damage but instead attack and deal damage with the normal attacks of your temporarily chosen form. You also have disadvantage on saving throws against spells or effects that affect an area. If the area attack does not allow a saving throw, you instead take double damage. In addition, while in this form, normal animals and vermin do not willingly approach within 30 feet of you unless the animal’s master makes a DC 15 Wisdom (Animal Handling). Normal animals and vermin without a master — or without a master present — do not willingly approach within 10 feet of you, becoming frightened for 1 round (no save) if they begin their turn within this radius if their Hit Dice are less than one-half your character level. Creatures with hit dice equal to half your level or more must succeed on a DC 13 Wisdom saving throw or become frightened for 1 round. Creatures with more Hit Dice than your character level may freely choose whether or not to remain within 10 feet of you.

Giant Foe.name: Giant Foe
Giant Foe.description:
Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
If you normally have disadvantage on attack rolls made with weapons with the Heavy property due to your size, you don’t have disadvantage on those attack rolls.
When a giant attacks you, any critical hit from it against you becomes a normal hit.
Whenever you make an Intelligence (History) check related to the culture or origins of a giant, you are considered proficient in the History skill and add double your proficiency bonus to the check, instead of your normal proficiency bonus.

Betrayer.name: Betrayer
Betrayer.description:
You can charm people into lowering their defenses, allowing you to ambush them more effectively.

The Dragon’s Hoard #41 © 2024, Legendary Games; Authors Authors Jason Nelson, Michael Mifsud, Matt Kimmel, Dan Dillon, James-Levi Cooke

Animal Companion.name: Animal Companion
Animal Companion.description:
Its proficiency bonus is equal to your proficiency bonus
It adds its proficiency bonus to its armor class, as well as all of its saving throws.
For each level you have above 4th, you companion gains an additional hit die, and increases its hit point maximum accordingly.

Adaptive Defense.name: Adaptive Defense
Adaptive Defense.description:
expires at the end of the combat and you can only adapt to one creature type at a time.
When an enemy forces you to make a Strength or Dexterity saving throw against a spell or ability, you may use your reaction to adapt to that attack. When you do this, gain advantage on Strength or Dexterity saving throws against spells of the same school or the exact ability used against you. This benefit expires at the end of the combat and you can only adapt to one spell or ability type at a time.

Academician.name: Academician
Academician.description: Scarred Races. © 2019, Wanderer's Haven Publications; Author: Jeremy Hochhalter

Deadly Finish.name: Deadly Finish
Deadly Finish.description:
Your attacks don’t just fell your opponents—they kill them outright.

Battlemasters & Berserkers © 2021, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

Sudden Stealth.name: Sudden Stealth
Sudden Stealth.description:
While you rollinitiativefor combat, and you are within range of a Dash action of something you could hide behind, you can also roll aDexterity(Stealth) check against theinitiativeof hostile creatures as you dive forcover. Anyone whoseinitiativecheck you beat with yourDexterity(Stealth) check is unaware of your presence.

Art of Might: Artful Dodgers© 2022, d20fsrd.com Publishing; Author: Ed Kabar

Defiant Spirit.name: Defiant Spirit
Defiant Spirit.description:
As an action, you can touch a creature and know if it’s currently poisoned.
As an action, you can touch a creature and know if it’s poisonous or venomous.
As an action, you can touch an object and know if it is poisonous or contains poison.
When a poison enters your body, you can identify its exact effects even if it doesn’t affect you.

Necromancer.name: Necromancer
Necromancer.description: Your study of the necromantic arts allows you to create an undead familiar. You learn the find familiar spell and can use this feat to cast it as a ritual. When cast in this way you must choose one of the following undead creatures instead of the options you could normally choose: ossuary hound, mummified cat, corpse crawler, shade, Nyssian scarabs, vampiricbat, floating skull.

Worldly Linguist.name: Worldly Linguist
Worldly Linguist.description: Legendary Adventures © 2020 Mike Myler, published under license by Legendary Games.

Pattern Savant.name: Pattern Savant
Pattern Savant.description:
Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You have advantage on Intelligence and Wisdom checks to make logical conclusions, translate languages, decipher codes, and recognize patterns in objects, events, or creatures you observe.
You learn one language of your choice.

Elemental Fury.name: Elemental Fury
Elemental Fury.description:
You have advantage on saving throws against effects that would deal acid, cold, fire, or lightning damage.
When you take acid, cold, fire, or lightning damage while raging, you can rage for one additional round and your weapon attacks deal extra damage of the same type equal to.your Rage Damage bonus for one round. This extra damage ignores resistance and immunity.

Art of Surprise.name: Art of Surprise
Art of Surprise.description:
Surpriseis not something to be wasted. Once per round, when you hit an enemy which is unaware of you, with a melee weapon, you may apply yoursneak attackdamage to a second melee attack. This attack need not be against the same target and uses a bonus action.

Art of Might: Artful Dodgers© 2022, d20fsrd.com Publishing; Author: Ed Kabar

Scion of the Earth.name: Scion of the Earth
Scion of the Earth.description:
Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You may use Wrath of the Earth an additional 3 times before needing to rest.

Enhanced Wishes.name: Enhanced Wishes
Enhanced Wishes.description:
Benefit(s): A creature can wish for an object that they need, which you can grant as areaction. This object must be non-magical and can cost an additional 10 gp for every Hit Die that you have. The object immediately appears in the creature’s hand. Once you use this ability, you cannot use it again until you complete a long rest. YourCharismascore increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Banishing Strike.name: Banishing Strike
Banishing Strike.description:
You have learned the weaknesses of fiends and other extraplanar monsters through harrowing combat. You gain the following benefits.

Sandy Petersen’s Planet Apocalypse, © 2021, Petersen Games.

Elemental Resistance.name: Elemental Resistance
Elemental Resistance.description:
Increase yourConstitutionscore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Choose one type of elemental damage: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder. You gainresistanceto that type of damage.

Comprehend the Corrupted.name: Comprehend the Corrupted
Comprehend the Corrupted.description:
You possess wisdom of such incredible & unerring acuity that you may sense the bright spark of goodness – though buried deep, dormant & perhaps long-silenced – hidden within the cold, stony heart of even the most corrupt, vile and seemingly-irredeemable of villains.

Whenever a creature within 60 feet attacks you or an ally, as a bonus action you can make aWisdom(Insight) check, opposed by that creature’sCharisma(Deception) check.

If your check succeeds, you can determine whether the creature has the potential to be swayed to your side by youractions, by your words, by outside circumstance beyond your control, or by some combination of those factors.

Creatures that are innately evil are instantly revealed as such unless their alignment aura is disguised by magic. You also can determine if a creature is not evil but ischarmedor under some type of magical influence or control, or if a creature is entirely mindless and driven only by instinctual urges.

For creatures that do not fit into any of the above categories, a successful check gives you a useful hunch or clue about the creature’s motivations in attacking you, including a misguided good-aligned creature, a lawful soldier simply following orders, a case of mistaken identity, or even a case of the creature being forced toattackunder duress or blackmail. The specifics of what is learned are up to the GM, but a successful check should provide some useful insight. A failed check may mark the target as suspicious but gives relatively little information.

You must have line of sight to the creature and be able to clearly specify that creature, even if it is disguised, polymorphed, has partial concealment, or otherwise is hiding its identity. You can use this feat once per round as a free action. You also can use this feat as a bonus action to reflect on the motivations of a creature who attacked you or an ally within the past minute.

At the GM’s option, you also can use this feat to gain insight into the motivations of a creature performing other types ofactionsbesides attacking, such as theft or breaking into a building.

The Dragon’s Hoard #27 © 2023, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Michael Mifsud, Robert J. Grady, Darrin Drader, James-Levi Cooke.

Grit and Determination.name: Grit and Determination
Grit and Determination.description:
Increase yourConstitutionscore by 1, to a maximum of 20. Additionally, when you are reduced to0 hit pointsbut not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. Once used, you can’t use this feature again until you finish a short or long rest.

Pirates and Plunder A Compendium For 5e © 2024 Published by Mythos Chronicles; Author Filippo Bardoscia

Healing Chakra.name: Healing Chakra
Healing Chakra.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Dreadful.name: Dreadful
Dreadful.description:
Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.
You gain proficiency in the Intimidation skill, and your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses that skill.
You can try to frighten a creature within 30 feet of you that can see and hear you. As an action, you make a Charisma (Intimidation) check contested by the target’s Wisdom saving throw. If you succeed, the target is frightened of you until the end of your next turn. This is a nonmagical effect.
When you cast a spell or use a class feature that would render one or more targets frightened, you can choose to either double the range of the effect, or target twice as many creatures as you could normally affect within range.
When you cast a spell or use a class feature that would render one or more targets frightened, the duration of the effect is doubled if it is normally 1 minute or longer; if the effect normally lasts for less than 1 minute, you can increase its duration to 1 minute, but the target can make a new saving throw at the end of each of its turn, ending the effect on a successful save.

Oracle.name: Oracle
Oracle.description:
Chosen by your god, you are a paragon of your deity’s ideals, spreading your faith through perseverance and example.

When dealing with those who do not worship a god, you may add yourWisdombonus to anyDeceptionorPersuasionskill check, and you double yourWisdombonus for anyInsightskill check.

Scarred Races. © 2019, Wanderer’s Haven Publications; Author: Jeremy Hochhalter

Technopath.name: Technopath
Technopath.description:
Your communion with machine language allows you to connect with devices with the power of thought. This ability allows you to mentally interface with computers and devices, but not creatures, up to 60 feet away. You can access any function someone could access by physically manipulating the device without needing to touch it. Manipulating devices in this way requires concentration, and you can simultaneously access a number of devices equal to yourIntelligencemodifier (minimum 1). As an action, you can choose one device you are mentally interfaced with and cause it to shut down or cause it to behave erratically for 1d4 rounds.

Spells and effects that would interrupt magical telepathy also interrupt this ability. If a device you are trying to interface with is intelligent, magical, or otherwise unusual in the DM’s discretion, you must succeed anIntelligencesaving throw with a DC of the DM’s discretion.

Strange creatures inhabit the worlds of fantasy, from the menacing to the magnificent, each one keen to guard its own treasures, or sometimes set as guardian to protect the wealth of another. You must always keep your eyes open and your wits about you to survive the dangers waiting beyond the horizon or beyond the next dungeon door!

The Dragon’s Hoard #13 © 2021, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Miguel Colon, Robert J. Grady, Michael “solomani” Mifsud, Dan Dillon, Matt Kimmel, Scott D. Young, and JamesLevi Cooke

Heroic Defiance.name: Heroic Defiance
Heroic Defiance.description: you to do so. You can use this ability again after a long rest.

Aerial Guardian.name: Aerial Guardian
Aerial Guardian.description:
Benefit(s): Your flight speed increases by 20 feet. You gain advantage on Dexterity saving throws while in flight. Your Dexterity score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Ironguts.name: Ironguts
Ironguts.description:
Benefit(s): You are immune to thepoisonedcondition and poison damage when you ingest something that inflicts that condition. You also have advantage on saving throws against diseases caused by ingestion.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Body Control.name: Body Control
Body Control.description: After you have used Body Control once, each additional use before you finish a short rest gives you a level of exhaustion. You regain your use of Body Control when you finish a short rest.

Relentless Predator.name: Relentless Predator
Relentless Predator.description: Your hunting skills are peerless. You have advantage on attack rolls against creatures that are at or below half theirhit pointsmaximum.

Demon Slayer.name: Demon Slayer
Demon Slayer.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Vaulter.name: Vaulter
Vaulter.description:
You have trained extensively for the games and have greatly improved your ability tojump.

5E: Age of Antiquity Adventure and Intrigue in the Ancient World © 2019 Aruzian Publishing, Stephen Delucchi, Marcus Lundin

Invulnerable Rager.name: Invulnerable Rager
Invulnerable Rager.description:
Prerequisite(s): The ability to enter a rage
You have resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage.
While raging, you have resistance to all damage except psychic.

Horned Epidermis.name: Horned Epidermis
Horned Epidermis.description:
While you are unarmed, you can use Constitution instead of Strength for the attack and damage rolls of your unarmed strikes.
You increase the primary damage dice of devil’s strike to 3d10.
You gain AC 12+Dexterity modifier (natural armor) while not wearing any armor.

Vocal Virtuoso.name: Vocal Virtuoso
Vocal Virtuoso.description:
You can gain advantage on three Charisma (Persuasion) or Charisma (Deception) checks. You regain these three uses after along rest.

Art of Magic – Heretical Pacts © 2019, d20pfsrd.com Publishing; Author: Ed Kabara

Insomniac.name: Insomniac
Insomniac.description: of long rest more than once per 24 hours as normal.

Unstable Mutation.name: Unstable Mutation
Unstable Mutation.description:
of one extra effect of your choice from the Mutated Physiology table.
You can select this feat multiple times. Each time you do so, you must choose a different mutation.

Dual Specialty.name: Dual Specialty
Dual Specialty.description:
You have split your focus, pursuing your martial prowess and spellcasting capabilities.

Creed's Codex: Arcane Secrets of the Summoners © 2022 Brendan Jonesrebandt Consulting LLC DBA Knight Vision Creative, Author Brendan Jonesrebandt

Defensive Expertise.name: Defensive Expertise
Defensive Expertise.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Restful Vigilance.name: Restful Vigilance
Restful Vigilance.description:
of rest.
Prerequisite(s): Half-Giant
Benefit(s): As an action, the half-giant can spend two Hit Dice before taking a short rest and remain alert for the purposes of surprise and resolving random encounters during this time. This ability cannot be used during a long rest.

Cyclopean Might.name: Cyclopean Might
Cyclopean Might.description:
Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
When you successfully hit a creature up to two sizes larger than you with a melee weapon attack, you can push the target up to 5 feet away from you.

Out of Sight.name: Out of Sight
Out of Sight.description:
Casting Time: 1 action

Rangepersonal Components V, S, M (a strip of black cloth)

DurationConcentration, up to 10 minutes

The spell inhibits the memories of creatures that perceive you. While creatures can perceive you normally, when a creature stops observing you, it must attempt aWisdomsaving throw. If it fails, it loses all memory of its awareness of you and youractionswhile you were under the effects of this spell. The spell’s duration measures how long the out of sight effect lasts on you, but the memory alteration is instantaneous and can be reversed only by magic such asmodify memory. The creature is still aware of any other changes to itself or its environment. For instance, a guard will remember running, and may notice a newly unlocked door, but will not remember that he was chasing after you. Creatures that cannot becharmedare immune to this spell.

Forest Kingdom Campaign Compendium 5e© 2017, Legendary Games; Lead Designer Jason Nelson. Authors: Clinton J. Boomer, Benjamin Bruck, Matt Goodall, Tim Hitchcock, N. Jolly, Julian Neale, Jason Nelson, Thomas J. Phillips, Alistair J. Rigg, David N. Ross, Neil Spicer, Todd Stewart, Russ Taylor, Michael D. Welham, Linda Zayas-Palmer.

Punish Weakness.name: Punish Weakness
Punish Weakness.description:
Benefit(s): Success breeds success. As a bonus action, you can spend two Hit Dice to activate this ability. When you make three successful attacks against a single target, your nextattackautomatically becomes a critical hit. This ability can be used once per short rest.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Sea Shooter.name: Sea Shooter
Sea Shooter.description: Pirate Campaign Compendium© 2018, Legendary Games; Lead Designer Jason Nelson. Authors: Alex Augunas, Jeff Gomez, Matt Goodall, Jim Groves, Tim Hitchcock, Victoria Jaczko, Jonathan H. Keith, Lyz Liddell, Thomas J. Phillips, Alistair J. Rigg, Alex Riggs, Loren Sieg, Neil Spicer, Todd Stewart, Rachel Ventura, Michael D. Welham, Linda Zayas-Palmer.

Hidden Potential.name: Hidden Potential
Hidden Potential.description:
When you cast any spell, you can channel innate magical energy into it to increase its power.

Your spellcasting ability increases by 1 (if you have multiple, you choose which), to a maximum of 20. When youcast a spellusing a spell slot, you can choose to treat it as if it had been cast using a spell slot with a level equal to your proficiency bonus.

You can use this feature once, then cannot use it again until you complete a short rest.

Crowd Pleaser.name: Crowd Pleaser
Crowd Pleaser.description:
Your grand presence draws eyes swiftly and holds their attention with a firm grasp.

5E: Age of Antiquity Adventure and Intrigue in the Ancient World © 2019 Aruzian Publishing, Stephen Delucchi, Marcus Lundin

Shield Specialist.name: Shield Specialist
Shield Specialist.description: When you take this feat, any shield that grants a natural +2 AC bonus or less (magical bonuses not included), gains the following weapon properties: Finesse, Returning, Range (30/80), Thrown. It deals 1d8 bludgeoning damage on a hit and you are proficient with it. Also, you can don or doff the shield in the same way you would sheath or unsheathe a sword.

Extra Lay On Hands.name: Extra Lay On Hands
Extra Lay On Hands.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Bloodzerker.name: Bloodzerker
Bloodzerker.description: The familiar scent of blood in the air drives you to further acts of violence. While a creature (excluding you, constructs, and undead) that has no more than half its totalhit pointsis within 10 feet of you, you can roll 1d4 each time you make a weapon attack against a creature, adding the result to the attack roll.

Dry Rambler.name: Dry Rambler
Dry Rambler.description:
You may spend up to an hour per day in direct sunlight without suffering the effects of your Sunlight Hypersensitivity. You may spend an additional hour in sunlight without repercussion per two hit dice you have.
You lose light blindness.
You only take 10 acid damage from fresh water.

Elemental Spell.name: Elemental Spell
Elemental Spell.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Veil of the Aurora.name: Veil of the Aurora
Veil of the Aurora.description:
Increase yourCharismaorWisdomscore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

As an action, you can emanate an auroral light that creates a shimmering, colorful veil in a 15-foot radius around you for 1 minute. This veil makes it difficult for enemies to accurately perceive where you and your allies are within it. Attacks from creatures outside the veil against you and allies within the veil have disadvantage. Once used, this ability cannot be used again until after a short or long rest.

Adder Strike.name: Adder Strike
Adder Strike.description: Battlemasters & Berserkers © 2021, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

Craven Rat.name: Craven Rat
Craven Rat.description:
You gain a +1 bonus toDexterity, up to a maximum of 20.

Anytime you would deal damage to a creature who would qualify for a sneakattack, you deal 1d6 extra damage. This damage stacks with sneakattack. However, you have disadvantage on all saving throws against thefrightenedcondition.

Breath of Life: The Beguiler (5e), © 2024, Orphaned Bookworm Productions, LLC, Authors: Connor Bates and Norman Mitchell Jr.

Stand Still.name: Stand Still
Stand Still.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Hellsmith.name: Hellsmith
Hellsmith.description:
You master the art of forging fiend-slaying weapons, perhaps due to the mentorship of a master or the lost notes of someone who knew too much and died first in the fiendish invasion. You gain the following benefits.

Sandy Petersen’s Planet Apocalypse, © 2021, Petersen Games.

Bow Fighter.name: Bow Fighter
Bow Fighter.description:
Benefit(s): You can use a shortbow, longbow, or greatbow* you are proficient with as a melee weapon, and you use yourDexteritymodifier when attacking and determining the damage. When attacking in this way, the weapon die is lowered one level, meaning that 1d8 becomes 1d6 and 1d6 becomes 1d4 and so on. You are proficient in these attacks.

You can use an action of attempt to restrain a large or smaller creature by choking them out with the string on your bow. Make anStrength(Athletics) check opposed the creature’sStrength(Athletics) orDexterity(Acrobatics) check. If you succeed, the creature isrestrained. It may use its action on its turn to attempt to break free, and you may use your action on each of your subsequent turns to maintain your hold over the creature. The creature is given another chance to escape if you do so.

*This weapon is detailed in this compendium.

Opening Volley.name: Opening Volley
Opening Volley.description: Battlemasters & Berserkers © 2021, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

Savage Warrior.name: Savage Warrior
Savage Warrior.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Elemental Mastery.name: Elemental Mastery
Elemental Mastery.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Gift of the Fire Giant.name: Gift of the Fire Giant
Gift of the Fire Giant.description:
Increase your Wisdom, Charisma, Intelligence, or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You learn to harness the destructive power of fire. You can cast the fireball spell once per day without expending a spell slot. You can also cast this spell using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spell’s spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

Physician.name: Physician
Physician.description:
You are a person of science. You have trained on human anatomy, and you know to repair wounds quickly.

Stone Mother’s Assault - © 2020, Adrian Arduini; Author: Adrian Arduini

Ahooling Flight.name: Ahooling Flight
Ahooling Flight.description:
You gain flying speed equal to your base speed.
If you already have a flying speed from the flight of the vampire ability, your flying speed increases to 60 ft.

Born Rider.name: Born Rider
Born Rider.description:
You have advantage on all Wisdom (Animal Handling) checks when handling any domesticated beast that is trained as a mount.
You use only 5 feet of your movement to mount or dismount a creature that has been trained as a mount.
When you are mounted and not incapacitated, your mount’s movement speed increases by 10 feet.
When you are mounted and not incapacitated, if your mount provokes an opportunity attack while you’re on it, you can choose whether the attacker targets you or the mount.

Gearsmith.name: Gearsmith
Gearsmith.description: Your mastery of the artificer’s art is perfected.

Survivalist.name: Survivalist
Survivalist.description:
Increase your Constitution by +1, to a maximum of 20
You find twice the amount of food and water in extreme conditions
You and your party gain advantage on saving throws vs environmental damage due to extreme heat or cold.

Survival Instinct.name: Survival Instinct
Survival Instinct.description:
You have mastered the art of survival in the underworld.

Underworld Races and Classes © 2017 AAW Games LLC; Designers: Thilo Graf and Mike Myler

Primal Speaker.name: Primal Speaker
Primal Speaker.description:
You are in touch with creatures associated with your kind.

Underworld Races and Classes © 2017 AAW Games LLC; Designers: Thilo Graf and Mike Myler

Radiant Resistance.name: Radiant Resistance
Radiant Resistance.description:
Benefit(s): Increase yourConstitutionscore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gainresistanceto radiant damage. Additionally, you are immune to beingblinded.

Sanctify Land.name: Sanctify Land
Sanctify Land.description:
With intense prayer and devotion, a place or thing can be sanctified. This becomes a regular duty for those priests charged with the caretaking of holy sites, shrines, and temple sanctuaries. Altars, mausoleums, and sepulchers are also frequent targets, especially if intrusion or unholyresurrectionis a risk.

While not as powerful as higher-level divine magic, a divine spellcaster can spend a short rest in prayer and the preparation of material sacrifice to achieve a similar magical effect.

After spending a short rest in prayer, roll percentile dice. If you roll a number equal to or lower than your character level, you are successful, and any items you sacrificed are used up. You may then choose one secondary effect from thehallowspell, which then stays in effect for a week or until dispelled. For every 10 gp you spend in sacrificed material you add 5 to your character level for the purpose of this rite.

Warlock Grimoire 4. ©2023 Open Design LLC. Authors: Lou Anders, Wolfgang Baur, HH Carlan, Robert Fairbanks, Basheer Ghouse, Richard Green, Tim Hitchcock, Jeremy Hochhalter, Victoria Jaczko, Rajan Khanna, Sarah Madsen, Ben McFarland, Jonathan Miley, Kelly Pawlik, Sebastian Rombach, Adam W. Roy, Paul Scofield, Amber Stewart, Brian Suskind, Mike Welham.

Void Scribe.name: Void Scribe
Void Scribe.description:
For the glyph to remain intact, you must concentrate on it as if concentrating on a spell. In addition to the normal demands of concentration, you must also make a successful DC 10Constitutionsaving throw at the start ofyour turnor the glyph crumbles away and ceases to function.Void Rift

Deep Magic for 5th Edition(c) 2020 Open Design LLC; Authors: Dan Dillon, Chris Harris, and Jeff Lee.

Kyubi Ascension.name: Kyubi Ascension
Kyubi Ascension.description:
Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Your true form grows an additional tail upon gaining this feat. You can grow additional tails using any of the methods described on pages 10-11, provided the GM agrees that growing an additional tail is an appropriate reward for your deeds during the campaign. The GM determines the rate at which you can acquire additional tails, though you typically can’t have more tails than half your level (minimum 2).
You learn the dancing lights spell.
You learn one 1st-level bard spell of your choice. This spell must be from the enchantment, illusion, or transmutation schools. You learn an additional spell for each new tail you gain beyond the second; this new spell can be one level higher than the previous tail’s spell (for example, your third tail grants you a spell of 3rd-level or lower, your fourth tail grants you a spell of 4th-level or lower, and so on). You can cast any two spells from among those you’ve gained from this benefit without expending a spell slot. Spells that can be cast at a higher level are always cast at a spell level equal to half your level or 1st-level, whichever is higher. You regain the ability to cast these spells when you finish a long rest. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells.

Inherent Spirit.name: Inherent Spirit
Inherent Spirit.description: You may lack the sage knowledge and concentration of your peers, but your inborn connection to your ki obvious to your foes. For any of yourmonkfeatures that use yourWisdommodifier, you may instead use yourConstitutionmodifier.

Deck Brawler.name: Deck Brawler
Deck Brawler.description:
Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain a +2 bonus to initiative while standing on anything that is floating on water.
Climbing doesnât half your speed.
You can add your proficiency bonus to any check that involves boarding another sea vessel.

Eyes of the Watcher.name: Eyes of the Watcher
Eyes of the Watcher.description:
Permanently altered by a dream or vision, you manifest an uncanny ability to perceive otherworldly forces. Your eyes change appearance, such as to solid black or tawny orange with cat like slits, granting you the following benefits.

Sandy Petersen’s Planet Apocalypse, © 2021, Petersen Games.

Awareness on Dark Winds.name: Awareness on Dark Winds
Awareness on Dark Winds.description:
While it is assuredly true that you are ‘territorial,’ you have also laid claim to hunting-grounds which extend from horizon to horizon. You possess the deadliest of supernatural senses, capable of hearing the whispers of certain terrible secrets upon the far-away breeze and of stealing visions from those whom you stalk, cripple and consume. With the blasphemous gifts given over by your mighty patron, you are truly the most fearsome of all predators, making your prey of all those who live. None who have glimpsed the hidden rites or heard uttered the forbidden lore of your order shall ever sleep safely again, knowing that you listen in the blackness.

You can hear your name, your title or the name of Pazuzu spoken aloud within a range of 10 miles per character level; you know the immediate direction to – and the rough distance toward – any favored enemy within that range. You gain advantage onCharisma(Deception),Intelligence(Nature),Wisdom(Perception), andWisdom(Insight), andWisdom(Survival) checks against favored enemies, as well as a +2 bonus on weaponattackanddamage rollsagainst them.

In addition, any creature who has spoken your name, your title, or the name of Pazuzu within the last 24 hours is treated as though it were a member of your favored enemy type – regardless of the creature’s actual type.

The Dragon’s Hoard #26© 2022, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Robert J. Grady, Darrin Drader, James-Levi Cooke.

Thunderous Decree.name: Thunderous Decree
Thunderous Decree.description: You proclaim your spells with the awesome authority of the High Heavens. When you cast a spell of 1st level or higher with verbal components, you can force each creature that can hear you within 30 feet of you (excluding yourself) to make aConstitutionsaving throw against your spell save DC. You can choose a number of creatures up to your spellcasting ability modifier that you can see to make the saving throw with advantage. Each creature that fails the saving throw takes thunder damage equal to the spell’s level and is pushed 10 feet directly away from you. A creature that fails the saving throw by 5 or more is also knockedprone.

Linguistics Expert.name: Linguistics Expert
Linguistics Expert.description:
You are a scholar of languages, ancienttonguesand scripts.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Grotesque Gaze.name: Grotesque Gaze
Grotesque Gaze.description:
Benefit(s): The target must succeed at a Wisdom saving throw or take 1d6 psychic damage. The damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6). You regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest.

You can see through magical darkness.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Earth’s Embrace.name: Earth’s Embrace
Earth’s Embrace.description: Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You can tap into the power of earth as a bonus action during your turn, gaining temporary hit points equal to double your Constitution modifier. Once you use this ability, can’t use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

Grin and Bear It.name: Grin and Bear It
Grin and Bear It.description:
As areaction, you can use yourConstitutionsaving throw in place of another saving throw you must make.

You regain use of this feat after a short or long rest.

Breath of Life - The Scout (5e)© 2024, Orphaned Bookworm Productions; Authors: Norman Mitchell Jr. and Connor Bates

Ruin’s Echo.name: Ruin’s Echo
Ruin’s Echo.description:
Benefit(s): Increase yourIntelligenceorWisdomscore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gain advantage on saving throws against spells cast by creatures that are undead or have been transformed by cataclysmic magic or effects.

Two-Weapon Rend.name: Two-Weapon Rend
Two-Weapon Rend.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Dragon Blade Master.name: Dragon Blade Master
Dragon Blade Master.description:
When making anattackwith a dragon blade, you gain a nonmagical +1 bonus to yourattackanddamage rolls. In addition, you score a critical on a roll of 19 or 20.

Scarred Races. © 2019, Wanderer’s Haven Publications; Author: Jeremy Hochhalter

Sharp Shot.name: Sharp Shot
Sharp Shot.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Bounty Hunter.name: Bounty Hunter
Bounty Hunter.description:
You can designate one creature as your bounty. You have advantage onWisdom(Insight) andIntelligence(Investigation) skill checks relating to that creature.

When you make aDexteritycheck to determine theinitiativeorder in combat against your bounty, you gaintemporary hit pointsequal to twice your proficiency bonus.

Thesetemporary hit pointslast until your bounty is slain or falls unconscious, or until you take a short orlong rest. You can only have one bounty at a time, and you may designate a new bounty after a short orlong rest.

Stone’s Resilience.name: Stone’s Resilience
Stone’s Resilience.description: Your affinity for stone and earth grants you incredible resilience. When a creature that you can see hits you with an attack while yourStoneskinracial trait is active, you can use yourreactionto become immune to that instance of damage. You can use this ability once per long rest without suffering any penalty, and after doing so, you can decide to use it again by suffering a level ofexhaustion. You can remove a level ofexhaustiongained in this way only by finishing a long rest.

Maculosfunglets Spores.name: Maculosfunglets Spores
Maculosfunglets Spores.description:
You may expend one use of your poison to breathe forth a cone of poisonous spores in a 15 ft. cone. All targets in the cone are affected by your poison as though it was an inhaled poison.
You may expend two of your uses of poison to create a cloud of poisonous spores in a 20 ft.-radius around you. The cloud persists for a number of rounds equal to your Constitution modifier. Creatures within the cloud are affected by your poison as though it was an inhaled poison. Creatures that manage to save against the poisonous spores must continue to save against it for as long as they remain within your spore cloud.

Conduit of the Black Blade.name: Conduit of the Black Blade
Conduit of the Black Blade.description:
Though your lethal powers are incredible to behold, you know in your darkest and most secret heart that you are nothing more than a tool, a pawn, a fleshy and fragile vessel for the will of forces both insane and ancient. You are merely wielded, a weapon in the palm of something born—or, rather, forged—of the Abyss to strike the world dead.

The Dragon’s Hoard #34© 2023, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Ismael Alvarez, Miguel Colon, Jeff Lee, Michael Mifsud.

Curse Bearer.name: Curse Bearer
Curse Bearer.description: Sandy Petersen’s Planet Apocalypse, © 2021, Petersen Games.

Grand Summoner.name: Grand Summoner
Grand Summoner.description: You have achieved true mastery over the art of summoning, pushing your magic beyond mortal limits. As an action, you can channel your inner power, reinforcing the bond between you and your Summon. Your Summon immediately regains all itshit pointsand is cured of any conditions affecting it. Once you use this ability, you must finish a long rest before you can use it again.

Penetrating Strike.name: Penetrating Strike
Penetrating Strike.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Blocking Expertise.name: Blocking Expertise
Blocking Expertise.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Rat King.name: Rat King
Rat King.description: With practice, you’ve learned to control your transformations better and to exert dominion overratsand similar rodents. You can swap between your rat, hybrid, orhumanoidforms as a bonus action on your turn. Additionally, you can communicate with rats as if you shared a language, and they recognize you as their natural leader, granting you advantage onCharisma(Intimidation) andCharisma(Persuasion) checks made to influencerats.

Highly Skilled.name: Highly Skilled
Highly Skilled.description: Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Fox in The Henhouse.name: Fox in The Henhouse
Fox in The Henhouse.description:
Benefit(s): Whenever you are alone and undetected, as a bonus action, you may spend 3 HD and gain advantage on anattackroll against an opponent. This ability can be used once per long rest and costs 3HD.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Close to Undeath.name: Close to Undeath
Close to Undeath.description:
Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You have resistance to necrotic and poison damage.
You have advantage on saving throws against effects that would give you the poisoned condition.

Fury of the Elements.name: Fury of the Elements
Fury of the Elements.description:
Increase yourStrengthorDexterityscore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Once per turn, when you hit with a weaponattack, you can deal an extra 1d4 damage of an elemental type of your choice (acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder) to the target.

Elemental Dissonance.name: Elemental Dissonance
Elemental Dissonance.description:
You have learned to manipulate elemental energies to disrupt your foes.

Increase yourIntelligenceorCharismascore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

When a creature within 60 feet of you is casting a spell that deals damage of an elemental type (acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder), as areaction, you can make a spellcasting ability check against their spell save DC. On a success, the creature’s spell fails and has no effect, and they take 2d8 damage of the spell’s elemental type. This ability can be used successfully once, after which, you need to complete a long rest to recharge it and replenish its power.

Lightning Fast Reflexes.name: Lightning Fast Reflexes
Lightning Fast Reflexes.description:
Increase yourDexterityorIntelligencescore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gain a +2 bonus toinitiativerolls. Additionally, once per long rest, you can take tworeactionsin a round instead of one.

Hex-Binding Smite.name: Hex-Binding Smite
Hex-Binding Smite.description:
You have trained diligently—your heart beating in time to the occult might of your bonded master—to complement your ward’s vast spell-casting acumen. Your brutal blows serve to weaken the resistance of those fools who would dare face the incredible, other-worldly power which you serve.

Legendary Classes: Templars & Tyrants© 2023, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Darrin Drader, Miguel Colon, Clinton J. Boomer, Amber Scott

Elemental Evasion.name: Elemental Evasion
Elemental Evasion.description:
Increase yourDexterityscore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gain advantage onDexteritysaving throws against spells and effects that deal acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage. Additionally, once per long rest, if you succeed on a saving throw that would allow you to take half damage from such spells or effects, you instead take no damage.

Psychic Leech.name: Psychic Leech
Psychic Leech.description:
Casting Time: 1 action

DurationConcentration, up to 10 minutes

One creature you can see must make aWisdomsaving throw. On a failed saving throw, the target experiences feelings of ennui and lethargy, gaining one level ofexhaustionfor the spell’s duration. While the target is within the spell’s range, you gain advantage onStrengthandDexteritychecks and saving throws andattackrolls. On a successful saving, the target only suffers one level ofexhaustionuntil the end of their next turn and you receive no advantage. This spell has no effect if it targets a creature that already hasexhaustion.

Forest Kingdom Campaign Compendium 5e© 2017, Legendary Games; Lead Designer Jason Nelson. Authors: Clinton J. Boomer, Benjamin Bruck, Matt Goodall, Tim Hitchcock, N. Jolly, Julian Neale, Jason Nelson, Thomas J. Phillips, Alistair J. Rigg, David N. Ross, Neil Spicer, Todd Stewart, Russ Taylor, Michael D. Welham, Linda Zayas-Palmer.

Psychic Talent.name: Psychic Talent
Psychic Talent.description:
Benefit(s): You have some basic psychic abilities. You know the following cantrips:

Additionally, you know one of the following spells:charm person,command, orsleep. You can cast that spell once per day at the lowest spell level.

Intelligenceis your spellcasting ability score for these spells. If the spell has both verbal and somatic components, you need only provide one of these when you cast it in this way.

In and Out.name: In and Out
In and Out.description:
You need to get in, get it done, and get out.

Art of Might: Artful Dodgers© 2022, d20fsrd.com Publishing; Author: Ed Kabar

Shake It Off.name: Shake It Off
Shake It Off.description: Battlemasters & Berserkers © 2021, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

Echoing Howl.name: Echoing Howl
Echoing Howl.description:
Benefit(s): Increase yourCharismascore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

As a bonus action, you can unleash a howl that echoes with the power of the wasteland. Choose up to three creatures within 60 feet that can hear you. They must make aWisdomsaving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + yourCharismaability score modifier) or befrightenedof you until the end of your next turn. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

Rotting Touch.name: Rotting Touch
Rotting Touch.description: NoteInfernal feats are first gained by taking the Infernal Pact feat. This feat ties a character to a Circle’s particular lord. If the character is not from that Circle, the Circle is considered his “home” Circle from that point on. The feats available to a character are determined by his home Circle—a character cannot take infernal feats that are not listed as tied to a Circle.

Warder.name: Warder
Warder.description:
You learn ancient protective magics from studying lost magic items or texts, granting you the following benefits.

Sandy Petersen’s Planet Apocalypse, © 2021, Petersen Games.

Mycelium Web Access.name: Mycelium Web Access
Mycelium Web Access.description:
Benefit(s): Make all lore checks related to nature, life, death, and renewal at +4. As areaction(and with the expenditure of a Hit Die), The myconaut can choose to succeed on any lore check. YourIntelligencescore increases by 1.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Tinker.name: Tinker
Tinker.description:
You master the artificer’s art of creating clockwork creatures. As a light activity during a long rest you use tinker’s tools and 50 gp worth of metal which is consumed during the process to create one of the following creatures: bronzeback armadillo, clockwork spider, faceted scorpion, mechanical octopus, quicksilver fox, siegemetal ram, springjaw centipede swarm, or steelwing moth.

You may activate a clockwork creature you created using this feat by attuning to it. Active clockwork creatures follow your verbal commands and take their turn immediately after yours. Inactive clockwork creatures are consideredpetrified. If a clockwork creature falls to0 hit pointsyou can attempt to repair it, spending ten minutes to make a DC 13 tinker’s tools check. On a successful check, the creature is restored to fullhit points; on a failed check it is destroyed, becoming a pile of scrap metal worth 25 gp.

Toxic Retaliation.name: Toxic Retaliation
Toxic Retaliation.description:
Increase yourConstitutionscore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

When a creature hits you with amelee attack, you can use yourreactionto release a burst of acidic toxins. The attacker must make aDexteritysaving throw (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + yourConstitutionmodifier). On a failed save, the creature takes 2d6 acid damage and ispoisoneduntil the end of its next turn. On a successful save, the creature takes half damage and isn’tpoisoned. This ability can be used a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, and all expended uses are restored after a long rest.

Amateur Crystalline Cannonade.name: Amateur Crystalline Cannonade
Amateur Crystalline Cannonade.description:
You may grow your choice of either a light crossbow, hand crossbow or heavy crossbow from your crystal-sheathed arm as part of making a ranged attack. This crossbow is loaded and fires shards of your own, rapidly regenerating body as ammunition. The crystalline ammunition is in all regards identical to regular ammunition for the respective crossbow. Only your crossbow can fire your ammunition. You can will your crossbow back into your body as an action that provokes opportunity attacks.
Starting at 6th level, your crystalline ammunition receives +1 to attack and damage rolls and is treated as ammunition+1 for all intents and purposes. This bonus increases to +2 at 12th level and +3 at 18th level. Crystalline ammunition becomes brittle and loses all potency when taken from your body and thus can never be sold.

Background Knowledge.name: Background Knowledge
Background Knowledge.description:
Seeing some things in your travels has taught you a thing or two. You add half your proficiency bonus, rounded down, to all skill checks with which you are not proficient.

Art of Might: Artful Dodgers© 2022, d20fsrd.com Publishing; Author: Ed Kabar

Eagle-Eyed.name: Eagle-Eyed
Eagle-Eyed.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Raging Vitality.name: Raging Vitality
Raging Vitality.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Shield Mastery.name: Shield Mastery
Shield Mastery.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Dazzling Display.name: Dazzling Display
Dazzling Display.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Tree of Knowledge.name: Tree of Knowledge
Tree of Knowledge.description:
Ability Score Increase. Increase your Wisdom or Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Fruit of Knowledge. You may add your Wisdom bonus to Intelligence (History), Intelligence (Investigation), and Intelligence (Nature) skill checks.

Apocalyptic Mutation: Claws.name: Apocalyptic Mutation: Claws
Apocalyptic Mutation: Claws.description: Sandy Petersen’s Planet Apocalypse, © 2021, Petersen Games.

Unyielding Stance.name: Unyielding Stance
Unyielding Stance.description:
Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
When you end your turn without using any movement, you gain temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier.

Hive Mind.name: Hive Mind
Hive Mind.description:
Casting Time: 1 action

Components: V, S, M (piece of hoyrall antennae)

Range: 60 feet or 600 feet

Duration: Concentration, up to 10 minutes

This spell can function in one of two ways:

First, it might be used exactly as lesser hivemind, but at a range of 600 feet and it can affect up to 6 creatures.

Second, it can be used at a range of only 60 feet as lesser hive mind, creating a stronger effect that allows subjects to communicate emotions, images and any other sensory data at their disposal to other subjects under the effects of hive mind. This effect can also affect up to 6 creatures.

Underworld Races and Classes © 2017 AAW Games LLC; Designers: Thilo Graf and Mike Myler

The Set Costs More!.name: The Set Costs More!
The Set Costs More!.description:
You’ve done the impossible and sold your soul twice, gaining power from both buyers and forcing them to spend more energy to acquire your soul. Choose two otherworldly beings. When you gain a class ability from your patron, you can choose which patron to gain the power from.

Art of Magic – Heretical Pacts © 2019, d20pfsrd.com Publishing; Author: Ed Kabara

Psychic Resilience.name: Psychic Resilience
Psychic Resilience.description:
Increase your Constitution or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain resistance to psychic damage.
You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

Inner Resilience.name: Inner Resilience
Inner Resilience.description:
Increase your Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You have 3 ki points, which you can spend to fuel the Patient Defense or Step of the Wind features from the monk class. When you spend a ki point, it is unavailable until you finish a short or long rest, at the end of which you draw all of your expended ki back into yourself. You must spend at least 30 minutes of the rest meditating to regain your ki points.
If you already have ki points, your ki point maximum increases by 3 instead.

Mark of the Fallen.name: Mark of the Fallen
Mark of the Fallen.description:
ends if you attack the creature. You have advantage on the first weapon attack roll you make against the tracked creature.
Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You have advantage on ability checks and saving throws against effects that would force you to move. At the start of your turn, you can gain advantage on all melee weapon attack rolls during that turn, but attack rolls against you have advantage until the start of your next turn.
Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You have resistance to lightning and thunder damage.
Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You can become attuned to one additional magic item. When you are the only creature targeted by a spell, you can use your reaction to gain advantage on your saving throw against that spell.
Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed. In addition, you can use your action to hypnotize a target within 30 feet that can see you. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency modifier + your Charisma modifier). On a failed save, the target is charmed by you. While it is charmed, the target’s speed is reduced to 0. The target can make a new saving throw at the end of each of its turns. The effect ends once the target makes a saving throw, the target can’t see you, or the target isn’t charmed by you anymore. Once you use this ability, you must finish a short or long rest before you can use it again.
Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain resistance to fire and radiant damage.
Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20. When you take the Dash action, you gain a fly speed equal to your base speed until the start of your next turn. You must concentrate to maintain this flight, as if you were concentrating on a spell. If you lose your concentration or fail to take the Dash action at the start of your next turn, you fall.

Planetar Visage.name: Planetar Visage
Planetar Visage.description: of this feat but gain the ability to automatically detect lies. Ending the effects of this feat and renewing its other benefit requires a bonus action.

Disruptive Spell.name: Disruptive Spell
Disruptive Spell.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Darkness Adaptation.name: Darkness Adaptation
Darkness Adaptation.description:
Your Wisdom modifier increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain darkvision out to a range of 60 feet. If you already have darkvision from your species or a feature, its range increases by 60 feet.

Heightened Senses.name: Heightened Senses
Heightened Senses.description: Your senses are sharply honed, granting you superior awareness. Increase yourWisdomscore by 1, to a maximum of 20. Additionally, you gain advantage on allWisdom(Perception) checks anddarkvisionout to a range of 120 feet.

Guiding Light.name: Guiding Light
Guiding Light.description:
A fragment of the High Heavens has bound itself to you, manifesting as a tiny mote of light. It counts as neither creature nor object and is intangible, but it is bound to your soul and perpetually hovers near you within your space.

You can use a bonus action to make it disappear until you use another bonus action to make it resume visibly hovering near you. While the guiding light is present, it emits light per thelightcantrip. When you make an ability check while you can see the guiding light, you can use a bonus action to add a +1d4 bonus to the roll. Additionally, when you fail a saving throw while you can see the guiding light, you can use yourreactionto reroll the saving throw. You must use the new result. When you do so, your guiding light disappears, and you can’t make it reappear until you finish a long rest.

Bestial Avatar.name: Bestial Avatar
Bestial Avatar.description:
You are a conduit for a god of bestial destruction, an avatar of wild physical might.

As a bonus action you may assume a bestial hybrid form similar to that of your deity’s favored creature for 1 minute. Choose bite or claws when you gain this feat, each time you transform you gain that benefit.

You must finish a short rest before you may use this ability again. After using it a second time in one day, you must finish a long rest before you may use it again.

Clerics & Cultists© 2021, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader, Nicholas Hite, Sean K Reynolds, Jason Nelson, Jenny Jarzabski, Miguel Colon, Michael “solomani” Mifsud, Matt Daley, Nathan Reinecke.

Fire Giant’s Fury.name: Fire Giant’s Fury
Fire Giant’s Fury.description:
As a bonus action during your turn, you can touch a simple or martial weapon and infuse it with the power of fire. For the next minute, the weapon deals an extra 1d6 fire damage when it hits. After you use this bonus action, you can’t do so again until you finish a short or a long rest.
When you take fire damage, you can use your reaction to grant yourself immunity to that instance of damage. You can use this reaction once, and you regain the ability to do so after you finish a long rest.

Putrid Avatar.name: Putrid Avatar
Putrid Avatar.description:
You are infused with the essence of the gods of un-life. You breathe their most glorious creations into existence. Undead withIntelligence2 or less are never hostile to you unless they are under the direct control of another creature.

Any time you animate one or more undead creatures, you may choose to animate one of those creatures as any undead creature with CR up to 1/4 your character level. The corpse used to animate this creature must have the same size and approximate shape as the undead creature you are attempting to animate.

Clerics & Cultists© 2021, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader, Nicholas Hite, Sean K Reynolds, Jason Nelson, Jenny Jarzabski, Miguel Colon, Michael “solomani” Mifsud, Matt Daley, Nathan Reinecke.

Flintlock Expert.name: Flintlock Expert
Flintlock Expert.description:
You are proficient with pistols.
Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesnât impose disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls.
When you use the Attack action and attack with a one-handed weapon, you can use a bonus action to attack with a loaded pistol you are holding.
You can use this feat for any pistols you are carrying that are loaded.

Vow of Stamina.name: Vow of Stamina
Vow of Stamina.description:
Benefit(s): YourWisdomscore increases by 1, to a maximum of 20. You lose the Unbalanced ability, and Divine Stamina reducesexhaustion1 more step. You may select oneclericcantrip that you may cast at will.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

A Taste of Power.name: A Taste of Power
A Taste of Power.description:
You’ve been granted spells from a patron, now you can gain a bit more power from the same patron. A little more power never corrupts. Choose an otherworldly patron from those available to the warlock class. You gain the level one abilities of that pact. If the abilities refer to your warlock level, your level is effectively one quarter your total level, minimum 1. If you gain a level in warlock, you lose this feat and may retain it to a new feat.

Art of Magic - Heretical Pacts © 2019, d20pfsrd.com Publishing; Author: Ed Kabara

Demolisher.name: Demolisher
Demolisher.description:
Benefit(s): Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20. When you attack an object or a creature that is a construct, you gain advantage on the roll. You inflict double damage against objects and structures.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Cardshark.name: Cardshark
Cardshark.description: You are an expert at playing cards, odds, and people.

Razortooth.name: Razortooth
Razortooth.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Gifted Metallurgist.name: Gifted Metallurgist
Gifted Metallurgist.description: You can craft metallic items in one-third the normal time required. In addition, your crafted items have a 10% bonus to their structural hit points. Lastly, you may add a bonus equal to your proficiency bonus whenever you make an Intelligence (History) check related to simple items made from metal (weapons, armor, shields, rings, jewelry).

Sweeping Tail.name: Sweeping Tail
Sweeping Tail.description:
Your unarmed strike with your tail has a reach of 10 feet.
As an action, you can sweep a 10-foot semicircle with your tail. Make a single attack roll for an unarmed strike with your tail against each creature in the area.
When you use a bonus action to successfully shove a creature with your tail, you regain your bonus action.

Knife Work.name: Knife Work
Knife Work.description:
Your daggers deal 1d6 damage instead of the normal 1d4 damage.

Art of Might: Artful Dodgers© 2022, d20fsrd.com Publishing; Author: Ed Kabar

Solar Gaze.name: Solar Gaze
Solar Gaze.description:
Your stare embodies all of the authority of the great beyond, able to rob sight from those you find unworthy and granting you a level of protection from divine energy.

Book of Exalted Darkness. © 2018 Mike Myler, published under license by Legendary Games.

Unarmed Fighting.name: Unarmed Fighting
Unarmed Fighting.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Colossal Smash.name: Colossal Smash
Colossal Smash.description:
Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can choose to deliver a Colossal
Smash. If you do so, the target becomes unable to take reactions and it’s movement movement speed is halved until the end of its next turn. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining any expended uses of this ability when you finish a long rest.

Manifested Will.name: Manifested Will
Manifested Will.description: Your Summon becomes an extension of your mind, gaining proficiency inIntelligence,Wisdom, andCharismasaving throws.

Blightborn Resistance.name: Blightborn Resistance
Blightborn Resistance.description:
Benefit(s): Increase yourConstitutionscore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gainresistanceto one damage type associated with environmental hazards (choose from acid, cold, fire, or poison).

Demoralizing Strike.name: Demoralizing Strike
Demoralizing Strike.description:
When you inflict damage on an opponent with a melee weapon, you can use your bonus action to cause that creature to make aWisdomsaving throw or becomefrightenedof you for 1 round. The DC for the saving throw is equal to 8 + your proficiency modifier + yourCharismamodifier. Whether the creature saves or not, it cannot be affect again for 24 hours. After using this ability, you cannot use it again until you complete a short or long rest.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Fiendish Resilience.name: Fiendish Resilience
Fiendish Resilience.description:
Benefit(s): You cannot be affected or targeted by cantrips unless you wish to be. You have advantage on saving throws for all spells of 3rd level or lower and all magical effects.

Once per week, you can choose not to be affected by a 1st level spell of your choice.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Magical Tail.name: Magical Tail
Magical Tail.description:
Benefit(s): As an action while in your natural form, you can transform into your second form and at the same time target a creature within 30 feet with memory-altering magic. The target must succeed aWisdomsaving throw with a DC of 8 + yourCharismamodifier + your proficiency bonus or lose the memory for a number of rounds equal to half your level. If the creature knows about your identity as a kitsune, they can make anotherWisdomsaving throw with the same DC or forget that you are a kitsune. Once you use this ability, you cannot use it again until you complete a short or long rest. YourCharismascore increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Fey Soul: Pixie.name: Fey Soul: Pixie
Fey Soul: Pixie.description:
Summary:You have learned to tap into your fairy soul to gain a more permanent form of magical flight.

Benefit(s): You gain a pair of wings (your choice on type) that grant you a fly speed of 30 feet. You cannot fly using these wings if you are wearing heavy armor.

Stone Mother’s Assault - © 2020, Adrian Arduini; Author: Adrian Arduini

Harbinger’s Call.name: Harbinger’s Call
Harbinger’s Call.description:
Benefit(s): Increase yourCharismascore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

As a bonus action, you can make anIntimidationcheck contested by theWisdom(Insight) check of a creature you can see within 30 feet. If you win the contest, that creature isfrightenedof you until the end of your next turn.

Storm Giant’s Fury.name: Storm Giant’s Fury
Storm Giant’s Fury.description:
As a bonus action during your turn, you can electrify a simple or martial weapon, imbuing it with the power of storms. For the next minute, the weapon deals an extra 1d6 lightning damage when it hits. After you use this bonus action, you can’t do so again until you finish a short or a long rest.
When you are subjected to lightning damage, you can use your reaction to grant yourself immunity to that instance of damage. You can use this reaction once, and you regain the ability to do so after you finish a long rest.

Healing Thoughts.name: Healing Thoughts
Healing Thoughts.description:
Benefit(s): As an action, the myconaut can spend two Hit Dice to remove one condition or heal a creature adjacent to it. Use the result of the spent Hit Dice as the healing amount. This removes one of the following conditions:blinded,deafened,exhaustion(one level), orpoisoned. As a result, the condition no longer affects the patient but instead afflicts the myconaut. (The myconaut’s condition immunities, if any, still apply). All other effects remain the same, such as the duration of the condition and the DC of the saving throw needed to end the effect. Alternatively, the myconaut can absorb two Hit Dice (roll your spent Hit Dice to determine effect) of damage from any creature adjacent to it. The myconaut must choose at the time of activation which version of the ability to use.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Lookout.name: Lookout
Lookout.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Command Undead.name: Command Undead
Command Undead.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Combat Reflexes.name: Combat Reflexes
Combat Reflexes.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Haggler.name: Haggler
Haggler.description:
In the mercantile world of Cloak & Coin, you quickly learn that everything has a price and that price can usually be negotiated. You have a talent for getting the best price, whether buying or selling.

Increase yourCharismascore by 1, to a maximum of 20. When you are buying or selling either items or services, you double your proficiency bonus when you make aCharisma(Persuasion) check to negotiate the price.

Darting Strike.name: Darting Strike
Darting Strike.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Feint Partner.name: Feint Partner
Feint Partner.description:
A little diversion is all you need to slip through your foe’s defenses.

Battlemasters & Berserkers © 2021, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

Manhunter.name: Manhunter
Manhunter.description:
Benefit(s): Manhunters gain a supernatural sense regarding their targets. If a Manhunter has met their target, or spent at least an hour reviewing information about them via records, images, and/or testimony of people who know them, they gain a sense of intuition about this target. Treat a target as if they are casket under a constantlocate creatureeffect as long as the Manhunter is looking for them. Additionally, the Manhunter rolls with Advantage on allSurvival,Perception,Insight,Intimidation, andPersuasionchecks made in furtherance of locating their target.

Guilds of Sundara © 2022, eGDC Ltd; Author: Neal Litherland

Scorching Sun Warrior.name: Scorching Sun Warrior
Scorching Sun Warrior.description:
Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency with shields.
You gain the Unarmored Defense feature: while you are not wearing any armor, your Armor Class equals 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Constitution modifier. You can use a shield and still gain this benefit.

Ariser.name: Ariser
Ariser.description:
You can take your action to magically assume a humanoid form. This form is the same size as your beast form, or small, if your beast form is smaller than that. You retain your ability scores, Hit Dice, and hit points in humanoid form but lose any other traits of your beast form. You always assume the same humanoid form, which typically appears human, although some aquatic rhydan have humanoid forms like sea-folk, and others have forms more like vata or even night people. Regardless of appearance, you do not gain any of the ancestral traits of those humanoids.
