Rhydan humanoid forms often have minor “tells” or traits that reflect their beast forms like unusual hair, eye, or skin colors, vestigial horns, tails, or wings, and so forth.

You can remain in humanoid form for a number of hours equal to half your level. You then revert to your normal form unless you expend another use of this feat.

You can revert to your normal form earlier using a bonus action on your turn. You automatically revert if you fall unconscious, drop to 0 hit points, or die. You can use this ability twice, then must complete a long rest before using it again.

Withheld Strikes.name: Withheld Strikes
Withheld Strikes.description: Ultimate Kingdoms (5E)© 2020, Legendary Games; Lead Designer: Jason Nelson. Authors: Ben Walklate, Mark Seifter, Linda Zayas-Palmer, Will McCardell

Power Thrower.name: Power Thrower
Power Thrower.description:
You can subtract up to your proficiency bonus from yourattackroll to add 10 feet of range per 1 subtracted.

Breath of Life - The Scout (5e)© 2024, Orphaned Bookworm Productions; Authors: Norman Mitchell Jr. and Connor Bates

Cyclone.name: Cyclone
Cyclone.description:
As an action, you can blow away creatures surrounding you. Each creature adjacent to you must succeed a Strength saving throw or take bludgeoning and slashing damage equal to 1d6 + your Strength modifier and be flung 20 feet in a random direction away from you. If a thrown creature strikes a wall or an object, it takes an additional 1d6 bludgeoning damage if it traveled more than 10 feet. If the target is thrown at another creature, the second creature must succeed a Dexterity saving throw or both creatures take 1d6 bludgeoning damage and are both knocked prone. The DCs for any saving throws provoked by this ability are equal to 8 + your Charisma modifier + your Proficiency Bonus.
You can lift and carry unheld items that eight up to 10 lbs. using the winds you can create and maneuver them in a distance up to 20 feet away from you.

Legendary Resistance.name: Legendary Resistance
Legendary Resistance.description: Legendary Adventures © 2020 Mike Myler, published under license by Legendary Games.

Hoist the Colors.name: Hoist the Colors
Hoist the Colors.description: Pirate Campaign Compendium© 2018, Legendary Games; Lead Designer Jason Nelson. Authors: Alex Augunas, Jeff Gomez, Matt Goodall, Jim Groves, Tim Hitchcock, Victoria Jaczko, Jonathan H. Keith, Lyz Liddell, Thomas J. Phillips, Alistair J. Rigg, Alex Riggs, Loren Sieg, Neil Spicer, Todd Stewart, Rachel Ventura, Michael D. Welham, Linda Zayas-Palmer.

Infuriating Presence.name: Infuriating Presence
Infuriating Presence.description:
Benefit(s): Increase yourCharismascore by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain proficiency inIntimidation. When making anIntimidationcheck, you can use your choice of yourStrengthmodifier or yourCharismamodifier.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Dual Wielder.name: Dual Wielder
Dual Wielder.description: You can use two weapon fighting even when the one-handed melee weapons you are wielding aren’t light. You can draw or stow two one-handed weapons when you would normally only be able to do so with one. When you use areactionto make opportunity attacks, you can make oneattackwith your primary weapon and another with your off-hand weapon.

Heightened Spell (Meta Magic).name: Heightened Spell (Meta Magic)
Heightened Spell (Meta Magic).description:
Druids of the Arcane Circle have exclusive access to metamagic feats. Rather than taking the Ability Score Improvement feature at 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th and 19th level, they can choose this feat.

When youcast a spellthat forces a creature to make a saving throw to resist its effects, you can spend 3 sorcery points to give one target of the spell disadvantage on its first saving throw made against the spell.

Stoic Discipline.name: Stoic Discipline
Stoic Discipline.description:
You have advantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain your concentration.
You have advantage on saving throws to resist being charmed or frightened.
Creatures have disadvantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks to determine your emotional state.

Curse Item.name: Curse Item
Curse Item.description:
Whether as a trap, or to punish a particularly poorly performing underling, cursing magical items is a time-honored tradition for evil spellcasters. When you create a magical item instead of spending the full cost for that item you can spend half that cost and create a cursed version of the item.

You may choose a specific cursed item or you may create a new cursed item with one of the following effects:

Alternately you can add one such curse to an existing magical item for 1 week castingbestow curseon it.

Your cursed items appear to be standard items of their type until they are attuned. A creature using anidentifyspell can attempt anIntelligence(Arcana) check with a DC of 8 + yourIntelligence(Arcana) bonus. Failure means they do not notice the curse. Once a cursed item has been worn, wielded, or attuned, it cannot be removed until aremove cursespell is cast on the user.

Clerics & Cultists© 2021, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader, Nicholas Hite, Sean K Reynolds, Jason Nelson, Jenny Jarzabski, Miguel Colon, Michael “solomani” Mifsud, Matt Daley, Nathan Reinecke.

Negotiator.name: Negotiator
Negotiator.description:
Increase your Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
When you attempt to convince a creature to engage in a course of action or to change its attitude with a Charisma (Persuasion) check and fail, you can retry the check on your next turn with disadvantage.
When you purchase a good or service, you can attempt an opposed Charisma (Persuasion) check versus the seller’s Wisdom (Insight). If you win the contest, you secure a 10 percent discount on the transaction. Once you use this feature on a given individual, you can’t use it on them again for one week.
When you pay for lifestyle expenses during downtime, they are halved.

Arcane Warden.name: Arcane Warden
Arcane Warden.description:
You learn the counterspell and dispel magic spells. Your spellcasting ability for these spells is Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma (your choice). You can cast one of these spells once without expending a spell slot, regaining the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. You can also cast these spells using your spell slots (if you have any).
When you cast counterspell or dispel magic, you can add your proficiency bonus to the ability check.

Zwerc Knight.name: Zwerc Knight
Zwerc Knight.description: Whenever you take either acid, cold, fire, force, thunder or lightning damage equal to or greater than twice your level from a single source, you gain resistance to that damage type for 1 round.

Confident.name: Confident
Confident.description: You are remarkably self-assured. Whether it be due to high self-confidence, fearlessness, subconscious denial of the stakes of your circumstances, or abject stupidity, you are unaffected by nonmagical attempts to intimidate you.Charisma(Intimidation) checks that target you automatically fail. This has no effect whatsoever on magical effects, substances, or creature abilities that cause thefrightenedcondition.

Gift of the Frost Giant.name: Gift of the Frost Giant
Gift of the Frost Giant.description:
Increase your Wisdom, Charisma, Intelligence, or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You learn to harness the chilling power of ice. You can cast the ice storm spell once per day without expending a spell slot. You can also cast this spell using spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
The spell’s spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

Gaunt.name: Gaunt
Gaunt.description:
Evil sucks at your muscles, drawing them down to the bone and giving you a ghastly appearance. Your condition has reduced the flow of blood to most of your brain, pumping more of it through your heart instead.

Book of Exalted Darkness. © 2018 Mike Myler, published under license by Legendary Games.

Escape Route.name: Escape Route
Escape Route.description: Fighters Unlimited 5E© 2019, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

Elf-Bond.name: Elf-Bond
Elf-Bond.description:
You and another willing living creature can be bonded in a ceremony that takes 8 hours. This ability grants you several gifts.

Death separates the bond, though any creature resurrected or raised again could have the bond performed once more.

Agile Maneuvers.name: Agile Maneuvers
Agile Maneuvers.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Beacon of Hope.name: Beacon of Hope
Beacon of Hope.description: from this feat again until it has finished a short or long rest.

Giant’s Toughness.name: Giant’s Toughness
Giant’s Toughness.description:
Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You have advantage on saving throws against being stunned, paralyzed, restrained, or petrified.

Polearm Expertise.name: Polearm Expertise
Polearm Expertise.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Colossal Roar.name: Colossal Roar
Colossal Roar.description: When you use your Mighty Stomp racial feature, you can also unleash a deafening roar that shakes the ground. Each creature of your choice within 60 feet of you that can hear you must make aWisdomsaving throw (DC 8 + yourStrengthorConstitutionmodifier + your proficiency bonus) or befrightenedfor 1 minute. A creature frightened in this way can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Gigantism.name: Gigantism
Gigantism.description:
from this feature.
When you hit with a Strength based melee weapon attack, you can use your bonus action to attempt the shove attack action on the same target in the same turn if that target is medium size or smaller.
You count as one size larger with regards to the shove and grapple attack actions.

Fleet.name: Fleet
Fleet.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Breath Weapon Crossfire.name: Breath Weapon Crossfire
Breath Weapon Crossfire.description:
Casting Time: 1 action (see text)

Components: V, S, M (volcanic ash)

When you cast this spell, you must use your draaki breath weapon as part of the casting of this spell, beginning to coordinate a relentless crossfire of draaki breaths. Your draaki breath weapon follows all the usual rules for draaki breath weapons.

Any creatures in squares targeted by your breath weapon who are then subject to another draaki breath weapon before the duration of the spell has elapsed, suffer from disadvantage to the saves of any subsequent draaki breath weapons for the duration of spell has elapsed.

Underworld Races and Classes © 2017 AAW Games LLC; Designers: Thilo Graf and Mike Myler

Studious Transfixion.name: Studious Transfixion
Studious Transfixion.description:
If theattackis a critical hit, the target makes the saving throw with disadvantage.

While a both your speed and the target’s speed are 0 and you can see the target, you can use a bonus action to learn one of the following pieces of information:

Cruel Kiss of Thunder.name: Cruel Kiss of Thunder
Cruel Kiss of Thunder.description:
You are the violent tempest, the crackling whirlwind, the blistering scream of the storm.

When dealing lightning damage, your Divine Smite does not deal additional damage to undead or fiends, instead, the damage increases by 1d8 if the target is in water or flying, to a maximum of 6d8.

Legendary Classes: Templars & Tyrants© 2023, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Darrin Drader, Miguel Colon, Clinton J. Boomer, Amber Scott

Ingrained Strength.name: Ingrained Strength
Ingrained Strength.description:
When using your Ingrain racial ability and are damaged, as a Reaction you gain Resistance to that type of damage until the start of your next turn. You can use this ability a number of times equal to your Constitution modifier. You must take a Long Rest to reset the uses of this ability.
While using your Ingrain racial ability, you can choose to make all adjacent squares of your choosing Difficult Terrain.

Improved Back to Back.name: Improved Back to Back
Improved Back to Back.description:
After much practice, you and an ally have become adept at fighting in close proximity to one another.

Fighters Unlimited 5E© 2019, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

Chain Master.name: Chain Master
Chain Master.description:
You gain a +1 bonus to AC.
The weapon loses the two-handed property and gains the versatile property, dealing 2d4 piercing damage when you wield it in two hands.
When you take the Attack action, you can use a bonus action to make a melee attack with the opposite end of the spiked chain. The weapon’s damage die for this purpose is 1d4, and the attack deals piercing or slashing damage (your choice).
The chosen benefit remains in effect until you end it (no action required), you become incapacitated, or you change to another benefit.

Cartomancy.name: Cartomancy
Cartomancy.prerequisite: Intelligence 13 or higher, and proficiency with game set (cards)Y
Cartomancy.description: Your supernatural insights and card-cunning are one and the same.

Floriographer.name: Floriographer
Floriographer.description:
Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You learn Floriography, the language of flowers. Similar to Druidic and Thieves’ Cant, Floriography is a secret language often used to communicate subtle ideas, symbolic meaning, and even basic messages. Floriography is conveyed through the combinations of colors, styles, and even types of flowers in bouquets, floral arrangements, and floral illustrations, often with a gift-giving component.
Your fluency with the subtle messages in floral displays gives you a keen eye for discerning subtle or hidden messages elsewhere. You have advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) and Wisdom (Insight) checks to notice and discern hidden messages of a visual nature, such as the runes of a magic trap or the subtle hand signals passing between two individuals.

Elementalist.name: Elementalist
Elementalist.description:
You learn Primordial.
You gain one of the following crantrips based on the element you chose: produce flame, shape earth, mold water, or air gust.
You gain the ability to manifest an elemental of your chosen element. As an action, you can summon a mephit to an unoccupied square within 30 feet.
You can summon a mephit in this way once, and regain the ability to do so when you finish a long rest. You may only have one mephit at a time, and summoning a new mephit causes your current mephit to vanish. The mephit summoned is based on the element you chose: magma mephit (fire), dust mephit (earth), ice mephit (water), wind mephit (air).

Unstoppable Juggernaut.name: Unstoppable Juggernaut
Unstoppable Juggernaut.description: You have advantage on saving throws against beingcharmedorfrightened. Additionally, once per long rest, you can use yourreactionto reroll a failed saving throw. If you do so, you must use the new roll.

Skyborne Mastery.name: Skyborne Mastery
Skyborne Mastery.description:
As a bonus action during your turn, you can imbue yourself with the power of the clouds. For the next minute you gain a flying speed of 60 feet and the ability to hover. After you use this bonus action, you can’t do so again until you finish a short or a long rest.
When you take thunder damage, you can use your reaction to grant yourself immunity to that instance of damage. You can use this reaction once, and you regain the ability to do so after you finish a long rest.

Vengeance Quest.name: Vengeance Quest
Vengeance Quest.description:
You may only take this feat once.

Battlemasters & Berserkers © 2021, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

Sorcerous Vigor.name: Sorcerous Vigor
Sorcerous Vigor.description:
When your magical reserves are low, you can call on your lifeforce to fuel your magic.

Tome of Heroes ©2022 Open Design LLC; Authors: Celeste Conowitch, Jeff Lee, Sarah Madsen, Ben McFarland, Kelly Pawlik, Brian Suskind

Scion of Stone.name: Scion of Stone
Scion of Stone.description:
Benefit(s): Your Constitution score increases by +1, to a maximum of 20. You gain damage resistance vs. nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. Finally, when in contact with stone, you gain advantage on Constitution saving throws.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Toxin Tolerance.name: Toxin Tolerance
Toxin Tolerance.description:
Benefit(s): Increase yourConstitutionscore by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gain advantage onConstitutionsaving throws to resist poison. You sense the presence of any poison in food or beverage that you can see and smell. You can consume double the amount of alcohol of other creatures without suffering any ill effects.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Draakistorian.name: Draakistorian
Draakistorian.description:
Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You learn two languages of your choice.
You can spend 5 minutes telling anecdotal allegories of draconic wisdom, shoring up the resolve of your allies to fight. When you do so, choose up to 6 friendly creatures capable of understanding you (this can include yourself) within 30 feet of you. Each creature may thereafter reroll their weapon’s damage dice once within the next 5 minutes. A creature can only benefit from this use of the feat once per day.

Harrier.name: Harrier
Harrier.description:
Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
When you use your Shadow Traveler trait or cast misty step, you have advantage on the next attack you make before the end of your turn.

Prone Shooter.name: Prone Shooter
Prone Shooter.description: Battlemasters & Berserkers © 2021, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

Child of Chaos.name: Child of Chaos
Child of Chaos.description:
This change can raise your ability scores above 20.

Creed's Codex: Arcane Secrets of the Summoners © 2022 Brendan Jonesrebandt Consulting LLC DBA Knight Vision Creative, Author Brendan Jonesrebandt

Rune Expert.name: Rune Expert
Rune Expert.description:
Thanks to extensive study with ancient true runes, you have gained some access to true runic power.

Rune Magic, 5e © 2020, Owen K.C. Stephens; Author: Owen K.C. Stephens. Project manager and Planning: Lj Stephens. Bon Vivant: Stan!

Arcane Sorcery (Meta Magic).name: Arcane Sorcery (Meta Magic)
Arcane Sorcery (Meta Magic).description:
Druids of the Arcane Circle have exclusive access to metamagic feats. Rather than taking the Ability Score Improvement feature at 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th and 19th level, they can choose this feat.

You have learned to control and manipulate the natural arcane forces that exist all around you.

Your influence over this omnipresent force is represented by sorcery points, which allow you to create a variety of magical effects.

You have a number of sorcery points equal to yourdruidlevel. You can never have more sorcery points than yourdruidlevel. You regain all spent sorcery points when you finish a long rest.

Bloody Shade of the Umbral Wood.name: Bloody Shade of the Umbral Wood
Bloody Shade of the Umbral Wood.description:
The long, twisting wounds you have given yourself during your ecstatic twilight pilgrimages seep with a reddish-grey rot that permeates all you touch; a naked and howling survivor of the wild, fierce joy pumps in your veins when you hunt.

Legendary Classes: Templars & Tyrants© 2023, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Darrin Drader, Miguel Colon, Clinton J. Boomer, Amber Scott

Master of the Cutlass.name: Master of the Cutlass
Master of the Cutlass.description:
Increase yourDexterityorStrengthscore by 1, to a maximum of 20. Additionally, you can roll one additional weapon damage die when determining the extra damage for a critical hit with amelee attackmade with a scimitar or rapier.

Pirates and Plunder A Compendium For 5e © 2024 Published by Mythos Chronicles; Author Filippo Bardoscia

Heroic Surge.name: Heroic Surge
Heroic Surge.description:
With this feat you gain one bonus action that you can use in combat onyour turn. After using this feat, you cannot use it again until you complete a short or long rest.

After reaching 17th level, you can use this feat twice before resting.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Sailor’s Endurance.name: Sailor’s Endurance
Sailor’s Endurance.description:
Increase yourConstitutionscore by 1, to a maximum of 20. Additionally, you haveresistanceto poison damage and advantage on saving throws against diseases,exhaustion, and poison.

Pirates and Plunder A Compendium For 5e © 2024 Published by Mythos Chronicles; Author Filippo Bardoscia

Balor Wings.name: Balor Wings
Balor Wings.description:
You may spend an action to sprout wings that grant you a fly speed of 80 feet. While these wings are out, you are at disadvantage when making non-Intimidation Charisma ability checks against creatures that are not evil.
By spending a bonus action you may retract your wings to a quarter of their size, losing your fly speed but gaining a fire aura. At the start of your turn, each creature within 5 feet of you takes 3d6 fire damage, and flammable objects in the aura that aren’t being carried or worn ignite. A creature that touches you or hits you with a melee attack while within 5 feet of you takes 3d6 fire damage. You may only use this fire aura for a number of rounds equal to your proficiency bonus before requiring a short rest. These rounds need not be consecutive and you can return the wings to full size as a bonus action.

Absorb Jewel.name: Absorb Jewel
Absorb Jewel.description:
As an action, you can force a jewel of at least 1000 gp into your skin, granting you a +1 bonus to your AC. You increase this value by+ 1 for every additional 500 gp of the gem’s value (maximum +5). You may only have one gem implanted at any given time.
Alternatively, you can gain damage threshold 1, + 1 for every additional 1,500 gp of the gem’s value you inserted for a number of minutes equal to class level.
This consumes the gem. You may only have one gem implanted at any given time.

Augment Adept.name: Augment Adept
Augment Adept.description:
Whenever you gain a level, you can replace the augment with another one from the summoner class.

Creed's Codex: Arcane Secrets of the Summoners © 2022 Brendan Jonesrebandt Consulting LLC DBA Knight Vision Creative, Author Brendan Jonesrebandt

Couatl Crest.name: Couatl Crest
Couatl Crest.description:
You grow a resplendent feathery crest on your forehead not unlike that of a glorious celestial serpent, making your mind an impregnable fortress and expanding your consciousness.

Book of Exalted Darkness. © 2018 Mike Myler, published under license by Legendary Games.

Graceful Poise.name: Graceful Poise
Graceful Poise.description:
You have advantage on ability checks and saving throws to avoid losing your balance or being knocked prone.
You have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.
When you make a Constitution saving throw to maintain your concentration, you can add your choice of your Dexterity or Charisma modifier to the result as a bonus.

Military Student.name: Military Student
Military Student.description:
When you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can use the Help action as a bonus action to assist an ally in attacking the same target. Your ally must be within 5 feet of the target you hit with your attack.
You can study an opponent’s style to discern a weakness in its defenses. Choose a hostile creature you can see within 5 feet of you. You can use a bonus action to gain advantage on attack rolls against the target until the start of your next turn. Once you have used this ability against a creature, you can’t use it against the same creature until you finish a short or long rest.
As long as you can see at least one friendly creature within 60 feet of you that is not incapacitated, you have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

Alien Communication.name: Alien Communication
Alien Communication.description:
You can communicate with up to 2 allied creatures that can clearly see your antennae twitch at will as if using telepathic bond.
You no longer suffer disadvantage to Charisma (Deception) checks.
You increase your Charisma score by 2 to a maximum of 20.

Oaken Fortification.name: Oaken Fortification
Oaken Fortification.description:
Benefit(s): Your AC improves by 1. You gainresistanceto non-magical bludgeoning and piercing damage. YourConstitutionscore increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Unholy Scar.name: Unholy Scar
Unholy Scar.description:
You are a chosen avatar of your deity. The symbol of your deity is etched into your skin by ritual scarification, a gruesome birthmark of sorts that symbolizes your rebirth into the service of your god. This grants the following abilities:

In addition to the Unholy Scar feat, each of the following Avatar feats requires service to a deity whose areas of influence lend themselves to the supernatural corruption of mind, body, and flesh appropriate to each feat.

Clerics & Cultists© 2021, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader, Nicholas Hite, Sean K Reynolds, Jason Nelson, Jenny Jarzabski, Miguel Colon, Michael “solomani” Mifsud, Matt Daley, Nathan Reinecke.

Dragon Forger.name: Dragon Forger
Dragon Forger.description:
Benefit(s): Increase yourIntelligenceby 1 to a maximum of 20. Gain proficiency in any 2 tool kits of your choosing. Gainresistanceto fire damage.

Guilds of Sundara © 2022, eGDC Ltd; Author: Neal Litherland

Sacrificial Summons.name: Sacrificial Summons
Sacrificial Summons.description:
You increase your Charisma, Intelligence, or Wisdom score by 1 to a maximum of 20.
When you strike the killing blow on a creature using a spell effect your next summoning spell (any spell that calls another creature to your aid) is effectively one level higher for determining the number or CR of the creature you can summon. This affect is accumulative but fades after 1 minute.

Frozen Fortitude.name: Frozen Fortitude
Frozen Fortitude.description: Character Options: Feats of Cold © 2020, Fat Goblin Games; Author:Troy Daniels

Practiced Reconnoiter.name: Practiced Reconnoiter
Practiced Reconnoiter.description:
You can take theSearchaction as a bonus action.

Breath of Life - The Scout (5e)© 2024, Orphaned Bookworm Productions; Authors: Norman Mitchell Jr. and Connor Bates

Expanding Torso.name: Expanding Torso
Expanding Torso.description:
You can hold your breath for an additional number of rounds equal to your Constitution score.
You can breathe deeply as an action to make yourself appear as if you are one size larger than you are, gaining advantage on Charisma (Intimidation) and Wisdom (Animal Handling) checks as creatures instinctively cower before your bulk. However, your speed is halved while you bolster yourself this way and you can’t benefit from any bonus to your speed. You may breathe out at any time as your free object interaction during a move or as a reaction to being attacked or taking damage.

Weapon Breaker.name: Weapon Breaker
Weapon Breaker.description:
You gain a +1 bonus to your attack rolls.
Whenever you make an attack roll with advantage, if the result of the lower die would have been sufficient to hit your target, you can disarm it in addition to the normal effects of your attack. If you disarm your target, designate one of the weapons it wields, which lands in a space of your choice within 5 feet of it.
Whenever you score a critical hit against a creature, in addition to the normal effects, you can break a nonmagical weapon held by the creature, making it unusable.

Guardian of the Fallen.name: Guardian of the Fallen
Guardian of the Fallen.description:
Benefit(s): Increase yourStrengthorConstitutionscore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You can use yourreactionto impose disadvantage on anattackroll made against a creature within 5 feet of you.

Fight On.name: Fight On
Fight On.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Hard To Kill.name: Hard To Kill
Hard To Kill.description:
Increase yourConstitutionscore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You may add yourConstitutionmodifier to your death saving throw rolls.

Double Down.name: Double Down
Double Down.description:
Both cards use the same attack roll, but each deal separate damage to the same target. Special damage applied by an attack like sneak attack is only applied once and a roll of a 20 is only a critical hit for one of the two cards. Abilities that are applied to a card are applied to each card separately.

Polymorph: The Dealer (5E), © 2024, Orphaned Bookworm Productions, LLC, Author: Connor Bates.

Kennel Master’s Authority.name: Kennel Master’s Authority
Kennel Master’s Authority.description:
Creatures charmed by you have disadvantage on saving throws to end effects causing them to be charmed.
You have advantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain concentration on spells that allow you to dictate another creature’s actions through commands or direct control (e.g. command, conjure elemental, dominate monster, planar binding, or suggestion).

Parrying Style.name: Parrying Style
Parrying Style.description:
With this feat, you can use yourreactionto parrymelee attacksthat hit you, reducing the damage by an amount equal to 1 + yourDexteritymodifier. You must be armed and aware of the attacker to use this feat.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Eel Strike.name: Eel Strike
Eel Strike.description: Pirate Campaign Compendium© 2018, Legendary Games; Lead Designer Jason Nelson. Authors: Alex Augunas, Jeff Gomez, Matt Goodall, Jim Groves, Tim Hitchcock, Victoria Jaczko, Jonathan H. Keith, Lyz Liddell, Thomas J. Phillips, Alistair J. Rigg, Alex Riggs, Loren Sieg, Neil Spicer, Todd Stewart, Rachel Ventura, Michael D. Welham, Linda Zayas-Palmer.

Practicing Chirurgeon.name: Practicing Chirurgeon
Practicing Chirurgeon.description:
The work of fleshcraft is difficult and grisly, but not impossible for a common mind to master. After butchering a few corpses and one surviving living patient, you gain some control over the arts of chirurgy. You learn 1 chirurgical procedure, treating your level as your mad scientist level.

You are able to learn more chirurgical procedures as a fleshworker mad scientist can, treating each as a 3rd-level spell. Any chirurgical procedure with any DC of 20 or higher is treated instead as a 5th-level spell.

Mutants and Mad Scientists (5E)© 2018, Legendary Games; Authors: Jason Nelson, Mike Myler, and Clinton J. Boomer.

Glíma Master.name: Glíma Master
Glíma Master.description:
Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You may choose to use your Dexterity in place of Strength when attempting a grapple check against an opponent.
Your unarmed strike uses a d4 for damage.
When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike or while you have a creature grappled, you may use a bonus action to attempt to shove the target, either to knock it prone or push it 5 feet away from you.

Eldritch Power.name: Eldritch Power
Eldritch Power.description:
You’ve earned extra privileges from your master. You gain two extra eldritch invocations.

Art of Magic – Heretical Pacts © 2019, d20pfsrd.com Publishing; Author: Ed Kabara

Elemental Warden.name: Elemental Warden
Elemental Warden.description:
Increase yourConstitution,Dexterity, orStrengthscore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

When an ally within 5 feet of you takes acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder damage, you can use yourreactionto grant that allyresistanceto that instance of damage, effectively halving the damage they take.

Fey Resonance.name: Fey Resonance
Fey Resonance.description:
You can sense how many fey are within 60 feet of you at any time, but this sense can’t determine their identity or exact location.
You have advantage on saving throws against illusion and enchantment spells.
When you make an ability check to recognize an illusion’s true nature or recognize a creature as charmed, you make the roll with advantage.
During a long rest, you can have a lucid dream and explore the Scintillating Fey Courts remotely, gaining the benefit of a divination spell. Once you have a lucid dream in this way, you can’t do so again for three days.

Sylvan Keeper.name: Sylvan Keeper
Sylvan Keeper.description:
You have traversed the border of the Fey Wild and gained knowledge of the creatures that dwell in its mists.

You learn the druidcraft cantrip.

You can cast the find familiar spell without using a spell slot. You can’t do so again until you finish a long rest. When you cast the find familiar spell in this way, the spirit you summon is a fey chosen from one of the following options instead of those you could normally choose: nettle boar, fern wolf, moss fawn, snakeroot, ringkeeper, dryad’s hair, thornling, humming blossom, twigling.

Familiars summoned in this way add your proficiency bonus to their spellcasting modifier and the DC for all of their abilities.

Cold Born.name: Cold Born
Cold Born.description:
Your ancestry imbues you withresistanceto cold damage.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Twin Summons.name: Twin Summons
Twin Summons.description:
Your connection to conjuration magic allows you to duplicate your summons at a cost.

When youcast a spellof 1st level or higher that creates, summons, or conjures a single creature, you can choose to create two creatures of the same type instead. Each of these creatures has half the maximumhit pointsit would normally have. Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a short or long rest, unless you expend a spell slot of 1st level or higher to use it again.

Dungeoneer.name: Dungeoneer
Dungeoneer.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Death Defiant.name: Death Defiant
Death Defiant.description: Creed's Codex: Arcane Secrets of the Summoners © 2022 Brendan Jonesrebandt Consulting LLC DBA Knight Vision Creative, Author Brendan Jonesrebandt

Lava Shaper.name: Lava Shaper
Lava Shaper.description:
There are some wolákani who have learned how to superheat the ground, turning it into squares of lava. You gain the following benefits.

The Dragon’s Hoard #8 © 2021, Legendary Games; Jason Nelson, Miguel Colon, Robert J. Grady, Michael “solomani” Mifsud, Matt Kimmel, Scott D. Young, Mark Hart, and Jeff Ibach

Arcane Precision.name: Arcane Precision
Arcane Precision.description:
Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
When you cast a spell that requires a ranged attack roll, you can reroll the attack roll if the result is a 1 or 2. If you do so, you must use the new roll.

Thespian.name: Thespian
Thespian.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Epic Resistance.name: Epic Resistance
Epic Resistance.description: Legendary Adventures © 2020 Mike Myler, published under license by Legendary Games.

Blessings of The Moon Goddess.name: Blessings of The Moon Goddess
Blessings of The Moon Goddess.description:
Benefit(s): When in dim or no light, you gain advantage onDexterity(Stealth) checks made tohide. As areaction(and with the expenditure of a Hit Die), you can choose to gain advantage on a saving throw when you are in dim light or no light. YourCharismascore increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Initiate.name: Initiate
Initiate.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Shadow Power.name: Shadow Power
Shadow Power.description:
Benefit(s): You do not suffer disadvantage onStealthchecks when running. You can see through magicaldarkness. Shadows (including your own) bend to protect you, granting you a +1 armor class.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Ceremorphosis.name: Ceremorphosis
Ceremorphosis.description:
Benefit(s): You can expend an additional hit die (2) when using Stunning Pulse to deal 4d8 damage (instead of 4d6) and increase the range of the cone to 60 feet.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Elusive Celerity.name: Elusive Celerity
Elusive Celerity.description:
Your Dexterity modifier increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
When you take the Dash or Disengage action during a turn and move at least 5 feet before the end of that turn, you can add your proficiency bonus to your Armor Class until the start of your next turn.

Two-Weapon Fighting Mastery.name: Two-Weapon Fighting Mastery
Two-Weapon Fighting Mastery.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Master Physician.name: Master Physician
Master Physician.description:
You develop your innate healing skills to their fullest potential. You can cast the spelldetect poison and diseaseat will. It does not use a spell slot. You also learn the spellslesser restorationandrevivify. You can cast each of these spells once and regain the ability to do so after completing a long rest.Charismais your spellcasting ability for these spells.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Lycan Mastery.name: Lycan Mastery
Lycan Mastery.description: With practice, you’ve learned to control your transformations. You can now swap between yourwolf, hybrid, orhumanoidforms as a bonus action on your turn. Additionally, you always succeed onConstitutionsaving throws made to avoid theexhaustioncondition as part of your Unstable Transformation trait.

Exhaustive Burnout.name: Exhaustive Burnout
Exhaustive Burnout.description:
Your internal flames sustain your life and can give you a burst of adrenaline when they are snuffed out.

YourStrengthorConstitutionscore increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Whenever you are reduced to0 hit pointsor killed while under the effects of your lord of brass feature, you are instead reduced to a number ofhit pointsequal to one of your hit dice plus yourConstitutionmodifier (rolling the result and expending the hit die immediately). The effects of lord of brass then end immediately. If you were higher than 10 feet from the ground when this effect was triggered, your wings remain briefly. You safely descend up to 60 feet before your wings of flame vanish, provoking no opportunity attacks as you do.

Dretch Belch.name: Dretch Belch
Dretch Belch.description:
You gain immunity to the poisoned condition and resistance to poison damage.
You are at disadvantage when making non-Intimidation Charisma ability checks against creatures that are not evil and able to smell you.
By spending an action, you expel a 10-foot radius of disgusting green gas that spreads around corners and makes the squares it occupies lightly obscured. It lasts for 1 minute or until a strong wind disperses it. Any creature that starts its turn in that area must succeed on a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + your Constitution modifier) or be poisoned until the start of its next turn. While poisoned in this way, the target can take either an action or a bonus action on its turn, not both, and can’t take reactions. You require a long rest before you are able to belch gas again.

Arcane Shield.name: Arcane Shield
Arcane Shield.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Tinkerer.name: Tinkerer
Tinkerer.description:
Your Intelligence increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You have proficiency with artisanâs tools (tinkerâs tools).
Using tinkerâs tools, you can spend 1 hour and 10 gp worth of materials to construct a Tiny clockwork device (AC 5, 1 hp).
The device ceases to function after 24 hours (unless you spend 1 hour repairing it to keep the device functioning), or when you use your action to dismantle it; at that time, you can reclaim the materials used to create it. You can have up to three such devices active at a time.
Clockwork Toy. This toy is a clockwork animal, monster, or person, such as a frog, mouse, bird, dragon, or soldier. When placed on the ground, the toy moves 5 feet across the ground on each of your turns in a random direction. It makes noises as appropriate to the creature it represents.

Sentient Item.name: Sentient Item
Sentient Item.description:
You gain a sentient version of the chosen magic item.

The sentient item’s ability scores, alignment, senses, and all of its other traits are randomly determined.

Legendary Adventures © 2020 Mike Myler, published under license by Legendary Games.

Valiant.name: Valiant
Valiant.description:
Whenever you fail a saving throw against being frightened, you can immediately use your reaction to reroll this saving throw. The result of the second roll replaces the first.
You have a bonus to the attack and damage rolls of your melee weapon attacks against larger creatures. The bonus is equal to +1 for each size category between you and the creature.
Whenever a creature scores a critical hit against you, you can use your reaction to make a melee attack against a creature within range.

Fiery Spirit.name: Fiery Spirit
Fiery Spirit.description:
You no longer have the Vulnerability to Cold racial ability.
You can start a 5-foot-wide fire with flammable material within 10 feet. If left unchecked, this fire will spread at a rate of 5 feet per round so long as it is still on flammable materials.

Initiate of Thanatokenesis.name: Initiate of Thanatokenesis
Initiate of Thanatokenesis.description:
Power over the very energies of death and unlife, dancing like flickers of cinder & ash upon your pale fingertips.

There are more ways – unnatural though they may be – to access the dark gifts of the corpse-born than mere heredity; by your deep scholarly studies, the fabled Necromancy of Blood’s Path now lies within your living grasp.

Choose any one necromancy spell whose spell level is no higher than one-half your character level; this spell must have a casting time of one action or less. For example, if you were a character of 12th level or higher, you could choosecircle of death. As an action, you can use this chosen spell as a cantrip. You cannot use this cantrip while in direct sunlight. You must choose this spell at the time you take this feat and you cannot select a different spell at a later time. The DC for saving throw against this spell is equal to 8 + proficiency bonus + your spellcasting ability modifier. A spell you cast using this feat is suppressed and has no effect if you enter direct sunlight, though its duration continues to elapse; if any duration remains when you leave the area of direct sunlight, the spell’s duration resumes.

You may gain this feat multiple times. Each time you gain this feat, you choose another necromancy spell of a level no higher than one half your character level with a casting time of one action or less.

Designer’s Note: This ability is particularly well-known amongst Black Mages, and among those who serve the Horseman of the Apocalypse, particularly the Horseman of War.

The Dragon’s Hoard #27 © 2023, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Michael Mifsud, Robert J. Grady, Darrin Drader, James-Levi Cooke.

Swift.name: Swift
Swift.description:
Your speed increases by 10 feet.
Drinking the contents of a vial costs you no action (this benefit can be used only once per round, and only on your turn).
You ignore the loading property of weapons. When you are prone, standing up uses only 5 feet of your movement.

Dreadful Carnage.name: Dreadful Carnage
Dreadful Carnage.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Pecking Strike.name: Pecking Strike
Pecking Strike.description:
Your beak is a natural weapon, which you can use to make unarmed strikes. If you hit with it, you deal piercing damage equal to 1d4 + your Strength modifier, instead of the bludgeoning damage normal for an unarmed strike.
You can make attacks with your beak as a bonus action when you are wielding a finesse weapon.

Enlarged Cerebrum.name: Enlarged Cerebrum
Enlarged Cerebrum.description:
Seeking to free your mind from evil spirits using the ancient technique of trepanning, you perforated your skull. Unfortunately that only gave dark entities greater access to your brain, enlarging a part of it.

Book of Exalted Darkness. © 2018 Mike Myler, published under license by Legendary Games.

Flowing Wave.name: Flowing Wave
Flowing Wave.description: Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Raging Strength.name: Raging Strength
Raging Strength.description:
While raging, your attacks do even more damage.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Extra Inspiration.name: Extra Inspiration
Extra Inspiration.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Duelist’s Grace.name: Duelist’s Grace
Duelist’s Grace.description:
Increase yourDexterityorStrengthscore by 1, to a maximum of 20. Additionally, when you are wielding a melee weapon in one hand and no other weapons, you gain a +1 bonus to AC and advantage on opportunity attacks.

Pirates and Plunder A Compendium For 5e © 2024 Published by Mythos Chronicles; Author Filippo Bardoscia

Improved Initiative.name: Improved Initiative
Improved Initiative.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Toppling Spell.name: Toppling Spell
Toppling Spell.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Once Possessed.name: Once Possessed
Once Possessed.description:
Your Wisdom or Charisma score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You can’t be possessed by another creature.
You have advantage on saving throws to resist being charmed.
You have advantage on ability checks to recognize or determine that a creature is charmed or possessed.

Danger Sense.name: Danger Sense
Danger Sense.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Brutal Pugilist.name: Brutal Pugilist
Brutal Pugilist.description:
Your unarmed strike gains the versatile property, allowing you to increase its damage die by 1 size if you have both hands free when you make the attack (d4, d6, d8, d10, d12).
Your unarmed strike attack rolls do not have disadvantage while you are restrained.
When you use the Attack action to grapple or pin and succeed, you also deal your unarmed strike damage to the creature you are grappling.
You count as one size larger when a creature tries to swallow you. If it does, you can use your reaction to make an opportunity attack against it.

Patient Predator.name: Patient Predator
Patient Predator.description:
You can try to hide when you are lightly obscured from the creature from which you are hiding.
You gain proficiency in two skills of your choice from the following list: Strength (Athletics), Dexterity (Acrobatics), Dexterity (Stealth), Intelligence (Nature), Wisdom (Survival), and Charisma (Deception).
When you roll damage for a melee weapon attack against a surprised target, you can reroll the damage dice and use either total.
Your bite gains the finesse property.

Arcane Convergence.name: Arcane Convergence
Arcane Convergence.description:
When youcast a spellof 1st through 8th level, you can choose to tap into the power of convergence. This allows you to gain the effects of the spell as though it was cast one level higher.

You must then roll on the convergence table to determine your mental accuracy. You regain the use of this ability once you’ve completed a short or long rest.

Creed's Codex: Arcane Secrets of the Summoners © 2022 Brendan Jonesrebandt Consulting LLC DBA Knight Vision Creative, Author Brendan Jonesrebandt

Animal Affinity.name: Animal Affinity
Animal Affinity.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Ruinbound Agility.name: Ruinbound Agility
Ruinbound Agility.description:
Benefit(s): Increase yourDexterityscore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gain a climbing speed equal to your walking speed.

You can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

Heart Ripper.name: Heart Ripper
Heart Ripper.description:
You score critical hits on a 19 or 20 when using when you use an unarmed strike
When you reduce a creature of Large size or smaller to 0 or fewer hit points with an unarmed strike, you can tear the victim’s heart out as a bonus action. The target is entitled to a Constitution saving throw to negate this effect. If you kill a creature with an unarmed strike, you automatically tear their heart out (legendary creatures are immune to this effect).
You gain a +1d4 bonus to Intimidate checks against any creature that witnessed you using this feat to rip out a victim’s heart. This bonus lasts for 1 minute, and it stacks if you have ripped out the hearts of multiple creatures.

Fight Against Good.name: Fight Against Good
Fight Against Good.description:
Benefit(s): You no longer have the Weakness to Good racial ability.

Then a Good-aligned creature attacks you with a melee weaponattackor a ranged weaponattack, you can choose to cause it to have disadvantage as areaction. You can use this a number of times equal to yourCharismamodifier. Taking a long rest resets this ability.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Discerning Senses.name: Discerning Senses
Discerning Senses.description:
You have advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks against all creatures you have “charged” with your sonar.
Your Poison Detector ability now also detects diseases.

Steal Breath.name: Steal Breath
Steal Breath.description:
These hurákani have the ability to not only make it more difficult for others to breathe, but to steal the breath from other creatures entirely.

The Dragon’s Hoard #44© 2024, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Miguel Colon, Darrin Drader, Mark Hart, Dustin Knight, Robert J. Grady, James-Levi Cooke.

Steel Soul.name: Steel Soul
Steel Soul.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Deadly Stroke.name: Deadly Stroke
Deadly Stroke.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Great Weapon Expertise.name: Great Weapon Expertise
Great Weapon Expertise.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Green Ooze.name: Green Ooze
Green Ooze.description: Clean Destruction. The acidic properties of green ooze are not without their merits. While most mundane alchemists can distill vials of acid, only the most skilled can produce green ooze. The substance is highly valued by master thieves who use the ooze to melt locks, traps, and doors. Even more unsavory members of the underground have been known to use green ooze to dispose of bodies and other evidence of their crimes.

Echoes of the Deep.name: Echoes of the Deep
Echoes of the Deep.description: Your connection to the depths has heightened your senses, allowing you to perceive threats unseen. You gain blindsight out to a range of 30 feet.

Spell Penetration.name: Spell Penetration
Spell Penetration.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Chosen of Fortune.name: Chosen of Fortune
Chosen of Fortune.prerequisite: Intelligence 13 or higherYour shrewd mind for money quickl
Chosen of Fortune.description: Your shrewd mind for money quickly turns profits.

Hardy.name: Hardy
Hardy.description:
Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You have a +2 bonus to Constitution checks and Constitution saving throws.
Your death saving throws are successful on a roll of 8 or higher.

Extra Secret of the Stone.name: Extra Secret of the Stone
Extra Secret of the Stone.description: You gain 3 additional uses of secrets of the stone that you can freely distribute among your individual uses of known secrets of the stone when taking a long rest. You could, for example grant one secret of the stone +3 uses, or grant one +1 use and another +2 uses.

Forest Denizen.name: Forest Denizen
Forest Denizen.description:
Increase your Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You can discern if a plant or fungal growth is safe to eat.
You learn to speak, read, and write Sylvan.
You have advantage on Strength (Athletics) and Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks you make to escape from being grappled or restrained as long as you are being grappled or restrained by nonmagical vegetation or a beast’s action such as a giant frog’s bite or a spider’s web.

True Draaki.name: True Draaki
True Draaki.description:
You may, as a reaction to taking damage to which you are resistant due to your draaki subtypes, tap into your inner reservoirs of strength and expend a use of a breath weapon whose energy damage corresponds to the damage you’ve taken. If you do, you negate the damage and become immune to the damage type for 1 minute.
You increase the damage dice of all your draaki breath weapons by +1d6.

Funerary Servant.name: Funerary Servant
Funerary Servant.description:
Your elemental or elemental spirit is immune to Necrotic damage and deals an additional 1d8 Necrotic damage with its slam attacks. Your spell that conjures an elemental spirit does this additional damage as well.

Ancient Tombs (5E) © 2025, Legendary Games; Authors Alex Riggs, Anthony Adam, Jason Nelson, Loren Sieg, and Robert J. Grady

Elemental Alchemy.name: Elemental Alchemy
Elemental Alchemy.description:
Increase yourIntelligencescore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gain proficiency with alchemist’s supplies. If you are already proficient, you double your proficiency bonus for checks made with these supplies. Additionally, once per long rest, you can spend 10 minutes and materials worth 1 gp to create a special alchemical item. This item can either function similarly to alchemist’s fire but deals 4d6 damage of a chosen elemental type (acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder) with a save DC of 8 + yourIntelligencemodifier + your proficiency bonus, or it can act like apotion of resistance, providingresistanceto a chosen elemental type for 10 minutes when consumed. The created alchemical item retains its potency for 3 days before losing its magical properties.

Wield Anything.name: Wield Anything
Wield Anything.description:
Your training with other weapons carries over to your improvised attacks.

Battlemasters & Berserkers © 2021, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

Mystical Multitask.name: Mystical Multitask
Mystical Multitask.description: Due to intensive training, a deep connection to the Source, sheer stubbornness, or natural talent, you are able to maintain concentration on two spells or effects at the same time. This is a taxing practice, and automatically accrues one point of mind-lock.

Combat Caster.name: Combat Caster
Combat Caster.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Source Tap.name: Source Tap
Source Tap.description: Your connection to the Source when casting magic of a particular school is potent. When you choose this feat, select a school of magic. When calculating your spell save DC for spells of that school, you use double your proficiency bonus. You may take this feat multiple times, selecting a different spell school each time the feat is taken.

Widen Spell.name: Widen Spell
Widen Spell.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Waste Walker.name: Waste Walker
Waste Walker.description:
Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20
You are unaffected by natural difficult terrain in badlands and similar regions
You have advantage on checks to determine whether a plant or beast is safe to eat, and you have advantage on Survival checks to find drinkable water or shelter from storms
You have advantage on saving throws against effects that give you the poisoned condition.

Ruin-Runner.name: Ruin-Runner
Ruin-Runner.description:
Benefit(s): Increase yourDexterityscore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Your base walking speed increases by 5 feet. In areas of ruins or wastelands, you can use theDashaction as a bonus action onyour turn.

Clanmind.name: Clanmind
Clanmind.description:
You gain a +1 bonus to AC while a friendly dweorg is within 5 ft. of you.
You gain a bonus action to aid all friendly dweorg attacking creatures within 5 feet of you. If the ally attacks the target before your next turn, the first attack roll the dweorg ally makes is made with advantage.
You may use your action to allow a friendly dweorg within 5 ft. of you to take the disengage action as a bonus action on their next turn.

Photosynthetic Healing.name: Photosynthetic Healing
Photosynthetic Healing.description:
Benefit(s): When in contact with sunlight, you regain 1d4 hit points per hour. You do not need to be resting to regain these hit points. If you take a short rest while in sunlight, add twice yourConstitutionmodifier to the result. You cannot regainhit pointswhen away from sunlight.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Secrets of Irox.name: Secrets of Irox
Secrets of Irox.description:
Benefit(s): YourCharismascore increases by 1, to a maximum of 20. You gaindarkvision. You may select one invocation, awarlockof 2 levels lower than your character can take.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Felling Smash.name: Felling Smash
Felling Smash.description:
You commit all your focus to a devastating blow, trying to crush your opponent to the ground.

Fighters Unlimited 5E© 2019, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

Cleaver.name: Cleaver
Cleaver.description: Increase yourStrengthscore by 1, to a maximum of 20. In addition, when you reduce a creature to0 hit pointswith a melee weapon attack that deals slashing damage, you can decide to carry over any excess damage to another creature nearby. To do so, you must target another creature within reach, applying any remaining damage to it as long as the original attack roll would hit against the new target’s AC. If the creature is reduced to 0 hit points, you can repeat this process, carrying over the remaining damage until there are no valid targets, or until the damage fails to reduce a creature to 0 hit points.

Undead Slayer.name: Undead Slayer
Undead Slayer.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Thrown Weapon Mastery.name: Thrown Weapon Mastery
Thrown Weapon Mastery.description: Once per turn, when you make anattackwith a weapon that has the thrown property and hit, you can make it ricochet to another target within 30 feet of it, you must make anotherattackroll as normal for this hit. If you miss at any point during this specialattack, the thrown weapon returns to your hand.

Greater Wind Magic.name: Greater Wind Magic
Greater Wind Magic.description:
With this feat you develop your inherent magical skills to their full potential. You learn the spell featherfall and can cast it at will. It does not require a spell slot. You also learn the spellsgust of windandfly. You may only castflyon yourself, and when you do, feathered wings sprout from your back. Using these spells does not expend spell slots.Charismais your spellcasting ability for these spells. You may cast each spell one time. After that, you must complete a long rest before you can cast them again.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Gunslinger.name: Gunslinger
Gunslinger.description:
You can use akimbo shooting with all one-handed firearms that do not have the heavy property.
Having a hostile creature within 5 feet of you does not impose disadvantage on attacks you make with firearms that do not have the two-handed property.
You can draw or stow two firearms when you would normally be able to draw or stow only one.

Weasel War Dancer.name: Weasel War Dancer
Weasel War Dancer.description:
When you use the Dash action, all creatures that can see you have disadvantage on their attack rolls against you until the beginning of your next turn.
By reducing your speed by 10 feet, you gain advantage on an attack made after moving at least 5 feet.

Subtle Spell (Meta Magic).name: Subtle Spell (Meta Magic)
Subtle Spell (Meta Magic).description:
Druids of the Arcane Circle have exclusive access to metamagic feats. Rather than taking the Ability Score Improvement feature at 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th and 19th level, they can choose this feat.

When youcast a spell, you can spend 1 sorcery point to cast it without any somatic or verbal components.

Troll’s Fury.name: Troll’s Fury
Troll’s Fury.description: Increase yourStrengthscore by 1, to a maximum of 20. Additionally, you can use a bonus action duringyour turnto enter a state of fury for 1 minute. During this time, when you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack, you can add an extra 1d4 damage of the weapon’s type (e.g. bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing) to the damage roll. Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a long rest.

Back to Back.name: Back to Back
Back to Back.description:
After much practice, you and an ally have become adept at fighting in close proximity to one another.

The Dragon’s Hoard #41 © 2024, Legendary Games; Authors Authors Jason Nelson, Michael Mifsud, Matt Kimmel, Dan Dillon, James-Levi Cooke

Fearsome Presence.name: Fearsome Presence
Fearsome Presence.description: Increase yourCharismascore by 1, to a maximum of 20. Additionally as a bonus action, you can force all creatures of your choice within 30 feet of you to make aWisdomsaving throw (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + yourCharismamodifier). On a failed save, a creature isfrightenedfor 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, the target can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. You can use this feature a number of time equal to yourCharismamodifier (minimum of once), regaining any expended uses when you finish a long rest.

Devastating Cantrip.name: Devastating Cantrip
Devastating Cantrip.description:
Choose a class:bard,cleric,druid,sorcerer,warlock, orwizard. When you cast a cantrip from that class’s spell list, you can add one extra die to the damage it deals on a hit. This effect can occur only once per turn.

Devastating Cantrip and Eldritch Blast Instead of increasing the damage die of the Eldritch Blast cantrip, the Devastating Cantrip feat increase the number of beams created by the spell by one.

Mage Slayer.name: Mage Slayer
Mage Slayer.description:
against creatures with a spellcasting feature that is not innate: Your melee attacks do an additional 1d6 damage against creatures with the spellcasting feature that is not innate.
When a creature within 5 feet of you casts a spell, you can use your reaction to make a melee weapon attack against that creature. When you damage a creature that is concentrating on a spell, that creature has disadvantage on the saving throw it makes to maintain concentration.

Carrion Feeder.name: Carrion Feeder
Carrion Feeder.description:
This feat is intended for creatures whose race is animalistic in some way, with fur or feathers or similar bestial traits, such as gnolls and catfolk.

Your distant animal kin were scavengers, and you can stomach foods that would make weaker creatures ill. You gain advantage on saving throws against diseases and ingested poisons (but not other poisons). In addition, you gain advantage onWisdom(Survival) checks when foraging for food but can only find enough food for yourself.

The Dragon’s Hoard #21 © 2022, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Miguel Colon, Alex Riggs, Mike Myler, Robert J. Grady, Michael “solomani” Mifsud, Darrin Drader, Matt Kimmel, Scott D. Young.

Light Armor Proficiency.name: Light Armor Proficiency
Light Armor Proficiency.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Mnemonic Mastery.name: Mnemonic Mastery
Mnemonic Mastery.description: Your study of the spells at your disposal has advanced to such a degree that you may hold a portion of magical energy in reserve, freeing you from the restrictions of spell preparation. When you prepare spells, you may keep a number of open spells on your prepared list equal to your spellcasting ability modifier (minimum 1). As an action you may choose a spell you know but do not have prepared and make an ability check using your spellcasting ability (DC = 10 + the level of the desired spell). If successful, you may instantly prepare the desired spell. You must have at least one spell slot available of the desired spell’s level or higher in order to use this feat to prepare a spell.

Disengaging Feint.name: Disengaging Feint
Disengaging Feint.description:
You can useDeceptiontoDisengagefrom combat.

Fighters Unlimited 5E© 2019, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

Enhanced Rock Throwing.name: Enhanced Rock Throwing
Enhanced Rock Throwing.description:
Benefit(s): Your thrown rocks inflict an additional 1d8 bludgeoning damage. The range with your thrown rocks increases to 60/240. YourStrengthscore increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Deft Climber.name: Deft Climber
Deft Climber.description:
Climbing does not cost you extra movement. You can use Dexterity rather than Strength when you make an ability check to climb.
You can ignore difficult terrain while crawling.
If a trap or natural hazard would cause you to fall, you can use your reaction to avoid falling.
During a long rest, you can stand watch for 1 additional hour. This doesn’t change the time required for you to complete a long rest.
You can use a climber’s kit as a bonus action instead of an action.
When you are moving at travel pace, you contribute your Wisdom (Perception) to noticing threats even when you are engaged in another activity (such as foraging, navigating, or tracking).

Harpy’s Song.name: Harpy’s Song
Harpy’s Song.description:
Benefit(s): As an action, you can sing a magical melody that enchants those around you. Every enemy with 30 feet must succeed aWisdomsaving throw or becomecharmedandincapacitated. The DC for this saving throw equals 8 + yourCharismamodifier + your proficiency bonus.

You must take a bonus action on each of your turns to continue the song. You can stop singing at any time. The song ends if you areincapacitated.

If thecharmedtarget is more than 5 feet away from you, it must move on its turn towards you by the most direct route. It doesn’t avoid Opportunity Attacks, but before moving into damaging terrains, such as lava or a pit, and whenever it takes damage, a target can repeat the saving throw. A creature can also repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns. If a creature’s saving throw is successful, the effect ends on it. Once you use this ability, you must wait until you take a long rest to use it again. YourCharismascore increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Burning Spell.name: Burning Spell
Burning Spell.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Master of Magics.name: Master of Magics
Master of Magics.description:
By interacting with the constant flow of arcane energy, you have found a connection to these otherworldly elements and drawn them into yourself. As a result, you gain the following benefits.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Ore Dowser.name: Ore Dowser
Ore Dowser.description:
All That Glitters. You have Advantage onIntelligenceandWisdomchecks related to the presence of metal or ore, or evaluating its quality.

Hammer and Tongs. You gain proficiency with Smith’s Tools. If you already have proficiency with Smith’s Tools, gain proficiency in another tool instead.

Metal Detector. You can castLocate Objectwithout using a spell slot, provided the object is at least 50% ore or metal. You can cast the spell once in this fashion, before needing a Long Rest to cast it again.

The Dragon’s Hoard #60 © 2025, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Darrin Drader, Robert J. Grady, Kate Baker, Joel Flank, Wren Brown, James-Levi Cooke.

Protective Transmutation.name: Protective Transmutation
Protective Transmutation.description:
Increase the score of your spellcasting ability by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Reactive Shell. When you are about to take damage, you can use your reaction before the damage is rolled to expend a spell slot and gain resistance to the type of the incoming damage until the start of your next turn. If you expend a spell slot of 5th level or higher, you instead gain immunity to this type of damage until the start of your next turn.

Arcane Spiritualist.name: Arcane Spiritualist
Arcane Spiritualist.description:
Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency in the Arcana skill. If you’re already proficient in it, your proficiency bonus is doubled for any check you make with it.
You learn the speak with dead spell. You can cast this spell without the need for physical components. You may also cast this spell without the need of a physical corpse if you target a spirit that you can either name or describe.

Defiant.name: Defiant
Defiant.description: Sandy Petersen’s Planet Apocalypse, © 2021, Petersen Games.

Inspiring Leadership.name: Inspiring Leadership
Inspiring Leadership.description: from these temporary hit points again until they have taken at least a short rest.

Powerful Cantrip.name: Powerful Cantrip
Powerful Cantrip.description: When you miss a creature with a cantrip, the creature takes half the cantrip’s damage but suffers no additional effect from the cantrip.

Disrupting Strike.name: Disrupting Strike
Disrupting Strike.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Violent Motivation.name: Violent Motivation
Violent Motivation.description:
Increase your Charisma by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You may do damage equal to half your level to any creature you control as a bonus action on your turn. This damage may not be prevented by any means. If you do so, the creature gains advantage on an attack or check made on their turn.

Art of Magic – Heretical Pacts © 2019, d20pfsrd.com Publishing; Author: Ed Kabara

Shield Bearer.name: Shield Bearer
Shield Bearer.description:
If you do not move during your turn, you gain half cover until the start of your next turn. This benefit does not apply if you are incapacitated.
Whenever a creature misses you with a melee attack, you can use your reaction to automatically deal your attacker bludgeoning damage equal to 1d6 + your Strength modifier.

Honing Your Craft.name: Honing Your Craft
Honing Your Craft.description:
Benefit(s): Increase either yourStrength,Dexterity, orIntelligencescore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gain expertise with one set of artisan’s tools that you are proficient in.

When you have the opportunity to do a downtime activity, you can choose to spend it earning a living with your artisan’s tools. Normally, this would award you 1 gold piece per day as payment, but your expertise with your craft allows you to take on harder, more demanding jobs.

Instead of the traditional 1 gold piece, you instead earn an amount of gold pieces equal to your proficiency bonus per workday when using a set of tools you have expertise in.

Flesh Alchemist.name: Flesh Alchemist
Flesh Alchemist.description: 5E: Age of Antiquity Adventure and Intrigue in the Ancient World © 2019 Aruzian Publishing, Stephen Delucchi, Marcus Lundin

Sturdy Form.name: Sturdy Form
Sturdy Form.description:
These wolákani have taken their training with their rocklike skin to new depths and have learned how to completely negate a blow. You gain the following benefits.

The Dragon’s Hoard #8 © 2021, Legendary Games; Jason Nelson, Miguel Colon, Robert J. Grady, Michael “solomani” Mifsud, Matt Kimmel, Scott D. Young, Mark Hart, and Jeff Ibach

Senses of the Shrike.name: Senses of the Shrike
Senses of the Shrike.description:
When a creature on the same plane speaks this name or title, you learn which direction they are in but not how far they are from you. If they speak your name or title a second time within 24 hours, you learn exactly how far they are from you. If they speak your name a third time within 24 hours, you learn their name and any alias they may be using. You continue to know their direction and distance until you complete a long rest.

Legendary Classes: Templars & Tyrants© 2023, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Darrin Drader, Miguel Colon, Clinton J. Boomer, Amber Scott

Erudite Feaster.name: Erudite Feaster
Erudite Feaster.description:
You can maintain three additional insights from your Psychic Feast trait.
If you use your Psychic Feast trait to consume a spellcaster’s remains, you can absorb a bit of its lingering power to augment your own. If the body is less than 100 years old, instead of gaining a skill insight from the corpse, you can gain a spell known that the creature knew or had prepared in life if it is on your class list and is of a spell level you can cast. If the body is over 100 years old, you can gain an additional spell of a different level in place of a second insight.
Spells gained in this way don’t count against your number known. If you prepare spells, you can instead prepare the spell without counting it against the number you can prepare normally.
If you are a wizard, the spell is immediately prepared without scribing, and while it is prepared you can scribe it into your spellbook as if you were replacing a lost spellbook.

Sacrificial Power.name: Sacrificial Power
Sacrificial Power.description:
You increase your Charisma, Intelligence, or Wisdom score by 1 to a maximum of 20.
When you strike the killing blow on a creature using a spell effect you may add another die of damage or increase the DC of your next spell by 1.

Amber Wayfarer.name: Amber Wayfarer
Amber Wayfarer.description:
When using an Amberized Lodestone in conjunction with an Amber Attenuator, you are automatically cognizant of interfering resonance without requiring detect magic.
You decrease the chance of incurring a mishap when using an Amber Road while subject to multiple resonances or using a broken lodestone to 01-10 on a d%, with 11-50 depositing you in a similar area and 51-100 putting you on target.
You can cast seek earthly transit as a 1st-level spell at will. Intelligence is your spellcasting ability for this spell.

Winter Coat.name: Winter Coat
Winter Coat.description:
Your fur or feathers are adapted to conditions of extreme cold and your coloration matches icy conditions. You count as wearing cold weather gear for the purposes of dealing with extreme cold temperatures.

Your white plumage or fur also grants you advantage onStealthchecks in snowy or icy conditions.

The Dragon’s Hoard #20© 2022, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Miguel Colon, Alex Riggs, Mike Myler, Robert J. Grady, Michael “solomani” Mifsud, Darrin Drader, Matt Kimmel, Scott D. Young.

Extra Channel.name: Extra Channel
Extra Channel.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Coordinated Fighter.name: Coordinated Fighter
Coordinated Fighter.description:
If you attack with more than 3 weapons via your Multi-Armed racial feature instead of with more than 2, melee attacks against you gain advantage until your next turn.
You may wield more than one two-handed weapon. Wielding two two-handed weapon counts as wielding 4 weapons for the purpose of Multi-Armed.
At 16th level, enemies no longer gain advantage to melee attacks after you attacked with more than 3 weapons.

Deep One Might.name: Deep One Might
Deep One Might.description:
Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You can breathe air and water and don’t have to spend extra movement when swimming.
You grow webbed claws on your hands and when you make an unarmed strike with a claw it deals 1d6 slashing damage and has the light and finesse properties.
You grow monstrous fangs and when you make an unarmed strike with your bite it deals 1d6 piercing damage and has the light and finesse properties.

Mycelium Transport.name: Mycelium Transport
Mycelium Transport.description:
Benefit(s): The myconaut spends ten minutes preparing a ritual of travel. Following this, the myconaut sinks into the earth and begins to decay. The essence of the myconaut then travels along the Mycelium Web to another location where it can form a new body. The travel is instantaneous but the regrowth process requires 8 hours and results in any form the myconaut can normally assume.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Sympathetic Sorcery.name: Sympathetic Sorcery
Sympathetic Sorcery.description: If anattackis made against you and successfully hits, you may roll a d20 as areactionas if rolling to hit with anattackagainst your attacker’s AC. If successful, the attacker takes an amount of damage equivalent to the amount done to you before any modifiers such as resistances (minimum of 1 hit point damage). You may use this ability up to three times per day. This ability recharges at sunrise.

Adaptive Laborer.name: Adaptive Laborer
Adaptive Laborer.description:
Benefit(s): One skill of your choice increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gain proficiency in one set of artisan’s tools of your choice.

You gain proficiency in one of the following sets of tools: carver’s kit, disguise kit, forgery kit, herbalism kit, land vehicles, navigator’s tools, poisoner’s kit, water vehicles.

Divine Health.name: Divine Health
Divine Health.description:
Your divine heritage has rendered you immune to disease.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Spectral Strikes.name: Spectral Strikes
Spectral Strikes.description:
You channel necrotic energy into your attacks.

Once per turn, when you hit a creature with a melee weaponattack, you can deal additional necrotic damage equal to yourWisdommodifier to the target.

Stealth Synergy.name: Stealth Synergy
Stealth Synergy.description: from the advantage of any of its members unless all members have advantage. In that case, all members can roll twice and the group can take the highest roll overall.

Ironskin.name: Ironskin
Ironskin.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Epic Expertise.name: Epic Expertise
Epic Expertise.description:
Your proficiency bonus is doubled for any ability check you make that uses either of the chosen proficiencies.

Legendary Adventures © 2020 Mike Myler, published under license by Legendary Games.

Angel Mangler.name: Angel Mangler
Angel Mangler.description: Your attacks, features, and spells affecting celestials ignore anydamage resistance(but not immunity) the celestial has. Additionally, when you reduce a celestial to0 hit pointsonyour turn, you can use a bonus action to make a weapon attack against the same or another celestial you can see.

Arcane Conduit.name: Arcane Conduit
Arcane Conduit.description:
When you cast a spell with a range of self, you can have it also apply to your Summon as long as it is within 60 feet of you.
