When you cast a spell with a range of touch, you can deliver it through your Summon as long as it is within 60 feet of you.

Improvised Diversion.name: Improvised Diversion
Improvised Diversion.description:
You gain a +1 bonus toCharismaorDexterity, up to a maximum of 20.

You can make aDeceptioncheck as a bonus action to create a diversion to move andhide. ThisDeceptioncheck is opposed by each observer’sInsightcheck. Any that fail cannot takereactionsagainst you while you move and you may make aStealthcheck at the end of the movement. Any creatures that succeeded on theirInsightcheck gain advantage on theirPerceptioncheck to find you on their next turn.

Breath of Life: The Beguiler (5e), © 2024, Orphaned Bookworm Productions, LLC, Authors: Connor Bates and Norman Mitchell Jr.

Master of Illusions.name: Master of Illusions
Master of Illusions.description: from this experience, and still have great affinity with illusion spells.

Stance Warrior.name: Stance Warrior
Stance Warrior.description: 5E: Age of Antiquity Adventure and Intrigue in the Ancient World © 2019 Aruzian Publishing, Stephen Delucchi, Marcus Lundin

Warp Sense.name: Warp Sense
Warp Sense.description:
You have trained in readiness against fiendish creatures who walk between worlds to unleash their evil.

Whenever a creature uses a spell or effect that allows that creature to magically travel (misty step,teleport,etc.) to appear within 60 feet of you, you gain a +2 on any check to detect that creature. If successful, you are not surprised by the teleporting creature, and you can act even if the rest of your party is surprised. You also gain advantage on yourinitiativecheck if combat with the teleporting creature(s) begins within 1 minute of noticing the teleportation.

You can select one specific type of chaotic or fiend, such as devils, demons, etc. You are especially sensitive to teleportation used by creatures of that subtype, gaining advantage on any check to detect them.

This bonus to detect such teleportation is negated if the teleporting creature is usingnondetectionor a similar effect.

In such cases, the creature does not gain the advantage of that spell.

The Dragon’s Hoard #26© 2022, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Robert J. Grady, Darrin Drader, James-Levi Cooke.

Talented.name: Talented
Talented.description: Legendary Adventures © 2020 Mike Myler, published under license by Legendary Games.

Slam Expertise.name: Slam Expertise
Slam Expertise.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Bombardier.name: Bombardier
Bombardier.description:
Benefit(s): You know how to cause a distraction. Using pieces of string, mounds of dirt, or other on-hand material together with a bit of black powder, you can cause a small, nondamaging explosion to occur. Anyone within 300 feet of the explosion that can hear it will be naturally drawn to the sound and move towards it, giving them disadvantage onWisdomchecks for 1 minute while they investigate the disturbance. Some creatures might choose to not abandon their post regardless of the blast, such as guards, but they still have disadvantage onWisdomchecks if they are within range. Once you’ve used this feature, you can’t use it again until you’ve finished a short orlong restas you use this time to gather ingredients for your next bomb.

You also know how to craft bombs. Spending 50 gold on materials, you may spend a day to craft 1d4 bombs. These bombs can be thrown up to 30 feet away using an action and they have a blast radius of 5 feet. Each creature in range of the blast has to make aDexteritysaving throw (DC = 8 + your proficiency bonus + yourDexterityorIntelligencemodifier). The creature takes 1d12 damage on a failed save and half as much damage on a successful one.

You choose if the damage type is fire or piercing. This damage increases by 1d12 when you reach 5th level (2d12), 11th level (3d12) and 17th level (4d12).

Hated Supremacy.name: Hated Supremacy
Hated Supremacy.description:
You have mastered overcoming the defenses of a particular type of opponent that you hate above all others.

Battlemasters & Berserkers © 2021, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

Dvergr Daredevil.name: Dvergr Daredevil
Dvergr Daredevil.description:
You gain advantage on all Strength and Dexterity saving throws to avoid being caught in a cave-in, avalanche, collapsing structure, etc. On a successful save, you take no damage from the collapse and don’t fall prone or become buried.
You gain advantage on all Strength and Dexterity checks to dig yourself free from rubble, snow and similar substances that bury you.
You do not treat the ground subject to an earthquake or similar event as difficult terrain and don’t have to make Constitution saving throws during earthquakes to avoid having your concentration broken.
You add your proficiency bonus to the save DC of ambersticks you throw.

Campfire Expert.name: Campfire Expert
Campfire Expert.description: 5E: Age of Antiquity Adventure and Intrigue in the Ancient World © 2019 Aruzian Publishing, Stephen Delucchi, Marcus Lundin

Pale Hand Training.name: Pale Hand Training
Pale Hand Training.description:
Trained by the master thieves of the Pale Hand, you have learned to get into places you don’t belong.

Increase yourDexterityscore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gain proficiency in Thieves’ Tools. If you are already proficient in this skill, you may double your proficiency bonus when using thieves’ tools. In addition, you have advantage on ability checks when detecting or disarming traps.

Defiant Flow.name: Defiant Flow
Defiant Flow.description:
Your Strength or Dexterity score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.
When an effect would force you to fall prone or move at least 5 feet against your will, you can use your reaction to instead teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within 5 feet.

Corsair’s Ferocity.name: Corsair’s Ferocity
Corsair’s Ferocity.description:
Increase yourDexterity,Strength, orCharismascore by 1, to a maximum of 20. Additionally, when you reduce a creature to0 hit pointswith a melee weaponattack, you can use yourreactionto move up to half your speed without provoking opportunity attacks and make one melee weaponattack.

Pirates and Plunder A Compendium For 5e © 2024 Published by Mythos Chronicles; Author Filippo Bardoscia

Chain Spell.name: Chain Spell
Chain Spell.description:
You gain an additional metamagic ability. By expending 2 sorcery points you can cause a single-target spell to also affect secondary targets up to your spellcasting ability modifier within 30 feet. The secondary targets have advantage on any saving throws or you have disadvantage on your spellattackrolls against them. Any damage dealt is halved for the secondary targets, before the effects of saving throws are applied.

Breath of Life: The Beguiler (5e), © 2024, Orphaned Bookworm Productions, LLC, Authors: Connor Bates and Norman Mitchell Jr.

Hedgecraft.name: Hedgecraft
Hedgecraft.description:
Increase your Intelligence or Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You are skilled at locating and identifying magic plants. You have advantage on Intelligence and Wisdom checks to search for and identify magic plants.
When you fail to harvest a magic plant, you can try a second time before the magic plant is destroyed. You have disadvantage on this second attempt, which destroys the plant on a failure.
You have learned how to expertly care for magic plants, and you gain two magic plants of your choice. Each plant is in a small pot, pouch, or some other portable container that you carry with you on your travels. At the end of every 7 days, roll a d4 for each magic plant that you own. The number rolled determines how many uses of that plant you have for the next 7 days. Each plant then steadily regrows, providing more uses after 7 days have passed. While caring for a plant requires work, it is considered part of your routine when you take a long rest and requires no further skill checks. You can keep and care for a number of magic plants equal to 1 + your proficiency bonus at a time.

Shadow Dweller.name: Shadow Dweller
Shadow Dweller.description:
While you are in an area of darkness, you have advantage on saving throws to resist being frightened.
When you start your turn in an area of dim light, you gain a number of temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus.
While you are in an area of dim light or darkness, you can take the Hide action as a bonus action.

Shield Assault.name: Shield Assault
Shield Assault.description: Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Archivist.name: Archivist
Archivist.description:
Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Whenever you make an Intelligence (Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion) check, you have advantage on this check if you spend at least 1 minute reading your notes and gathering your memories. You can use this benefit only once on the same subject, and only if you haven’t already used the benefit below on this subject.
Whenever you make an Intelligence (Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion) check during a short rest, you can forsake your roll to instead resolve your check as if you had rolled a 15. You can use this benefit only once on the same subject.

Aerial Mastery.name: Aerial Mastery
Aerial Mastery.description: Book of Monstrous Might: Ecology of the Gargoyles © 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Authors: Brian Berg, George "Loki" Williams.

Evolved Crystal Conductivity.name: Evolved Crystal Conductivity
Evolved Crystal Conductivity.description:
You lose the conductivity racial trait.
As a reaction to taking lightning damage, you may move up to your speed.
You may use the Acid Conversion ability an additional 3 times before requiring a rest to recharge.

Vine Lasso.name: Vine Lasso
Vine Lasso.description:
As an action, you can conjure a vine into your hand and throw it at a creature within 30 feet. Make an attack roll. If you hit, you deal 1d4 Piercing damage to the creature and the creature is restrained until the end of your next turn.
You can conjure a regular vine as an action that acts as a 60-foot-long hemp rope. This vine lasts for 1 hour and you cannot summon another vine until it disappears.

Battlefield Glance.name: Battlefield Glance
Battlefield Glance.description:
Once per long rest, if you succeed on anIntelligence(Investigation) check at DC 13, you may determine two of the following attributes of your surroundings: the nearest high ground, nearest adequate shelter, source of water, approximate hours until sunrise or sunset, any collapse points or weaknesses in structures you are in or within 30 feet of you, or number of hostile creatures or persons within 30 feet of you. If you fail the check, you may only determine one of those attributes.

This ability recharges after a long rest.

Wishful Thinking.name: Wishful Thinking
Wishful Thinking.description:
Benefit(s): By concentrating for 10 minutes, the geniekin can grant an additional limitedwishper day, as an action, with no chance ofexhaustionfor the target. This ability costs 2HD and can be used once per long rest.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Gambit.name: Gambit
Gambit.description:
You gain +1 to your Wisdom score, with a maximum of 20.
As a bonus action when engaged with an enemy, you can make a feint to move away. If you win an opposed Wisdom (Insight) check with that enemy, it uses its reaction to make an attack of opportunity at you with disadvantage. If the enemy wins, it may choose whether to use its reaction to attack you. If it chooses to attack, it uses its reaction to do so and rolls with advantage.

Spellslinger.name: Spellslinger
Spellslinger.description: Through intense focus, training, and dedication, you’ve harnessed the techniques of rapid spellcasting. You are no longer limited to only one non-cantrip spell per turn. If you are able to access multipleactions, reduce the casting time of a spell to a bonus action, or by some other means introduce a second spellcasting action intoyour turn, you may cast a second spell that requires the expenditure of a spell slot. If you cast two or more spells in a single turn, only one of them can use a spell slot of 3rd level or higher.

Wrestling Legend.name: Wrestling Legend
Wrestling Legend.description: You gain four additional Wrestling Moves of your choice.

Raging Dragon Style.name: Raging Dragon Style
Raging Dragon Style.description:
Those of draconic heritage are often fortunate enough to be trained by dragons themselves in the mysterious Draconic Arts, reaching a level of mastery unseen by other monks. When you use an ability that requires you to expend ki points, the DC for such abilities is increased by 1. In addition, increase yourWisdomscore by 1, to a max of 20.

Scarred Races. © 2019, Wanderer’s Haven Publications; Author: Jeremy Hochhalter

Heighten Spell.name: Heighten Spell
Heighten Spell.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Whispering Shadows.name: Whispering Shadows
Whispering Shadows.description:
Shadows speak to you, revealing hidden secrets.

Increase yourWisdomorIntelligencescore by 1, to a maximum of 20. Additionally, you gain advantage on allIntelligence(Investigation) andWisdom(Perception) checks made in dim light or darkness.

Rakish Presence.name: Rakish Presence
Rakish Presence.description:
If the number of sneakattackdice you possess is greater than your proficiency bonus, you may use that number in place of your proficiency bonus for Intimidate checks. This allows you to apply this bonus even if you are not proficient with the skill.

Breath of Life - The Scout (5e)© 2024, Orphaned Bookworm Productions; Authors: Norman Mitchell Jr. and Connor Bates

Vicious Claws.name: Vicious Claws
Vicious Claws.description:
Benefit(s): Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20. Your claws are natural weapons, which you can use to make unarmed strikes. If you hit with them, you deal slashing damage equal to 1d4 + your Strength modifier.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Contained Green Ooze.name: Contained Green Ooze
Contained Green Ooze.description: As an action, you can make a DC 10Dexteritycheck to throw this jar up to 20 feet, shattering it on impact. On a failed check, the jar drops at your location and shatters. Once the jar is shattered, green ooze spreads out to a 15-foot diameter circle that lasts for 10 minutes before dissolving. When a creature moves into or within the area, it takes 1d4 acid damage for every 5 feet it travels.

Snap Shot.name: Snap Shot
Snap Shot.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Stalwart.name: Stalwart
Stalwart.description:
You can go on fighting when others would collapse and give up. You have advantage on saving throws against being exhausted or stunned.

In addition, when you are stunned or exhausted, you can try to shake it off. You can use a bonus action to reduce yourexhaustionlevel by 1. Alternately, at the end ofyour turn, you can make a new saving throw against any effect that has imposed the stunned condition on you, ending that condition on a success (the save DC is equal to that of the effect that stunned you, or DC 10, whichever is higher). In either case, once you use this ability, you must finish a short orlong restbefore you can use it again.

Scarred Lands Player’s Guide © 2016 Onyx Path Publishing Authors: Bill Ashbless, Jason Bolte, Chris Cowger, Adam Eichelberger, Alain Giorla, Nathan Knaack, Chris Sims, Eddy Webb

Enhanced Seismic Sense.name: Enhanced Seismic Sense
Enhanced Seismic Sense.description: You can use your Seismic Sense trait as a bonus action during your turn, and its range is doubled. You cannot be surprised by creatures as long as both you and they are in contact with the ground.

Transporter.name: Transporter
Transporter.description:
Benefit(s): At the start of every day, you can choose an item, or a group of people up to yourWisdommodifier in number, and declare them to be your ward. When you are within 5 feet of a person or item that is your ward, and someone attacks them, you may spend yourReactionto impose Disadvantage on thatattack. If you are carrying an item that is your ward, all attempts to get it away from you are made at Disadvantage. Lastly, if a person or item that is your ward is stolen, they are treated as if they are under the effect oflocate objectorlocate creaturefor you until you declare a new ward.

Guilds of Sundara © 2022, eGDC Ltd; Author: Neal Litherland

Apocalyptic Mutation: Horns.name: Apocalyptic Mutation: Horns
Apocalyptic Mutation: Horns.description:
Whether through surviving a fiend’s magic or as a result of being warped by the blasted landscape, a crown of demonic horns sprouts from your head. You gain the following benefits.

Sandy Petersen’s Planet Apocalypse, © 2021, Petersen Games.

Hear the Sea.name: Hear the Sea
Hear the Sea.description:
Benefit(s): You gain a +2 bonus to your passivePerceptionwhen you are in water, and on hearingbasedPerceptionchecks in all situations. You reduce the distance penalty on hearing-basedPerceptionchecks to -1 per 30 feet at the water’s surface and -1 per 60 feet underwater. In addition, you can detect the location of creatures moving creatures in the water within 5 feet (or within 20 feet for creatures lacking a swim speed) as if you had tremorsense.

Pirate Campaign Compendium© 2018, Legendary Games; Lead Designer Jason Nelson. Authors: Alex Augunas, Jeff Gomez, Matt Goodall, Jim Groves, Tim Hitchcock, Victoria Jaczko, Jonathan H. Keith, Lyz Liddell, Thomas J. Phillips, Alistair J. Rigg, Alex Riggs, Loren Sieg, Neil Spicer, Todd Stewart, Rachel Ventura, Michael D. Welham, Linda Zayas-Palmer.

Lasting Vanity.name: Lasting Vanity
Lasting Vanity.description:
Halfling Form. You may assume the appearance of a single halfling. You decide what you look like, including your height, weight, facial features, sound of your voice, hair length, coloration, and distinguishing characteristics, if any. You can use your action to switch between your halfling form and your true form.
While in halfling form, you do not suffer from Sunlight Hypersensitivity.

Improved Beast Companion.name: Improved Beast Companion
Improved Beast Companion.description:
Your beast companion is of greater power than most of its kind.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Misdirecting Ricochet.name: Misdirecting Ricochet
Misdirecting Ricochet.description:
Benefit(s): As a free action, umbral elves can spend three Hit Dice to direct missile attacks to ricochet from a solid surface and strike their opponent from an unexpected angle. A surface capable of producing a ricochet must be available for this ability to function. All attacks for the combat round can be made with this ability.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Fiend-Marked.name: Fiend-Marked
Fiend-Marked.description: when you finish a long rest.

Xenophobia.name: Xenophobia
Xenophobia.description: The Dragon’s Hoard #40 © 2023, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Matt Kimmel, Darrin Drader, Mike Myler

Bouncing Spell.name: Bouncing Spell
Bouncing Spell.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Anatomical Precision.name: Anatomical Precision
Anatomical Precision.description:
Your study ofhumanand inhuman anatomies allows you to strike with deadly precision. As abonus action, you can study the anatomy and movement style of a creature within 30 feet, making anIntelligencecheck appropriate to the creature’s type, with a DC of 8 + the target’s CR. If successful, for the next minute you may add yourIntelligencemodifier toattackrolls against the creature and increase the damage of any sneakattackdie against that target.

Mutants and Mad Scientists (5E)© 2018, Legendary Games; Authors: Jason Nelson, Mike Myler, and Clinton J. Boomer.

Beast Master.name: Beast Master
Beast Master.description:
Your affinity with animals deepens, bordering on the supernatural. You learn the following spells: beast sense,speak with animals, andanimal messenger.

You may cast these spells as rituals.

Lucid Dreamer.name: Lucid Dreamer
Lucid Dreamer.description:
You have greater control of the morphic nature of the Dimension of Dreams.

The Dragon’s Hoard #48© 2024, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Matt Kimmel, Michael Mifsud, Wren Roy, Matt Goodall, Ismael Alvarez

Void Channeler.name: Void Channeler
Void Channeler.description:
Other creatures who can hear you suffer minorreactionsto the void speech such as spontaneous nosebleeds, headaches, bits of hair falling out, and other unsettling effects. The first time you use this ability, you suffer no adverse effect. If you use it again before completing a short or long rest, you take 1d4 necrotic damage. Each additional time you use it before finishing a rest, the necrotic damage increases by 1d4.

Deep Magic: Void Magic © 2016 Open Design; Author: Dan Dillon.

Arcane Charm.name: Arcane Charm
Arcane Charm.description:
You can innately cast this spell without any components, and you can choose to reduce its casting time from 1 action to 1 bonus action, or from 1 bonus action to 1reaction(which you take at the end of another creature’s turn). Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a short rest or long rest.

Legendary Adventures © 2020 Mike Myler, published under license by Legendary Games.

Explosive Treatment.name: Explosive Treatment
Explosive Treatment.description:
Your connection to the positive energy plane fills you with great power, which can explosively boost yourhealingcapabilities.

YourWisdomorCharismascore increases by 1, to a maximum of 20. When you use a spell or feature to restorehit pointsto a creature, roll 1d100. On a result equal to your total level or lower, that creature regains the maximum possible amount ofhit pointsas if thehealingeffect’s dice rolled maximum results. If you roll a 100, the target regainshit pointsas normal and also gainstemporary hit pointsequal to thehit pointsthey regained.

Eye of the Storm.name: Eye of the Storm
Eye of the Storm.description: Ultimate Kingdoms (5E)© 2020, Legendary Games; Lead Designer: Jason Nelson. Authors: Ben Walklate, Mark Seifter, Linda Zayas-Palmer, Will McCardell

Born of Shadow and Light.name: Born of Shadow and Light
Born of Shadow and Light.description:
Benefit(s): You gain the Trance ability. You no longer suffer the Light Sensitivity flaw. You gain advantage onIntelligence(Deception) checks to disguise yourself as a high elf.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Defensive Weapon Training.name: Defensive Weapon Training
Defensive Weapon Training.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Life-bound.name: Life-bound
Life-bound.description:
Ability Score Increase. Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Resist Death. You have advantage on Death saving throws.

Hypnotic Predator.name: Hypnotic Predator
Hypnotic Predator.description:
You may use your hypnotic gaze a number of times equal to your up to your Constitution modifier before requiring a short rest to recharge.
You may use hypnotic gaze an additional time before requiring a short rest for each additional feat you have taken with the prerequisite kraidyl.

Universalist.name: Universalist
Universalist.description:
Increase your Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You have advantage on Intelligence (Arcana) checks to recall lore about spells.
When you prepare the list of wizard spells that are available for you to cast each day, you may prepare 4 additional spells, each from different schools. The spells must be of a level for which you have spell slots.

Weapon Expert.name: Weapon Expert
Weapon Expert.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Weapon Specialization.name: Weapon Specialization
Weapon Specialization.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Extra Secondary Archetype Feature.name: Extra Secondary Archetype Feature
Extra Secondary Archetype Feature.description: Legendary Adventures © 2020 Mike Myler, published under license by Legendary Games.

Smooth Grappler.name: Smooth Grappler
Smooth Grappler.description:
You can make a Dexterity (Athletics) check instead of a Strength (Athletics) check when grappling or shoving a creature (see Grappling and Shoving a Creature).
Once per turn, when you make a successful unarmed strike, you can immediately use your reaction to attempt to grapple or shove the target of your attack.

Mirror Eyes.name: Mirror Eyes
Mirror Eyes.description:
Benefit(s): As areaction, the elfling can spend two Hit Dice to reflectsleep, charm, orfear-based spells back upon the opponent caster. The elfling must be able to see the opponent, and the opponent must be able to see the elfling for this ability to function correctly. The range, saves, and other spell attributes are assumed to originate from the targeted elfling for the purposes of resolving the spell’s effects. For example, if a spell is cast on the elfling fromcover, then the reflected spell will take thecoverinto account when applying its effects.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Anesthetist.name: Anesthetist
Anesthetist.description:
When you use a poison that causes unconsciousness, you increase the DC of saving throws made to resist it by 1 for every 2 points of proficiency bonus you possess, and if the unconsciousness caused by that poison has a variable duration that duration is always the maximum amount.
When examining a creature rendered unconscious by such a poison, you can make a Wisdom (Medicine) check against the poison’s save DC + 5 to determine how much time remains until the target awakens.
You can also use the Medicine skill to ameliorate pain.
As an action and bonus action, you can infuse or inject a creature with a mixture of pain-deadening compounds. After 1 minute, the target gains advantage on saving throws against fear and poison. This bonus lasts 1 hour.
Alternatively, you can provide a fast-acting sedative that provides the above benefits 1 round after being injected rather than 1 minute; however, the duration of the effect is reduced to 1 minute. If the target is already affected by a pain effect or is already frightened or poisoned, they can instead attempt a new saving throw (without advantage) to suppress the effect as long as the anesthesia lasts.
Once you have used this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier, you require a long rest before it can be used again.

Bits and Pieces.name: Bits and Pieces
Bits and Pieces.description:
Benefit(s): After observing the normal belongings, objects, and thrown-off trash of a place, you are granted a divine insight into the potential locations of treasures and the abilities of those that might provide advantages or be threats to a common thief. As an action, this can be used once per long rest. For each 2 HD spent, the player can choose one item from the following list:

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Lucid Thoughtwalker.name: Lucid Thoughtwalker
Lucid Thoughtwalker.description:
You can cast dream once per day. This dream has a range of personal and a target of you.
You can imbue a sense of reality to objects you create in the Dimension of Dreams. Objects you create through by mundane means (e.g. crafting) in the Dimension of Dreams are physical objects which can be carried between planes by physically present creatures. Objects created by impossible feats are not affected by this feat.

Shared Essence.name: Shared Essence
Shared Essence.description: Your magic and your Summon’s power flow as one, reinforcing each other. When youcast a spellof 1st level or higher, both you and your Summon gaintemporary hit pointsequal to the spell’s level.

Eyes of Ice.name: Eyes of Ice
Eyes of Ice.description:
Your Wisdom score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20. When you are in an area that is partially or heavily obscured by fog, rain, snow, or mist, you can see through the interference normally out to the range of your darkvision.
You can cast the spell misty step (requiring no spell slot or components) a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining expended uses when you complete a short or long rest.

Sorcerous Damnation.name: Sorcerous Damnation
Sorcerous Damnation.description:
Your inherent magical abilities, drawn from a mysterious legacy, are enhanced by the pacts and sacrifices you have made to the darkest of powers.

Every time you gain access to a new spell level (which happens atpaladinlevels 5, 9, 13, and 17), pick one spell that is not on your spell list for that level and add it to yourpaladinspells for that level. Thus, as a level 9paladin, you could choose to addfireball,lightning bolt, or any other third level spell that normally cannot be cast by paladins. In addition to this, when you use your divine smite ability, you may choose to change the additional damage from radiant to necrotic. Unlike normal necrotic damage, opponents who have suffered this necrotic damage cannot recover losthit pointsthrough non-magical means. For every day the affected creature does not receive magical healing, it must make a DC 15Constitutionsave. Creatures failing this save lose 1 point ofConstitution. Creatures that die as a result of thisConstitutionloss transform into aghoul(at the GMs discretion) 1d4 days after their death.

The Dragon’s Hoard #24 © 2022, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Miguel Colon, Alex Riggs, Mike Myler, Robert J. Grady, Michael “solomani” Mifsud, Darrin Drader, Matt Kimmel, Scott D. Young.

Light-Bringer.name: Light-Bringer
Light-Bringer.description:
You may emit light as a hooded or bull’s eye lantern for up to 6 hours before requiring a short rest to recharge. You may suppress or ignite this light at will.
If your last long rest was in the sunlight, the light you emit is treated as sunlight for the purposes of Sunlight (Hyper-)Sensitivity and similar vulnerabilities.
You gain advantage to attack rolls against any enemy that is sensitive to light, blinded by it, or otherwise hampered by exposure to light while emitting your light.

Wild Scent.name: Wild Scent
Wild Scent.description:
If you are blinded, attack rolls you make against creatures within 30 feet of you do not have disadvantage. Other creatures still have advantage on their attack rolls against you while you are blinded.
You gain blindsight out to a range of 10 feet. You can’t detect creatures that don’t emit smells using this ability, such as incorporeal or ethereal creatures. Alternatively, creatures that emit a strong odor may be detected from further away. You can’t use this ability if you lose your sense of smell.
You have advantage on Perception and Survival checks that involve your sense of smell.

Shadowdancer.name: Shadowdancer
Shadowdancer.description: You are one with the shadows, an imperceptible, elusive target that cannot be caught. You gain the following benefits.

Drow Blade Master.name: Drow Blade Master
Drow Blade Master.description: Underworld Races and Classes © 2017 AAW Games LLC; Designers: Thilo Graf and Mike Myler

Acrobatic Steps.name: Acrobatic Steps
Acrobatic Steps.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Absorb Violent Energies.name: Absorb Violent Energies
Absorb Violent Energies.description:
You are a walking, smoldering battery for hyper-lethal doses of flesh-rending, bone-shattering and soul-scorching power; those titanic forces which ripple over you – and through you! – re-charge the god within … even as they tear-apart every cell of your mortal being.

You gainvulnerabilityto cold. This cannot be used in conjunction with any other ability or effect that causes coldvulnerability. In exchange, you gainresistanceto one of the following types of damage: acid, fire, lightning, radiant, and thunder.

Special: You may gain this feat multiple times. Each time this feat is chosen, you may choose a different type of energyresistance. You may not choose the same energy type multiple times.

The Dragon’s Hoard #25 © 2022, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Robert J. Grady, Darrin Drader, James-Levi Cooke.

Toss Enemy.name: Toss Enemy
Toss Enemy.description:
You may pick up and wield smaller enemies as a weapon.

Battlemasters & Berserkers © 2021, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

Mutagenic Summons.name: Mutagenic Summons
Mutagenic Summons.description:
Your magic transforms conjured creatures into hideous abominations. When you cast any conjuration spell that summons creatures from the Material Plane, you may apply the mutant template to the creature(s) you summon. When you use this feat, you summon one fewer creature than normal for the Challenge level you select. If you cast the spell using a slot 1 level higher than normal, you summon the normal number of creatures, each of which have the mutant template. All creatures you summon with a spell have the same mutation.

The Dragon’s Hoard #42© 2024, Legendary Games; Authors Authors Jason Nelson, Michael Mifsud, Matt Kimmel, Dan Dillon, James-Levi Cooke

Disarm Expertise.name: Disarm Expertise
Disarm Expertise.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Twinned Spell.name: Twinned Spell
Twinned Spell.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Great Focus.name: Great Focus
Great Focus.description:
Your training and experience have paid off, giving you mental fortitude others could only wish for.

You may maintain a second martial focus. This martial focus is gained and expended independently from the first.

Giant’s Vigor.name: Giant’s Vigor
Giant’s Vigor.description:
Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
When you make a Strength or Constitution ability check or saving throw, you can roll a d4 and add the result to the total.
You have advantage on saving throws against being knocked prone or pushed against your will.

Sidestep.name: Sidestep
Sidestep.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Duergar Sciencraft.name: Duergar Sciencraft
Duergar Sciencraft.description:
You’ve received training in advanced duergar techniques.

You must use the new result even if it is lower than the previous one. Once you’ve used this feat’s ability, you must finish a short or long rest to use it again.

Agile Swimmer.name: Agile Swimmer
Agile Swimmer.description: The Dragon’s Hoard #37© 2023, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Matt Kimmel, Michael Mifsud, Scott D. Young, Miguel Colon.

Nerve Assault.name: Nerve Assault
Nerve Assault.description:
Whenever you roll a natural 20 on anattackagainst a creature using a melee weapon, the weapon surges with lightning that pumps through their body, frying their nerves.

The target must make aConstitutionsaving throw. On a failure, they areparalyzedfor 1 minute. A creatureparalyzedthis way can reattempt the saving throw at the end of each of their turns, ending the effect on a success.

The DC for theConstitutionsave is equal to 8 + yourConstitutionmodifier + your proficiency bonus.

Vigorous Health.name: Vigorous Health
Vigorous Health.description: Legendary Adventures © 2020 Mike Myler, published under license by Legendary Games.

Bodyguard.name: Bodyguard
Bodyguard.description:
You are adept at warding off enemies attacking nearby allies.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Hell-forged Mettle.name: Hell-forged Mettle
Hell-forged Mettle.description: You find a twisted comfort when suffering the familiar torments of the Iron Hells.

Kraken Slayer.name: Kraken Slayer
Kraken Slayer.description:
Your experience in fighting sea monsters has made you a formidable monster hunter. Increase yourStrengthorDexterityscore by 1, to a maximum of 20. Additionally, you have advantage onattackrolls against Large or bigger creatures with a swimming speed of 40 feet or higher.

Pirates and Plunder A Compendium For 5e © 2024 Published by Mythos Chronicles; Author Filippo Bardoscia

Improvised Weapon Mastery.name: Improvised Weapon Mastery
Improvised Weapon Mastery.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Catch Off-Guard.name: Catch Off-Guard
Catch Off-Guard.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Sea Sight.name: Sea Sight
Sea Sight.description: Pirate Campaign Compendium© 2018, Legendary Games; Lead Designer Jason Nelson. Authors: Alex Augunas, Jeff Gomez, Matt Goodall, Jim Groves, Tim Hitchcock, Victoria Jaczko, Jonathan H. Keith, Lyz Liddell, Thomas J. Phillips, Alistair J. Rigg, Alex Riggs, Loren Sieg, Neil Spicer, Todd Stewart, Rachel Ventura, Michael D. Welham, Linda Zayas-Palmer.

Juggernaut.name: Juggernaut
Juggernaut.description: Creed's Codex: Arcane Secrets of the Summoners © 2022 Brendan Jonesrebandt Consulting LLC DBA Knight Vision Creative, Author Brendan Jonesrebandt

Summoner’s Strength.name: Summoner’s Strength
Summoner’s Strength.description: You are gifted and share a special rapport with creatures you magically summon. When youcast a spellsuch asfind familiar,conjure woodland beings, orconjure minor elemental, you may add a bonus equal to your proficiency bonus to either the attacks or Armor Class of the creatures you summon. You must choose which of these you wish to apply the bonus to at the time you cast the spell and may not change it later. This bonus applies to all creatures summoned with the same casting of the spell. If you choose to apply the bonus to attacks, the bonus applies to all melee andranged attackrolls made by the creatures but does not apply to damage dealt by those attacks.

Umbral Reflexes.name: Umbral Reflexes
Umbral Reflexes.description: Additionally, when a creature you can see misses you with anattackwhile you are in dim light or darkness, you can use yourreactionto move up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.

Deadly Maw.name: Deadly Maw
Deadly Maw.description:
Increase the base damage die size of your bite attack by one step. (1d6 -> 1d8 -> 2d6 -> 3d6)
Once per turn when you roll damage for a melee weapon attack with your bite, you can reroll the bite’s damage dice and use either total.

Fairy Blessing.name: Fairy Blessing
Fairy Blessing.description:
Increase your Wisdom or Charisma by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Creatures with the fey type regard you as equivalent in social status to a fey yourself. Thus, you may enter places only fey may go, request audiences of fey nobility, and so forth. This may not extend to creatures that are enemies of your fey ally, depending on the foe’s sense of honor.
Your proficiency bonus, if any, is doubled when making Charisma checks against fey creatures.
You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened by a spell or magical ability.

Call of Community.name: Call of Community
Call of Community.description: from the options given. This feature resets after a long rest.

Flanking Confounder.name: Flanking Confounder
Flanking Confounder.description:
Benefit(s): Whenever you become adjacent to 2 or more creatures, immediately choose one. That creature has disadvantage on all melee weapon attacks against you. You can change your choice of creature as a bonus action. YourWisdomscore increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Point Blank Shot.name: Point Blank Shot
Point Blank Shot.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Quickling Ancestry.name: Quickling Ancestry
Quickling Ancestry.description:
Benefit(s): You gain a +2 bonus toinitiativerolls. Your movement increases to 50 feet. You can take theDashaction as a bonus action onyour turn.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Second Manifestation.name: Second Manifestation
Second Manifestation.description:
Benefit(s): You are able to take a second Bloodline Manifestation. As with your original racial ability, this must be taken from either Common Abilities or the Unique Ability appropriate for your heritage.

Normal: Dragon descendants only receive one Bloodline Manifestation.

Endurance.name: Endurance
Endurance.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Extra Ki.name: Extra Ki
Extra Ki.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Grabbing Jaws.name: Grabbing Jaws
Grabbing Jaws.description: By spending one of your Hit Dice from your pool as part of a successful melee weapon attack with your bite, you gain the Path of the Primordial Predator’s Savage Grab feature for this grapple.

War Child.name: War Child
War Child.description:
When engaged in combat you can use your bonus action to become infused with the pure essence of war, inherited though your divine ancestry. While this effect is active, you gain the following benefits.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Aerial Warrior.name: Aerial Warrior
Aerial Warrior.description:
You can now take to the skies in medium and heavy armor. If wearing medium armor would normally restrict your ability to use your flying speed, you can now fly up to 30 feet if your speed would otherwise allow it. Likewise, in heavy armor you can now use up to 25 feet of your flying speed.

Through your training, your instincts in the air are unmatched. You can reroll a failedDexteritysave made while you are airborne and use result of the new roll. Once you use this feature to do so, you must finish a short or long rest before you can do so again.

Galder’s Gazetteer Author(s) Matt Click, Gabe Hicks, Jess Ross

Stalker.name: Stalker
Stalker.description:
You gain proficiency in the Stealth and Survival skills.
You have advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks made to track a creature you have seen in the past 24 hours.

Four-Armed Fighting.name: Four-Armed Fighting
Four-Armed Fighting.description:
When you use your reaction to make an opportunity attack that misses, you regain your reaction at the end of the turn. You can only use this reaction to make an opportunity attack with a weapon other than the one you made an opportunity attack with since the end of your last turn.
You can use two-weapon fighting to attack with any weapon you wield in one or two hands after using the Attack action to attack with any weapon you wield in one or two hands.
When you use two-weapon fighting with light melee weapons, you can make a third attack and a fourth attack with light melee weapons you wield in two other hands. You don’t add your ability modifier to the damage with either attack (even if you chose the Two-Weapon Fighting option for your Fighting Style feature).

Blind-Fight.name: Blind-Fight
Blind-Fight.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Dark Blessing.name: Dark Blessing
Dark Blessing.description: When you reduce a creature to0 hit points, you gain a number oftemporary hit pointsequal to yourCharismamodifier + your proficiency bonus.

Wind Magic.name: Wind Magic
Wind Magic.description:
Upon taking this feat you learn two cantrips, druidcraft andresistance. However, theresistancecantrip is only applicable against lightning damage. You also learn one 1st level spell of your choice from the following list:fog cloud,jump, orspeak with animals(birds only). Once made, this choice cannot be changed. You cast this spell as a 1st level sorceress, using a 1st level spell slot.Charismais your spellcasting ability. After casting this spell, you must complete a long rest before you can cast it again.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Heaven’s Chosen.name: Heaven’s Chosen
Heaven’s Chosen.description:
You have drawn the attention of a benevolent celestial spirit that protects you from harm. When you fail a saving throw, you can choose to roll a new saving throw with a single d20 regardless of any circumstances that would otherwise impose advantage or disadvantage.

You can’t use this feat again until you finish along rest.

Deep Magic: Elemental Magic © 2017 Open Design; Author: Dan Dillon.

Blessing of the Jiaolung.name: Blessing of the Jiaolung
Blessing of the Jiaolung.description:
Increase your Strength of Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You have advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks to swim.
In calm waters, you always succeed at Strength (Athletics) checks to swim if the DC is 10 or lower.
For purposes of determining how long you can hold your breath underwater, treat your Constitution score as 30.

Fiend Hunter.name: Fiend Hunter
Fiend Hunter.description:
You are trained in the art of slaying fiends, either by a grizzled mentor or by harsh circumstance. You gain the following benefits.

Sandy Petersen’s Planet Apocalypse, © 2021, Petersen Games.

Boundless Might.name: Boundless Might
Boundless Might.description:
You add double your proficiency bonus to any ability check made using theAthleticsskill. In addition, you can now grapple a creature up to four sizes larger than you, and you move at full speed when you drag agrappledcreature.

Galder’s Gazetteer Author(s) Matt Click, Gabe Hicks, Jess Ross

Thrallborn.name: Thrallborn
Thrallborn.description:
You and your ancestors were enslaved by horrific invaders from the lowest pits of the outer planes and forced into servitude, yet you endured it all despite their attempts to work you to death.

You gain advantage on checks for any oneIntelligence(Nature), (Religion),Wisdom(Animal Handling), (Medicine), or (Survival) check. In addition, you gain advantage on saving throws against effects that would cause you to take on one or more levels of theexhaustioncondition.

However, you have disadvantage on saving throws against mind-affecting effects used by fiends.

You must select this feat as a 1st-level character.

The Dragon’s Hoard #26© 2022, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Robert J. Grady, Darrin Drader, James-Levi Cooke.

Healing Hands.name: Healing Hands
Healing Hands.description:
When you gain this feat you gain the following abilities.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Magic Catalyst.name: Magic Catalyst
Magic Catalyst.description: Whenever you take damage from a spell, you can recover a spell slot of a level equal to or below one tenth of the effective damage taken (rounded down). If you have no spell slot to recover, you gain no benefit.

Hearthfinder.name: Hearthfinder
Hearthfinder.description:
Increase your Constitution or Charisma ability score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You may claim advantage on Charisma (Persuasion) and Charisma (Intimidation) checks when used toward finding food, shelter, or medicine for you or your companions.

Counterstriker.name: Counterstriker
Counterstriker.description:
You can use this feature twice and can’t do so again until you finish a short or long rest.

Galder’s Gazetteer Author(s) Matt Click, Gabe Hicks, Jess Ross

Pegasus Wings.name: Pegasus Wings
Pegasus Wings.description:
Two pairs of sizable wings emerge from your back, like those of a flighted celestial horse. Though they constrain your movements, you are able to traverse through the air with implacable grace.

Book of Exalted Darkness. © 2018 Mike Myler, published under license by Legendary Games.

Dragon Slayer.name: Dragon Slayer
Dragon Slayer.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Night Hunter.name: Night Hunter
Night Hunter.description:
Your darkvision range increases to 120 feet.
You gain advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight while in dim light or darkness.

Cosmic Avatar.name: Cosmic Avatar
Cosmic Avatar.description:
You are an avatar of the gods of inconceivable alien knowledge.

You can share that knowledge with others, whether they are equipped to handle it or not. This grants the following abilities:

You must finish a short rest before you may use this ability again. After using it a second time in one day, you must finish a long rest before you may use it again.

Clerics & Cultists© 2021, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader, Nicholas Hite, Sean K Reynolds, Jason Nelson, Jenny Jarzabski, Miguel Colon, Michael “solomani” Mifsud, Matt Daley, Nathan Reinecke.

Apocalyptic Mutation: Scales.name: Apocalyptic Mutation: Scales
Apocalyptic Mutation: Scales.description:
Whether by contact with fiendish blood or being warped by the blasted landscape, your skin dries, cracks, and becomes scaly. You gain the following benefits.

Sandy Petersen’s Planet Apocalypse, © 2021, Petersen Games.

Malformed Basal Ganglia.name: Malformed Basal Ganglia
Malformed Basal Ganglia.description:
An unholy tumor has formed in the intuitive part of your brain and expanded your mind, drawing you to the attention of dark things from the beyond that touched you with a supernatural gift.

Book of Exalted Darkness. © 2018 Mike Myler, published under license by Legendary Games.

Infernal Familiar (General).name: Infernal Familiar (General)
Infernal Familiar (General).description: NoteInfernal feats are first gained by taking the Infernal Pact feat. This feat ties a character to a Circle’s particular lord. If the character is not from that Circle, the Circle is considered his “home” Circle from that point on. The feats available to a character are determined by his home Circle—a character cannot take infernal feats that are not listed as tied to a Circle.

Sealed Brand.name: Sealed Brand
Sealed Brand.description:
You do not suffer the backlashes associated with your brand as long as it remains sealed, but you cannot activate and do not receive the benefits of your boons. You may release your sealed brand as a move action. Resealing your brand takes one minute.
When you use the ability of any of your brands, you may automatically conceal any manifestations of activating the boon without having to use a reaction. You still must succeed at a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check, but may take advantage when you do so.
You leave your brand disguise or partially sealed enough that disadvantage is not imposed to Charisma checks involving characters opposed to your patron.

Cerebrogenerate.name: Cerebrogenerate
Cerebrogenerate.description:
Benefit(s): As an action, the half-brain gorger can make amelee attackwith their tentacles. If successful, they deal its normal damage and drain one Hit Die from the target. Using the target’s hit die, recoverhit pointsequal to the rolled amount (disregarding theirConstitutionmodifier). This may be performed on any creature with remaining hit dice or on any creature that has not been dead for longer than 1 hour. Assume dead or defeated creatures have 1 remaining hit die.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Slug Knight.name: Slug Knight
Slug Knight.description:
When mounted on a svirf riding slug (or any other kind of slug), your mount gains a +15 ft. bonus to all movement speeds.
Slugs and snails never willingly attack you or your allies and when forced to do so, do so at disadvantage and take your proficiency bonus as a penalty to their attack roll.
Slugs and snails can communicate, miraculously, even complex concepts beyond their Intelligence to you via eyestalk gestures and, in some breeds, meowing. They are treated as though they had Intelligence 10 and shared a common language with you. Slugs and snails will go out of their way to help you and “ask” you for help.

Herculean Intimidation.name: Herculean Intimidation
Herculean Intimidation.description:
Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency in the Intimidation skill. If you are already proficient in it, you double your proficiency bonus for Intimidation checks.
When you make an Intimidation check, you can choose to apply your Strength modifier instead of your Charisma, provided the creature you are trying to intimidate is no more than one size larger than you.

Lesser Hive Mind.name: Lesser Hive Mind
Lesser Hive Mind.description:
Casting Time: 1 action

Components: V, S, M (piece of hoyrall antennae)

Duration: Concentration, up to 10 minutes

You choose up to 3 creatures in range. The subjects become linked with a primitive form of telepathy allowing them to have a dialogue in mutually shared languages, so long as they remain within close range of one another.

Should they venture out of this area, there’s a 50% chance that they cannot understand or be understood through hive mind within double the spell’s range and beyond that, are no longer under its effects. Should they reenter the spell’s area during the duration, its effects immediately reinstate themselves for the duration of the spell.

Underworld Races and Classes © 2017 AAW Games LLC; Designers: Thilo Graf and Mike Myler

Celestial Charter.name: Celestial Charter
Celestial Charter.description: Pirates and Plunder A Compendium For 5e © 2024 Published by Mythos Chronicles; Author Filippo Bardoscia

Freeze.name: Freeze
Freeze.description:
While you remain motionless, you are indistinguishable from a statue. Even close examination does not give you away, though attacking you obviously causes pain and may cause you to give your true nature away.
You gain proficiency in Dexterity (Stealth) checks. When you try to hide in a subterranean environment or against a backdrop of unworked rock, your ossified bones blend right in, granting you advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.

Frostwalker’s Grace.name: Frostwalker’s Grace
Frostwalker’s Grace.description:
Increase yourDexterityscore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You can move acrossdifficult terrainmade of ice or snow without expending extra movement, ignoringdifficult terrainon it. When you move, the ground where you have walked freezes and becomesdifficult terrainuntil the start of your next turn.

Lingering Summons.name: Lingering Summons
Lingering Summons.description: Your summoned creatures linger even after their time runs out. When a summoned creature you control would disappear at the end of a spell’s duration, it instead remains for an additional number of rounds equal to your proficiency bonus before vanishing.

Legendary Accuracy.name: Legendary Accuracy
Legendary Accuracy.description: Legendary Adventures © 2020 Mike Myler, published under license by Legendary Games.

Avatar of Agony.name: Avatar of Agony
Avatar of Agony.description:
You are the flensing blade wielded by the gods of torment.

Their exquisite blessing flows through you into others.

As an action you may cut your own flesh, dealing 1d4 damage to yourself. Choose a creature within 60 feet that you can see, and a body part that creature possesses. For as long as you concentrate, up to 1 minute, that creature suffers the associated effect.

You must finish a short rest before you may use this ability again. After using it a second time in one day, you must finish a long rest before you may use it again.

Clerics & Cultists© 2021, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader, Nicholas Hite, Sean K Reynolds, Jason Nelson, Jenny Jarzabski, Miguel Colon, Michael “solomani” Mifsud, Matt Daley, Nathan Reinecke.

Rage Mage.name: Rage Mage
Rage Mage.description:
Increase your spellcasting ability by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You can cast and concentrate on spells while raging.

Tomb Monolith.name: Tomb Monolith
Tomb Monolith.description:
In addition, your elemental’s current and maximumhit pointsincrease by 5 whenever it scores a critical hit or reduces a creature to 0 hit points. When it reduces a creature to 0 hit points, that creature gains Disadvantage on its next death save.

If a target fails a saving throw against beingRestrainedby your conjured elemental spirit, they also must make this saving throw or have their maximum hit points reduced as above.

Ancient Tombs (5E) © 2025, Legendary Games; Authors Alex Riggs, Anthony Adam, Jason Nelson, Loren Sieg, and Robert J. Grady

Warped Mind.name: Warped Mind
Warped Mind.description:
Your distended thoughts and malformed intellect protect you from psychic damage. You have advantage on saving throws against psychic damage, and you haveresistanceagainst psychic damage.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Tengu Wings.name: Tengu Wings
Tengu Wings.description:
Benefit(s): Once per day, you can sprout a pair of giant black crow’s wings, granting you a fly speed of 30 feet for 1 minute per level.

The Dragon’s Hoard #33© 2023, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Miguel Colon, Scott D. Young, Matt Kimmel, Jeff Lee, James Abendroth.

Athletic.name: Athletic
Athletic.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Savant.name: Savant
Savant.description:
Increase your Intelligence or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency with calligrapher’s supplies or jeweler’s tools.
When you use a crystal as an arcane focus, you add your spellcasting ability modifier to the damage you deal with any cantrip.
You learn a unique script, related to the Primordial alphabet, which allows you to write information, whether mundane or magical, in a very concise format. Text written using this script takes up only one-fifth of the space it would normally require. It can be read only by creatures able to read this script.

Wild Vigor.name: Wild Vigor
Wild Vigor.description:
Increase your Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
When you roll a 1 or 2 on a Hit Die, you can reroll it, but you must use the new roll, even if it’s a 1 or 2.
When you make a saving throw against poison, you can spend one of your Hit Dice, roll it, and add the result to your saving throw as a bonus. You can’t spend more than 1 Hit Die in this way during the same turn, and a Hit Dice spent in this way doesn’t restore hit points.

Sunder Expertise.name: Sunder Expertise
Sunder Expertise.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Expel Spirits.name: Expel Spirits
Expel Spirits.description:
When Turn Undead or thedispel evil and goodspell are unavailable or inadequate, other measures may be required to end a possession. To do so, a character must make a series of checks with a DC determined by how tenacious the possession is.

The character makes three checks:Intelligence(Religion),Wisdom(Religion), and a specialCharismacheck that has a bonus equal to a roll of the character’s largest Hit Die (this roll doesn’t spend that die). The DC for each of the checks is determined by the possessing creature’s CR + 1d6 + 10. Generate a separate DC for each one. If the character succeeds on two or more checks, the possession ends, and any spirit present is driven out and away as if by a cleric’s Turn Undead. If the character fails on two or more, the possession becomes entrenched, and any further attempts to expel the possessing spirit automatically fail for the next 24 hours. Allies can use theHelpaction to assist, but they may have to contend with any complications. Intimate knowledge of the possessing spirit ordemon, such as a true name or hidden secret, could potentially provide advantage on one of the checks.

Complications. Possessions are challenging under the best of circumstances. A creature that doesn’t want to give up its host will most likely retaliate against those performing the ritual as well as anyone else present. After each check is made, roll a d6 and consult the Possession Complications table to see what complications characters might have to deal with. If a complication calls for a saving throw or skill check, the DC is the same as the previous check.

Warlock Grimoire 4. ©2023 Open Design LLC. Authors: Lou Anders, Wolfgang Baur, HH Carlan, Robert Fairbanks, Basheer Ghouse, Richard Green, Tim Hitchcock, Jeremy Hochhalter, Victoria Jaczko, Rajan Khanna, Sarah Madsen, Ben McFarland, Jonathan Miley, Kelly Pawlik, Sebastian Rombach, Adam W. Roy, Paul Scofield, Amber Stewart, Brian Suskind, Mike Welham.

Unholy Blessing.name: Unholy Blessing
Unholy Blessing.description: NoteInfernal feats are first gained by taking the Infernal Pact feat. This feat ties a character to a Circle’s particular lord. If the character is not from that Circle, the Circle is considered his “home” Circle from that point on. The feats available to a character are determined by his home Circle—a character cannot take infernal feats that are not listed as tied to a Circle.

Heavy Armor Proficiency.name: Heavy Armor Proficiency
Heavy Armor Proficiency.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Cutting Blow.name: Cutting Blow
Cutting Blow.description:
Your Strength or Dexterity increases by +1, to a maximum of 20.
On a critical hit when using a slashing weapon, you add an extra die of damage. The die type is the same as that of the weapon used. This Cutting Blow damage die is in addition to the critical hit, and not doubled. The target continues to take the Cutting Blow die in damage each round at the start of their turn until they receive magical healing or receive treatment via a successful DC 10 Wisdom (Medicine) check. The DC of this check is increased by 1 for every 10 points of damage dealt in the initial strike.

Survivor’s Tenacity.name: Survivor’s Tenacity
Survivor’s Tenacity.description:
Benefit(s): Increase yourConstitutionscore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You have advantage onConstitutionsaving throws againstexhaustion, and you can go twice as long before needing food, water, or sleep.

Light Prison.name: Light Prison
Light Prison.description:
Casting Time: 1 action

DurationConcentration, up to 1 minute

Rays of light burst forth from your outstretched hand, encircling a target’s space with a cage of light. The target must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed saving throw, it becomes enclosed in the light prison. A creature enclosed in a light prison can attack, cast spells, and otherwise act normally as long as it stays within the light prison. However, if a creature passes through the walls of a light prison enclosing it, it takes 1d8 radiant damage and is blinded until the end of its next turn. Once a creature passes through the walls of a light prison surrounding it, the effect ends for that creature.

At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, you can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd. The creatures must be within 30 feet of each other when you target them.

Forest Kingdom Campaign Compendium 5e© 2017, Legendary Games; Lead Designer Jason Nelson. Authors: Clinton J. Boomer, Benjamin Bruck, Matt Goodall, Tim Hitchcock, N. Jolly, Julian Neale, Jason Nelson, Thomas J. Phillips, Alistair J. Rigg, David N. Ross, Neil Spicer, Todd Stewart, Russ Taylor, Michael D. Welham, Linda Zayas-Palmer.

Ruined Mind.name: Ruined Mind
Ruined Mind.description:
Benefit(s): Increase yourIntelligence,Wisdom, orCharismascore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You have advantage on saving throws against beingcharmedorfrightened.

Inherited Madness.name: Inherited Madness
Inherited Madness.description:
You gain an insanity of the GM’s choice (see Madness). Your GM should work with you to ensure its nature makes the game more fun for you and the group, and it should generally fall into the category of a first-degree insanity.

As long as you have this insanity, you have advantage onConstitutionsaving throws to concentrate on spells and on allWisdomsaving throws. If your insanity is cured, you may either gain a different insanity or choose a new feat in place of this one.

Anyone usingdetect thoughtsor other magic to hear your thoughts must make aWisdomsave (DC 8 + your proficiency bonus + yourCharismamodifier) or suffer from a randomly determined short term madness.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Firearms Expert.name: Firearms Expert
Firearms Expert.description:
.
You are proficient with all firearms.
Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesnât impose disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls made with a firearm.
When you use the Attack action and attack with a one-handed weapon, you can use a bonus action to make a ranged attack with a loaded firearm you are holding.
You can use this feat for any firearms you are carrying that are loaded.

Bound by Magic.name: Bound by Magic
Bound by Magic.description:
The first time a creature summoned by you would take damage in combat, it instead takes no damage.
If a creature summoned by you would be banished or dispelled, roll a d6; on a 1 or 2, the creature is banished or dispelled as normal. On a result of 3 or higher, the spell or effect that would banish or dispel the creature simply fails.
Once per long rest, when you cast a spell that creates, summons, or conjures a single creature, you can choose to double its duration.

Veil of Despair.name: Veil of Despair
Veil of Despair.description:
When a creature within 10 feet of you regains hit points, it only regains half as many hit points as normal. You can choose any number of creatures to be immune to this effect.
When a creature within 10 feet of you fails an ability check or saving throw, it takes psychic damage equal to your proficiency bonus. You can choose any number of creatures to be immune to this effect.
When a creature you can see within 10 feet of you makes an ability check, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the roll.

Elemental Affinity.name: Elemental Affinity
Elemental Affinity.description:
Benefit(s): You have immunity to the damage type for which your subrace hasresistance. You add 1d6 damage of the damage type to allmelee attacksfor which you gain immunity. As areaction, when a creature within 30 feet of you is targeted with magic that deals a damage type

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Soul Power.name: Soul Power
Soul Power.description:
With this feat, you can withstand the powers of necromancy.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Parry Spell.name: Parry Spell
Parry Spell.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Maddening Tongue.name: Maddening Tongue
Maddening Tongue.description:
You can infuse your spoken spellcasting with maddening power siphoned from The Pit. When youcast a spellof 1st level or higher with verbal components, you can force each creature that can hear you within 30 feet of you (excluding yourself) to make aWisdomsaving throw against your spell save DC. You can choose a number of creatures up to your spellcasting ability modifier that you can see to make the saving throw with advantage. Each creature that fails the saving throw takes psychic damage equal to the spell’s level.

A creature that suffers psychic damage in this way must also roll 1d12 at the start of its next turn to determine how madness grips the creature.

False Opening.name: False Opening
False Opening.description:
When you make aranged attackwhile threatened, you can fool your opponent into thinking he has an opening.

Battlemasters & Berserkers © 2021, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

Boundless Reserves.name: Boundless Reserves
Boundless Reserves.description:
Increase your Wisdom score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
When you start your turn and have no ki points remaining, you can use a reaction to spend one Hit Die. Roll the die and add your Constitution modifier to it. You regain expended ki points equal to up to half the total (minimum of 1). You can never have more ki points than the maximum for your level. Hit Dice spent using this feat can’t be used to regain hit points during a short rest.

Wrangler.name: Wrangler
Wrangler.description:
Benefit(s): Gain proficiency in the whip. You may also use any rope as a whip at no penalty. You may throw a lasso (tied from any rope or chain) as aranged attackagainst a foe from up to 20 feet away. Thisattackdoes no damage, but if successful then as a bonus action the wrangler may tighten the lasso. Treat this as a grappling attempt, with the wrangler gaining Advantage due to their lasso. If the target fails, they gain thegrappledcondition as normal, but they may move toward the wrangler if they so choose. Alternatively, the wrangler may choose to use the Shove action toknockthe creature over, using the lasso to pull their legs out from under them. This ability may also be used to pull a creature closer with the Shove action; you cannot push a creature away from you using a lasso. If a creature has been successfully shoved with the lasso, they also gain thegrappledcondition. Breaking the lasso ends the effect.

Guilds of Sundara © 2022, eGDC Ltd; Author: Neal Litherland

Apocalyptic Survivor.name: Apocalyptic Survivor
Apocalyptic Survivor.prerequisite: Wisdom 13, native to a wounded land or bordering ter
Apocalyptic Survivor.description:
You are the near-feral survivor of a corrupted apocalypse, staying hidden in the shadows of a wounded land or escaping into the questionable safety of the borderlands beyond.

You gain advantage on saving throws against disease and poison, and you have natural immunity to tainted plagues in your native wounded land. You can contract such diseases and even infect others, though you never manifest symptoms yourself. You are considered proficient with all improvised weapons, which deal 1d6 damage instead of 1d4.

You also gain a +1 bonus onDexterity(Stealth) andWisdom(Survival) checks; this bonus is increased to +2 against fiends, and to +4 against fiends within your native lands.

The Dragon’s Hoard #26© 2022, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Robert J. Grady, Darrin Drader, James-Levi Cooke.

Spell Resistance.name: Spell Resistance
Spell Resistance.description: Your mastery of magical resilience grants you advantage on saving throws against spells.

Corsair.name: Corsair
Corsair.description: Pirate Campaign Compendium© 2018, Legendary Games; Lead Designer Jason Nelson. Authors: Alex Augunas, Jeff Gomez, Matt Goodall, Jim Groves, Tim Hitchcock, Victoria Jaczko, Jonathan H. Keith, Lyz Liddell, Thomas J. Phillips, Alistair J. Rigg, Alex Riggs, Loren Sieg, Neil Spicer, Todd Stewart, Rachel Ventura, Michael D. Welham, Linda Zayas-Palmer.

Seize the Moment.name: Seize the Moment
Seize the Moment.description:
You and your allies are poised to pounce whenever one of you scores a telling blow.

Battlemasters & Berserkers © 2021, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

Alien Wisdom.name: Alien Wisdom
Alien Wisdom.description:
Increase your Wisdom score by 2, to a maximum of 20.
You gain resistance to radiant damage.

Poisonous Bite.name: Poisonous Bite
Poisonous Bite.description: Your bite carries a potent venom. When you hit a creature with your bite attack, the target takes an additional 1d6poisondamage. Additionally, you have resistance topoisondamage and advantage on saving throw against being poisoned.

Elemental Harmony.name: Elemental Harmony
Elemental Harmony.description:
Increase yourConstitution,Intelligence,Wisdom, orCharismascore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You can cast the elemental ward spell at will without expending a spell slot. Your spellcasting modifier for this spell is the ability score you increased with this feature.

Void Walker.name: Void Walker
Void Walker.description:
Increase your Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) ability checks made to hide while in dim light or darkness.
You learn the void step cantrip. When you use it, you can immediately take the Hide action as a bonus action during the same turn, provided you are in dim light or darkness.

Buried Secrets.name: Buried Secrets
Buried Secrets.description:
Ability Score Increase. Increase your Wisdom or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Take it to the Grave. You have Advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks to avoid telling a secret that you were given, and on saves against spells and effects that would cause you to divulge such a secret.

Bite Fighter.name: Bite Fighter
Bite Fighter.description:
with this feat:
Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
The damage of your bite attack increases by one die size (i.e., d6 increases to d8, d4 to d6, d3 to d4, etc.).
When you make a bite attack against a creature you have grappled or that is otherwise restrained, you have advantage on the attack roll.
If you hit an opponent within 5 feet of you with a melee weapon attack as part of an Attack action, you can use your bonus action to attack the same target with your bite.

Pernicious Poisoner.name: Pernicious Poisoner
Pernicious Poisoner.description:
You gain proficiency with poisoner’s kits, and may treat alchemist’s supplies as a poisoner’s kit.You craft poisons twice as quickly as normal, doubling all daily progress made while crafting.You may create concentrated poisons by mixing two doses of the same poison together, imposing disadvantage on all saving throws to resist the poison.You always have advantage on saving throws against poison effects.Section 15: Copyright NoticeEN World EN5ider Presents: A Touch of Class. Copyright 2017 EN Publishing.
