Twinned Spell (Meta Magic).name: Twinned Spell (Meta Magic)
Twinned Spell (Meta Magic).description:
Druids of the Arcane Circle have exclusive access to metamagic feats. Rather than taking the Ability Score Improvement feature at 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th and 19th level, they can choose this feat.

When youcast a spellthat targets only one creature and doesn’t have a range of self, you can spend a number of sorcery points equal to the spell’s level to target a second creature in range with the same spell (1 sorcery point if the spell is a cantrip).

To be eligible, a spell must be incapable of targeting more than one creature at the spell’s current level. For example,magic missileandscorching rayaren’t eligible, butray of frostand chromatic orb are.

Endless Arsenal.name: Endless Arsenal
Endless Arsenal.description:
You can use your wondrous arsenal racial trait to conjure weapons an extra number of times per day equal to one-half your character level.
You can use your wondrous arsenal racial trait to conjure ranged weapons. Reloading a weapon takes the same action as normal, but you conjure regular ammunition for the weapon as needed to reload. Your conjured weapons are no longer dismissed if you are not holding them.

Master of Fate.name: Master of Fate
Master of Fate.description: An immense respect for their past has helped them to also understand their future, and so duergar have a particularly sophisticated knowledge ofdivination.

Clandestine Avatar.name: Clandestine Avatar
Clandestine Avatar.description:
You are a vessel for a god of terrible secrets, only those you wish to know of your existence may do so. This grants the following abilities:

You must finish a short rest before you may use this ability again. After using it a second time in one day, you must finish a long rest before you may use it again.

Clerics & Cultists© 2021, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader, Nicholas Hite, Sean K Reynolds, Jason Nelson, Jenny Jarzabski, Miguel Colon, Michael “solomani” Mifsud, Matt Daley, Nathan Reinecke.

Stormwalker.name: Stormwalker
Stormwalker.description:
Increase yourDexterityorConstitutionscore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gain advantage on saving throws against spells and effects that deal lightning or thunder damage, and you ignoredifficult terraincreated by ice, snow, or storms. Additionally, once per short rest, when you are targeted by amelee attack, you can use yourreactionto impose disadvantage on theattackroll.

Combat Training.name: Combat Training
Combat Training.description: You gain two bonus martial talents of your choice. You can select this feat multiple times.

Prescience.name: Prescience
Prescience.description:
You have a sharp, quick mind. You gain the following benefits.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Forgemaster’s Insight.name: Forgemaster’s Insight
Forgemaster’s Insight.description:
Increase yourConstitution,Intelligence, orWisdomscore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gain proficiency with Smith’s tools. If you’re already proficient, you double your proficiency bonus for checks made with these tools. Additionally, once per long rest, you can dedicate 1 hour to temporarily enhance a weapon with elemental energy. This grants the weapon a +1 bonus toattackrolls and allows it to deal extra damage of an elemental type (choose from acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder) equal to your proficiency bonus. This enhancement lasts for 24 hours.

New Best Friend.name: New Best Friend
New Best Friend.description:
You gain +1 Intelligence, to a maximum of 20.
You gain advantage on all Intelligence checks made to figure out alien technology.
You may apply half your proficiency bonus to technological tools and weapons (rounding down to a minimum of 1).
You can become proficient in technological tools and equipment in half the normal time.

Crystalline Diplomat.name: Crystalline Diplomat
Crystalline Diplomat.description:
Increase your Charisma score by +1 up to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency in two skills of your choice.
You may use Crystalline Refraction an additional time before requiring a rest to recharge it.

Spider Speaker.name: Spider Speaker
Spider Speaker.description: Underworld Races and Classes © 2017 AAW Games LLC; Designers: Thilo Graf and Mike Myler

Breather.name: Breather
Breather.description:
when you take the Dodge action, in addition to the normal effects:
You can immediately spend any number of Hit Dice and regain hit points in accordance with the short rest rules (see the Adventuring chapter).
You have advantage on all your saving throws (not just Dexterity saving throws) until the start of your next turn.
You have resistance against all damage until the start of your next turn.
You can take the Search action (see the Combat chapter: Actions in Combat) at no cost.

Rune Adept.name: Rune Adept
Rune Adept.description:
Thanks to extensive study with ancient true runes, you have gained extensive to true runic power.

Rune Magic, 5e © 2020, Owen K.C. Stephens; Author: Owen K.C. Stephens. Project manager and Planning: Lj Stephens. Bon Vivant: Stan!

Extra Skills.name: Extra Skills
Extra Skills.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Horned Warrior.name: Horned Warrior
Horned Warrior.description: Stone Mother’s Assault - © 2020, Adrian Arduini; Author: Adrian Arduini

Halo Effect.name: Halo Effect
Halo Effect.description:
Increase Charisma by 1 point to a maximum of 20.
You may grant advantage up to three times per long rest on Charisma (Deception), Charisma (Intimidation), and Charisma (Persuasion) checks made by an ally of your choice if you are within 30 feet of them. The ally does not need to perceive you, but you must be able to perceive them.

Hard-Headed.name: Hard-Headed
Hard-Headed.description:
Benefit(s): You have advantage on saving throws against magic that inflicts thecharmedcondition. If you fail your saving throw, you can attempt a new saving throw at the end of your next turn. If you succeed on your saving throw and are aware of the source creature, you have advantage on yourattackrolls against that creature for 1 minute.

Other creatures have disadvantage onCharisma(Deception), andCharisma(Persuasion) checks against you. YourCharismaorWisdomscore increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Superior Wish.name: Superior Wish
Superior Wish.description:
Benefit(s): You gain the ability to castwishonce per day, though you can only cast it when another creature asks for a wish. When a creature asks you for a wish, you can castwishas areactionin order to grant the wish. The stress of casting this spell to produce any effect other than duplicating another spell still weakens you as per the wish spell, and you still have the 33% chance of never being able to cast wish again if you do this.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Prolific Healer.name: Prolific Healer
Prolific Healer.description: The Bright Wylds’ wild beneficence flows through your healing magic. When youcast a spellof 1st level or higher that requires you to roll dice to determine how many hit points the spell restores, you can reroll any number of the dice and use either result. You can’t do so more than once per turn.

Fey Magic.name: Fey Magic
Fey Magic.description:
Benefit(s): You learn two cantrips and one 1st-level spell of your choice from thedruidclass’s spell list. Once you cast your 1st-level spell, you must finish a long rest before you can cast it again using this feat. Your spellcasting ability for these spells isWisdom.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Poison Master.name: Poison Master
Poison Master.description:
You gain proficiency with the poisoner’s kit.
You add your proficiency bonus to the saving throw DC of poisons you craft.
You can use a poison as a bonus action on your turn.
If a creature would make a saving throw to avoid taking damage from a basic poison that you crafted, the creature automatically fails their saving throw.

Occult Aegis.name: Occult Aegis
Occult Aegis.description:
Increase your Constitution or Intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You learn the mage armor spell, which is always prepared for you without counting against the number of spell you know or can prepare. Once per long rest, you can cast mage armor without expending a spell slot.
When you cast a spell that grants temporary hit points or increases AC, its duration is doubled, provided the spell’s duration is at least 1 minute.

Abyssal Shinobi.name: Abyssal Shinobi
Abyssal Shinobi.description:
You deal violent, gruesome death at the whispered behest of demonic masters with smooth and terrifying precision, moving from shadow to shadow like a stroke of oily-black lightning. In the quiet places haunted by your unseen presence, murder moves in the wind; vanishing once more, hushed terror coils in the wake of your merciless deeds.

Legendary Classes: Templars & Tyrants© 2023, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Darrin Drader, Miguel Colon, Clinton J. Boomer, Amber Scott

Mighty Swings.name: Mighty Swings
Mighty Swings.description: Increase yourStrengthorConstitutionscore by 1, to a maximum of 20. When you score a critical hit with a melee weapon attack, you can choose toknockthe targetproneand push it up to 10 feet away from you.

Standard Bearer.name: Standard Bearer
Standard Bearer.description:
With your standard in hand, you can coordinate or rally your allies as an action. Choose one of the following options:

Galder’s Gazetteer Author(s) Matt Click, Gabe Hicks, Jess Ross

Knife Thrower.name: Knife Thrower
Knife Thrower.description:
when you make a ranged attack using a weapon with the finesse and thrown properties:
As a bonus action, you can make another ranged attack using a weapon with the finesse and thrown properties.
Your attacks ignore half cover and three-quarters cover.
Being within 5 feet of a hostile creature doesn’t impose disadvantage on your ranged attack rolls.

Load Bearing.name: Load Bearing
Load Bearing.description: Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Fate Nudge.name: Fate Nudge
Fate Nudge.description: has no effect. Once you have used this benefit, you cannot use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

Swimmer.name: Swimmer
Swimmer.description:
Benefit(s): Increase youStrength,Dexterity, orConstitutionscore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

You gain a swim speed equal to your walking speed.

You can hold your breath for a number of minutes equal to twice yourConstitutionmodifier (minimum of 1).

Greater Transformation.name: Greater Transformation
Greater Transformation.description:
Benefit(s): You gainresistanceto poison and are immune to thepoisonedandpetrifiedconditions.

YourConstitutionscore increases by +1, to a maximum of 20.

Shadows seemingly cling to thegargoyleand move with a semblance of life, wrapping them in a cloak of darkness.

Book of Monstrous Might: Ecology of the Gargoyles© 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Authors: Brian Berg, George “Loki” Williams.

Book of Monstrous Might: Ecology of the Gargoyles © 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Authors: Brian Berg, George "Loki" Williams.

Plunderer.name: Plunderer
Plunderer.description:
Additionally, you gain proficiency in theInvestigationskill, and you have advantage on checks made to determine the value and authenticity of treasure and other items.

Pirates and Plunder A Compendium For 5e © 2024 Published by Mythos Chronicles; Author Filippo Bardoscia

Arcane Strike.name: Arcane Strike
Arcane Strike.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Heavy Armor Expertise.name: Heavy Armor Expertise
Heavy Armor Expertise.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Pirate’s Luck.name: Pirate’s Luck
Pirate’s Luck.description:
Increase yourCharismascore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Additionally, when you make an ability check,attackroll, or saving throw, you can roll a d4 and add the result to your roll. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all expended uses when you finish a long rest.

Pirates and Plunder A Compendium For 5e © 2024 Published by Mythos Chronicles; Author Filippo Bardoscia

Flame-Tested.name: Flame-Tested
Flame-Tested.description:
Benefit(s): You gain advantage on all saves against fire. You no longer have weakness against fire damage. YourConstitutionscore increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Ghastly Vigor.name: Ghastly Vigor
Ghastly Vigor.description:
Increase the score of your spellcasting ability by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Necromantic Surge. Whenever a creature of at least small size that you can see is reduced to 0 hit points within 30 feet of you, you can immediately use your reaction to either cast a cantrip you know or recover a number of hit points equal to triple your proficiency bonus. This does not apply if the creature reduced to 0 hit points is undead or a construct.

Wasteland Warrior.name: Wasteland Warrior
Wasteland Warrior.description:
Benefit(s): Increase yourStrengthorDexterityscore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Once per turn, when you hit a creature with amelee attack, you can deal additional damage equal to your proficiency bonus.

Social Proficiency.name: Social Proficiency
Social Proficiency.description:
You are skilled at personal interaction and navigating relationships. You gain the following benefits.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Devil’s Arm.name: Devil’s Arm
Devil’s Arm.description:
Your Strength and Constitution scores increase by 2. Your maximum for those scores increases by 2.
You are able to conjure flames to use as ranged attacks. By spending a bonus action, you generate as many flames as you have attacks in a round; at the beginning of your next turn, any unused flames dissipate. The range for your hurled flames is 150 feet and on a successful hit, they deal 4d6 fire damage + your Strength modifier. If the target is a flammable object that isn’t being worn or carried, it also catches fire.
You are at disadvantage when making non-Intimidation Charisma ability checks against creatures able to see you.

Extended Spell.name: Extended Spell
Extended Spell.description: Fifth Edition Feats.© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Increased Movement (General).name: Increased Movement (General)
Increased Movement (General).description: NoteInfernal feats are first gained by taking the Infernal Pact feat. This feat ties a character to a Circle’s particular lord. If the character is not from that Circle, the Circle is considered his “home” Circle from that point on. The feats available to a character are determined by his home Circle—a character cannot take infernal feats that are not listed as tied to a Circle.

Savage Assault.name: Savage Assault
Savage Assault.description:
Increase your Strength score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
On your turn, when you score a critical hit with a melee weapon or reduce a creature to 0 hit points, you can make one additional melee attack as part of the same action.

Summoner’s Gift.name: Summoner’s Gift
Summoner’s Gift.description:
Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, up to a maximum of 20.
You learn the lesser summoning spell and can cast it once without expending a spell slot. You also learn one 1st-level spell of your choice from the Summoner spell list. You can cast each of these spells without expending a spell slot. Once you cast either of these spells in this way, you can’t cast that spell in this way again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast these spells using spell slots you have of the appropriate level. The spells’ spellcasting ability is the ability increased by this feat.

Apprentice Cantripothist.name: Apprentice Cantripothist
Apprentice Cantripothist.description:
Increase your Intelligence by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You learn two cantrips of your choice from any spell list. These count as either wizard or sorcerer spells for you, but do not count against your number of cantrips known.
When a cantrip you know would increase in damage, area, number of targets, or in any other way at 5th, 11th, and 17th level increments, you may increase them at 4th, 10th, and 16th level increments instead.

Arcane Heartbeat.name: Arcane Heartbeat
Arcane Heartbeat.description:
Your innate magical abilities become greater, allowing you to weave your desires into reality.

Choose one spell on the Sorcerer spell list with a base level equal to or less than your proficiency bonus. You can cast this spell once per long rest, requiring no components or spell slot, as if it were part of your planar legacy feature. When you gain a level where you would be able to take a new feat or ability score increase, you can switch out your selected Sorcerer spell for another one that qualifies for this feat.

Charging Expertise.name: Charging Expertise
Charging Expertise.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Historyskin.name: Historyskin
Historyskin.description:
Increase your intelligence score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain proficiency with the History skill, as well as calligrapher’s tools.
When you roll the d20 for an ability check that uses the History skill but before the result of the check is determined, you can choose to examine your history-skin. The GM rolls a d4 in secret. On a roll of 1, you gain an incorrect piece of information. On a 2-3, you use the result of your d20 roll. On a 4, you automatically succeed on the check.

Arcane Trickery.name: Arcane Trickery
Arcane Trickery.description:
Increase your Intelligence or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
When you perform a task with mage hand, your Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) checks made to perform that task stealthily are made with advantage.
You learn disguise self and silent image and can cast one of them once without expending a spell slot. You regain the ability to cast one of these spells in this way when you finish a long rest. If you already know either of these spells, then when you cast it without expending a spell slot, you also cast it without verbal components.

Fleet-Footed.name: Fleet-Footed
Fleet-Footed.description:
You are faster than most.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Radiant Endurance.name: Radiant Endurance
Radiant Endurance.description:
Benefit(s): Increase yourStrengthorConstitutionscore by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Immediately after you take radiant or necrotic damage, you can use yourreactionto gaintemporary hit pointsequal to half the damage taken.

Ignore Pain.name: Ignore Pain
Ignore Pain.description: Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Cleaving Finish.name: Cleaving Finish
Cleaving Finish.description:
When you strike down an opponent, you can continue your swing into another target.

Battlemasters & Berserkers © 2021, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

Cornered Fury.name: Cornered Fury
Cornered Fury.description:
Benefit(s): When there are no allies that aren’tincapacitatedorunconsciouswithin 30 feet of your space, you gain advantage on melee weaponattackrolls, and your AC increases by 1.

Book of Monstrous Might(C) 2021 Total Party Kill Games. Author(s): Brian Berg, Mark A. Hart & Danny Grimes.

Moonlight Stalker.name: Moonlight Stalker
Moonlight Stalker.description:
You are adept at using shadows to conceal your attacks.

You leave your opponents swinging at shadows while you slide elusively through the darkness.

Battlemasters & Berserkers © 2021, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

Snicker-Snack.name: Snicker-Snack
Snicker-Snack.description:
While wielding two light weapons, you may make a third attack as part of your bonus action second attack.

Art of Might: Artful Dodgers© 2022, d20fsrd.com Publishing; Author: Ed Kabar

Water Vortex.name: Water Vortex
Water Vortex.description:
These hurákani have the uncanny ability to create vortexes in water, making it impossible for creatures to escape from them.

The Dragon’s Hoard #44© 2024, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Miguel Colon, Darrin Drader, Mark Hart, Dustin Knight, Robert J. Grady, James-Levi Cooke.

Death from Above.name: Death from Above
Death from Above.description: Battlemasters & Berserkers © 2021, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

Spiritually Sustained.name: Spiritually Sustained
Spiritually Sustained.description: * Your Charisma or Constitution score increases by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Fortified Armor Training.name: Fortified Armor Training
Fortified Armor Training.description:
You have learned to let your armor bear the brunt of the worst attacks.

Battlemasters & Berserkers © 2021, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

Flexible Casting (Meta Magic).name: Flexible Casting (Meta Magic)
Flexible Casting (Meta Magic).description:
Druids of the Arcane Circle have exclusive access to metamagic feats. Rather than taking the Ability Score Improvement feature at 4th, 8th, 12th, 16th and 19th level, they can choose this feat.

You can use your sorcery points to gain additional spell slots, or sacrifice spell slots to gain additional sorcery points. You learn other ways to use your sorcery points as you learn more metamagic feats.

Any spell slot you create with this feature vanishes when you finish a long rest.

Converting a Spell Slot to Sorcery Points. As a bonus action onyour turn, you can expend one spell slot and gain a number of sorcery points equal to the slot’s level.

Cartwheel Dodge.name: Cartwheel Dodge
Cartwheel Dodge.description:
You use your knack for avoiding damage to reposition yourself in combat, especially with allies who also have trained to make combat a veritable dance.

Battlemasters & Berserkers © 2021, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

Turn Aberration.name: Turn Aberration
Turn Aberration.description:
Effect(s): You make yourself anathema to aberrations.

As an action, you perform the same ability that you already use to turn creatures, but you instead target aberrations. Each aberration within 30 feet that can see or hear you must make aWisdomsaving throw. If the creature fails its saving throw, it is turned for 1 minute or until it takes any damage.

A turned creature must spend its turns trying to move as far away from you as it can, and it can’t willingly move to a space within 30 feet of you. It also can’t takereactions. For its action, it can use only theDashaction or try to escape from an effect that prevents it from moving. If there’s nowhere to move, the creature can use theDodgeaction.

Warlock Grimoire 4. ©2023 Open Design LLC. Authors: Lou Anders, Wolfgang Baur, HH Carlan, Robert Fairbanks, Basheer Ghouse, Richard Green, Tim Hitchcock, Jeremy Hochhalter, Victoria Jaczko, Rajan Khanna, Sarah Madsen, Ben McFarland, Jonathan Miley, Kelly Pawlik, Sebastian Rombach, Adam W. Roy, Paul Scofield, Amber Stewart, Brian Suskind, Mike Welham.

Dark Power Adept.name: Dark Power Adept
Dark Power Adept.description:
Fear is the path to anger, to hate, to suffering… and to power.

You may freely spend ki points to activate the spell-like abilities listed below:

Your character level is the caster level for these spell-like abilities, and you use aCharismasaving throw when a Concentration check is necessary. All spells may only be cast on yourself, regardless of the spell’s full description.

The saving throw against these special spell-like abilities, if any, is equal to 8 + your proficiency bonus +Charismabonus.

The Dragon’s Hoard #27 © 2023, Legendary Games; Authors Jason Nelson, Michael Mifsud, Robert J. Grady, Darrin Drader, James-Levi Cooke.

Quick Draw.name: Quick Draw
Quick Draw.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Chronal Step.name: Chronal Step
Chronal Step.description: Once per long rest, as a bonus action, you can step briefly into the future. Effectively, you vanish from your current point in time and reappear at the start of your next turn in the same spot or in the nearest unoccupied space if your original location is occupied. During this vanished state, you are immune to all effects, and the battlefield proceeds as if you were not present. Upon reappearing, you gain advantage on your firstattackroll, spellattackroll, ability check, or saving throw you make within the next minute.

Cantrip Master.name: Cantrip Master
Cantrip Master.description: Choose a class:bard,cleric,druid,sorcerer,warlock, orwizard. When you cast a cantrip from that class’s spell list, you can add your spellcasting ability modifier to the damage it deals on a hit. This effect can occur only once per turn.

Deflect Arrows.name: Deflect Arrows
Deflect Arrows.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

Pin Down.name: Pin Down
Pin Down.description:
You easily block enemy escapes.

Battlemasters & Berserkers © 2021, Legendary Games; Author Darrin Drader.

Strength Surge.name: Strength Surge
Strength Surge.description:
You can summon up tremendous strength to empower your attacks. With this feat, the damage of yourmelee attacksincreases by 3 points. This increase to your damage lasts for a number of rounds equal to yourStrengthmodifier (minimum 1 round). Once used, you cannot use this feat again until you complete a short or long rest.

Amazons Vs Valkyries: Bloodline Feats, © 2020, Bloodstone Press; Author: L.J. Ogre

Broken Sword Initiate.name: Broken Sword Initiate
Broken Sword Initiate.description: You studied briefly with the Broken Swords or otherwise share the ideal of the protective, defensive martial artist. However, you took a different path than the Broken Swords themselves, whether through choice or through destiny, and instead use their ideals to guide your own approach to combat.

Unstoppable Force.name: Unstoppable Force
Unstoppable Force.description:
Increase your Strength or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
You gain advantage on saving throws against being grappled, restrained, knocked prone or paralyzed.

Fervent Belief.name: Fervent Belief
Fervent Belief.description: Creed's Codex: Arcane Secrets of the Summoners © 2022 Brendan Jonesrebandt Consulting LLC DBA Knight Vision Creative, Author Brendan Jonesrebandt

Tactile Sense.name: Tactile Sense
Tactile Sense.description:
You gain tremorsense with a range of 15 feet. This allows you to detect and locate the source of vibrations within 15 feet, provided you and the source of the vibrations are in contact with the same surface. Your tremorsense can’t detect flying creatures.
In addition, attackers don’t get advantage on melee attack rolls to hit you just because you can’t see them (including as a result of invisibility).

Cursed Agility.name: Cursed Agility
Cursed Agility.description: The lycanthropic curse flowing through your veins enhances your alertness and your speed. Increase yourDexterityscore by 1, to a maximum of 20. Additionally, when you are in yourrator hybrid form, you add double yourDexteritymodifier (instead of adding it only once) to the attack roll for your bite.

Poison Sense.name: Poison Sense
Poison Sense.description:
As an action, you can touch a creature and know if it’s currently poisoned.
As an action, you can touch a creature and know if it’s poisonous or venomous.
As an action, you can touch an object and know if it is poisonous or contains poison.
When a poison enters your body, you can identify its exact effects even if it doesn’t affect you.

Divine Charm.name: Divine Charm
Divine Charm.description:
You can innately cast this spell without any components, and you can choose to reduce its casting time from 1 action to 1 bonus action, or from 1 bonus action to 1reaction(which you take at the end of another creature’s turn). Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a short or long rest.

Legendary Adventures © 2020 Mike Myler, published under license by Legendary Games.

Improved Wild Shape.name: Improved Wild Shape
Improved Wild Shape.description:
Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution score by 1, to a maximum of 20.
Natural Connection. The maximum Challenge Rating for forms you Wild Shape into increases by 1, up to a maximum of your Druid level divided by 3 (round down).

Spell Mastery.description: Fifth Edition Feats.Â© 2016 Total Party Kill Games, Brian Berg.

passive_abilities.advantage_performance: when trying to entertain an audience

passive_abilities.charge_attack: when you use your action to Dash, you can make a melee weapon attack or shove

Dual Wielder.description: You master fighting with two weapons

passive_abilities.dual_wield_non_light: can use two-weapon fighting with non-light weapons

Dungeon Delver.description: Alert to the hidden traps and secret doors found in many dungeons

prerequisites: Ability to cast at least one spell
Elemental Adept.description: When you gain this feat, choose one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or thunder

passive_abilities.treat_1_as_2: treat 1s as 2s for chosen damage type

Grappler.description: You've developed the skills necessary to hold your own in close-quarters grappling

passive_abilities.grapple_advantage: advantage on attack rolls against grappled creatures
passive_abilities.grapple_restrain: can use action to restrain grappled creature

Great Weapon Master.description: You've learned to put the weight of a weapon to your advantage

passive_abilities.power_attack: take -5 penalty to attack roll for +10 damage
passive_abilities.bonus_action_attack: bonus action attack on critical hit or kill with heavy weapon

passive_abilities.healer_kit_healing: healer's kit can restore 1d6+4+target's level hit points

Heavily Armored.description: You have trained to master the use of heavy armor

Heavy Armor Master.description: You can use your armor to deflect strikes that would kill others

passive_abilities.damage_reduction: reduce non-magical bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage by 3

Inspiring Leader.description: You can spend 10 minutes inspiring your companions

passive_abilities.inspiring_leader: up to 6 friendly creatures gain temporary hit points equal to your level + your Charisma modifier

Keen Mind.description: You have a mind that can track time, direction, and detail with uncanny precision

passive_abilities.perfect_recall: always know which way is north, number of hours left before next sunset, and can accurately recall anything seen or heard within past month

Lightly Armored.description: You have trained to master the use of light armor

Linguist.description: You have studied languages and codes

Lucky.description: You have inexplicable luck that seems to kick in at just the right moment

passive_abilities.luck_advantage: can spend luck point to roll additional d20

Mage Slayer.description: You have practiced techniques useful in melee combat against spellcasters

passive_abilities.opportunity_attack_caster: opportunity attack when creature casts spell within 5 feet
passive_abilities.disadvantage_concentration: attacks cause disadvantage on concentration saves
passive_abilities.advantage_saves: advantage on saving throws against spells cast within 5 feet

Magic Initiate.description: Choose a class: bard, cleric, druid, sorcerer, warlock, or wizard

Martial Adept.description: You have martial training that allows you to perform special combat maneuvers

Medium Armor Master.description: You have practiced moving in medium armor to gain the following benefits

passive_abilities.medium_armor_dex_bonus: no penalty for wearing medium armor
passive_abilities.medium_armor_stealth: can add up to 3 Dexterity modifier to AC when wearing medium armor

Mobile.description: You are exceptionally speedy and agile

passive_abilities.dash_difficult_terrain: dash doesn't cost extra movement in difficult terrain
passive_abilities.no_opportunity_attack: no opportunity attacks from creatures you attack

Moderately Armored.description: You have trained to master the use of medium armor and shields

passive_abilities.medium_armor_proficiency: proficiency with medium armor and shields

Mounted Combatant.description: You are a dangerous foe to face while mounted

passive_abilities.mount_advantage: advantage on melee attack rolls against unmounted creatures smaller than mount
passive_abilities.mount_protection: force attacks targeting mount to target you instead
passive_abilities.mount_save_advantage: mount has advantage on Dexterity saving throws

Observant.description: Quick to notice details of your environment

passive_abilities.lip_reading: can read lips of creatures you can see

Polearm Master.description: You can keep your enemies at bay with reach weapons

passive_abilities.bonus_action_attack: bonus action attack with opposite end of polearm
passive_abilities.opportunity_attack_enter: opportunity attack when creature enters your reach

passive_abilities.saving_throw_proficiency: proficiency in chosen ability's saving throws

Ritual Caster.description: You have learned a number of spells that you can cast as rituals

passive_abilities.ritual_spellbook: gain a ritual spellbook with 2 1st-level ritual spells
passive_abilities.ritual_casting: can cast rituals from chosen class

Savage Attacker.description: Once per turn when you roll damage for a melee weapon attack

passive_abilities.reroll_damage: once per turn, reroll weapon damage dice and use either result

Sentinel.description: You have mastered techniques to take advantage of every drop in any enemy's guard

passive_abilities.opportunity_attack_ally: opportunity attack when creature attacks ally within 5 feet
passive_abilities.disadvantage_disengage: creatures can't gain advantage on opportunity attacks against you

Sharpshooter.description: You have mastered ranged weapons and can make shots that others find impossible

passive_abilities.power_shot: take -5 penalty to attack roll for +10 damage with ranged weapon

Shield Master.description: You use shields not just for protection but also for offense

passive_abilities.shield_bonus_action: bonus action to shove with shield
passive_abilities.shield_dex_saves: add shield's AC bonus to Dexterity saving throws
passive_abilities.shield_damage_immunity: no damage from Dexterity saving throw if you make the save

Skilled.description: You gain proficiency in any combination of three skills or tools

Skulker.description: You are expert at slinking through shadows

passive_abilities.miss_advantage: when you miss with ranged attack, you can hide as bonus action

prerequisites: Ability to cast at least one spell
Spell Sniper.description: You have learned techniques to enhance your attacks with certain kinds of spells

passive_abilities.spell_range_double: double the range of spells with attack rolls
passive_abilities.spell_ignore_cover: ignore half and three-quarters cover for spells
passive_abilities.spell_cantrip: learn one cantrip that requires an attack roll

Tavern Brawler.description: Accustomed to rough-and-tumble fighting using whatever weapons happen to be at hand

passive_abilities.unarmed_strike: unarmed strike uses d4 and is considered a weapon
passive_abilities.grapple_bonus_action: bonus action to grapple after unarmed strike

Tough.description: Your hit point maximum increases by an amount equal to twice your level

prerequisites: Ability to cast at least one spell
War Caster.description: You have practiced casting spells in the midst of combat

passive_abilities.advantage_concentration: advantage on Constitution saving throws for concentration
passive_abilities.spell_opportunity_attack: can cast spell as opportunity attack
passive_abilities.spell_components: can perform somatic components while holding weapons/shields

Weapon Master.description: You have practiced extensively with a variety of weapons

Fey Touched.description: Your exposure to the Feywild's magic has changed you

passive_abilities.spell_casting: can cast each spell once per long rest

Shadow Touched.description: Your exposure to the Shadowfell's magic has changed you

passive_abilities.spell_casting: can cast each spell once per long rest

Crusher.description: You are practiced in the art of crushing your enemies

passive_abilities.critical_hit_push: when you score a critical hit with a bludgeoning weapon, push target 5 feet
passive_abilities.bludgeoning_advantage: once per turn, when you hit with bludgeoning damage, next attack against target has advantage

Piercer.description: You are practiced in the art of piercing your enemies

passive_abilities.critical_hit_reroll: when you score a critical hit with a piercing weapon, roll one additional damage die
passive_abilities.piercing_reroll: once per turn, when you hit with piercing damage, reroll one damage die

Slasher.description: You are practiced in the art of slashing your enemies

passive_abilities.critical_hit_slow: when you score a critical hit with a slashing weapon, target's speed is reduced by 10 feet
passive_abilities.slashing_disadvantage: once per turn, when you hit with slashing damage, target has disadvantage on next attack

Telekinetic.description: You learn to move things with your mind

passive_abilities.extended_range: mage hand range increased by 30 feet
passive_abilities.telekinetic_shove: bonus action to shove creature within 30 feet

Telepathic.description: You awaken the ability to connect your mind to the minds of others

passive_abilities.telepathic_speech: can communicate telepathically with any creature within 60 feet
passive_abilities.spell_casting: can cast detect thoughts once per long rest

Gunner.description: You have a quick hand and keen eye when employing firearms

passive_abilities.close_quarters: no disadvantage on ranged attacks within 5 feet

Skill Expert.description: You have honed your proficiency with particular skills

Chef.description: You have mastered the art of cooking

passive_abilities.special_dish: can create special dishes that provide temporary hit points
passive_abilities.healing_feast: can create a feast that provides healing

Eldritch Adept.description: You have made your mark on the cosmic forces of the multiverse

Metamagic Adept.description: You have learned how to exert your will on your spells

Fighting Initiate.description: Your martial training has helped you develop a particular style of fighting

Acid Splash.description: You hurl a bubble of acid. Choose one creature within range, or choose two creatures within range that are within 5 feet of each other.

Blade Ward.description: You extend your hand and trace a sigil of warding in the air. Until the end of your next turn, you have resistance against bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage dealt by weapon attacks.

Booming Blade.description: You brandish the weapon used in the spell's casting and make a melee attack with it against one creature within 5 feet of you.

Chill Touch.description: You create a ghostly, skeletal hand in the space of a creature within range.

Control Flames.description: You choose nonmagical flame that you can see within range and that fits within a 5-foot cube.

Create Bonfire.description: A bonfire appears at a point you choose within range.

Dancing Lights.description: You create up to four torch-sized lights within range.

Druidcraft.description: Whispering to the spirits of nature, you create one of the following effects within range.

Eldritch Blast.description: A beam of crackling energy streaks toward a creature within range.

Fire Bolt.description: You hurl a mote of fire at a creature or object within range.

Friends.description: For the duration, you have advantage on all Charisma checks directed at one creature of your choice that isn't hostile toward you.

Frostbite.description: You cause numbing frost to form on one creature that you can see within range.

Green-Flame Blade.description: You brandish the weapon used in the spell's casting and make a melee attack with it against one creature within 5 feet of you.

Guidance.description: You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one ability check of its choice.

Gust.description: You seize the air and compel it to create one of the following effects at a point you can see within range.

Light.description: You touch one object that is no larger than 10 feet in any dimension.

Mage Hand.description: A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range.

Magic Stone.description: You touch one to three pebbles and imbue them with magic.

Mending.description: This spell repairs a single break or tear in an object you touch.

Message.description: You point your finger toward a creature within range and whisper a message.

Minor Illusion.description: You create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration.

Mold Earth.description: You choose a portion of dirt or stone that you can see within range and that fits within a 5-foot cube.

Poison Spray.description: You extend your hand toward a creature you can see within range and project a puff of noxious gas from your palm.

Prestidigitation.description: This spell is a minor magical trick that novice spellcasters use for practice.

Produce Flame.description: A flickering flame appears in your hand.

Ray of Frost.description: A frigid beam of blue-white light streaks toward a creature within range.

Sacred Flame.description: Flame-like radiance descends on a creature that you can see within range.

Shape Water.description: You choose an area of water that you can see within range and that fits within a 5-foot cube.

Shillelagh.description: The wood of a club or quarterstaff you are holding is imbued with nature's power.

Shocking Grasp.description: Lightning springs from your hand to deliver a shock to a creature you try to touch.

Spare the Dying.description: You touch a living creature that has 0 hit points.

Sword Burst.description: You create a momentary circle of spectral blades that sweep around you.

Thaumaturgy.description: You manifest a minor wonder, a sign of supernatural power, within range.

Thorn Whip.description: You create a long, vine-like whip covered in thorns that lashes out at your command toward a creature in range.

Thunderclap.description: You create a burst of thunderous sound that can be heard up to 100 feet away.

Toll the Dead.description: You point at one creature you can see within range, and the sound of a dolorous bell fills the air around it for a moment.

True Strike.description: You extend your hand and point a finger at a target in range.

Vicious Mockery.description: You unleash a string of insults laced with subtle enchantments at a creature you can see within range.

Absorb Elements.description: The spell captures some of the incoming energy, lessening its effect on you and storing it for your next melee attack.

Alarm.description: You set an alarm against unwanted intrusion.

Animal Friendship.description: This spell lets you convince a beast that you mean it no harm.

Armor of Agathys.description: A protective magical force surrounds you, manifesting as a spectral frost that covers you and your gear.

Bane.description: Up to three creatures of your choice that you can see within range must make Charisma saving throws.

Beast Bond.description: You establish a telepathic link with one beast you touch that is friendly to you or charmed by you.

Bless.description: You bless up to three creatures of your choice within range.

Burning Hands.description: As you hold your hands with thumbs touching and fingers spread, a thin sheet of flames shoots forth from your outstretched fingertips.

Charm Person.description: You attempt to charm a humanoid you can see within range.

Command.description: You speak a one-word command to a creature you can see within range.

Compelled Duel.description: You attempt to compel a creature into a duel.

Comprehend Languages.description: For the duration, you understand the literal meaning of any spoken language that you hear.

Create or Destroy Water.description: You either create or destroy water.

Cure Wounds.description: A creature you touch regains a number of hit points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier.

Detect Evil and Good.description: For the duration, you know if there is an aberration, celestial, elemental, fey, fiend, or undead within 30 feet of you.

Detect Magic.description: For the duration, you sense the presence of magic within 30 feet of you.

Detect Poison and Disease.description: For the duration, you can sense the presence and location of poisons, poisonous creatures, and diseases within 30 feet of you.

Disguise Self.description: You make yourself—including your clothing, armor, weapons, and other belongings on your person—appear different until the spell ends or until you use your action to dismiss it.

Divine Favor.description: Your prayer empowers you with divine radiance.

Ensnaring Strike.description: The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before this spell ends, a writhing mass of thorny vines appears at the point of impact.

Entangle.description: Grasping weeds and vines sprout from the ground in a 20-foot radius centered on a point within range.

Expeditious Retreat.description: This spell allows you to move at an incredible pace.

Faerie Fire.description: Each object in a 20-foot cube within range is outlined in blue, green, or violet light (your choice).

False Life.description: Bolstering yourself with a necromantic facsimile of life, you gain 1d4 + 4 temporary hit points for the duration.

Feather Fall.description: Choose up to five falling creatures within range.

Find Familiar.description: You gain the service of a familiar, a spirit that takes an animal form you choose.

Fog Cloud.description: You create a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog centered on a point within range.

Goodberry.description: Up to ten berries appear in your hand and are infused with magic for the duration.

Grease.description: Slick grease covers the ground in a 10-foot square centered on a point within range and turns it into difficult terrain for the duration.

Guiding Bolt.description: A flash of light streaks toward a creature of your choice within range.

Hail of Thorns.description: The next time you hit a creature with a ranged weapon attack before the spell ends, this spell creates a rain of thorns that sprouts from your ranged weapon or ammunition.

Healing Word.description: A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier.

Hellish Rebuke.description: You point your finger, and the creature that damaged you is momentarily surrounded by hellish flames.

Heroism.description: A willing creature you touch is imbued with bravery.

Hex.description: You place a curse on a creature that you can see within range.

Hunter's Mark.description: You choose a creature you can see within range and mystically mark it as your quarry.

Identify.description: You choose one object that you must touch throughout the casting of the spell.

Illusory Script.description: You write on parchment, paper, or some other suitable writing material and imbue it with a potent illusion that lasts for the duration.

Inflict Wounds.description: Make a melee spell attack against a creature you can reach.

Jump.description: You touch a creature. The creature's jump distance is tripled until the spell ends.

Longstrider.description: You touch a creature. The target's speed increases by 10 feet until the spell ends.

Magic Missile.description: You create three glowing darts of magical force.

Protection from Evil and Good.description: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is protected against certain types of creatures.

Purify Food and Drink.description: All nonmagical food and drink within a 5-foot-radius sphere centered on a point of your choice within range is purified and rendered free of poison and disease.

Ray of Sickness.description: A ray of sickening greenish energy lashes out toward a creature within range.

Sanctuary.description: You ward a creature within range against attack.

Searing Smite.description: The next time you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack during this spell's duration, your weapon flares with white-hot intensity.

Shield.description: An invisible barrier of magical force appears and protects you.

Shield of Faith.description: A shimmering field appears and surrounds a creature of your choice within range, granting it a +2 bonus to AC for the duration.

Silent Image.description: You create the image of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon that is no larger than a 15-foot cube.

Sleep.description: This spell sends creatures into a magical slumber.

Snare.description: As you cast this spell, you use rope to create a circle with a 5-foot radius on the ground or the floor.

Speak with Animals.description: You gain the ability to comprehend and verbally communicate with beasts for the duration.

Tasha's Hideous Laughter.description: A creature of your choice that you can see within range perceives everything as hilariously funny and falls into fits of laughter if this spell affects it.

Tenser's Floating Disk.description: This spell creates a circular, horizontal plane of force, 3 feet in diameter and 1 inch thick, that floats 3 feet above the ground in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range.

Thunderous Smite.description: The first time you hit with a melee weapon attack during this spell's duration, your weapon rings with thunder that is audible within 300 feet of you.

Thunderwave.description: A wave of thunderous force sweeps out from you.

Unseen Servant.description: This spell creates an invisible, mindless, shapeless force that performs simple tasks at your command until the spell ends.

Witch Bolt.description: A beam of crackling, blue energy lances out toward a creature within range.

Wrathful Smite.description: The next time you hit with a melee weapon attack during this spell's duration, your attack deals an extra 1d6 psychic damage.

Misty Step.description: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see.

Counterspell.description: You attempt to interrupt a creature in the process of casting a spell.

Fireball.description: A bright streak flashes from your pointing finger to a point you choose within range and then blossoms with a low roar into an explosion of flame.

Lightning Bolt.description: A stroke of lightning forming a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide blasts out from you in a direction you choose.

Haste.description: Choose a willing creature that you can see within range. Until the spell ends, the target's speed is doubled, it gains a +2 bonus to AC, it has advantage on Dexterity saving throws, and it gains an additional action on each of its turns.

Slow.description: You alter time around up to six creatures of your choice in a 40-foot cube within range.

Fly.description: You touch a willing creature. The target gains a flying speed of 60 feet for the duration.

Invisibility.description: A creature you touch becomes invisible until the spell ends.

Polymorph.description: This spell transforms a creature that you can see within range into a new form.

Teleport.description: This spell instantly transports you and up to eight willing creatures of your choice that you can see within range, or a single object that you can see within range, to a destination you select.

Wish.description: Wish is the mightiest spell a mortal creature can cast. By simply speaking aloud, you can alter the very foundations of reality in accord with your desires.

Meteor Swarm.description: Blazing orbs of fire plummet to the ground at four different points you can see within range.

Power Word Kill.description: You utter a word of power that can compel one creature you can see within range to die instantly.

Time Stop.description: You briefly stop the flow of time for everyone but yourself.

Mass Heal.description: A flood of healing energy flows from you into injured creatures around you.

True Resurrection.description: You touch a creature that has been dead for no longer than 200 years and that didn't die of old age.

Gate.description: You conjure a portal linking an unoccupied space you can see within range to a precise location on a different plane of existence.

Astral Projection.description: You and up to eight willing creatures within range project your astral bodies into the Astral Plane.

Imprisonment.description: You create a magical restraint to hold a creature.

Weird.description: Drawing on the deepest fears of a group of creatures, you create illusory creatures in their minds, visible only to them.

Prismatic Wall.description: A shimmering, multicolored plane of light forms a vertical opaque wall—up to 90 feet long, 30 feet high, and 1 inch thick—centered on a point you can see within range.

Storm of Vengeance.description: A churning storm cloud forms, centered on a point you can see and spreading to a radius of 360 feet.

Foresight.description: You touch a willing creature and bestow a limited ability to see into the immediate future.

Invulnerability.description: You are immune to all damage until the spell ends.

Mass Polymorph.description: You transform up to ten creatures of your choice that you can see within range.

Power Word Heal.description: A wave of healing energy flows through you. Choose any number of creatures within 30 feet of you, and divide 700 hit points among them.

Psychic Scream.description: You unleash the power of your mind to blast the intellect of up to ten creatures of your choice that you can see within range.

Ravenous Void.description: A 20-foot-radius sphere of crushing force forms at a point you can see within range.

Shapechange.description: You assume the form of a different creature for the duration.

True Polymorph.description: Choose one creature or nonmagical object that you can see within range.

Mastiff.description: War dog, can be ridden by small creatures

Keelboat.description: River boat with sail and oars

Balloon.description: Hot air balloon for aerial travel

Dragon Turtle Ship.description: Ship built on dragon turtle shell

Phoenix Mount.description: Magical phoenix that can be ridden

Griffon.description: Flying mount with eagle head and lion body
